`````kotlin
package com.oclock.liquidglass

import android.Manifest
import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Matrix
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.RadialGradient
import android.graphics.Shader
import android.graphics.SurfaceTexture
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.hardware.camera2.CameraCaptureSession
import android.hardware.camera2.CameraCharacteristics
import android.hardware.camera2.CameraDevice
import android.hardware.camera2.CameraManager
import android.hardware.camera2.CaptureRequest
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.HandlerThread
import android.os.Looper
import android.util.Size
import android.util.TypedValue
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.Surface
import android.view.TextureView
import android.view.View
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

class CameraOverlayView(
    context: Context,
    private val onRequestPermission: () -> Unit,
    private val onShutterFired: () -> Unit,
    private val onClosed: () -> Unit
) : FrameLayout(context) {

    private val dens = resources.displayMetrics.density
    private val mainHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var camThread: HandlerThread? = null
    private var camHandler: Handler? = null

    private val textureView: TextureView
    private val irisView: View
    private val shutterFlash: View
    private val msgText: TextView
    private val shutterBtn: FrameLayout
    private val closeBtn: TextView

    private var cameraDevice: CameraDevice? = null
    private var captureSession: CameraCaptureSession? = null
    private var previewSize: Size = Size(1280, 720)
    private var autoShootPending = false
    private var autoShootRunnable = Runnable { shoot() }
    var isOpen = false
        private set

    init {
        visibility = GONE
        setBackgroundColor(Color.BLACK)
        isClickable = true
        isFocusable = true

        textureView = TextureView(context).apply {
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
            surfaceTextureListener = object : TextureView.SurfaceTextureListener {
                override fun onSurfaceTextureAvailable(st: SurfaceTexture, w: Int, h: Int) {
                    if (isOpen) openCameraHardware()
                }
                override fun onSurfaceTextureSizeChanged(st: SurfaceTexture, w: Int, h: Int) {
                    configureTransform(w, h)
                }
                override fun onSurfaceTextureDestroyed(st: SurfaceTexture): Boolean = true
                override fun onSurfaceTextureUpdated(st: SurfaceTexture) {}
            }
        }
        addView(textureView)

        // Radial iris vignette matching #cam-iris
        irisView = object : View(context) {
            private val p = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
            override fun onDraw(canvas: android.graphics.Canvas) {
                val r = max(width, height) * 0.65f
                if (r <= 1f) return
                p.shader = RadialGradient(
                    width * 0.5f, height * 0.5f, r,
                    intArrayOf(0, 0, Color.argb(108, 0, 0, 0)),
                    floatArrayOf(0f, 0.58f, 1f),
                    Shader.TileMode.CLAMP
                )
                canvas.drawRect(0f, 0f, width.toFloat(), height.toFloat(), p)
            }
        }.apply {
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
        }
        addView(irisView)

        msgText = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "لا يتوفر إذن الكاميرا في هذا الجهاز"
            setTextColor(Color.argb(210, 255, 255, 255))
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 14f)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            visibility = GONE
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, Gravity.CENTER)
        }
        addView(msgText)

        closeBtn = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "✕"
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 18f)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            val s = (40f * dens).roundToInt()
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(s, s, Gravity.TOP or Gravity.END).apply {
                topMargin = (44f * dens).roundToInt()
                marginEnd = (18f * dens).roundToInt()
            }
            background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL
                setColor(Color.argb(110, 0, 0, 0))
            }
            setOnClickListener { close() }
        }
        addView(closeBtn)

        shutterBtn = FrameLayout(context).apply {
            val outer = (74f * dens).roundToInt()
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(outer, outer, Gravity.BOTTOM or Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL).apply {
                bottomMargin = (44f * dens).roundToInt()
            }
            background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL
                setColor(Color.TRANSPARENT)
                setStroke((3.2f * dens).roundToInt(), Color.WHITE)
            }
            val inner = View(context).apply {
                val ins = (58f * dens).roundToInt()
                layoutParams = LayoutParams(ins, ins, Gravity.CENTER)
                background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                    shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL
                    setColor(Color.WHITE)
                }
            }
            addView(inner)
            setOnClickListener { shoot() }
        }
        addView(shutterBtn)

        shutterFlash = View(context).apply {
            setBackgroundColor(Color.WHITE)
            alpha = 0f
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
        }
        addView(shutterFlash)
    }

    fun open(autoShoot: Boolean = false) {
        isOpen = true
        autoShootPending = autoShoot
        visibility = VISIBLE
        alpha = 0f
        animate().alpha(1f).setDuration(260L).start()
        msgText.visibility = GONE
        shutterBtn.isEnabled = false
        shutterBtn.alpha = 0.55f

        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.CAMERA) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            msgText.text = "يلزم السماح بإذن الكاميرا"
            msgText.visibility = VISIBLE
            onRequestPermission()
            return
        }
        if (textureView.isAvailable) openCameraHardware()
    }

    fun onPermissionResult(granted: Boolean) {
        if (!isOpen) return
        if (granted) {
            msgText.visibility = GONE
            if (textureView.isAvailable) openCameraHardware()
        } else {
            msgText.text = "لم يتم منح إذن الكاميرا"
            msgText.visibility = VISIBLE
        }
    }

    private fun startThread() {
        if (camThread == null) {
            camThread = HandlerThread("OClockCam").apply { start() }
            camHandler = Handler(camThread!!.looper)
        }
    }

    private fun stopThread() {
        camThread?.quitSafely()
        camThread = null
        camHandler = null
    }

    private fun openCameraHardware() {
        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.CAMERA) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) return
        startThread()
        val mgr = context.getSystemService(Context.CAMERA_SERVICE) as? CameraManager ?: return
        try {
            val camId = mgr.cameraIdList.firstOrNull { id ->
                mgr.getCameraCharacteristics(id).get(CameraCharacteristics.LENS_FACING) == CameraCharacteristics.LENS_FACING_BACK
            } ?: mgr.cameraIdList.firstOrNull() ?: return

            val chars = mgr.getCameraCharacteristics(camId)
            val map = chars.get(CameraCharacteristics.SCALER_STREAM_CONFIGURATION_MAP)
            val choices = map?.getOutputSizes(SurfaceTexture::class.java)
            if (!choices.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                previewSize = choices.minByOrNull { kotlin.math.abs(it.width * 9 - it.height * 16) + kotlin.math.abs(it.height - 1080) }
                    ?: choices[0]
            }

            mgr.openCamera(camId, object : CameraDevice.StateCallback() {
                override fun onOpened(cam: CameraDevice) {
                    if (!isOpen) { cam.close(); return }
                    cameraDevice = cam
                    startPreviewSession()
                }
                override fun onDisconnected(cam: CameraDevice) {
                    cam.close()
                    cameraDevice = null
                }
                override fun onError(cam: CameraDevice, error: Int) {
                    cam.close()
                    cameraDevice = null
                    mainHandler.post {
                        msgText.text = "تعذر تشغيل الكاميرا"
                        msgText.visibility = VISIBLE
                    }
                }
            }, camHandler)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            msgText.text = "الكاميرا غير متوفرة"
            msgText.visibility = VISIBLE
        }
    }

    private fun startPreviewSession() {
        val cam = cameraDevice ?: return
        val st = textureView.surfaceTexture ?: return
        st.setDefaultBufferSize(previewSize.width, previewSize.height)
        val surface = Surface(st)
        mainHandler.post { configureTransform(textureView.width, textureView.height) }

        try {
            val req = cam.createCaptureRequest(CameraDevice.TEMPLATE_PREVIEW).apply {
                addTarget(surface)
                set(CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AF_MODE, CaptureRequest.CONTROL_AF_MODE_CONTINUOUS_PICTURE)
            }
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            cam.createCaptureSession(listOf(surface), object : CameraCaptureSession.StateCallback() {
                override fun onConfigured(session: CameraCaptureSession) {
                    if (!isOpen) { session.close(); return }
                    captureSession = session
                    try {
                        session.setRepeatingRequest(req.build(), null, camHandler)
                        mainHandler.post {
                            shutterBtn.isEnabled = true
                            shutterBtn.alpha = 1f
                            if (autoShootPending) {
                                autoShootPending = false
                                mainHandler.postDelayed(autoShootRunnable, 520L)
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (_: Throwable) {}
                }
                override fun onConfigureFailed(session: CameraCaptureSession) {}
            }, camHandler)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}
    }

    private fun configureTransform(vw: Int, vh: Int) {
        if (vw <= 0 || vh <= 0) return
        val m = Matrix()
        val bw = previewSize.height.toFloat() // Portrait sensor orientation swap
        val bh = previewSize.width.toFloat()
        val scale = max(vw / bw, vh / bh)
        m.setScale((bw * scale) / vw, (bh * scale) / vh, vw * 0.5f, vh * 0.5f)
        textureView.setTransform(m)
    }

    private fun shoot() {
        if (!isOpen || !shutterBtn.isEnabled) return
        shutterFlash.animate().cancel()
        shutterFlash.alpha = 1f
        shutterFlash.animate().alpha(0f).setDuration(460L).start()
        irisView.alpha = 0f
        irisView.animate().alpha(1f).setDuration(450L).start()
        onShutterFired()
    }

    fun close() {
        if (!isOpen) return
        isOpen = false
        mainHandler.removeCallbacks(autoShootRunnable)
        captureSession?.close(); captureSession = null
        cameraDevice?.close(); cameraDevice = null
        stopThread()
        animate().alpha(0f).setDuration(200L).withEndAction {
            visibility = GONE
            onClosed()
        }.start()
    }
}
`````

`````kotlin
package com.oclock.liquidglass

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.BitmapShader
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.RectF
import android.graphics.Shader
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.os.Build
import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import kotlin.math.ceil
import kotlin.math.floor
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.round
import kotlin.math.roundToInt
import kotlin.math.sqrt

data class NumeralMetrics(val capRatio: Float, val refMidRel: Float)

data class StretchedGlyph(
    val alphaBmp: Bitmap,
    val w: Int,
    val h: Int,
    val xCenterOffset: Float,
    val yCenterRel: Float
)

data class ColonDots(
    val topBmp: Bitmap?,
    val botBmp: Bitmap?,
    val topW: Int,
    val topH: Int,
    val botW: Int,
    val botH: Int,
    val natSep: Float
)

data class ClockArtifact(
    val alphaBmp: Bitmap,
    val fieldBmp: Bitmap,
    val alphaShader: BitmapShader?,
    val fieldShader: BitmapShader?,
    val maxAbsCss: Float,
    val wDp: Float,
    val hDp: Float,
    val wPx: Int,
    val hPx: Int,
    val ss: Float,
    val sizeDp: Float,
    val textWDp: Float,
    val textHDp: Float,
    val lineHDp: Float,
    val padDp: Float,
    val inkLeftDp: Float,
    val inkTopDp: Float,
    val inkRightDp: Float,
    val inkBottomDp: Float,
    val sx: Float,
    val sy: Float,
    val minuteKey: String,
    val maskKey: String
) {
    val byteSize: Long get() = alphaBmp.allocationByteCount.toLong() + fieldBmp.allocationByteCount.toLong()
}

class ClockGlyphRenderer(private val context: Context) {
    private val typefaceCache = HashMap<String, Typeface>(4)
    private val metricsCache = HashMap<String, NumeralMetrics>(4)
    private val glyphCache = object : LinkedHashMap<String, StretchedGlyph>(28, 0.75f, true) {
        override fun removeEldestEntry(eldest: MutableMap.MutableEntry<String, StretchedGlyph>?): Boolean {
            return size > 24
        }
    }
    private val colonCache = object : LinkedHashMap<String, ColonDots>(8, 0.75f, true) {
        override fun removeEldestEntry(eldest: MutableMap.MutableEntry<String, ColonDots>?): Boolean {
            return size > 8
        }
    }
    private val artifactCache = object : LinkedHashMap<String, ClockArtifact>(4, 0.75f, true) {
        override fun removeEldestEntry(eldest: MutableMap.MutableEntry<String, ClockArtifact>?): Boolean {
            return size > 3
        }
    }

    fun getCacheBytes(): Long = synchronized(artifactCache) {
        artifactCache.values.sumOf { it.byteSize }
    }

    fun clearTransientGlyphs() {
        synchronized(glyphCache) { glyphCache.clear() }
        synchronized(colonCache) { colonCache.clear() }
    }

    private fun getTypeface(fontId: String): Typeface {
        return typefaceCache.getOrPut(fontId) {
            val f = ClockFont.fromId(fontId)
            if (f.assetPath != null) {
                try {
                    Typeface.createFromAsset(context.assets, f.assetPath)
                } catch (_: Throwable) {
                    Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
                }
            } else {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 28) {
                    Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, 600, false)
                } else {
                    Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.BOLD)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun measureNumeralMetrics(fontId: String): NumeralMetrics {
        synchronized(metricsCache) {
            metricsCache[fontId]?.let { return it }
            val tf = getTypeface(fontId)
            val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(160, 160, Bitmap.Config.ALPHA_8)
            val c = Canvas(bmp)
            val p = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
                typeface = tf
                textSize = 100f
                textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
                color = Color.WHITE
            }
            val buf = ByteArray(160 * 160)
            var yMin = 160
            var yMax = -1
            for (sample in arrayOf("0", "8", "6")) {
                bmp.eraseColor(Color.TRANSPARENT)
                c.drawText(sample, 80f, 80f, p)
                ByteBuffer.wrap(buf).also {
                    it.rewind()
                    bmp.copyPixelsToBuffer(it)
                }
                for (y in 0 until 160) {
                    val row = y * 160
                    for (x in 0 until 160) {
                        if ((buf[row + x].toInt() and 0xFF) > 10) {
                            if (y < yMin) yMin = y
                            if (y > yMax) yMax = y
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            bmp.recycle()
            val capRatio = if (yMax >= yMin) ((yMax - yMin + 1) / 100f).coerceIn(0.55f, 0.92f) else 0.74f
            // Baseline offset relative to 100px so optical numeral center lands at 80f
            val refMidRel = if (yMax >= yMin) (((yMin + yMax + 1) * 0.5f) - 80f) / 100f else 0f
            return NumeralMetrics(capRatio, refMidRel).also { metricsCache[fontId] = it }
        }
    }

    private fun stretchDigitBitmap(
        ch: Char,
        fontPx: Float,
        fontId: String,
        sx: Float,
        sy: Float,
        ss: Float,
        refMidRel: Float
    ): StretchedGlyph? {
        val key = "$ch|${"%.1f".format(fontPx)}|${"%.3f".format(sx)}|${"%.3f".format(sy)}|${"%.2f".format(ss)}|$fontId"
        synchronized(glyphCache) {
            glyphCache[key]?.let { return it }
        }

        val vSub = max(2, ceil(sy * 1.6f).toInt().coerceAtMost(4))
        val srcPx = fontPx * ss
        val sw = ceil(srcPx * sx * 1.25f).toInt() + 16
        val sh = ceil(srcPx * vSub * 1.55f).toInt() + 16
        val src = Bitmap.createBitmap(sw, sh, Bitmap.Config.ALPHA_8)
        val sc = Canvas(src)
        sc.save()
        sc.scale(sx, vSub.toFloat())
        val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            typeface = getTypeface(fontId)
            textSize = srcPx
            textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
            color = Color.WHITE
        }
        val baseY = (sh / (2f * vSub)) - refMidRel * srcPx
        sc.drawText(ch.toString(), sw / (2f * sx), baseY, paint)
        sc.restore()

        val sData = ByteArray(sw * sh)
        ByteBuffer.wrap(sData).also {
            it.rewind()
            src.copyPixelsToBuffer(it)
        }
        src.recycle()

        var xMin = sw
        var xMax = -1
        var yMin = sh
        var yMax = -1
        for (y in 0 until sh) {
            val row = y * sw
            for (x in 0 until sw) {
                if ((sData[row + x].toInt() and 0xFF) > 10) {
                    if (x < xMin) xMin = x
                    if (x > xMax) xMax = x
                    if (y < yMin) yMin = y
                    if (y > yMax) yMax = y
                }
            }
        }
        if (xMax < xMin || yMax < yMin) return null

        val w = xMax - xMin + 1
        val g = yMax - yMin + 1
        val g0 = g.toFloat() / vSub
        val targetG = max(4, (g0 * sy).roundToInt())

        // Measure max continuous horizontal run per row (two vertical walls stay ~0.33, true horizontal bars reach ~0.60..0.96)
        val run = FloatArray(g)
        for (r in 0 until g) {
            val row = (yMin + r) * sw
            var cur = 0f
            var best = 0f
            for (x in xMin..xMax) {
                val a = (sData[row + x].toInt() and 0xFF) / 255f
                if (a >= 0.45f) {
                    cur += a
                    if (cur > best) best = cur
                } else {
                    cur = 0f
                }
            }
            run[r] = best / w
        }

        val bodyStart = floor(0.16f * g).toInt()
        val bodyEnd = max(bodyStart + 1, ceil(0.84f * g).toInt()).coerceAtMost(g)
        val bodyRun = FloatArray(bodyEnd - bodyStart) { run[bodyStart + it] }
        bodyRun.sort()
        val stemRun = if (bodyRun.isNotEmpty()) bodyRun[(bodyRun.size * 0.25f).toInt().coerceIn(0, bodyRun.lastIndex)] else 0.32f
        val barThresh = (stemRun * 1.48f).coerceIn(0.48f, 0.74f)

        var bar = FloatArray(g) { r ->
            val inValidBand = r < (0.16f * g) || r > (0.84f * g) || (r >= (0.32f * g) && r <= (0.82f * g))
            if (inValidBand && run[r] >= barThresh) 1f else 0f
        }

        val topEnd = floor(0.15f * g).toInt().coerceAtMost(g - 1)
        var lastTop = -1
        for (r in 0..topEnd) if (bar[r] > 0.5f) lastTop = r
        if (lastTop >= 0) for (r in 0..lastTop) bar[r] = 1f

        val botStart = floor(0.85f * g).toInt().coerceAtLeast(0)
        var firstBot = -1
        for (r in botStart until g) {
            if (bar[r] > 0.5f) {
                firstBot = r
                break
            }
        }
        if (firstBot >= 0) for (r in firstBot until g) bar[r] = 1f

        // Bridge small inner curve dips inside a horizontal bar (e.g. middle waist of '3') so bar never oscillates 1->0->1
        val gapMax = max(2, (0.075f * g).roundToInt())
        var ri = 0
        while (ri < g) {
            if (bar[ri] < 0.5f && ri > 0 && bar[ri - 1] > 0.5f) {
                var j = ri
                while (j < g && bar[j] < 0.5f && (j - ri) <= gapMax) j++
                if (j < g && bar[j] > 0.5f) {
                    for (k in ri until j) bar[k] = 1f
                }
                ri = j
            } else {
                ri++
            }
        }

        val rad = max(3, (0.060f * g).roundToInt())
        repeat(4) {
            val next = FloatArray(g)
            for (r in 0 until g) {
                var s = 0f
                var c = 0
                val a = max(0, r - rad)
                val b = min(g - 1, r + rad)
                for (k in a..b) {
                    s += bar[k]
                    c++
                }
                next[r] = s / c
            }
            bar = next
        }

        val maxBar = if (sy > 1.35f) 0.86f else 1.0f
        for (r in 0 until g) bar[r] *= maxBar

        var barMass = 0f
        var stemMass = 0f
        for (r in 0 until g) {
            barMass += bar[r] / vSub
            stemMass += (1f - bar[r]) / vSub
        }

        val localScale = FloatArray(g)
        if (sy >= 1.0f && stemMass > 0.14f * g0) {
            val stemStretch = max(1.0f, (targetG - barMass) / stemMass)
            for (r in 0 until g) {
                localScale[r] = bar[r] + (1f - bar[r]) * stemStretch
            }
        } else {
            for (r in 0 until g) localScale[r] = sy
        }

        val cum = DoubleArray(g + 1)
        for (r in 0 until g) cum[r + 1] = cum[r] + localScale[r] / vSub
        val norm = targetG / max(1e-6, cum[g])
        for (r in 1..g) cum[r] *= norm

        val padOut = 1
        val outW = w + padOut * 2
        val outH = targetG + padOut * 2
        val outBytes = ByteArray(outW * outH)
        var rCur = 0
        for (dy in 0 until targetG) {
            val target = dy + 0.5
            while (rCur < g - 1 && cum[rCur + 1] < target) rCur++
            val span = max(1e-6, cum[rCur + 1] - cum[rCur])
            val frac = rCur + (target - cum[rCur]) / span - 0.5
            val syClamped = frac.coerceIn(0.0, (g - 1).toDouble()).toFloat()
            val f0 = floor(syClamped).toInt()
            val fy = syClamped - f0
            val w0 = 1f - fy
            val y0 = yMin + f0
            val y1 = min(yMax, y0 + 1)
            val rowOut = (dy + padOut) * outW + padOut
            val row0 = y0 * sw
            val row1 = y1 * sw
            for (x in 0 until w) {
                val a0 = sData[row0 + xMin + x].toInt() and 0xFF
                val a1 = sData[row1 + xMin + x].toInt() and 0xFF
                outBytes[rowOut + x] = (a0 * w0 + a1 * fy).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255).toByte()
            }
        }

        val outBmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(outW, outH, Bitmap.Config.ALPHA_8)
        outBmp.copyPixelsFromBuffer(ByteBuffer.wrap(outBytes))

        val refMidYSrc = sh * 0.5f
        val digitCenterYSrc = (yMin + yMax + 1) * 0.5f
        val res = StretchedGlyph(
            alphaBmp = outBmp,
            w = outW,
            h = outH,
            xCenterOffset = ((xMin + xMax + 1) * 0.5f) - sw * 0.5f,
            yCenterRel = ((digitCenterYSrc - refMidYSrc) / vSub) * sy
        )
        synchronized(glyphCache) { glyphCache[key] = res }
        return res
    }

    private fun getColonDots(fontPx: Float, fontId: String, ss: Float, refMidRel: Float): ColonDots {
        val key = "colon|${"%.1f".format(fontPx)}|${"%.2f".format(ss)}|$fontId"
        synchronized(colonCache) {
            colonCache[key]?.let { return it }
        }
        val srcPx = fontPx * ss
        val sw = ceil(srcPx * 0.8f).toInt() + 16
        val sh = ceil(srcPx * 1.35f).toInt() + 16
        val src = Bitmap.createBitmap(sw, sh, Bitmap.Config.ALPHA_8)
        val sc = Canvas(src)
        val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            typeface = getTypeface(fontId)
            textSize = srcPx
            textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
            color = Color.WHITE
        }
        sc.drawText(":", sw * 0.5f, sh * 0.5f - refMidRel * srcPx, paint)

        val sData = ByteArray(sw * sh)
        ByteBuffer.wrap(sData).also {
            it.rewind()
            src.copyPixelsToBuffer(it)
        }
        src.recycle()

        val mid = sh / 2
        fun crop(yA: Int, yB: Int): Triple<Bitmap, Int, Float>? {
            var x0 = sw
            var x1 = -1
            var y0 = sh
            var y1 = -1
            for (y in yA until yB) {
                val row = y * sw
                for (x in 0 until sw) {
                    if ((sData[row + x].toInt() and 0xFF) > 10) {
                        if (x < x0) x0 = x
                        if (x > x1) x1 = x
                        if (y < y0) y0 = y
                        if (y > y1) y1 = y
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x1 < x0 || y1 < y0) return null
            val cw = x1 - x0 + 1
            val ch = y1 - y0 + 1
            val bytes = ByteArray(cw * ch)
            for (r in 0 until ch) {
                System.arraycopy(sData, (y0 + r) * sw + x0, bytes, r * cw, cw)
            }
            val b = Bitmap.createBitmap(cw, ch, Bitmap.Config.ALPHA_8)
            b.copyPixelsFromBuffer(ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes))
            return Triple(b, cw, (y0 + y1 + 1) * 0.5f)
        }

        val top = crop(0, mid)
        val bot = crop(mid, sh)
        val natSep = if (top != null && bot != null) (bot.third - top.third) * 0.5f else srcPx * 0.14f
        val res = ColonDots(
            topBmp = top?.first,
            botBmp = bot?.first,
            topW = top?.second ?: 0,
            topH = top?.first?.height ?: 0,
            botW = bot?.second ?: 0,
            botH = bot?.first?.height ?: 0,
            natSep = natSep
        )
        synchronized(colonCache) { colonCache[key] = res }
        return res
    }

    fun buildArtifact(
        lines: List<String>,
        cfg: LockConfig,
        hostWDp: Float,
        availableHDp: Float,
        density: Float,
        version: Long
    ): ClockArtifact? {
        var size = cfg.size
        val maxW = max(80f, hostWDp - 12f)
        var ss = min(3.8f, max(2.6f, density * 1.35f))

        val (capRatio, refMidRel) = measureNumeralMetrics(cfg.font)
        val tf = getTypeface(cfg.font)
        val probe = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            typeface = tf
            textSize = size
        }

        fun measureLineW(ln: String): Float {
            var sum = 0f
            for (ch in ln) sum += probe.measureText(ch.toString())
            return sum + max(0, ln.length - 1) * cfg.tracking
        }

        var maxLineW = 0f
        for (ln in lines) maxLineW = max(maxLineW, measureLineW(ln))

        val pad = 18f
        val rawW = max(40f, maxLineW * cfg.sx)
        val rawH = max(40f, lines.size * size * capRatio * cfg.sy)
        val fit = min(1f, min((maxW - pad * 2f) / rawW, (availableHDp - pad * 2f) / rawH))
        size *= max(0.1f, fit)

        probe.textSize = size
        maxLineW = 0f
        for (ln in lines) maxLineW = max(maxLineW, measureLineW(ln))

        val capH = size * capRatio
        val wDp = ceil(max(40f, maxLineW * cfg.sx) + pad * 2f)
        val hDp = ceil(max(40f, lines.size * capH * cfg.sy) + pad * 2f)

        val rawArea = max(1f, wDp * hDp)
        val maxArea = 2_600_000f
        if (rawArea * ss * ss > maxArea) {
            ss = max(1.8f, floor(sqrt(maxArea / rawArea) * 10f) / 10f)
        }
        val longSide = max(wDp, hDp)
        if (longSide * ss > 2200f) ss = max(1.8f, floor((2200f / longSide) * 10f) / 10f)

        val wPx = max(4, (wDp * ss).roundToInt())
        val hPx = max(4, (hDp * ss).roundToInt())

        val minuteKey = lines.joinToString("|")
        val maskKey = "${"%.2f".format(size)}|$wPx|$hPx|${cfg.font}|${cfg.sx}|${cfg.sy}|${cfg.tracking}|$minuteKey"

        synchronized(artifactCache) {
            artifactCache[maskKey]?.let { return it }
        }

        val alphaBmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(wPx, hPx, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply {
            setHasAlpha(false)
            eraseColor(Color.BLACK)
        }
        val c = Canvas(alphaBmp)
        val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG or Paint.FILTER_BITMAP_FLAG).apply {
            typeface = tf
            textSize = size
            textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
            color = Color.WHITE
        }

        val digitTargetH = capH * cfg.sy * ss
        val lineStep = digitTargetH * 1.06f
        val startY = ((hDp * ss) - (lines.size - 1) * lineStep) * 0.5f

        var inkMinX = Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY
        var inkMinY = Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY
        var inkMaxX = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY
        var inkMaxY = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY
        val tb = android.graphics.Rect()
        fun includeInk(l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float) {
            if (r > l && b > t) {
                if (l < inkMinX) inkMinX = l
                if (t < inkMinY) inkMinY = t
                if (r > inkMaxX) inkMaxX = r
                if (b > inkMaxY) inkMaxY = b
            }
        }

        for ((li, ln) in lines.withIndex()) {
            val advs = FloatArray(ln.length) { i -> probe.measureText(ln[i].toString()) }
            val totalW = advs.sum() + max(0, ln.length - 1) * cfg.tracking
            val lineCenterPx = startY + li * lineStep
            var curX = -totalW * 0.5f

            for (i in ln.indices) {
                val ch = ln[i]
                val adv = advs[i]
                val charCenterPx = (wDp * 0.5f + (curX + adv * 0.5f) * cfg.sx) * ss
                curX += adv + cfg.tracking

                if (ch == ':') {
                    val dots = getColonDots(size, cfg.font, ss, refMidRel)
                    if (dots.topBmp != null && dots.botBmp != null) {
                        val dotScale = min(1.28f, 1f + max(0f, cfg.sy - 1f) * 0.16f) * (0.5f + 0.5f * cfg.sx)
                        val sep = max(dots.natSep, digitTargetH * 0.158f)
                        val tw = dots.topW * dotScale
                        val th = dots.topH * dotScale
                        val bw = dots.botW * dotScale
                        val bh = dots.botH * dotScale
                        val topRect = RectF(charCenterPx - tw * 0.5f, lineCenterPx - sep - th * 0.5f, charCenterPx + tw * 0.5f, lineCenterPx - sep + th * 0.5f)
                        val botRect = RectF(charCenterPx - bw * 0.5f, lineCenterPx + sep - bh * 0.5f, charCenterPx + bw * 0.5f, lineCenterPx + sep + bh * 0.5f)
                        c.drawBitmap(dots.topBmp, null, topRect, paint)
                        c.drawBitmap(dots.botBmp, null, botRect, paint)
                        includeInk(topRect.left, topRect.top, topRect.right, topRect.bottom)
                        includeInk(botRect.left, botRect.top, botRect.right, botRect.bottom)
                    }
                    continue
                }

                if (ch in '0'..'9' && cfg.sy >= 1.03f) {
                    val g = stretchDigitBitmap(ch, size, cfg.font, cfg.sx, cfg.sy, ss, refMidRel)
                    if (g != null) {
                        val gl = charCenterPx - g.w * 0.5f + g.xCenterOffset
                        val gt = lineCenterPx - g.h * 0.5f + g.yCenterRel
                        c.drawBitmap(g.alphaBmp, gl, gt, paint)
                        includeInk(gl + 1f, gt + 1f, gl + g.w - 1f, gt + g.h - 1f)
                        continue
                    }
                }

                probe.getTextBounds(ch.toString(), 0, 1, tb)
                if (!tb.isEmpty) {
                    val gl = charCenterPx + (tb.left - adv * 0.5f) * ss * cfg.sx
                    val gr = charCenterPx + (tb.right - adv * 0.5f) * ss * cfg.sx
                    val gt = lineCenterPx + (-refMidRel * size + tb.top) * ss * cfg.sy
                    val gb = lineCenterPx + (-refMidRel * size + tb.bottom) * ss * cfg.sy
                    includeInk(gl, gt, gr, gb)
                }

                c.save()
                c.translate(charCenterPx, lineCenterPx)
                c.scale(ss * cfg.sx, ss * cfg.sy)
                c.drawText(ch.toString(), 0f, -refMidRel * size, paint)
                c.restore()
            }
        }

        val inkLeftDp = if (inkMaxX > inkMinX) (inkMinX / ss).coerceIn(0f, wDp * 0.45f) else pad
        val inkTopDp = if (inkMaxY > inkMinY) (inkMinY / ss).coerceIn(0f, hDp * 0.45f) else pad
        val inkRightDp = if (inkMaxX > inkMinX) (inkMaxX / ss).coerceIn(inkLeftDp + 20f, wDp) else (wDp - pad)
        val inkBottomDp = if (inkMaxY > inkMinY) (inkMaxY / ss).coerceIn(inkTopDp + 20f, hDp) else (hDp - pad)

        val fieldBmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(wPx, hPx, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply {
            setHasAlpha(false)
        }
        val maxAbsCss = if (NativeGlass.available) {
            NativeGlass.computeClockField(
                alphaBmp, fieldBmp, ss.toDouble(),
                1.5, 40.0, 50.0, 0, version
            ).toFloat()
        } else {
            16f
        }
        if (maxAbsCss < 0f) {
            alphaBmp.recycle()
            fieldBmp.recycle()
            return null
        }

        val alphaShader = if (LiquidGlassShaders.isGpuAgslAvailable()) {
            BitmapShader(alphaBmp, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP).apply {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) filterMode = BitmapShader.FILTER_MODE_LINEAR
            }
        } else null
        val fieldShader = if (LiquidGlassShaders.isGpuAgslAvailable()) {
            BitmapShader(fieldBmp, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP).apply {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) filterMode = BitmapShader.FILTER_MODE_LINEAR
            }
        } else null

        val artifact = ClockArtifact(
            alphaBmp = alphaBmp,
            fieldBmp = fieldBmp,
            alphaShader = alphaShader,
            fieldShader = fieldShader,
            maxAbsCss = maxAbsCss,
            wDp = wDp,
            hDp = hDp,
            wPx = wPx,
            hPx = hPx,
            ss = ss,
            sizeDp = size,
            textWDp = max(40f, maxLineW * cfg.sx),
            textHDp = max(40f, lines.size * capH * cfg.sy),
            lineHDp = capH,
            padDp = pad * 2f,
            inkLeftDp = inkLeftDp,
            inkTopDp = inkTopDp,
            inkRightDp = inkRightDp,
            inkBottomDp = inkBottomDp,
            sx = cfg.sx,
            sy = cfg.sy,
            minuteKey = minuteKey,
            maskKey = maskKey
        )

        synchronized(artifactCache) { artifactCache[maskKey] = artifact }
        return artifact
    }
}
`````

`````kotlin
    private fun makeActionPill(label: String, onClick: () -> Unit): TextView {

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    private fun bindHandle(view: View, dir: String) {
        view.setOnTouchListener { v, ev ->
            when (ev.actionMasked) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    handler.removeCallbacks(autoCloseRunnable)
                    val art = clockView.activeArtifact
                    dragDir = dir
                    dragX0 = ev.rawX
                    dragY0 = ev.rawY
                    startSize = clockView.config.size
                    startFitSize = art?.sizeDp ?: clockView.committedSize()
                    startSy = clockView.config.sy
                    startW = art?.textWDp ?: (clockView.width / dens)
                    startH = art?.textHDp ?: (clockView.height / dens)

                    applyDelta(d, (ev.rawX - dragX0) / dens, (ev.rawY - dragY0) / dens)
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                    if (dragDir != null) {
                        dragDir = null
                        labelPill.text = "اسحب المقبض · أو اضغط تصغير"

    private fun applyDelta(dir: String, dx: Float, dy: Float) {
        val cfg = clockView.config
        val (maxW, maxH) = getLimits()
        val horiz = dir.contains('e') || dir.contains('w')
        val vert = dir.contains('n') || dir.contains('s')
        val fitSz = max(40f, startFitSize)
        val fullWidthSize = (fitSz * (maxW / max(40f, startW))).roundToInt().toFloat().coerceIn(56f, 420f)

        val baseUnitH = startH / max(0.5f, startSy)
        val maxSizeAtUnitSy = (fitSz * (maxH / max(40f, baseUnitH))).coerceIn(56f, fullWidthSize)

        if (horiz) {
            val dxOut = dx * if (dir.contains('w')) -2f else 2f
            val nextW = (startW + dxOut).coerceIn(80f, maxW)
            cfg.size = (fitSz * (nextW / max(40f, startW))).roundToInt().toFloat().coerceIn(56f, maxSizeAtUnitSy)
            cfg.sx = 1.0f
        }
        val baseHAtSize = baseUnitH * (cfg.size / fitSz)
        val maxSyAtSize = (maxH / max(40f, baseHAtSize)).coerceIn(1.0f, 3.10f)

        if (vert) {
            val dyOut = dy * if (dir.contains('n')) -1f else 1f
            if (dyOut >= 0f) {
                val room = max(60f, maxH - startH)
                cfg.sy = (startSy + (dyOut / room) * max(0.35f, maxSyAtSize - startSy)).coerceIn(1.0f, maxSyAtSize)
            } else {
                val shrink = max(70f, startH * 0.65f)
                cfg.sy = (startSy + (dyOut / shrink) * max(0.25f, startSy - 1.0f)).coerceIn(1.0f, maxSyAtSize)
            }
        } else if (cfg.sy > maxSyAtSize) {
            cfg.sy = maxSyAtSize
        }

        val wPct = ((cfg.size / max(56f, fullWidthSize)) * 100f).roundToInt().coerceIn(15, 100)
        val hPct = (((cfg.sy - 1f) / max(0.1f, maxSyAtSize - 1f)) * 100f).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 100)
        labelPill.text = "الحجم $wPct% · الطول $hPct%"

        val art = clockView.activeArtifact
        val baseSize = max(40f, art?.sizeDp ?: clockView.committedSize())
        val baseSy = max(0.5f, clockView.committedSy())
        val curTextW = max(40f, art?.textWDp ?: (clockView.width / dens))
        val curTextH = max(40f, art?.textHDp ?: (clockView.height / dens))
        val rawScaleX = (cfg.size / baseSize) * cfg.sx
        val rawScaleY = (cfg.size / baseSize) * (cfg.sy / baseSy)
        val previewFit = min(1f, min(maxW / max(1f, curTextW * rawScaleX), maxH / max(1f, curTextH * rawScaleY)))
        clockView.updatePreviewTransform(rawScaleX * previewFit, rawScaleY * previewFit)
        layoutAroundClock()
        onConfigChanged(true)
    }

    fun layoutAroundClock() {
        val parentV = clockView.parent as? View ?: return
        val art = clockView.activeArtifact
        val viewW = if (clockView.width > 0) clockView.width.toFloat() else (art?.wDp ?: 260f) * dens
        val parentW = if (parentV.width > 0) parentV.width.toFloat() else resources.displayMetrics.widthPixels.toFloat()
        val viewX = if (clockView.width > 0) clockView.x else (parentW - viewW) * 0.5f

        val inkL = (art?.inkLeftDp ?: 18f) * dens
        val inkT = (art?.inkTopDp ?: 18f) * dens
        val inkR = (art?.inkRightDp ?: (viewW / dens - 18f)) * dens
        val inkB = (art?.inkBottomDp ?: ((if (clockView.height > 0) clockView.height / dens else (art?.hDp ?: 210f)) - 18f)) * dens

        val pivX = viewW * 0.5f
        val sL = pivX + (inkL - pivX) * clockView.scaleX
        val sR = pivX + (inkR - pivX) * clockView.scaleX
        val sT = inkT * clockView.scaleY
        val sB = inkB * clockView.scaleY

        val boxPadX = 10f * dens
        val boxPadY = 10f * dens
        var boxLeft = parentV.x + viewX + sL - boxPadX
        var boxRight = parentV.x + viewX + sR + boxPadX
        val boxTop = parentV.y + clockView.y + sT - boxPadY
        val boxBottom = parentV.y + clockView.y + sB + boxPadY

        val shellW = (parent as? View)?.width?.toFloat() ?: 0f
        if (shellW > 90f * dens) {
            val edgeMargin = 12f * dens
            boxLeft = boxLeft.coerceIn(edgeMargin, shellW - 72f * dens)
            boxRight = boxRight.coerceIn(boxLeft + 60f * dens, shellW - edgeMargin)
        }

        val boxW = (boxRight - boxLeft).roundToInt().coerceAtLeast((80f * dens).roundToInt())
        val boxH = (boxBottom - boxTop).roundToInt().coerceAtLeast((60f * dens).roundToInt())

        val boxLp = boxFrame.layoutParams as LayoutParams
        boxLp.width = boxW
        boxLp.height = boxH
        boxLp.leftMargin = hitPadX
        boxLp.topMargin = hitPadTop
        boxFrame.layoutParams = boxLp

        val pillLp = labelPill.layoutParams as LayoutParams
        pillLp.topMargin = hitPadTop + boxH + (12f * dens).roundToInt()
        labelPill.layoutParams = pillLp

        val actLp = actionsRow.layoutParams as LayoutParams
        actLp.topMargin = hitPadTop + boxH + (46f * dens).roundToInt()
        actionsRow.layoutParams = actLp

        val lp = (layoutParams as? LayoutParams) ?: LayoutParams(
            boxW + hitPadX * 2,
            boxH + hitPadTop + hitPadBot,
            Gravity.TOP or Gravity.LEFT
        )
        lp.gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.LEFT
        lp.width = boxW + hitPadX * 2
        lp.height = boxH + hitPadTop + hitPadBot
        lp.leftMargin = (boxLeft - hitPadX).roundToInt()
        lp.topMargin = (boxTop - hitPadTop).roundToInt()
        layoutParams = lp
    }

    fun open() {
        isOpen = true
        layoutAroundClock()
        visibility = VISIBLE
        labelPill.text = "اسحب المقبض · أو اضغط تصغير"
        pulseAnim?.cancel()
        pulseAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(1f, 1.18f, 1f).apply {
            duration = 1600L
            repeatCount = ValueAnimator.INFINITE
            addUpdateListener { anim ->
                val s = anim.animatedValue as Float
                cornerDots.forEach { d -> d.scaleX = s; d.scaleY = s }
            }
            start()
        }
        onHaptic("heavy")
        scheduleAutoClose()
    }

    fun close() {
        if (!isOpen) return
        isOpen = false
        visibility = GONE
        pulseAnim?.cancel()
        pulseAnim = null
        handler.removeCallbacks(autoCloseRunnable)
        if (dragDir != null) {
            dragDir = null
            clockView.clearPreviewTransform()
            onCommit()
        }
    }

    fun scheduleAutoClose() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(autoCloseRunnable)
        handler.postDelayed(autoCloseRunnable, 9000L)
    }
}
`````

`````kotlin
    private fun openHexColorDialog() {
        val input = EditText(context).apply {
            inputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_TEXT
            setText(if (cfg.color == "auto") "#ffffff" else cfg.color)
            setTextColor(Color.BLACK)
        }
        AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("تعديل كود اللون (Hex)")
            .setView(input)
            .setPositiveButton("تطبيق") { _, _ ->
                val raw = input.text.toString().trim()
                val fixed = if (raw.startsWith("#")) raw else "#$raw"
                try {
                    Color.parseColor(fixed)
                    cfg.color = fixed
                    syncProFromColor()
                    callbacks.onColorOrOpacityChanged()
                    syncFromConfig()
                } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            }
            .setNegativeButton("إلغاء", null)
            .show()
    }

    fun setAiStatus(msg: String, busy: Boolean) {
        aiDepthStatus.text = msg
        aiDepthBtn.alpha = if (busy) 0.55f else 1f
    }

    fun setPerfStatus(msg: String) {
        perfStatus.text = msg
    }

    fun updatePerfUi(snap: PerfMonitor.SummarySnapshot) {
        if (!isOpen) return
        perfMeta.text = "تشغيل ${snap.uptimeSec}s · ${snap.engineLabel}"
        perfFpsVal.text = "${snap.avgFps} / ${snap.currentFps}"
        perfJankVal.text = "${snap.dropped24} / ${snap.jank50}"
        perfMemVal.text = "${snap.gpuCacheMb} MB"
        perfPssVal.text = "${snap.totalPssMb} MB"
    }

    private fun syncProFromColor() {
        if (cfg.color != "auto") {
            val hsl = AppConstants.rgbIntToHsl(AppConstants.parseHexColor(cfg.color, Color.WHITE))
            proHue = hsl[0]
            proTone = hsl[2]
        }
    }

    fun syncFromConfig() {
        suppressSeek = true
        for ((id, tv) in fontBtns) {
            val active = cfg.font == id
            tv.setTextColor(if (active) 0xFFB3DFFF.toInt() else Color.WHITE)
            tv.background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                setColor(if (active) Color.argb(38, 179, 223, 255) else Color.argb(18, 255, 255, 255))
                cornerRadius = 12f * dens
                setStroke((1.2f * dens).roundToInt(), if (active) 0xFFB3DFFF.toInt() else Color.argb(20, 255, 255, 255))
            }
        }
        sizeSeek.progress = cfg.size.roundToInt().coerceIn(56, 420)
        sizeVal.text = "${((cfg.size / 172f) * 100f).roundToInt()}%"
        val stPct = (cfg.sy * 100f).roundToInt().coerceIn(100, 310)
        stretchSeek.progress = stPct
        stretchVal.text = "$stPct%"
        ySeek.progress = (cfg.clockY.roundToInt() + 20).coerceIn(0, 100)
        yVal.text = "${cfg.clockY.roundToInt()}px"

        fun styleFmt(btn: TextView, active: Boolean) {
            btn.setTextColor(if (active) 0xFFB3DFFF.toInt() else Color.WHITE)
            btn.background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                setColor(if (active) Color.argb(34, 179, 223, 255) else Color.argb(18, 255, 255, 255))
                cornerRadius = 11f * dens
                setStroke((1.1f * dens).roundToInt(), if (active) 0xFFB3DFFF.toInt() else Color.argb(20, 255, 255, 255))
            }
        }
        styleFmt(fmt12Btn, !cfg.hour24)
        styleFmt(fmt24Btn, cfg.hour24)

        for ((id, v) in colorSwatches) {
            val active = cfg.color.equals(id, ignoreCase = true)
            v.background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL
                if (id == "auto") {
                    setColor(0xFF475569.toInt())
                } else {
                    setColor(AppConstants.parseHexColor(id))
                }
                setStroke(
                    (if (active) 2.5f else 1f * dens).roundToInt(),
                    if (active) 0xFFB3DFFF.toInt() else Color.argb(80, 255, 255, 255)
                )
            }
        }
        syncProUi()

        for ((id, box) in wallThumbs) {
            val active = cfg.wall == id
            box.foreground = GradientDrawable().apply {
                cornerRadius = 12f * dens
                setStroke((if (active) 2.2f else 0.8f * dens).roundToInt(), if (active) 0xFFB3DFFF.toInt() else Color.argb(40, 255, 255, 255))
            }
        }

        inOpSeek.progress = cfg.innerOpacity
        inOpVal.text = "${cfg.innerOpacity}%"
        inThSeek.progress = (cfg.innerThickness * 10f).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 80)
        inThVal.text = "%.1f".format(cfg.innerThickness)
        inAngSeek.progress = cfg.innerAngle.roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 360)
        inAngVal.text = "${cfg.innerAngle.roundToInt()}°"
        inFadeSeek.progress = cfg.innerFade.coerceIn(0, 100)
        inFadeVal.text = "${cfg.innerFade}%"

        for ((hex, v) in innerSwatches) {
            val active = cfg.innerColor.equals(hex, ignoreCase = true)
            v.background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL
                setColor(AppConstants.parseHexColor(hex))
                setStroke(
                    (if (active) 2.5f else 1f * dens).roundToInt(),
                    if (active) 0xFFB3DFFF.toInt() else Color.argb(80, 255, 255, 255)
                )
            }
        }

        styleToggle(togWeather, cfg.weather)
        styleToggle(togMusic, cfg.music)
        styleToggle(togNotif, cfg.notifications)
        styleToggle(togDepth, cfg.depth)
        styleToggle(togDnd, cfg.dnd)
        suppressSeek = false
    }

    private fun syncProUi() {
        syncProFromColor()
        val isAuto = cfg.color == "auto"
        val col = if (isAuto) Color.WHITE else AppConstants.parseHexColor(cfg.color, Color.WHITE)
        proHex.text = if (isAuto) "تلقائي" else cfg.color.uppercase()
        proSwatch.background = GradientDrawable().apply {
            shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL
            setColor(col)
            setStroke((1.5f * dens).roundToInt(), Color.argb(140, 255, 255, 255))
        }
        hueSeek.progress = proHue.roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 360)
        toneSeek.progress = proTone.roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 100)
        opacitySeek.progress = cfg.clockOpacity
        opacityVal.text = "${cfg.clockOpacity}%"

        val barPad = (10f * dens).roundToInt()
        hueSeek.progressDrawable = android.graphics.drawable.InsetDrawable(
            GradientDrawable(
                GradientDrawable.Orientation.LEFT_RIGHT,
                intArrayOf(0xFFFF3B30.toInt(), 0xFFFFCC00.toInt(), 0xFF34C759.toInt(), 0xFF00C7BE.toInt(), 0xFF007AFF.toInt(), 0xFFAF52DE.toInt(), 0xFFFF2D55.toInt(), 0xFFFF3B30.toInt())
            ).apply { cornerRadius = 99f },
            0, barPad, 0, barPad
        )

        val pureHue = AppConstants.hslToRgbInt(proHue, 86f, 52f)
        toneSeek.progressDrawable = android.graphics.drawable.InsetDrawable(
            GradientDrawable(
                GradientDrawable.Orientation.LEFT_RIGHT,
                intArrayOf(Color.BLACK, pureHue, Color.WHITE)
            ).apply { cornerRadius = 99f },
            0, barPad, 0, barPad
        )

        val opTarget = if (isAuto) Color.WHITE else col
        opacitySeek.progressDrawable = android.graphics.drawable.InsetDrawable(
            GradientDrawable(
                GradientDrawable.Orientation.LEFT_RIGHT,
                intArrayOf(Color.argb(18, Color.red(opTarget), Color.green(opTarget), Color.blue(opTarget)), opTarget)
            ).apply { cornerRadius = 99f },
            0, barPad, 0, barPad
        )
    }

    private fun styleToggle(tv: TextView, active: Boolean) {
        tv.setTextColor(if (active) 0xFFB3DFFF.toInt() else Color.argb(215, 255, 255, 255))
        tv.background = GradientDrawable().apply {
            setColor(if (active) Color.argb(36, 179, 223, 255) else Color.argb(16, 255, 255, 255))
            cornerRadius = 11f * dens
            setStroke((1f * dens).roundToInt(), if (active) 0xFFB3DFFF.toInt() else Color.argb(24, 255, 255, 255))
        }
    }

    fun open() {
        if (isOpen) return
        isOpen = true
        val lp = sheetCard.layoutParams as LayoutParams
        lp.height = (resources.displayMetrics.heightPixels * 0.72f).roundToInt()
        sheetCard.layoutParams = lp
        syncFromConfig()
        updatePerfUi(perf.snapshot())
        visibility = VISIBLE
        alpha = 0f
        sheetCard.translationY = resources.displayMetrics.heightPixels * 0.45f
        animate().alpha(1f).setDuration(240L).start()
        sheetCard.animate()
            .translationY(0f)
            .setDuration(420L)
            .setInterpolator(DecelerateInterpolator(2.1f))
            .start()
        callbacks.onHaptic("tick")
    }

    fun close() {
        if (!isOpen) return
        isOpen = false
        animate().alpha(0f).setDuration(200L).start()
        sheetCard.animate()
            .translationY(resources.displayMetrics.heightPixels * 0.55f)
            .setDuration(240L)
            .withEndAction {
                visibility = GONE
                sheetCard.translationY = 0f
                callbacks.onClose()
            }
            .start()
    }

    private fun secHeader(txt: String): TextView {
        return TextView(context).apply {
            text = txt
            setTextColor(Color.argb(158, 255, 255, 255))
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 12f)
            typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.BOLD)
            setPadding(0, (14f * dens).roundToInt(), 0, (6f * dens).roundToInt())
        }
    }

    private fun secHeaderWithValue(txt: String, initVal: String): Pair<LinearLayout, TextView> {
        val row = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            setPadding(0, (12f * dens).roundToInt(), 0, (4f * dens).roundToInt())
        }
        val l = TextView(context).apply {
            text = txt
            setTextColor(Color.argb(158, 255, 255, 255))
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 12f)
            typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.BOLD)

        }

            text = initVal
            setTextColor(Color.argb(210, 255, 255, 255))
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 12f)
            fontFeatureSettings = "tnum"
        }
        row.addView(l); row.addView(v)
        return row to v
    }

    private fun miniSliderLabel(txt: String): TextView {
        return TextView(context).apply {
            text = txt
            setTextColor(Color.argb(145, 255, 255, 255))
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 11f)
            setPadding(0, (8f * dens).roundToInt(), 0, (2f * dens).roundToInt())
        }
    }

    private fun makeSeekBar(minV: Int, maxV: Int, onChange: (Int, Boolean) -> Unit): SeekBar {
        return SeekBar(context).apply {
            if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) min = minV
            max = maxV
            thumb = GradientDrawable().apply {
                shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL
                setSize((18f * dens).roundToInt(), (18f * dens).roundToInt())
                setColor(Color.WHITE)
                setStroke((2f * dens).roundToInt(), Color.argb(60, 0, 0, 0))
            }
            progressTintList = android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(0xFFB3DFFF.toInt())
            progressBackgroundTintList = android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.argb(46, 255, 255, 255))
            splitTrack = false
            setOnSeekBarChangeListener(object : SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener {
                override fun onProgressChanged(sb: SeekBar?, p: Int, fromUser: Boolean) {
                    val realVal = if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) p else max(minV, p)
                    onChange(realVal, fromUser)
                }
                override fun onStartTrackingTouch(sb: SeekBar?) {}
                override fun onStopTrackingTouch(sb: SeekBar?) {
                    if (sb === sizeSeek || sb === stretchSeek || sb === ySeek) {
                        callbacks.onGeometryCommit()
                    }
                }
            })
        }
    }
`````

`````kotlin
package com.oclock.liquidglass

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.BitmapShader
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Matrix
import android.graphics.RuntimeShader
import android.graphics.Shader
import android.os.Build
import androidx.annotation.RequiresApi
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.max

object LiquidGlassShaders {
    // Pure GPU card & pill Liquid Glass (Snell convex squircle + optical blur + Fresnel rim)
    private const val CARD_AGSL = """
        uniform shader uBackdrop;
        uniform float2 uCardOrigin;
        uniform float2 uCardSize;
        uniform float uRadius;
        uniform float uBezel;
        uniform float uThick;
        uniform float uIor;
        uniform float4 uGlassBg;
        uniform float uShadowInt;
        uniform float2 uLightDir;
        uniform float uInnerShadow;

        float sdRoundBox(float2 p, float2 b, float r) {
            float2 q = abs(p) - b + r;
            return length(max(q, 0.0)) + min(max(q.x, q.y), 0.0) - r;
        }

        float squircleH(float u) {
            float t = clamp(u, 0.0, 1.0);
            return pow(max(0.0, 1.0 - pow(1.0 - t, 4.0)), 0.25);
        }

        half4 main(float2 fragCoord) {
            float2 halfSz = uCardSize * 0.5;
            float r = min(uRadius, min(halfSz.x, halfSz.y));
            float2 p = fragCoord - halfSz;
            float dd = sdRoundBox(p, halfSz, r);
            if (dd > 1.0) return half4(0.0);
            float maskA = clamp(0.5 - dd, 0.0, 1.0);

            float e = 0.75;
            float2 grad = float2(
                sdRoundBox(p + float2(e, 0.0), halfSz, r) - sdRoundBox(p - float2(e, 0.0), halfSz, r),
                sdRoundBox(p + float2(0.0, e), halfSz, r) - sdRoundBox(p - float2(0.0, e), halfSz, r)
            );
            float glen = length(grad);
            float2 n = glen > 0.0001 ? grad / glen : float2(0.0, -1.0);

            float disp = 0.0;
            if (dd < 0.0 && -dd < uBezel) {
                float u = clamp(-dd / max(1.0, uBezel), 0.0, 1.0);
                float u1 = max(0.0, u - 0.002);
                float u2 = min(1.0, u + 0.002);
                float hVal = squircleH(u) * uThick;
                float slope = ((squircleH(u2) - squircleH(u1)) / (u2 - u1)) * uThick / max(1.0, uBezel);
                float sl = length(float2(-slope, 1.0));
                float snx = -slope / sl;
                float snz = 1.0 / sl;
                float eta = 1.0 / max(1.01, uIor);
                float sin2 = eta * eta * (1.0 - snz * snz);
                if (sin2 <= 1.0) {
                    float fac = eta * snz - sqrt(1.0 - sin2);
                    float tx = fac * snx;
                    float ty = -eta + fac * snz;
                    if (abs(ty) > 0.0001) disp = (-hVal / ty) * tx;
                }
            }

            float2 samplePos = uCardOrigin + fragCoord - n * disp;
            // Subtle 5-tap frosted optical softening matching backdrop blur
            float3 col = uBackdrop.eval(samplePos).rgb * 0.40
                + uBackdrop.eval(samplePos + float2(2.2, 2.2)).rgb * 0.15
                + uBackdrop.eval(samplePos + float2(-2.2, 2.2)).rgb * 0.15
                + uBackdrop.eval(samplePos + float2(2.2, -2.2)).rgb * 0.15
                + uBackdrop.eval(samplePos + float2(-2.2, -2.2)).rgb * 0.15;

            // saturate(1.15) contrast(1.06)
            float lum = dot(col, float3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
            col = clamp((lum + (col - lum) * 1.15 - 0.5) * 1.06 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);

            // glass-bg tint
            col = mix(col, uGlassBg.rgb, uGlassBg.a);

            // Soft fading directional white inner shadow (no full border stroke)
            if (uInnerShadow > 0.001 && dd < 0.0) {
                float depthPx = -dd;
                float span = max(14.0, uBezel * 1.35);
                if (depthPx < span) {
                    float td = clamp(depthPx / span, 0.0, 1.0);
                    float fall = pow(1.0 - td, 2.45);
                    float2 lDir = normalize(float2(-0.32, -0.95));
                    float topLit = pow(clamp(dot(n, lDir) * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0), 2.35);
                    float botLit = pow(clamp(dot(n, -lDir) * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0), 3.6) * 0.22;
                    float innerGlow = clamp((topLit + botLit) * fall * uInnerShadow * 0.50, 0.0, 0.56);
                    col = mix(col, float3(1.0), innerGlow);
                }
            }

            // Fresnel specular rim shadow
            if (uShadowInt > 0.001 && dd <= 0.45 && -dd <= 1.8) {
                float band = clamp((1.5 + dd) / 1.5, 0.0, 1.0);
                float edgeAA = clamp((0.45 - dd) / 0.9, 0.0, 1.0);
                float k = abs(dot(n, uLightDir));
                float rim = pow(band, 0.6) * edgeAA * pow(max(0.0, k), 1.8) * uShadowInt;
                col = mix(col, float3(1.0), clamp(rim, 0.0, 1.0));
            }
            return half4(half3(col * maskA), half(maskA));
        }
    """

    // Pure GPU Clock Liquid Glass (reads C++ EDT Field + Mask, computes Snell refraction + tint + dynamic inner rim)
    private const val CLOCK_AGSL = """
        uniform shader uBackdrop;
        uniform shader uField;
        uniform shader uMask;
        uniform float2 uClockOrigin;
        uniform float2 uDstSize;
        uniform float2 uClockScale;
        uniform float2 uFieldSize;
        uniform float uMaxAbsPx;
        uniform float uSS;
        uniform float4 uTintTop;
        uniform float4 uTintBot;
        uniform float4 uShadowTop;
        uniform float4 uInnerColor;
        uniform float uInnerThick;
        uniform float uInnerOp;
        uniform float uInnerFade;
        uniform float2 uInnerDir;

        half4 main(float2 fragCoord) {
            float2 uv = fragCoord / max(float2(1.0), uDstSize);
            float2 fp = uv * uFieldSize;

            // 4-tap Rotated-Grid Supersampling (RGSS) eliminates texture-minification aliasing & 8-bit SDF jaggies
            float2 pxScale = uFieldSize / max(float2(1.0), uDstSize);
            float2 rg = max(float2(0.38), pxScale * 0.56);
            float4 m0 = uMask.eval(fp + float2( 0.75 * rg.x,  0.25 * rg.y));
            float4 m1 = uMask.eval(fp + float2(-0.75 * rg.x, -0.25 * rg.y));
            float4 m2 = uMask.eval(fp + float2(-0.25 * rg.x,  0.75 * rg.y));
            float4 m3 = uMask.eval(fp + float2( 0.25 * rg.x, -0.75 * rg.y));
            float alpha = (m0.r + m1.r + m2.r + m3.r) * 0.25;
            if (alpha <= 0.002) return half4(0.0);

            float4 f0 = uField.eval(fp + float2( 0.75 * rg.x,  0.25 * rg.y));
            float4 f1 = uField.eval(fp + float2(-0.75 * rg.x, -0.25 * rg.y));
            float4 f2 = uField.eval(fp + float2(-0.25 * rg.x,  0.75 * rg.y));
            float4 f3 = uField.eval(fp + float2( 0.25 * rg.x, -0.75 * rg.y));
            float4 fld = (f0 + f1 + f2 + f3) * 0.25;
            float2 dispNorm = (fld.rg * 255.0 - 128.0) / 127.0;
            float2 disp = dispNorm * uMaxAbsPx;

            float2 localScaled = float2((fragCoord.x - uDstSize.x * 0.5) * uClockScale.x + uDstSize.x * 0.5, fragCoord.y * uClockScale.y);
            float2 samplePos = uClockOrigin + localScaled + disp;
            float3 col = uBackdrop.eval(samplePos).rgb * 0.56
                + uBackdrop.eval(samplePos + float2(1.1, 0.0)).rgb * 0.11
                + uBackdrop.eval(samplePos + float2(-1.1, 0.0)).rgb * 0.11
                + uBackdrop.eval(samplePos + float2(0.0, 1.1)).rgb * 0.11
                + uBackdrop.eval(samplePos + float2(0.0, -1.1)).rgb * 0.11;

            // saturate(1.22) brightness(1.04)
            float lum = dot(col, float3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
            col = clamp((lum + (col - lum) * 1.22) * 1.04, 0.0, 1.0);

            // vertical clock tint gradient
            float4 tint = mix(uTintTop, uTintBot, clamp(uv.y, 0.0, 1.0));
            col = mix(col, tint.rgb, tint.a);

            // --clock-shadow-op subtle top ink glaze
            col = mix(col, uShadowTop.rgb, uShadowTop.a);

            // Silky fading iOS 26 inner glass shadow (scales smoothly from ultra-fine 0.9dp at 0.1 to deep glow, fades to 0 on unlit edges)
            float depthPx = max(0.0, fld.b * 255.0 / 1.5 - 1.0);
            float fallLimit = uInnerThick > 0.01 ? max(0.75 * uSS, (uInnerThick * 4.8 + 0.45) * uSS) : 0.0;
            if (uInnerOp > 0.001 && uInnerThick > 0.01 && depthPx < fallLimit) {
                float2 nRaw = ((m0.gb + m1.gb + m2.gb + m3.gb) * 0.25 * 255.0 - 128.0) / 127.0;
                float gl = length(nRaw);
                if (gl > 0.01) {
                    float ridgeFade = clamp(gl * 1.40, 0.0, 1.0);
                    float2 n = nRaw / gl;
                    float k = abs(dot(n, uInnerDir));
                    float t = clamp(depthPx / fallLimit, 0.0, 1.0);
                    float decay = pow(1.0 - t, 2.75);
                    float fadeAmt = clamp(uInnerFade, 0.0, 1.0);
                    float lit = pow(clamp((k - 0.28) / 0.72, 0.0, 1.0), 1.85);
                    float dirTerm = mix(1.0, lit, fadeAmt);
                    float rimA = clamp(dirTerm * decay * ridgeFade * uInnerOp * 0.68, 0.0, 0.80);
                    col = mix(col, uInnerColor.rgb, rimA);
                }
            }

            return half4(half3(col * alpha), half(alpha));
        }
    """

    class BackdropState {
        var wallBitmap: Bitmap? = null
        var compositedBitmap: Bitmap? = null
        var wallShader: BitmapShader? = null
        var compositedShader: BitmapShader? = null
        var wallLeft = 0f
        var wallTop = 0f
        var wallScaleX = 1f
        var wallScaleY = 1f
        private val matrix = Matrix()

        fun updateWallAndSubject(
            wall: Bitmap,
            subject: Bitmap?,
            depthEnabled: Boolean,
            screenW: Int,
            screenH: Int,
            pullZoom: Float
        ) {
            if (screenW <= 0 || screenH <= 0) return
            val bw = wall.width.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f)
            val bh = wall.height.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f)
            val baseScale = max(screenW / bw, screenH / bh)
            val finalScale = baseScale * pullZoom
            val drawnW = bw * finalScale
            val drawnH = bh * finalScale
            wallLeft = (screenW - drawnW) * 0.5f
            wallTop = (screenH - drawnH) * 0.5f
            wallScaleX = finalScale
            wallScaleY = finalScale

            if (wallBitmap !== wall || wallShader == null) {
                wallBitmap = wall
                wallShader = BitmapShader(wall, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP).also {
                    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) it.filterMode = BitmapShader.FILTER_MODE_LINEAR
                }
            }
            matrix.reset()
            matrix.setScale(wallScaleX, wallScaleY)
            matrix.postTranslate(wallLeft, wallTop)
            wallShader?.setLocalMatrix(matrix)

            if (depthEnabled && subject != null) {
                // Keep a lightweight 0.5x screen composited backdrop for cards sitting in front of subject
                val cw = (screenW / 2).coerceAtLeast(64)
                val ch = (screenH / 2).coerceAtLeast(64)
                val comp = compositedBitmap?.takeIf { it.width == cw && it.height == ch }
                    ?: Bitmap.createBitmap(cw, ch, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).also { compositedBitmap = it }
                val c = android.graphics.Canvas(comp)
                c.drawColor(Color.BLACK)
                val m = Matrix()
                val s = max(cw / bw, ch / bh)
                m.setScale(s, s)
                m.postTranslate((cw - bw * s) * 0.5f, (ch - bh * s) * 0.5f)
                c.drawBitmap(wall, m, null)
                val sw = subject.width.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f)
                val sh = subject.height.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f)
                val ss = max(cw / sw, ch / sh)
                m.reset()
                m.setScale(ss, ss)
                m.postTranslate((cw - sw * ss) * 0.5f, (ch - sh * ss) * 0.5f)
                c.drawBitmap(subject, m, null)
                if (compositedShader == null) {
                    compositedShader = BitmapShader(comp, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP).also {
                        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) it.filterMode = BitmapShader.FILTER_MODE_LINEAR
                    }
                }
                matrix.reset()
                val scX = (screenW.toFloat() / cw) * pullZoom
                val scY = (screenH.toFloat() / ch) * pullZoom
                matrix.setScale(scX, scY)
                matrix.postTranslate((screenW - cw * scX) * 0.5f, (screenH - ch * scY) * 0.5f)
                compositedShader?.setLocalMatrix(matrix)
            } else {
                compositedBitmap = null
                compositedShader = null
            }
        }

        fun updateZoomOnly(screenW: Int, screenH: Int, pullZoom: Float) {
            val wall = wallBitmap ?: return
            val bw = wall.width.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f)
            val bh = wall.height.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f)
            val finalScale = max(screenW / bw, screenH / bh) * pullZoom
            wallLeft = (screenW - bw * finalScale) * 0.5f
            wallTop = (screenH - bh * finalScale) * 0.5f
            wallScaleX = finalScale
            wallScaleY = finalScale
            matrix.reset()
            matrix.setScale(wallScaleX, wallScaleY)
            matrix.postTranslate(wallLeft, wallTop)
            wallShader?.setLocalMatrix(matrix)

            val comp = compositedBitmap
            if (comp != null && compositedShader != null) {
                val cw = comp.width.toFloat()
                val ch = comp.height.toFloat()
                val scX = (screenW / cw) * pullZoom
                val scY = (screenH / ch) * pullZoom
                matrix.reset()
                matrix.setScale(scX, scY)
                matrix.postTranslate((screenW - cw * scX) * 0.5f, (screenH - ch * scY) * 0.5f)
                compositedShader?.setLocalMatrix(matrix)
            }
        }
    }

    @RequiresApi(33)
    fun createCardShader(): RuntimeShader = RuntimeShader(CARD_AGSL)

    @RequiresApi(33)
    fun createClockShader(): RuntimeShader = RuntimeShader(CLOCK_AGSL)

    @RequiresApi(33)
    fun configureCardShader(
        shader: RuntimeShader,
        backdrop: BitmapShader,
        cardX: Float,
        cardY: Float,
        cardW: Float,
        cardH: Float,
        radiusPx: Float,
        bezelPx: Float,
        thickPx: Float,
        ior: Float,
        glassBg: Int,
        shadowInt: Float,
        innerShadow: Float = 0f
    ) {
        shader.setInputShader("uBackdrop", backdrop)
        shader.setFloatUniform("uCardOrigin", cardX, cardY)
        shader.setFloatUniform("uCardSize", cardW, cardH)
        shader.setFloatUniform("uRadius", radiusPx)
        shader.setFloatUniform("uBezel", bezelPx)
        shader.setFloatUniform("uThick", thickPx)
        shader.setFloatUniform("uIor", ior)
        shader.setFloatUniform(
            "uGlassBg",
            Color.red(glassBg) / 255f,
            Color.green(glassBg) / 255f,
            Color.blue(glassBg) / 255f,
            Color.alpha(glassBg) / 255f
        )
        shader.setFloatUniform("uShadowInt", shadowInt)
        val rad = Math.toRadians(55.0)
        shader.setFloatUniform("uLightDir", cos(rad).toFloat(), sin(rad).toFloat())
        shader.setFloatUniform("uInnerShadow", innerShadow)
    }

    fun isGpuAgslAvailable(): Boolean = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33
}
`````

`````kotlin
class LiquidGlassCardHelper(
    private val backdrop: LiquidGlassShaders.BackdropState,
    private val perf: PerfMonitor,
    private val radiusDp: Float,
    private val bezelDp: Float,
    private val thickDp: Float,
    private val ior: Float,
    private val shadowInt: Float,
    private val innerShadow: Float = 0f
) {
    private var shader: RuntimeShader? = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) LiquidGlassShaders.createCardShader() else null
    private val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG or Paint.FILTER_BITMAP_FLAG)
    private val dstRect = RectF()
    private var cpuBmp: Bitmap? = null
    private var cpuKey = ""

    fun draw(view: View, canvas: Canvas, glassBgColor: Int, originX: Float, originY: Float) {
        val w = view.width.toFloat()
        val h = view.height.toFloat()
        if (w <= 1f || h <= 1f) return
        val dens = view.resources.displayMetrics.density
        val radPx = radiusDp * dens
        val bzPx = bezelDp * dens
        val thPx = thickDp * dens

        val shaderSrc = backdrop.compositedShader ?: backdrop.wallShader
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33 && shader != null && shaderSrc != null) {
            val t0 = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
            val sh = shader!!
            LiquidGlassShaders.configureCardShader(
                sh, shaderSrc, originX, originY, w, h, radPx, bzPx, thPx, ior, glassBgColor, shadowInt, innerShadow
            )
            paint.shader = sh
            canvas.drawRect(0f, 0f, w, h, paint)
            paint.shader = null
            perf.recordWork("cardsDraw", (SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos() - t0) / 1_000_000.0)
        } else {
            val wall = backdrop.compositedBitmap ?: backdrop.wallBitmap ?: return
            val bw = max(16, (w / 2f).roundToInt())
            val bh = max(16, (h / 2f).roundToInt())
            val key = "${originX.roundToInt()}|${originY.roundToInt()}|$bw|$bh|$glassBgColor|${(backdrop.wallScaleX * 100).roundToInt()}"
            var out = cpuBmp?.takeIf { it.width == bw && it.height == bh }
            if (out == null || cpuKey != key) {
                if (out == null) {
                    out = Bitmap.createBitmap(bw, bh, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
                    cpuBmp = out
                }
                val isComp = backdrop.compositedBitmap != null
                val scX = if (isComp) (backdrop.wallScaleX * (backdrop.wallBitmap!!.width.toFloat() / wall.width)) else backdrop.wallScaleX
                val scY = if (isComp) (backdrop.wallScaleY * (backdrop.wallBitmap!!.height.toFloat() / wall.height)) else backdrop.wallScaleY
                NativeGlass.renderCardCpuFallback(
                    wall, out, originX, originY, w, h, radPx,
                    backdrop.wallLeft, backdrop.wallTop, scX, scY,
                    bzPx, thPx, ior, glassBgColor, shadowInt
                )
                cpuKey = key
            }
            dstRect.set(0f, 0f, w, h)
            canvas.drawBitmap(out, null, dstRect, paint)
        }
    }
}
`````
