`````kotlin
        shuffleBtn = makePillButton("⇄  تشغيل عشوائي", accent = true) { v ->
            bounceView(v)
            onHaptic("pop")
            if (!media.hasAudioPermission()) {
                triggerPermissionPrompt()
                return@makePillButton
            }
            if (allTracks.isEmpty()) {
                media.scanDeviceMusic(force = true)
                return@makePillButton
            }
            media.startShuffled()
            onNotify("تشغيل عشوائي للأغاني", 0xFF38BDF8.toInt())
            close()
        }
        sequentialBtn = makePillButton("▶  بالترتيب") { v ->
            bounceView(v)
            onHaptic("pop")
            if (allTracks.isEmpty()) return@makePillButton
            val startIdx = if (filteredIndices.isNotEmpty()) filteredIndices[0] else 0
            media.startSequential(startIdx)
            onNotify("تشغيل القائمة", 0xFF30D158.toInt())
            close()
        }
        refreshBtn = makePillButton("↻", weight = 0.42f) { v ->
            bounceView(v)
            onHaptic("tick")
            if (!media.hasAudioPermission()) {
                triggerPermissionPrompt()
            } else {
                subTitleView.text = "جارٍ البحث عن الأغاني والصور المصغرة..."
                media.scanDeviceMusic(force = true)
            }
        }
        actRow.addView(shuffleBtn)
        actRow.addView(sequentialBtn)
        actRow.addView(refreshBtn)
        panelCard.addView(actRow)

        // Compact Search Bar
        searchInput = EditText(context).apply {
            hint = "ابحث عن أغنية أو فنان..."
            setHintTextColor(Color.argb(120, 255, 255, 255))
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 13.5f)
            isSingleLine = true
            imeOptions = EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_DONE
            setPadding((14f * dens).roundToInt(), (10f * dens).roundToInt(), (14f * dens).roundToInt(), (10f * dens).roundToInt())
            background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                setColor(Color.argb(20, 255, 255, 255))
                cornerRadius = 14f * dens
                setStroke((0.8f * dens).roundToInt(), Color.argb(30, 255, 255, 255))
            }
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT).apply {
                bottomMargin = (10f * dens).roundToInt()
            }
            addTextChangedListener(object : TextWatcher {
                override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, count: Int, after: Int) {}
                override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, before: Int, count: Int) {}
                override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {
                    applyFilter(s?.toString() ?: "")
                }
            })
        }
        panelCard.addView(searchInput)

        // Permission / Empty Prompt Box
        permissionBox = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
            setPadding((16f * dens).roundToInt(), (20f * dens).roundToInt(), (16f * dens).roundToInt(), (20f * dens).roundToInt())
            background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                setColor(Color.argb(20, 255, 255, 255))
                cornerRadius = 20f * dens
                setStroke((1f * dens).roundToInt(), Color.argb(36, 255, 255, 255))
            }
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT).apply {
                topMargin = (8f * dens).roundToInt()
            }
            visibility = GONE
        }
        val iconBadge = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "♫"
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setTextColor(0xFF93C5FD.toInt())
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 24f)
            val s = (54f * dens).roundToInt()
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(s, s).apply { bottomMargin = (10f * dens).roundToInt() }
            background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL
                setColor(Color.argb(36, 56, 189, 248))
            }
        }
        permMsgView = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "لإظهار أغانيك وبوسترات الألبوم المصغرة من جهازك، امنح صلاحية الوصول للموسيقى والصور."
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setTextColor(Color.argb(225, 255, 255, 255))
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 13.5f)
            setPadding(0, 0, 0, (14f * dens).roundToInt())
        }
        permGrantBtn = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "منح صلاحية الموسيقى والصور"
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setTextColor(0xFF0A101D.toInt())
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 13.5f)
            typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.BOLD)
            setPadding((18f * dens).roundToInt(), (11f * dens).roundToInt(), (18f * dens).roundToInt(), (11f * dens).roundToInt())
            background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                setColor(0xFF93C5FD.toInt())
                cornerRadius = 14f * dens
            }
            setOnClickListener { v ->
                bounceView(v)
                onHaptic("pop")
                if (!media.hasAudioPermission()) {
                    if (permRequestCount >= 2) onOpenAppSettings() else triggerPermissionPrompt()
                } else {
                    media.scanDeviceMusic(force = true)
                }
            }
        }
        val manualPickBtn = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "أو اختيار ملف صوتي من الجهاز…"
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setTextColor(Color.argb(185, 255, 255, 255))
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 12f)
            setPadding((12f * dens).roundToInt(), (12f * dens).roundToInt(), (12f * dens).roundToInt(), (2f * dens).roundToInt())
            setOnClickListener {
                onHaptic("tick")
                onPickManualAudio()
                close()
            }
        }
        permissionBox.addView(iconBadge)
        permissionBox.addView(permMsgView)
        permissionBox.addView(permGrantBtn)
        permissionBox.addView(manualPickBtn)
        panelCard.addView(permissionBox)

        // Lightweight Virtualized ListView (recycles <10 views regardless of song count)
        listView = ListView(context).apply {
            divider = null
            dividerHeight = 0
            isVerticalScrollBarEnabled = false
            overScrollMode = View.OVER_SCROLL_ALWAYS
            clipToPadding = false
            setPadding(0, 0, 0, (12f * dens).roundToInt())
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f)
            adapter = trackAdapter
            setOnItemClickListener { _, view, position, _ ->
                if (position !in filteredIndices.indices) return@setOnItemClickListener
                val realIdx = filteredIndices[position]
                bounceView(view)
                onHaptic("pop")
                hideKeyboard()
                media.playDeviceTrack(realIdx, keepShuffle = false)
                close()
            }
        }
        panelCard.addView(listView)
        addView(panelCard)
    }

    private fun makePillButton(label: String, accent: Boolean = false, weight: Float = 1f, onClick: (View) -> Unit): TextView {
        return TextView(context).apply {
            text = label
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setTextColor(if (accent) 0xFFBAE6FD.toInt() else Color.WHITE)
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 12.5f)
            typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.BOLD)
            setPadding((10f * dens).roundToInt(), (10f * dens).roundToInt(), (10f * dens).roundToInt(), (10f * dens).roundToInt())
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, weight).apply {
                marginEnd = (6f * dens).roundToInt()
            }
            background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                setColor(if (accent) Color.argb(46, 56, 189, 248) else Color.argb(22, 255, 255, 255))
                cornerRadius = 14f * dens
                setStroke((0.9f * dens).roundToInt(), if (accent) Color.argb(120, 125, 211, 252) else Color.argb(34, 255, 255, 255))
            }
            setOnClickListener { onClick(it) }
        }
    }

    private fun bounceView(v: View) {
        v.animate().cancel()
        v.scaleX = 0.94f
        v.scaleY = 0.94f
        v.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(320L).setInterpolator(OvershootInterpolator(1.6f)).start()
    }

    private fun attachDragDismiss(handle: View) {
        val slop = ViewConfiguration.get(context).scaledTouchSlop.toFloat()
        var downY = 0f
        var dragging = false
        handle.setOnTouchListener { _, ev ->
            when (ev.actionMasked) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    downY = ev.rawY
                    dragging = false
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    val dy = ev.rawY - downY
                    if (!dragging && dy > slop) dragging = true
                    if (dragging) {
                        val ty = max(0f, dy)
                        panelCard.translationY = ty
                        val p = (1f - ty / max(200f, panelCard.height.toFloat())).coerceIn(0.35f, 1f)
                        scrimView.alpha = p
                    }
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                    if (dragging && panelCard.translationY > 110f * dens) {
                        close()
                    } else {
                        panelCard.animate().translationY(0f).setDuration(320L).setInterpolator(OvershootInterpolator(1.2f)).start()
                        scrimView.animate().alpha(1f).setDuration(240L).start()
                    }
                    dragging = false
                    true
                }
                else -> false
            }
        }
    }

    private fun triggerPermissionPrompt() {
        permRequestCount++
        onRequestPermission()
    }

    fun applySafeInsets(safeTopPx: Int, safeBottomPx: Int) {
        val lp = panelCard.layoutParams as LayoutParams
        lp.topMargin = max((36f * dens).roundToInt(), safeTopPx + (12f * dens).roundToInt())
        lp.bottomMargin = max((18f * dens).roundToInt(), safeBottomPx + (10f * dens).roundToInt())
        panelCard.layoutParams = lp
    }

    fun open() {
        if (isOpen) return
        isOpen = true
        visibility = VISIBLE
        panelCard.requestFocus()
        syncTracks(media.getLibraryTracks())

        if (!media.hasAudioPermission()) {
            triggerPermissionPrompt()
        } else if (!media.hasDeviceTracks() && !media.isScanning()) {
            subTitleView.text = "جارٍ فحص موسيقى الجهاز..."
            media.scanDeviceMusic(force = true)
        }

        scrimView.animate().cancel()
        panelCard.animate().cancel()
        scrimView.alpha = 0f
        scrimView.animate().alpha(1f).setDuration(240L).start()

        val h = resources.displayMetrics.heightPixels.toFloat()
        panelCard.setLayerType(LAYER_TYPE_HARDWARE, null)
        panelCard.translationY = h * 0.24f
        panelCard.scaleX = 0.90f
        panelCard.scaleY = 0.90f
        panelCard.alpha = 0f
        panelCard.animate()
            .translationY(0f)
            .scaleX(1f)
            .scaleY(1f)
            .alpha(1f)
            .setDuration(440L)
            .setInterpolator(OvershootInterpolator(1.06f))
            .withEndAction {
                panelCard.setLayerType(LAYER_TYPE_NONE, null)
            }
            .start()
    }

    fun close() {
        if (!isOpen) return
        isOpen = false
        hideKeyboard()
        val h = resources.displayMetrics.heightPixels.toFloat()
        panelCard.setLayerType(LAYER_TYPE_HARDWARE, null)
        scrimView.animate().alpha(0f).setDuration(220L).start()
        panelCard.animate()
            .translationY(h * 0.28f)
            .scaleX(0.92f)
            .scaleY(0.92f)
            .alpha(0f)
            .setDuration(250L)
            .setInterpolator(DecelerateInterpolator(1.8f))
            .withEndAction {
                panelCard.setLayerType(LAYER_TYPE_NONE, null)
                visibility = GONE
                panelCard.translationY = 0f
                panelCard.scaleX = 1f
                panelCard.scaleY = 1f
                panelCard.alpha = 1f
                onClosed()
            }
            .start()
    }

    fun onPermissionResult(granted: Boolean) {
        if (!isOpen) return
        if (granted) {
            subTitleView.text = "جارٍ تحميل الأغاني والصور المصغرة..."
            media.scanDeviceMusic(force = true)
        } else {
            syncTracks(emptyList())
        }
    }

    fun syncTracks(tracks: List<TrackInfo>) {
        allTracks.clear()
        allTracks.addAll(tracks)
        applyFilter(searchInput.text?.toString() ?: "")
        updateHeaderState()
    }

    private fun updateHeaderState() {
        val shuf = media.isShuffle()
        shuffleBtn.background = GradientDrawable().apply {
            setColor(if (shuf) Color.argb(88, 56, 189, 248) else Color.argb(42, 56, 189, 248))
            cornerRadius = 14f * dens
            setStroke((1f * dens).roundToInt(), if (shuf) 0xFF7DD3FC.toInt() else Color.argb(110, 125, 211, 252))
        }
        shuffleBtn.text = if (shuf) "⇄  العشوائي مفعّل" else "⇄  تشغيل عشوائي"

        if (!media.hasAudioPermission()) {
            permissionBox.visibility = VISIBLE
            permMsgView.text = "لإظهار أغانيك وبوسترات الألبوم المصغرة من جهازك، امنح صلاحية الوصول للموسيقى والصور."
            permGrantBtn.text = if (permRequestCount >= 2) "فتح إعدادات الصلاحيات" else "منح صلاحية الموسيقى والصور"
            searchInput.visibility = GONE
            listView.visibility = GONE
            subTitleView.text = "الصلاحية مطلوبة للوصول للموسيقى والصور"
        } else if (allTracks.isEmpty()) {
            permissionBox.visibility = VISIBLE
            permMsgView.text = if (media.isScanning()) "جارٍ فحص الصوتيات على جهازك..." else "لم يتم العثور على أغاني (MP3/M4A/FLAC) في ذاكرة الجهاز."
            permGrantBtn.text = "إعادة الفحص"
            searchInput.visibility = GONE
            listView.visibility = GONE
            subTitleView.text = if (media.isScanning()) "جارٍ الفحص..." else "لا توجد ملفات موسيقى"
        } else {
            permissionBox.visibility = GONE
            searchInput.visibility = VISIBLE
            listView.visibility = VISIBLE
            val suffix = if (shuf) " · تبديل عشوائي" else ""
            subTitleView.text = "${allTracks.size} أغنية على جهازك$suffix"
        }
    }

    private fun applyFilter(rawQuery: String) {
        val q = rawQuery.trim().lowercase()
        filteredIndices.clear()
        for (i in allTracks.indices) {
            val t = allTracks[i]
            if (q.isEmpty() ||
                t.title.lowercase().contains(q) ||
                t.artist.lowercase().contains(q) ||
                t.albumName.lowercase().contains(q)
            ) {
                filteredIndices.add(i)
            }
        }
        trackAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
    }

    private fun hideKeyboard() {
        searchInput.clearFocus()
        val imm = context.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE) as? InputMethodManager ?: return
        imm.hideSoftInputFromWindow(windowToken, 0)
    }

    private fun fmtSec(sec: Int): String {
        val m = sec / 60
        val s = sec % 60
        return "$m:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}"
    }

    private fun getFallbackArt(track: TrackInfo, sz: Int): Bitmap {
        val k = "${track.c1}|${track.c2}|${track.c3}|$sz"
        return fallbackArtCache.getOrPut(k) {
            val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(sz, sz, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
            val c = Canvas(bmp)
            val p = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
                shader = LinearGradient(
                    0f, 0f, sz.toFloat(), sz.toFloat(),
                    intArrayOf(track.c1, track.c2, track.c3),
                    floatArrayOf(0f, 0.55f, 1f),
                    Shader.TileMode.CLAMP
                )
            }
            c.drawRect(0f, 0f, sz.toFloat(), sz.toFloat(), p)
            val tp = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
                color = Color.argb(190, 255, 255, 255)
                textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
                textSize = sz * 0.44f
            }
            c.drawText("♪", sz * 0.5f, sz * 0.65f, tp)
            bmp
        }
    }

    private class RowHolder(
        val card: LinearLayout,
        val bg: GradientDrawable,
        val art: ImageView,
        val title: TextView,
        val artist: TextView,
        val duration: TextView,
        var boundUri: Uri? = null,
        var wasActive: Boolean? = null
    )

    private inner class TrackAdapter : BaseAdapter() {
        private val artPx = (48f * dens).roundToInt()

        override fun getCount(): Int = filteredIndices.size
        override fun getItem(position: Int): TrackInfo = allTracks[filteredIndices[position]]
        override fun getItemId(position: Int): Long = filteredIndices[position].toLong()

        override fun getView(position: Int, convertView: View?, parent: ViewGroup?): View {
            val holder: RowHolder
            val rowView: FrameLayout
            if (convertView == null) {
                rowView = FrameLayout(context).apply {
                    setPadding(0, (3f * dens).roundToInt(), 0, (3f * dens).roundToInt())
                }
                val rowBg = GradientDrawable().apply { cornerRadius = 18f * dens }
                val card = LinearLayout(context).apply {
                    orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
                    gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
                    layoutDirection = LAYOUT_DIRECTION_LTR
                    background = rowBg
                    setPadding((10f * dens).roundToInt(), (8f * dens).roundToInt(), (12f * dens).roundToInt(), (8f * dens).roundToInt())
                    layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
                }
                val art = ImageView(context).apply {
                    layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(artPx, artPx).apply { marginEnd = (12f * dens).roundToInt() }
                    scaleType = ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP
                    clipToOutline = true
                    outlineProvider = object : android.view.ViewOutlineProvider() {
                        override fun getOutline(v: View, outline: android.graphics.Outline) {
                            outline.setRoundRect(0, 0, v.width, v.height, 11f * dens)
                        }
                    }
                }
                val meta = LinearLayout(context).apply {
                    orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
                    layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
                }
                val title = TextView(context).apply {
                    setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                    setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 14f)
                    typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.BOLD)
                    isSingleLine = true
                    ellipsize = TextUtils.TruncateAt.END
                }
                val artist = TextView(context).apply {
                    setTextColor(Color.argb(165, 255, 255, 255))
                    setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 11.5f)
                    isSingleLine = true
                    ellipsize = TextUtils.TruncateAt.END
                }
                meta.addView(title)
                meta.addView(artist)

                val duration = TextView(context).apply {
                    setTextColor(Color.argb(175, 255, 255, 255))
                    setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 11.5f)
                    typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.BOLD)
                    fontFeatureSettings = "tnum"
                    layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT).apply {
                        marginStart = (10f * dens).roundToInt()
                    }
                }
                card.addView(art)
                card.addView(meta)
                card.addView(duration)
                rowView.addView(card)
                holder = RowHolder(card, rowBg, art, title, artist, duration)
                rowView.tag = holder
            } else {
                rowView = convertView as FrameLayout
                holder = rowView.tag as RowHolder
            }

            val track = getItem(position)
            val current = media.currentTrack()
            val isActive = current.contentUri != null && current.contentUri == track.contentUri

            if (holder.wasActive != isActive) {
                holder.wasActive = isActive
                holder.bg.setColor(if (isActive) Color.argb(56, 56, 189, 248) else Color.argb(18, 255, 255, 255))
                holder.bg.setStroke(
                    (if (isActive) 1.2f else 0.7f * dens).roundToInt(),
                    if (isActive) Color.argb(145, 125, 211, 252) else Color.argb(24, 255, 255, 255)
                )
            }
            holder.title.text = track.title
            holder.title.setTextColor(if (isActive) 0xFFBAE6FD.toInt() else Color.WHITE)
            holder.artist.text = if (track.albumName.isNotBlank()) "${track.artist} · ${track.albumName}" else track.artist
            holder.duration.text = if (isActive && media.isPlaying()) "▶ ${fmtSec(track.durationSec)}" else fmtSec(track.durationSec)
            holder.duration.setTextColor(if (isActive) 0xFF7DD3FC.toInt() else Color.argb(165, 255, 255, 255))

            holder.boundUri = track.contentUri
            val cached = media.getCachedPoster(track, 112)
            if (cached != null) {
                holder.art.setImageBitmap(cached)
            } else {
                holder.art.setImageBitmap(getFallbackArt(track, artPx))
                val targetUri = track.contentUri
                media.loadTrackPoster(track, 112) { bmp ->
                    if (bmp != null && holder.boundUri == targetUri) {
                        holder.art.setImageBitmap(bmp)
                    }
                }
            }
            return rowView
        }
    }
}
`````

`````kotlin
package com.oclock.liquidglass

import android.graphics.Bitmap

object NativeGlass {
    val available: Boolean

    init {
        available = try {
            System.loadLibrary("oclock_glass")
            true
        } catch (_: UnsatisfiedLinkError) {
            false
        }
    }

    @JvmStatic
    external fun setLatestVersion(version: Long)

    @JvmStatic
    external fun compute(
        packet: ByteArray,
        offset: Int,
        w: Int,
        h: Int,
        values: DoubleArray,
        version: Long
    ): Array<ByteArray>?

    /**
     * Ultra-fast direct Bitmap lock C++ field compute:
     * Reads [alphaBmp] (ARGB_8888 opaque R-channel mask), stores smooth SDF normal (G, B), and writes
     * (R=dispX, G=dispY, B=(depth+4)*7, A=255) directly into [outFieldBmp] without PNG encode/decode.
     */
    @JvmStatic
    external fun computeClockField(
        alphaBmp: Bitmap,
        outFieldBmp: Bitmap,
        ss: Double,
        ior: Double,
        thickness: Double,
        bezel: Double,
        surfaceKind: Int,
        version: Long
    ): Double

    /**
     * API 26-32 fallback: direct native C++ refraction + gradient tint + inner rim into [outBmp].
     */
    @JvmStatic
    external fun renderClockCpuFallback(
        alphaBmp: Bitmap,
        fieldBmp: Bitmap,
        wallBmp: Bitmap,
        outBmp: Bitmap,
        dstX: Float,
        dstY: Float,
        dstW: Float,
        dstH: Float,
        wallLeft: Float,
        wallTop: Float,
        wallScaleX: Float,
        wallScaleY: Float,
        maxAbsPx: Float,
        ss: Float,
        topColor: Int,
        botColor: Int,
        shadowOp: Float,
        shadowTopColor: Int,
        innerColor: Int,
        innerThick: Float,
        innerOp: Float,
        innerAngleDeg: Float,
        innerFade: Float
    ): Boolean

    /**
     * API 26-32 fallback: direct native C++ card Snell refraction + rim highlight into [outBmp].
     */
    @JvmStatic
    external fun renderCardCpuFallback(
        wallBmp: Bitmap,
        outBmp: Bitmap,
        cardX: Float,
        cardY: Float,
        cardW: Float,
        cardH: Float,
        radiusPx: Float,
        wallLeft: Float,

        wallScaleX: Float,
        wallScaleY: Float,
        bezelPx: Float,
        thickPx: Float,
        ior: Float,
        glassBgColor: Int,
        shadowInt: Float
    ): Boolean
`````

`````kotlin
package com.oclock.liquidglass

import android.animation.Animator

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.text.TextUtils
import android.util.TypedValue
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.VelocityTracker
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewConfiguration
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator
import android.view.animation.OvershootInterpolator
import android.view.animation.PathInterpolator
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.OverScroller
import android.widget.ScrollView
import android.widget.TextView
import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.roundToInt
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt

class NotificationCenterView(
    context: Context,
    private val hub: NotificationHub,
    private val backdrop: LiquidGlassShaders.BackdropState,
    private val perf: PerfMonitor,
    private val getRootShell: () -> View?,
    private val onDismissNotification: (LockNotification) -> Unit,
    private val onClearAll: () -> Unit,
    private val onCardTapped: (LockNotification) -> Unit,
    private val onRequestAccess: () -> Unit,
    private val onScrollExpandChanged: (Float) -> Unit,
    private val onDragMusicCoupling: (Float) -> Unit,
    private val onHaptic: (String) -> Unit
) : FrameLayout(context) {

    private val dens = resources.displayMetrics.density
    private val containerCol: LinearLayout
    private val headerRow: LinearLayout
    private val headerSpacer: View
    private val accessPill: TextView
    private val clearBtn: GlassClearCircleButton
    private val scrollView: RubberScrollView
    private val listCol: LinearLayout
    private val moreHintPill: GlassMoreHintPill
    private val dismissLayer: FrameLayout

    private val cardViews = HashMap<String, NotificationCardRow>()
    private var currentItems: List<LockNotification> = emptyList()
    private val targetItems = ArrayList<LockNotification>()
    private var lastBurstRevealMs = 0L
    private val burstDelayMs = 185L
    private var burstPending = false
    private val burstRunnable = Runnable { processNextBurstReveal() }
    var onDisplayedCountChanged: (() -> Unit)? = null

    var expandFrac = 0f
        private set
    var restingOffsetPx = 0f
        private set
    private var restingVisibleListH = (118f * dens).roundToInt()
    private var isLandscapeCompact = false
    private var expandAnim: ValueAnimator? = null
    private val iosEase = PathInterpolator(0.22f, 1f, 0.36f, 1f)

    // Smooth stacked promotion & swipe-react state
    private var activeSwipeIndex = -1
    private var swipePeekAdvance = 0f
    private var swipePeekAnim: ValueAnimator? = null
    private var deckShift = 0f
    private var heightCompOffset = 0f
    private var deckPromoteAnim: ValueAnimator? = null
    private var deckCycleProg = 0f
    private var deckCycleCommitting = false
    private var deckCycleAnim: ValueAnimator? = null
    private var expandGapShift = 0f
    private var expandGapStartIdx = Int.MAX_VALUE
    private var expandGapAnim: ValueAnimator? = null
    private var hidingOnEmpty = false

    var uiInk = Color.WHITE
    var uiDim = Color.argb(205, 255, 255, 255)
    var glassBg = Color.argb(26, 18, 22, 30)

    init {
        layoutDirection = LAYOUT_DIRECTION_LTR
        clipChildren = false
        clipToPadding = false
        visibility = GONE
        alpha = 0f

        containerCol = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            clipChildren = false
            clipToPadding = false
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
        }

        // Compact Header Row: Optional Permission Pill + Flexible Swipe Spacer + Circular "X" clear button
        headerRow = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            clipChildren = false
            clipToPadding = false
            setPadding((2f * dens).roundToInt(), 0, (2f * dens).roundToInt(), (5f * dens).roundToInt())
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
        }

        accessPill = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "تفعيل إشعارات الهاتف الحقيقية"
            setTextColor(Color.argb(236, 255, 255, 255))
            setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 11f)
            typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.BOLD)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding((11f * dens).roundToInt(), (4f * dens).roundToInt(), (11f * dens).roundToInt(), (4f * dens).roundToInt())
            background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                setColor(Color.argb(56, 18, 22, 32))
                cornerRadius = 999f
                setStroke((0.85f * dens).roundToInt(), Color.argb(85, 255, 255, 255))
            }
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT).apply {
                marginEnd = (8f * dens).roundToInt()
            }
            setOnClickListener { v ->
                onHaptic("pop")
                v.animate().cancel()
                v.scaleX = 0.90f; v.scaleY = 0.90f
                v.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(320L).setInterpolator(OvershootInterpolator(1.8f)).start()
                onRequestAccess()
            }
        }

        headerSpacer = View(context).apply {
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, (34f * dens).roundToInt(), 1f)
            var hDownX = 0f
            var hDownY = 0f
            var hLastY = 0f
            var hDragging = false
            var hStartExp = 0f
            var hVt: VelocityTracker? = null
            val hSlop = ViewConfiguration.get(context).scaledTouchSlop.toFloat()
            @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
            setOnTouchListener { _, ev ->
                val canExp = !isLandscapeCompact && currentItems.isNotEmpty() && restingOffsetPx > 14f * dens
                when (ev.actionMasked) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                        expandAnim?.cancel()
                        hDownX = ev.rawX
                        hDownY = ev.rawY
                        hLastY = ev.rawY
                        hDragging = false
                        hStartExp = expandFrac
                        hVt?.recycle()
                        hVt = VelocityTracker.obtain().also { tracker ->
                            val c = MotionEvent.obtain(ev)
                            c.offsetLocation(ev.rawX - ev.x, ev.rawY - ev.y)
                            tracker.addMovement(c)
                            c.recycle()
                        }
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                        hVt?.let { tracker ->
                            val c = MotionEvent.obtain(ev)
                            c.offsetLocation(ev.rawX - ev.x, ev.rawY - ev.y)
                            tracker.addMovement(c)
                            c.recycle()
                        }
                        val dx = ev.rawX - hDownX
                        val dy = ev.rawY - hDownY
                        if (!hDragging && abs(dy) > hSlop && abs(dy) > abs(dx) * 1.05f) {
                            if (expandFrac <= 0.001f && dy > 0f && canCycleDeck()) {
                                hDragging = true
                                prepareDeckCycleForTouch()
                                applyDeckCycleDelta(ev.rawY - hLastY)
                                hLastY = ev.rawY
                            } else if (canExp && ((dy < 0f && expandFrac < 0.999f) || (dy > 0f && expandFrac > 0.001f))) {
                                hDragging = true
                                val travel = max(220f * dens, restingOffsetPx)
                                applyExpandProgress((expandFrac + (-dy) / travel).coerceIn(0f, 1f))
                                hLastY = ev.rawY
                            }
                        } else if (hDragging) {
                            val stepDy = ev.rawY - hLastY
                            hLastY = ev.rawY
                            if (deckCycleProg > 0.001f || (expandFrac <= 0.001f && stepDy > 0f && canCycleDeck())) {
                                applyDeckCycleDelta(stepDy)
                            } else if (canExp) {
                                val travel = max(220f * dens, restingOffsetPx)
                                applyExpandProgress((expandFrac + (-stepDy) / travel).coerceIn(0f, 1f))
                            }
                        }
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                        hVt?.let { tracker ->
                            val c = MotionEvent.obtain(ev)
                            c.offsetLocation(ev.rawX - ev.x, ev.rawY - ev.y)
                            tracker.addMovement(c)
                            c.recycle()
                        }
                        hVt?.computeCurrentVelocity(1000)
                        val vy = hVt?.yVelocity ?: 0f
                        hVt?.recycle()
                        hVt = null
                        val netDy = ev.rawY - hDownY
                        if (deckCycleProg > 0.001f || (canCycleDeck() && expandFrac <= 0.001f && vy > 110f * dens && netDy > 6f * dens)) {
                            settleDeckCycle(netDy, vy, ev.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL)
                        } else if (canExp && (hDragging || (-vy > 110f * dens && -netDy > 6f * dens) || (vy > 110f * dens && netDy > 6f * dens))) {
                            settleExpandProgress(hStartExp, expandFrac, netDy, vy)
                        } else if (canExp && expandFrac > 0.002f && expandFrac < 0.995f) {
                            settleExpandProgress(hStartExp, expandFrac, netDy, vy)
                        }
                        hDragging = false
                        true
                    }
                    else -> false
                }
            }
        }

        val btnSz = (34f * dens).roundToInt()
        clearBtn = GlassClearCircleButton(context, backdrop, perf, getRootShell) {
            onHaptic("pop")
            animateClearCascade()
        }.apply {
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(btnSz, btnSz)
        }

        headerRow.addView(accessPill)
        headerRow.addView(headerSpacer)
        headerRow.addView(clearBtn)

        scrollView = RubberScrollView(context).apply {
            isVerticalScrollBarEnabled = false
            overScrollMode = OVER_SCROLL_NEVER
            clipChildren = false
            clipToPadding = false
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f)
            onPullOverscroll = { pullDy -> onDragMusicCoupling(pullDy) }
            onRubberChanged = { updateCard3DAndPeek() }
            onInteractionStart = {
                expandAnim?.cancel()
                prepareDeckCycleForTouch()
            }
            getExpandTravelPx = { max(220f * dens, restingOffsetPx) }
            canCycleDeckFn = { canCycleDeck() }
            isCyclingFn = { deckCycleProg > 0.001f }
            onDeckCycleDeltaFn = { dyPx -> applyDeckCycleDelta(dyPx) }
            onDeckCycleReleaseFn = { netDy, vy, cancelled -> settleDeckCycle(netDy, vy, cancelled) }
        }
        scrollView.setOnScrollChangeListener { _, _, _, _, _ ->
            updateCard3DAndPeek()
        }
        scrollView.addOnLayoutChangeListener { _, _, top, _, bot, _, oTop, _, oBot ->
            if ((bot - top) != (oBot - oTop)) {
                scrollView.post {
                    updateCard3DAndPeek()
                    updateMoreHintPill()
                }
            }
        }

        listCol = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            clipChildren = false
            clipToPadding = false
            setPadding(0, (2f * dens).roundToInt(), 0, (240f * dens).roundToInt())
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
        }
        listCol.addOnLayoutChangeListener { _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _ ->
            updateCard3DAndPeek()
            updateMoreHintPill()
        }
        scrollView.addView(listCol)

        moreHintPill = GlassMoreHintPill(context, backdrop, perf, getRootShell) {
            onHaptic("pop")
            animateExpandTo(1f)
        }.apply {
            translationZ = 24f * dens
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, (25f * dens).roundToInt(), Gravity.TOP or Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL)
            visibility = GONE
        }

        dismissLayer = FrameLayout(context).apply {
            clipChildren = false
            clipToPadding = false
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
        }

        containerCol.addView(headerRow)
        containerCol.addView(scrollView)
        addView(containerCol)
        addView(moreHintPill)
        addView(dismissLayer)
        refreshPermissionBadge()
    }

    fun displayedCount(): Int = currentItems.size

    fun configureLayoutBounds(
        expandedTopPx: Int,
        restingTopPx: Int,
        fullHeightPx: Int,
        landscapeCompact: Boolean,
        preserveCurrentOffset: Boolean = false
    ) {
        isLandscapeCompact = landscapeCompact
        val targetResting = if (landscapeCompact) 0f else max(0f, (restingTopPx - expandedTopPx).toFloat())
        if (!preserveCurrentOffset || landscapeCompact) {
            restingOffsetPx = targetResting
        }
        val headerEst = headerHeightEstimatePx()
        restingVisibleListH = max((90f * dens).roundToInt(), fullHeightPx - targetResting.roundToInt() - headerEst)
        if (landscapeCompact) {
            expandFrac = 0f
            containerCol.translationY = 0f
        } else {
            containerCol.translationY = restingOffsetPx * (1f - expandFrac)
        }
        scrollView.setExpandCallbacks(
            canExpand = { !landscapeCompact && currentItems.isNotEmpty() && restingOffsetPx > 14f * dens },
            getExpand = { expandFrac },
            setExpand = { f -> applyExpandProgress(f) },
            onRelease = { startF, curF, netDy, vy -> settleExpandProgress(startF, curF, netDy, vy) }
        )
        post {
            updateCard3DAndPeek()
            updateMoreHintPill()
        }
    }

    fun setAnimatedRestingOffset(offsetPx: Float) {
        if (isLandscapeCompact) return
        restingOffsetPx = max(0f, offsetPx)
        containerCol.translationY = restingOffsetPx * (1f - expandFrac)
        updateCard3DAndPeek()
        updateMoreHintPill()
    }

    fun collapseScrollIfExpanded() {
        if (expandFrac > 0.02f) {
            scrollView.smoothScrollToTop()
            animateExpandTo(0f)
        }
    }

    private fun headerHeightEstimatePx(): Int {
        return headerRow.height.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: (40f * dens).roundToInt()
    }

    private fun applyExpandProgress(frac: Float) {
        val clamped = frac.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        if (abs(clamped - expandFrac) < 0.0004f) return
        expandFrac = clamped
        // Strict 1:1 linear mapping with expandFrac so slow finger drags never jump ahead!
        containerCol.translationY = restingOffsetPx * (1f - expandFrac)
        onScrollExpandChanged(expandFrac)
        updateCard3DAndPeek()
        updateMoreHintPill()
        scrollView.invalidate()
    }

    private fun settleExpandProgress(startFrac: Float, curFrac: Float, netTotalDyPx: Float, vyPxPerSec: Float) {
        val travel = max(220f * dens, restingOffsetPx)
        val lightSwipePx = 18f * dens
        val target = if (startFrac < 0.50f) {
            // Opening from stacked rest: support fast vertical flick, light short swipe (>= 18dp up), or long drag
            when {
                vyPxPerSec < -105f * dens -> 1f
                vyPxPerSec > 210f * dens -> 0f
                -netTotalDyPx >= lightSwipePx || curFrac >= 0.22f -> 1f
                else -> 0f
            }
        } else {
            // Collapsing from expanded list: support fast vertical flick down, light short swipe (>= 18dp down at top), or long drag
            val collapsedPx = (startFrac - curFrac) * travel
            when {
                vyPxPerSec > 105f * dens -> 0f
                vyPxPerSec < -210f * dens -> 1f
                collapsedPx >= lightSwipePx || netTotalDyPx >= lightSwipePx || curFrac <= 0.65f -> 0f
                else -> 1f
            }
        }
        animateExpandTo(target, vyPxPerSec)
    }

    fun animateExpandTo(target: Float, vyPxPerSec: Float = 0f) {
        expandAnim?.cancel()
        val start = expandFrac
        val dist = abs(target - start)
        if (dist < 0.006f) {
            applyExpandProgress(target)
            return
        }
        val speedBoost = (abs(vyPxPerSec) / (2800f * dens)).coerceIn(0f, 0.38f)
        val dur = ((260f + 260f * dist) * (1f - speedBoost)).roundToInt().toLong().coerceIn(220L, 500L)
        expandAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(start, target).apply {
            duration = dur
            interpolator = iosEase
            addUpdateListener { a ->
                applyExpandProgress((a.animatedValue as Float).coerceIn(0f, 1f))
            }
            start()
        }
    }

    fun refreshPermissionBadge() {
        accessPill.visibility = if (hub.hasNotificationAccess()) GONE else VISIBLE
    }

    fun applyTheme(ink: Int, dim: Int, gBg: Int) {
        uiInk = ink
        uiDim = dim
        glassBg = gBg
        clearBtn.uiInk = ink
        clearBtn.glassBg = gBg
        clearBtn.invalidate()
        moreHintPill.applyTheme(ink, gBg)
        for (i in 0 until listCol.childCount) {
            (listCol.getChildAt(i) as? NotificationCardRow)?.applyTheme(ink, dim, gBg)
        }
        invalidate()
    }

    fun nudgeFromMusic() {
        if (visibility != VISIBLE || currentItems.isEmpty() || expandFrac > 0.35f) return
        containerCol.animate().cancel()
        val baseTy = restingOffsetPx * (1f - expandFrac)
        containerCol.translationY = baseTy + 4.5f * dens
        containerCol.animate()
            .translationY(baseTy)
            .setDuration(420L)
            .setInterpolator(OvershootInterpolator(1.75f))
            .setUpdateListener { updateMoreHintPill() }
            .start()
    }

    fun invalidateCards() {
        clearBtn.invalidate()
        moreHintPill.invalidate()
        for (i in 0 until listCol.childCount) {
            listCol.getChildAt(i)?.invalidate()
        }
        for (i in 0 until dismissLayer.childCount) {
            dismissLayer.getChildAt(i)?.invalidate()
        }
    }

    private fun checkHideWhenEmpty() {
        if (currentItems.isEmpty() && !hidingOnEmpty && dismissLayer.childCount == 0) {
            visibility = GONE
        }
    }

    private fun handleRowSwipeProgress(row: NotificationCardRow, dragFrac: Float) {
        onDragMusicCoupling(-abs(dragFrac) * 3.5f * dens)
        if (!isLandscapeCompact && expandFrac < 0.35f) {
            val idx = listCol.indexOfChild(row)
            if (idx >= 0) {
                swipePeekAnim?.cancel()
                activeSwipeIndex = idx
                swipePeekAdvance = (dragFrac * 0.56f).coerceIn(0f, 0.56f)
                updateCard3DAndPeek()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun handleRowSwipeCancel(row: NotificationCardRow) {
        onDragMusicCoupling(0f)
        val idx = listCol.indexOfChild(row)
        if (activeSwipeIndex == idx && swipePeekAdvance > 0.005f) {
            swipePeekAnim?.cancel()
            val startAdv = swipePeekAdvance
            swipePeekAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(startAdv, 0f).apply {
                duration = 380L
                interpolator = OvershootInterpolator(1.25f)
                addUpdateListener { a ->
                    swipePeekAdvance = a.animatedValue as Float
                    updateCard3DAndPeek()
                }
                addListener(object : AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
                    override fun onAnimationEnd(animation: Animator) {
                        swipePeekAdvance = 0f
                        activeSwipeIndex = -1
                        updateCard3DAndPeek()
                    }
                })
                start()
            }
        } else {
            activeSwipeIndex = -1
            swipePeekAdvance = 0f
        }
    }

    private fun detachAndDismissRow(row: NotificationCardRow, cur: LockNotification, dir: Float, vx: Float) {
        val idx = listCol.indexOfChild(row)
        val stackedMode = !isLandscapeCompact && expandFrac < 0.35f
        val curLeft = row.left
        val curTop = (containerCol.translationY + scrollView.top + row.top - scrollView.scrollY + scrollView.rubberBotY + row.translationY).roundToInt()
        val curW = max(1, row.width)
        val curH = max(1, row.height)

        if (idx >= 0) {
            val nextRow = listCol.getChildAt(idx + 1) as? NotificationCardRow
            if (stackedMode) {
                val advanceUsed = if (activeSwipeIndex == idx) swipePeekAdvance else 0f
                swipePeekAnim?.cancel()
                swipePeekAdvance = 0f
                activeSwipeIndex = -1

                val heightDiff = if (idx == 0 && nextRow != null && nextRow.height > 0) {
                    (curH - nextRow.height).toFloat()
                } else 0f

                if (nextRow != null || currentItems.size > 1) {
                    deckPromoteAnim?.cancel()
                    val startShift = (deckShift + (1f - advanceUsed)).coerceIn(0f, 3.0f)
                    val startComp = heightCompOffset + heightDiff
                    deckShift = startShift
                    heightCompOffset = startComp
                    deckPromoteAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f).apply {
                        duration = 460L
                        interpolator = OvershootInterpolator(1.12f)
                        addUpdateListener { a ->
                            val t = a.animatedValue as Float
                            deckShift = startShift * (1f - t)
                            heightCompOffset = startComp * (1f - t)
                            updateCard3DAndPeek()
                            updateMoreHintPill()
                        }
                        addListener(object : AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
                            override fun onAnimationEnd(animation: Animator) {
                                deckShift = 0f
                                heightCompOffset = 0f
                                updateCard3DAndPeek()
                                updateMoreHintPill()
                            }
                        })
                        start()
                    }
                }
            } else {
                swipePeekAnim?.cancel()
                swipePeekAdvance = 0f
                activeSwipeIndex = -1
                if (nextRow != null) {
                    expandGapAnim?.cancel()
                    val startGap = expandGapShift + curH.toFloat() + 8f * dens
                    expandGapStartIdx = idx
                    expandGapShift = startGap
                    expandGapAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(startGap, 0f).apply {
                        duration = 340L
                        interpolator = iosEase
                        addUpdateListener { a ->
                            expandGapShift = a.animatedValue as Float
                            updateCard3DAndPeek()
                        }
                        addListener(object : AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
                            override fun onAnimationEnd(animation: Animator) {
                                expandGapShift = 0f
                                expandGapStartIdx = Int.MAX_VALUE
                                updateCard3DAndPeek()
                            }
                        })
                        start()
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Move dismissing card into unclipped dismissLayer at exact visual coordinates so cards behind never shift via lp.height!
        cardViews.remove(cur.id)
        listCol.removeView(row)
        row.isDismissing = true
        row.isClickable = false
        row.isFocusable = false
        row.translationY = 0f
        row.translationZ = 40f * dens
        dismissLayer.addView(
            row,
            LayoutParams(curW, curH).apply {
                leftMargin = curLeft
                topMargin = curTop
            }
        )

        val speedBoost = (abs(vx) / (3200f * dens)).coerceIn(0f, 0.35f)
        val dur = (275f * (1f - speedBoost * 0.42f)).roundToInt().toLong().coerceIn(190L, 285L)
        val targetTx = dir * max(280f, curW.toFloat()) * (0.50f + speedBoost * 0.14f)
        val targetTy = if (stackedMode) -10f * dens else -4f * dens

        row.animate().cancel()
        row.pivotX = curW * 0.5f
        row.pivotY = curH * 0.5f
        row.animate()
            .translationX(targetTx)
            .translationY(targetTy)
            .rotationY(dir * 16f)
            .rotation(dir * 3.4f)
            .scaleX(0.82f)
            .scaleY(0.82f)
            .alpha(0f)
            .setDuration(dur)
            .setInterpolator(iosEase)
            .setUpdateListener { row.invalidate() }
            .withEndAction {
                dismissLayer.removeView(row)
                checkHideWhenEmpty()
            }
            .start()

        onDismissNotification(cur)
    }

    fun setNotifications(items: List<LockNotification>, added: LockNotification?, removedId: String?) {
        refreshPermissionBadge()
        targetItems.clear()
        targetItems.addAll(items)

        if (items.isEmpty()) {
            removeCallbacks(burstRunnable)
            burstPending = false
            expandFrac = 0f
            swipePeekAnim?.cancel()
            deckPromoteAnim?.cancel()
            deckCycleAnim?.cancel()
            deckCycleProg = 0f
            deckCycleCommitting = false
            expandGapAnim?.cancel()
            swipePeekAdvance = 0f
            activeSwipeIndex = -1
            deckShift = 0f
            heightCompOffset = 0f
            expandGapShift = 0f
            expandGapStartIdx = Int.MAX_VALUE
            onScrollExpandChanged(0f)
            moreHintPill.visibility = GONE
            currentItems = emptyList()
            cardViews.clear()
            listCol.removeAllViews()
            if (visibility == VISIBLE) {
                hidingOnEmpty = true
                val baseTy = restingOffsetPx * (1f - expandFrac)
                containerCol.animate().cancel()
                containerCol.animate()
                    .alpha(0f)
                    .translationY(baseTy + 18f * dens)
                    .scaleX(0.95f)
                    .scaleY(0.95f)
                    .setDuration(240L)
                    .setInterpolator(iosEase)
                    .withEndAction {
                        hidingOnEmpty = false
                        if (currentItems.isEmpty()) {
                            containerCol.translationY = restingOffsetPx * (1f - expandFrac)
                            containerCol.scaleX = 1f
                            containerCol.scaleY = 1f
                            containerCol.alpha = 1f
                            checkHideWhenEmpty()
                        }
                    }
                    .start()
            }
            return
        }

        // Remove dismissed/missing rows immediately from displayed set
        val nextIdSet = items.mapTo(HashSet()) { it.id }
        val filteredDisplayed = ArrayList<LockNotification>(items.size)
        for (item in items) {
            if (currentItems.any { it.id == item.id } && item.id != removedId) {
                filteredDisplayed.add(item)
            }
        }
        if (removedId != null) {
            cardViews.remove(removedId)?.let { row ->
                if (!row.isDismissing) listCol.removeView(row)
            }
        }
        for (id in cardViews.keys.toList()) {
            if (id !in nextIdSet) {
                cardViews.remove(id)?.let { row ->
                    if (!row.isDismissing) listCol.removeView(row)
                }
            }
        }

        val pendingNew = items.filter { item -> filteredDisplayed.none { it.id == item.id } }

        if (pendingNew.isEmpty() && removedId == null && currentItems.size == items.size &&
            currentItems.mapTo(HashSet()) { it.id } == nextIdSet
        ) {
            // Preserve the user's rotated 3D deck order while updating notification counts/text in place
            val byId = items.associateBy { it.id }
            val ordered = currentItems.mapNotNull { byId[it.id] }
            commitDisplayedList(ordered, animateAddedId = null, seedEntrance = false)
            return
        }

        // Initial seed / unhidden restore with multiple existing cards -> show together with gentle slot-staggered reveal
        if (added == null && filteredDisplayed.isEmpty() && pendingNew.size > 1) {
            removeCallbacks(burstRunnable)
            burstPending = false
            lastBurstRevealMs = SystemClock.uptimeMillis()
            commitDisplayedList(items, animateAddedId = null, seedEntrance = true)
            return
        }

        if (pendingNew.isNotEmpty()) {
            deckCycleAnim?.cancel()
            deckCycleProg = 0f
            deckCycleCommitting = false
            val now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis()
            val elapsed = now - lastBurstRevealMs
            if (filteredDisplayed.isEmpty() || elapsed >= burstDelayMs) {
                removeCallbacks(burstRunnable)
                burstPending = false
                val nextReveal = if (pendingNew.size > 1) pendingNew.last() else pendingNew.first()
                val revealIds = filteredDisplayed.mapTo(HashSet()) { it.id }.apply { add(nextReveal.id) }
                val nextDisplay = items.filter { it.id in revealIds }
                lastBurstRevealMs = now
                commitDisplayedList(nextDisplay, animateAddedId = nextReveal.id, seedEntrance = false)
                if (pendingNew.size > 1) {
                    burstPending = true
                    postDelayed(burstRunnable, burstDelayMs)
                }
            } else {
                // Rebind already-visible rows while waiting cleanly for the next one-after-another entrance slot
                commitDisplayedList(filteredDisplayed, animateAddedId = null, seedEntrance = false)
                if (!burstPending) {
                    burstPending = true
                    val waitMs = (burstDelayMs - elapsed).coerceIn(45L, burstDelayMs)
                    postDelayed(burstRunnable, waitMs)
                }
            }
            return
        }

        commitDisplayedList(items, animateAddedId = null, seedEntrance = false)
    }

    private fun processNextBurstReveal() {
        burstPending = false
        if (targetItems.isEmpty()) return
        val existingIds = currentItems.mapTo(HashSet()) { it.id }
        val pendingNew = targetItems.filter { it.id !in existingIds }
        if (pendingNew.isEmpty()) return

        val nextReveal = if (pendingNew.size > 1) pendingNew.last() else pendingNew.first()
        val revealIds = HashSet(existingIds).apply { add(nextReveal.id) }
        val nextDisplay = targetItems.filter { it.id in revealIds }
        lastBurstRevealMs = SystemClock.uptimeMillis()
        commitDisplayedList(nextDisplay, animateAddedId = nextReveal.id, seedEntrance = false)
        onDisplayedCountChanged?.invoke()
        if (pendingNew.size > 1) {
            burstPending = true
            postDelayed(burstRunnable, burstDelayMs)
        }
    }

    private fun commitDisplayedList(
        displayItems: List<LockNotification>,
        animateAddedId: String?,
        seedEntrance: Boolean
    ) {
        if (animateAddedId == null && !seedEntrance && visibility == VISIBLE && !hidingOnEmpty &&
            displayItems.size == currentItems.size && displayItems.isNotEmpty() &&
            displayItems.indices.all { displayItems[it].id == currentItems[it].id && displayItems[it].count == currentItems[it].count }
        ) {
            currentItems = displayItems
            for (item in displayItems) {
                cardViews[item.id]?.bind(item, hub)
            }
            updateMoreHintPill()
            return
        }

        val prevCount = currentItems.size
        currentItems = displayItems

        if (visibility != VISIBLE || prevCount == 0 || hidingOnEmpty) {
            hidingOnEmpty = false
            visibility = VISIBLE
            containerCol.animate().cancel()
            containerCol.alpha = 1f
            containerCol.scaleX = 1f
            containerCol.scaleY = 1f
            containerCol.translationY = restingOffsetPx * (1f - expandFrac)
            animate().cancel()
            alpha = 0f
            translationY = 26f * dens
            scaleX = 0.94f
            scaleY = 0.94f
            animate()
                .alpha(1f)
                .translationY(0f)
                .scaleX(1f)
                .scaleY(1f)
                .setDuration(420L)
                .setInterpolator(OvershootInterpolator(1.22f))
                .withEndAction(null)
                .start()
        }

        val addedIndex = if (animateAddedId != null) displayItems.indexOfFirst { it.id == animateAddedId } else -1
        if (animateAddedId != null && prevCount > 0 && addedIndex == 0 && !isLandscapeCompact) {
            if (expandFrac < 0.35f) {
                deckPromoteAnim?.cancel()
                val startShift = (-1f + min(0f, deckShift)).coerceAtLeast(-2.0f)
                deckShift = startShift
                deckPromoteAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(startShift, 0f).apply {
                    duration = 380L
                    interpolator = iosEase
                    addUpdateListener { a ->
                        deckShift = a.animatedValue as Float
                        updateCard3DAndPeek()
                    }
                    addListener(object : AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
                        override fun onAnimationEnd(animation: Animator) {
                            deckShift = 0f
                            updateCard3DAndPeek()
                        }
                    })
                    start()
                }
            } else {
                expandGapAnim?.cancel()
                val firstExistingH = ((listCol.getChildAt(0) as? NotificationCardRow)?.cardHeightEstimate() ?: (68f * dens)) + 8f * dens
                expandGapStartIdx = 1
                expandGapShift = -firstExistingH
                expandGapAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(-firstExistingH, 0f).apply {
                    duration = 360L
                    interpolator = iosEase
                    addUpdateListener { a ->
                        expandGapShift = a.animatedValue as Float
                        updateCard3DAndPeek()
                    }
                    addListener(object : AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
                        override fun onAnimationEnd(animation: Animator) {
                            expandGapShift = 0f
                            expandGapStartIdx = Int.MAX_VALUE
                            updateCard3DAndPeek()
                        }
                    })
                    start()
                }
            }
        }

        val nextIds = displayItems.mapTo(HashSet()) { it.id }
        for (id in cardViews.keys.toList()) {
            if (id !in nextIds) {
                cardViews.remove(id)?.let { row ->
                    if (!row.isDismissing) listCol.removeView(row)
                }
            }
        }

        val existingById = HashMap<String, NotificationCardRow>(cardViews)
        listCol.removeAllViews()
        cardViews.clear()

        for ((index, item) in displayItems.withIndex()) {
            val row = existingById[item.id]?.also { it.bind(item, hub) }
                ?: NotificationCardRow(
                    context = context,
                    hub = hub,
                    backdrop = backdrop,
                    perf = perf,
                    getRootShell = getRootShell,
                    onSwipeProgress = { r, frac ->
                        handleRowSwipeProgress(r, frac)
                    },
                    onSwipeCancel = { r ->
                        handleRowSwipeCancel(r)
                    },
                    onDismiss = { r, dismissed, dir, vx ->
                        detachAndDismissRow(r, dismissed, dir, vx)
                    },
                    onTap = { tapped ->
                        onCardTapped(tapped)
                    },
                    onPressCancelled = {
                        updateCard3DAndPeek()
                    },
                    onEntranceFrame = {
                        updateCard3DAndPeek()
                    },
                    onHaptic = onHaptic
                ).apply {
                    bind(item, hub)
                    applyTheme(uiInk, uiDim, glassBg)
                }

            row.visibility = VISIBLE
            cardViews[item.id] = row
            listCol.addView(row)

            if (animateAddedId != null && item.id == animateAddedId) {
                row.playEntrance3D(delayMs = 0L)
            } else if ((seedEntrance || prevCount == 0) && index < 3) {
                row.playEntrance3D(delayMs = (index * 85L).coerceAtMost(170L))
            }
        }

        updateCard3DAndPeek()
        post {
            updateCard3DAndPeek()
            updateMoreHintPill()
        }
    }

    private fun updateMoreHintPill() {
        val hiddenCount = currentItems.size - 1
        if (isLandscapeCompact || hiddenCount <= 0 || expandFrac > 0.24f) {
            moreHintPill.visibility = GONE
            return
        }
        val firstRow = listCol.getChildAt(0)
        val firstBot = (if (firstRow != null && firstRow.height > 0) firstRow.bottom.toFloat() else (70f * dens)) + heightCompOffset
        val peekSpan = if (currentItems.size >= 3) 20f * dens else 11f * dens
        val stackBotInContainer = scrollView.top.toFloat() + firstBot + peekSpan
        val cycleArcYield = sin(deckCycleProg.coerceIn(0f, 1f) * PI).toFloat() * 14f * dens
        moreHintPill.visibility = VISIBLE
        moreHintPill.translationY = containerCol.translationY + stackBotInContainer + 4f * dens + cycleArcYield
        moreHintPill.alpha = (1f - expandFrac * 4.5f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        moreHintPill.setCount(hiddenCount)
        moreHintPill.invalidate()
    }

    private fun canCycleDeck(): Boolean =
        !isLandscapeCompact && expandFrac < 0.02f && currentItems.size > 1 && scrollView.scrollY <= 0

    private fun prepareDeckCycleForTouch() {
        if (deckCycleCommitting) {
            deckCycleAnim?.cancel()
            rotateFrontCardToBack()
            deckCycleProg = 0f
            deckCycleCommitting = false
            updateCard3DAndPeek()
            updateMoreHintPill()
        } else if (deckCycleAnim?.isRunning == true) {
            deckCycleAnim?.cancel()
        }
    }

    private fun applyDeckCycleDelta(dyPx: Float) {
        if (!canCycleDeck()) return
        val stride = max(64f * dens, 88f * dens)
        deckCycleProg = (deckCycleProg + dyPx / stride).coerceIn(0f, 1.08f)
        if (deckCycleProg > 0.001f) {
            onDragMusicCoupling(sin(deckCycleProg.coerceIn(0f, 1f) * PI).toFloat() * 8f * dens)
        } else {
            onDragMusicCoupling(0f)
        }
        updateCard3DAndPeek()
        updateMoreHintPill()
    }

    private fun rotateFrontCardToBack() {
        if (currentItems.size <= 1 || listCol.childCount <= 1) return
        val rotated = ArrayList<LockNotification>(currentItems.size)
        for (i in 1 until currentItems.size) rotated.add(currentItems[i])
        rotated.add(currentItems[0])
        currentItems = rotated

        val frontRow = listCol.getChildAt(0)
        if (frontRow != null) {
            listCol.removeViewAt(0)
            listCol.addView(frontRow)
        }
    }

    private fun settleDeckCycle(netTotalDyPx: Float, vyPxPerSec: Float, cancelled: Boolean = false) {
        onDragMusicCoupling(0f)
        if (!canCycleDeck()) {
            deckCycleProg = 0f
            deckCycleCommitting = false
            updateCard3DAndPeek()
            updateMoreHintPill()
            return
        }
        val shouldCommit = !cancelled && (
            (vyPxPerSec > 110f * dens && netTotalDyPx > 6f * dens) ||
                deckCycleProg >= 0.24f ||
                netTotalDyPx >= 22f * dens
            )
        deckCycleAnim?.cancel()
        val startP = deckCycleProg.coerceIn(0f, 1.08f)
        if (shouldCommit) {
            onHaptic("tick")
            deckCycleCommitting = true
            val speedBoost = (abs(vyPxPerSec) / (2600f * dens)).coerceIn(0f, 0.35f)
            val dur = ((1f - startP.coerceAtMost(0.95f)) * 360f * (1f - speedBoost)).roundToInt().toLong().coerceIn(190L, 380L)
            deckCycleAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(startP, 1f).apply {
                duration = dur
                interpolator = iosEase
                addUpdateListener { a ->
                    deckCycleProg = a.animatedValue as Float
                    updateCard3DAndPeek()
                    updateMoreHintPill()
                }
                addListener(object : AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
                    override fun onAnimationEnd(animation: Animator) {
                        if (deckCycleCommitting) {
                            rotateFrontCardToBack()
                            deckCycleProg = 0f
                            deckCycleCommitting = false
                            updateCard3DAndPeek()
                            updateMoreHintPill()
                        }
                    }
                })
                start()
            }
        } else {
            deckCycleCommitting = false
            deckCycleAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(startP, 0f).apply {
                duration = 280L
                interpolator = OvershootInterpolator(1.25f)
                addUpdateListener { a ->
                    deckCycleProg = a.animatedValue as Float
                    updateCard3DAndPeek()
                    updateMoreHintPill()
                }
                addListener(object : AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
                    override fun onAnimationEnd(animation: Animator) {
                        deckCycleProg = 0f
                        updateCard3DAndPeek()
                        updateMoreHintPill()
                    }
                })
                start()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun sampleDeckSlot(slot: Float): FloatArray {
        // Returns [peekPx, scale, rotX, alpha, transZ] with C1 smoothstep transitions across all slots
        return when {
            slot <= 0f -> {
                val s = slot.coerceAtLeast(-0.08f)
                floatArrayOf(s * 14f * dens, 1f - s * 0.08f, 0f, 1f, 32f * dens)
            }
            slot <= 1f -> {
                val t = slot
                val st = t * t * (3f - 2f * t)
                floatArrayOf(
                    11f * dens * st,
                    1f + (0.945f - 1f) * st,
                    -4f * st,
                    1f + (0.88f - 1f) * st,
                    (32f + (20f - 32f) * st) * dens
                )
            }
            slot <= 2f -> {
                val t = slot - 1f
                val st = t * t * (3f - 2f * t)
                floatArrayOf(
                    (11f + (20f - 11f) * st) * dens,
                    0.945f + (0.89f - 0.945f) * st,
                    -4f + (-7f - (-4f)) * st,
                    0.88f + (0.60f - 0.88f) * st,
                    (20f + (11f - 20f) * st) * dens
                )
            }
            slot <= 3f -> {
                val t = slot - 2f
                val st = t * t * (3f - 2f * t)
                floatArrayOf(
                    (20f + (22f - 20f) * st) * dens,
                    0.89f + (0.85f - 0.89f) * st,
                    -7f + (-9f - (-7f)) * st,
                    0.60f * (1f - st),
                    (11f + (4f - 11f) * st) * dens
                )
            }
            else -> floatArrayOf(22f * dens, 0.85f, -9f, 0f, 2f * dens)
        }
    }

    private fun updateCard3DAndPeek() {
        val count = listCol.childCount
        if (count == 0) return

        val svW = scrollView.width
        val svH = scrollView.height
        if (svW <= 0 || svH <= 0) return

        val visH = max(1f, svH.toFloat())
        val scrollY = scrollView.scrollY.toFloat()
        val rubberY = scrollView.rubberBotY
        val firstRow = listCol.getChildAt(0)
        val firstBot = (if (firstRow != null && firstRow.height > 0) firstRow.bottom.toFloat() else (70f * dens)) + heightCompOffset
        val topBand = 70f * dens
        val botBand = 88f * dens

        for (i in 0 until count) {
            val row = listCol.getChildAt(i) as? NotificationCardRow ?: continue
            if (row.isDismissing || row.isDragging) continue

            // Continuous C1 slot evaluation: handles rest stacking, live swipe-peek advance, smooth promotion/demotion, and unfolding!
            var restSc = 1f
            var restTy = 0f
            var restRx = 0f
            var restAlpha = 1f
            var restZ = 22f * dens
            var pivotRatioY = 0.5f

            if (!isLandscapeCompact) {
                val cycling = count > 1 && expandFrac < 0.05f && deckCycleProg > 0.001f
                if (cycling && i == 0) {
                    // Front card smoothly swings down-and-back in 3D behind the advancing card into the back slot
                    val p = deckCycleProg.coerceIn(0f, 1.08f)
                    val easeP = p.coerceIn(0f, 1f).let { it * it * (3f - 2f * it) }
                    val swing = sin(p.coerceIn(0f, 1f) * PI).toFloat()
                    val destSlot = min(count - 1, 3).toFloat()
                    val destVal = sampleDeckSlot(destSlot)
                    val destPeek = destVal[0]
                    val destScale = destVal[1]
                    val destRx = destVal[2]
                    val destAlpha = destVal[3]
                    val destZ = destVal[4]

                    val rowH = if (row.height > 0) row.height.toFloat() else row.cardHeightEstimate()
                    val destCollapsedTy = if (row.top > 0 || i == 0) {
                        (firstBot - rowH + destPeek) - row.top.toFloat()
                    } else {
                        -row.cardHeightEstimate() * min(count - 1, 3) * 0.85f
                    }
                    restSc = (1f + (destScale - 1f) * easeP) - 0.055f * swing
                    restTy = destCollapsedTy * easeP + (26f * dens) * swing
                    restRx = destRx * easeP - 17f * swing
                    restAlpha = (1f + (destAlpha - 1f) * easeP) * (1f - 0.16f * swing)
                    restZ = when {
                        p < 0.36f -> 34f * dens
                        p < 0.52f -> {
                            val zt = (p - 0.36f) / 0.16f
                            (34f * (1f - zt) + 2f * zt) * dens
                        }
                        else -> {
                            val zt = (p - 0.52f) / 0.48f
                            (2f + (destZ / dens - 2f) * zt) * dens
                        }
                    }
                    pivotRatioY = 0.42f
                } else {
                    val swipeBoost = if (activeSwipeIndex in 0 until i && expandFrac < 0.35f) swipePeekAdvance else 0f
                    val cycleAdvance = if (cycling && i >= 1) deckCycleProg.coerceIn(0f, 1.05f) else 0f
                    val effSlot = if (expandFrac < 0.35f) {
                        val shifted = when {
                            deckShift < -0.001f -> if (i == 0) 0f else max(0f, i.toFloat() + deckShift)
                            else -> i.toFloat() + deckShift
                        }
                        val base = max(0f, shifted - swipeBoost - cycleAdvance)
                        if (activeSwipeIndex >= 0 && i > activeSwipeIndex) max(activeSwipeIndex.toFloat(), base) else base
                    } else {
                        i.toFloat()
                    }

                    if (effSlot > 0.001f || effSlot < -0.001f || expandFrac < 0.999f) {
                        val slotVal = sampleDeckSlot(effSlot)
                        val dPeek = slotVal[0]
                        val dScale = slotVal[1]
                        val dRx = slotVal[2]
                        val dAlpha = slotVal[3]
                        val dZ = slotVal[4]

                        val staggerIdx = max(0, effSlot.roundToInt() - 1).coerceAtMost(4)
                        val staggerStart = staggerIdx * 0.045f
                        val staggerSpan = max(0.35f, 1f - staggerStart * 0.72f)
                        val cardP = if (effSlot <= 0.001f) {
                            expandFrac.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                        } else {
                            ((expandFrac - staggerStart) / staggerSpan).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                        }
                        val unfold = cardP * cardP * (3f - 2f * cardP)
                        val closed = 1f - unfold

                        val rowH = if (row.height > 0) row.height.toFloat() else row.cardHeightEstimate()
                        val collapsedTy = if (row.top > 0 || i == 0) {
                            (firstBot - rowH + dPeek) - row.top.toFloat()
                        } else {
                            -row.cardHeightEstimate() * min(i, 4) * 0.85f
                        }

                        restSc = dScale + (1f - dScale) * unfold
                        restTy = collapsedTy * closed
                        restRx = dRx * closed
                        restAlpha = if (effSlot >= 2.2f) {
                            val revealP = ((cardP - 0.10f) / 0.52f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                            val openAlpha = revealP * revealP * (3f - 2f * revealP)
                            dAlpha + (openAlpha - dAlpha) * unfold
                        } else {
                            dAlpha + (1f - dAlpha) * unfold
                        }
                        restZ = dZ * closed + (18f * dens) * unfold
                        if (closed > 0.08f && effSlot > 0.1f) pivotRatioY = 0.35f
                    } else {
                        restZ = 18f * dens
                    }

                    if (expandFrac >= 0.35f && abs(expandGapShift) > 0.5f && i >= expandGapStartIdx) {
                        restTy += expandGapShift
                    }
                }
            }

            // Gentle 3D depth barrel carousel while scrolling expanded viewport
            val cardTop = row.top - scrollY + rubberY
            val cardBot = row.bottom - scrollY + rubberY
            var scrSc = 1f
            var scrTy = 0f
            var scrRx = 0f
            var scrAlpha = 1f

            if (expandFrac > 0.82f) {
                val active3D = ((expandFrac - 0.82f) / 0.18f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                if (cardTop < topBand && (scrollY > 1f || rubberY < -2f)) {
                    val tf = ((topBand - cardTop) / max(1f, row.height + topBand)).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                    val easeT = tf * tf * (3f - 2f * tf)
                    scrSc = 1f - 0.09f * easeT * active3D
                    scrRx = 14f * easeT * active3D
                    scrTy = 5f * dens * easeT * active3D
                    scrAlpha = 1f - 0.72f * easeT * active3D
                    pivotRatioY = 0.80f
                    restZ *= (1f - 0.45f * easeT * active3D)
                } else if (cardBot > visH - botBand && cardTop < visH) {
                    val bf = ((cardBot - (visH - botBand)) / max(1f, row.height + botBand)).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                    val easeB = bf * bf * (3f - 2f * bf)
                    scrSc = 1f - 0.09f * easeB * active3D
                    scrRx = -14f * easeB * active3D
                    scrTy = -6f * dens * easeB * active3D
                    scrAlpha = 1f - 0.65f * easeB * active3D
                    pivotRatioY = 0.20f
                    restZ *= (1f - 0.45f * easeB * active3D)
                }
            }

            // Composite sequential entrance fraction directly inside slot transform so arriving cards never fight deck slots!
            val ef = row.enterFrac
            val efClamped = ef.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
            val enterSc = 0.88f + 0.12f * ef
            val enterTy = -(14f * dens) * (1f - ef)
            val enterRx = -10f * (1f - ef)
            val enterFadeT = (efClamped / 0.52f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
            val enterAlpha = enterFadeT * enterFadeT * (3f - 2f * enterFadeT)

            val finalSc = min(restSc, scrSc) * enterSc
            val finalRx = restRx + scrRx + enterRx
            val finalTy = restTy + scrTy + enterTy
            val finalAlpha = (min(restAlpha, scrAlpha) * enterAlpha).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
            val finalZ = if (ef < 0.995f && i == 0) 36f * dens else restZ

            row.cameraDistance = 12500f * dens
            row.pivotX = row.width * 0.5f
            row.pivotY = row.height * pivotRatioY
            row.scaleX = finalSc
            row.scaleY = finalSc
            row.translationY = finalTy
            row.translationZ = finalZ
            row.rotationX = finalRx
            row.alpha = finalAlpha
            if (finalAlpha > 0.02f && cardBot >= -80f && cardTop <= visH + 120f) {
                row.invalidate()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun animateClearCascade() {
        if (hidingOnEmpty) return
        val count = listCol.childCount
        if (count == 0) {
            onClearAll()
            return
        }
        moreHintPill.animate().alpha(0f).setDuration(140L).withEndAction {
            moreHintPill.visibility = GONE
            moreHintPill.alpha = 1f
        }.start()
        val rows = ArrayList<NotificationCardRow>(count)
`````
