`````kotlin
        for (i in 0 until count) {
            (listCol.getChildAt(i) as? NotificationCardRow)?.let { rows.add(it) }
        }
        rows.forEachIndexed { idx, row ->
            row.isDismissing = true
            row.animate().cancel()
            val dir = if (idx % 2 == 0) 1f else -1f
            val w = max(280f, row.width.toFloat())
            row.animate()
                .translationX(dir * w * 0.42f)
                .rotationY(dir * 14f)
                .alpha(0f)
                .scaleX(0.84f)
                .scaleY(0.84f)
                .setStartDelay((idx * 28L).coerceAtMost(112L))
                .setDuration(220L)
                .setInterpolator(iosEase)
                .setUpdateListener { row.invalidate() }
                .start()
        }
        postDelayed({
            onClearAll()
        }, (min(rows.size, 3) * 28L + 150L))
    }

    private class RubberScrollView(context: Context) : ScrollView(context) {
        private val dens = resources.displayMetrics.density
        private val touchSlop = ViewConfiguration.get(context).scaledTouchSlop.toFloat()
        private val vertSlop = min(touchSlop, 8f * dens)
        private val scroller = OverScroller(context)
        private var startRawX = 0f
        private var startRawY = 0f
        private var lastRawY = 0f
        private var dragActive = false
        private var startedExpanded = false
        private var startExpandFrac = 0f
        private var startedAtTop = true
        private var vt: VelocityTracker? = null
        private var rubberAnim: ValueAnimator? = null
        var rubberBotY = 0f
            private set
        var onPullOverscroll: ((Float) -> Unit)? = null
        var onRubberChanged: (() -> Unit)? = null
        var onInteractionStart: (() -> Unit)? = null
        var getExpandTravelPx: () -> Float = { 300f * dens }
        var canCycleDeckFn: () -> Boolean = { false }
        var isCyclingFn: () -> Boolean = { false }
        var onDeckCycleDeltaFn: (Float) -> Unit = {}
        var onDeckCycleReleaseFn: (Float, Float, Boolean) -> Unit = { _, _, _ -> }

        private var canExpandFn: () -> Boolean = { false }
        private var getExpandFn: () -> Float = { 0f }
        private var setExpandFn: (Float) -> Unit = {}
        private var onReleaseFn: (Float, Float, Float, Float) -> Unit = { _, _, _, _ -> }

        fun setExpandCallbacks(
            canExpand: () -> Boolean,
            getExpand: () -> Float,
            setExpand: (Float) -> Unit,
            onRelease: (Float, Float, Float, Float) -> Unit
        ) {
            canExpandFn = canExpand
            getExpandFn = getExpand
            setExpandFn = setExpand
            onReleaseFn = onRelease
        }

        fun abortScrolling() {
            if (!scroller.isFinished) scroller.abortAnimation()
            rubberAnim?.cancel()
            if (rubberBotY != 0f) setRubber(0f)
        }

        fun smoothScrollToTop() {
            abortScrolling()
            if (scrollY > 0) {
                scroller.startScroll(0, scrollY, 0, -scrollY, 360)
                postInvalidateOnAnimation()
            }
        }

        private fun setRubber(y: Float) {
            rubberBotY = y
            getChildAt(0)?.translationY = y
            onRubberChanged?.invoke()
            invalidate()
        }

        private fun springBackRubber() {
            if (abs(rubberBotY) < 0.5f) {
                setRubber(0f)
                return
            }
            rubberAnim?.cancel()
            val start = rubberBotY
            rubberAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(start, 0f).apply {
                duration = 380L
                interpolator = OvershootInterpolator(1.35f)
                addUpdateListener { a -> setRubber(a.animatedValue as Float) }
                start()
            }
        }

        override fun computeScroll() {
            if (scroller.computeScrollOffset()) {
                val maxScroll = max(0, (getChildAt(0)?.height ?: 0) - height)
                val cy = scroller.currY
                when {
                    cy < 0 -> {
                        if (scrollY != 0) scrollTo(0, 0)
                        setRubber(min(44f * dens, -cy.toFloat()))
                    }
                    cy > maxScroll -> {
                        if (scrollY != maxScroll) scrollTo(0, maxScroll)
                        setRubber(-min(44f * dens, (cy - maxScroll).toFloat()))
                    }
                    else -> {
                        if (rubberBotY != 0f) setRubber(0f)
                        if (scrollY != cy) scrollTo(0, cy)
                    }
                }
                onRubberChanged?.invoke()
                postInvalidateOnAnimation()
            } else if (!dragActive && abs(rubberBotY) > 0.5f && rubberAnim?.isRunning != true) {
                springBackRubber()
            }
        }

        // Clip ONLY vertically to ScrollView bounds, leaving left & right completely unclipped so swipes fade smoothly!
        override fun dispatchDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
            val saved = canvas.save()
            canvas.clipRect(-width * 2, scrollY, width * 3, scrollY + height)
            super.dispatchDraw(canvas)
            canvas.restoreToCount(saved)
        }

        private fun trackRawMovement(ev: MotionEvent) {
            val copy = MotionEvent.obtain(ev)
            copy.offsetLocation(ev.rawX - ev.x, ev.rawY - ev.y)
            vt?.addMovement(copy)
            copy.recycle()
        }

        private fun processVerticalDelta(dy: Float, rawY: Float) {
            val curExp = getExpandFn()
            val canExp = canExpandFn()
            val travel = max(220f * dens, getExpandTravelPx())

            if (!startedExpanded && curExp <= 0.001f && canCycleDeckFn() && (isCyclingFn() || dy > 0f)) {
                onDeckCycleDeltaFn(dy)
                return
            }

            if (canExp && dy < 0f && curExp < 0.999f) {
                val next = (curExp + (-dy) / travel).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                setExpandFn(next)
                val usedPx = (next - curExp) * travel
                val leftover = (-dy) - usedPx
                if (next >= 0.999f && leftover > 0.5f) {
                    val maxScroll = max(0, (getChildAt(0)?.height ?: 0) - height)
                    val avail = max(0, maxScroll - scrollY)
                    if (avail > 0) scrollBy(0, min(avail, leftover.roundToInt()))
                }
                return
            }
            if (canExp && dy > 0f && scrollY <= 0 && rubberBotY >= -0.5f && curExp > 0.001f) {
                val next = (curExp - dy / travel).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                setExpandFn(next)
                return
            }
            if (curExp >= 0.999f || !canExp) {
                val maxScroll = max(0, (getChildAt(0)?.height ?: 0) - height)
                if (rubberBotY < -0.5f && dy > 0f) {
                    val absorb = min(-rubberBotY, dy)
                    setRubber(rubberBotY + absorb)
                    val rem = dy - absorb
                    if (rem > 0f && scrollY > 0) scrollBy(0, -min(scrollY, rem.roundToInt()))
                } else if (dy < 0f) {
                    val avail = max(0, maxScroll - scrollY)
                    if (avail > 0) {
                        val used = min(avail.toFloat(), -dy)
                        scrollBy(0, used.roundToInt())
                        val left = (-dy) - used
                        if (left > 0.5f) setRubber(max(-64f * dens, rubberBotY - left * 0.38f))
                    } else {
                        setRubber(max(-64f * dens, rubberBotY + dy * 0.38f))
                    }
                } else if (dy > 0f && scrollY > 0) {
                    val used = min(scrollY.toFloat(), dy)
                    scrollBy(0, -used.roundToInt())
                    val left = dy - used
                    if (left > 0.5f && canExp) {
                        setExpandFn((curExp - left / travel).coerceIn(0f, 1f))
                    }
                }
                return
            }
            if (scrollY <= 0 && curExp <= 0.001f && rawY > startRawY) {
                onPullOverscroll?.invoke(min(18f * dens, (rawY - startRawY) * 0.14f))
            }
        }

        override fun onInterceptTouchEvent(ev: MotionEvent): Boolean {
            when (ev.actionMasked) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    abortScrolling()
                    onInteractionStart?.invoke()
                    startExpandFrac = getExpandFn()
                    startedExpanded = startExpandFrac >= 0.99f
                    startedAtTop = scrollY <= (4f * dens).roundToInt()
                    startRawX = ev.rawX
                    startRawY = ev.rawY
                    lastRawY = ev.rawY
                    dragActive = false
                    vt?.recycle()
                    vt = VelocityTracker.obtain()
                    trackRawMovement(ev)
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    trackRawMovement(ev)
                    val dx = ev.rawX - startRawX
                    val dy = ev.rawY - startRawY
                    val curExp = getExpandFn()
                    val canExp = canExpandFn()
                    val cyclePossible = !startedExpanded && curExp <= 0.001f && dy > 0f && canCycleDeckFn()
                    val slopReq = if (cyclePossible || (canExp && curExp < 0.999f)) vertSlop else touchSlop
                    if (abs(dy) > slopReq && abs(dy) > abs(dx) * 1.05f) {
                        if (cyclePossible ||
                            (canExp && ((dy < 0f && curExp < 0.999f) || (dy > 0f && scrollY <= 0 && curExp > 0.001f))) ||
                            curExp >= 0.999f ||
                            canScrollVertically(1) ||
                            canScrollVertically(-1)
                        ) {
                            dragActive = true
                            val initialDy = ev.rawY - lastRawY
                            lastRawY = ev.rawY
                            processVerticalDelta(initialDy, ev.rawY)
                            return true
                        }
                    }
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                    trackRawMovement(ev)
                    vt?.computeCurrentVelocity(1000)
                    val vy = vt?.yVelocity ?: 0f
                    vt?.recycle()
                    vt = null
                    val netDy = ev.rawY - startRawY
                    val netDx = ev.rawX - startRawX
                    val curExp = getExpandFn()
                    val canExp = canExpandFn()
                    val downCycleFlick = !startedExpanded && curExp <= 0.001f && canCycleDeckFn() &&
                        abs(netDy) >= abs(netDx) && ((vy > 110f * dens && netDy > 6f * dens) || netDy >= max(vertSlop, 14f * dens))
                    if (downCycleFlick) {
                        dragActive = false
                        onDeckCycleReleaseFn(netDy, vy, false)
                        return true
                    }
                    val upFlick = canExp && curExp < 0.995f && abs(netDy) >= abs(netDx) &&
                        ((-vy > 105f * dens && -netDy > 6f * dens) || -netDy >= max(vertSlop, 12f * dens))
                    val downFlick = canExp && curExp >= 0.995f && startedAtTop && scrollY <= 0 &&
                        abs(netDy) >= abs(netDx) && ((vy > 105f * dens && netDy > 6f * dens) || netDy >= max(vertSlop, 12f * dens))
                    if (upFlick || downFlick) {
                        dragActive = false
                        onReleaseFn(startExpandFrac, if (downFlick) 0.88f else curExp, netDy, vy)
                        return true
                    }
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                    vt?.recycle()
                    vt = null
                    dragActive = false
                }
            }
            return super.onInterceptTouchEvent(ev)
        }

        @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
        override fun onTouchEvent(ev: MotionEvent): Boolean {
            when (ev.actionMasked) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    abortScrolling()
                    onInteractionStart?.invoke()
                    startExpandFrac = getExpandFn()
                    startedExpanded = startExpandFrac >= 0.99f
                    startedAtTop = scrollY <= (4f * dens).roundToInt()
                    startRawX = ev.rawX
                    startRawY = ev.rawY
                    lastRawY = ev.rawY
                    dragActive = false
                    vt?.recycle()
                    vt = VelocityTracker.obtain()
                    trackRawMovement(ev)
                    return true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    trackRawMovement(ev)
                    if (!dragActive) {
                        val totalDy = ev.rawY - startRawY
                        val totalDx = ev.rawX - startRawX
                        val curExp = getExpandFn()
                        val cyclePossible = !startedExpanded && curExp <= 0.001f && totalDy > 0f && canCycleDeckFn()
                        val slopReq = if (cyclePossible || (canExpandFn() && curExp < 0.999f)) vertSlop else touchSlop
                        if (abs(totalDy) > slopReq && abs(totalDy) > abs(totalDx) * 1.05f) {
                            dragActive = true
                            val initialDy = ev.rawY - lastRawY
                            lastRawY = ev.rawY
                            processVerticalDelta(initialDy, ev.rawY)
                        }
                        return true
                    }

                    val dy = ev.rawY - lastRawY
                    lastRawY = ev.rawY
                    processVerticalDelta(dy, ev.rawY)
                    return true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                    trackRawMovement(ev)
                    vt?.computeCurrentVelocity(1000)
                    val vy = vt?.yVelocity ?: 0f
                    vt?.recycle()
                    vt = null
                    onPullOverscroll?.invoke(0f)
                    val curExp = getExpandFn()
                    val canExp = canExpandFn()
                    val wasDrag = dragActive
                    val netTotalDy = ev.rawY - startRawY
                    val netTotalDx = ev.rawX - startRawX
                    dragActive = false
                    springBackRubber()

                    val isFastUpFlick = ev.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP &&
                        -vy > 110f * dens && -netTotalDy > 6f * dens && abs(netTotalDy) >= abs(netTotalDx)
                    val isFastDownFlick = ev.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP &&
                        vy > 110f * dens && netTotalDy > 6f * dens && abs(netTotalDy) >= abs(netTotalDx)

                    if (!startedExpanded && curExp <= 0.001f && (isCyclingFn() || (canCycleDeckFn() && isFastDownFlick))) {
                        onDeckCycleReleaseFn(netTotalDy, vy, ev.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL)
                        return true
                    }
                    if (canExp && curExp < 0.995f && (wasDrag || isFastUpFlick || (curExp > 0.002f))) {
                        onReleaseFn(startExpandFrac, curExp, netTotalDy, vy)
                        return true
                    }
                    if (curExp >= 0.995f && (wasDrag || isFastDownFlick)) {
                        val maxScroll = max(0, (getChildAt(0)?.height ?: 0) - height)
                        if (canExp && startedAtTop && scrollY <= 0 && (vy > 105f * dens || netTotalDy > 18f * dens)) {
                            onReleaseFn(startExpandFrac, 0.88f, netTotalDy, vy)
                        } else if ((startedExpanded || scrollY > (12f * dens).roundToInt()) && abs(vy) > 150f * dens) {
                            scroller.fling(0, scrollY, 0, (-vy).roundToInt(), 0, 0, 0, maxScroll, 0, (42f * dens).roundToInt())
                            postInvalidateOnAnimation()
                        }
                    }
                    return true
                }
            }
            return super.onTouchEvent(ev)
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    private class GlassMoreHintPill(
        context: Context,
        backdrop: LiquidGlassShaders.BackdropState,
        perf: PerfMonitor,
        private val getRootShell: () -> View?,
        private val onClick: () -> Unit
    ) : LinearLayout(context) {
        private val dens = resources.displayMetrics.density
        private val glassHelper = LiquidGlassCardHelper(backdrop, perf, 14f, 12f, 9f, 1.44f, 0.24f)
        private val label: TextView
        var uiInk = Color.WHITE
        var glassBg = Color.argb(30, 18, 22, 30)

        init {
            orientation = HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setWillNotDraw(false)
            setPadding((12f * dens).roundToInt(), 0, (12f * dens).roundToInt(), 0)
            label = TextView(context).apply {
                setTextColor(uiInk)
                setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 11f)
                typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.BOLD)
                text = "↑ اسحب للأعلى"
            }
            addView(label)
            var pillDownY = 0f
            val pillSlop = ViewConfiguration.get(context).scaledTouchSlop.toFloat()
            setOnTouchListener { _, ev ->
                when (ev.actionMasked) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                        pillDownY = ev.rawY
                        animate().cancel()
                        animate().scaleX(0.90f).scaleY(0.90f).setDuration(90L).start()
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                        animate().cancel()
                        animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(360L).setInterpolator(OvershootInterpolator(1.9f)).start()
                        val dy = ev.rawY - pillDownY
                        if (dy <= pillSlop) {
                            onClick()
                        }
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                        animate().cancel()
                        animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(220L).start()
                        true
                    }
                    else -> false
                }
            }
        }

        fun setCount(hidden: Int) {
            label.text = if (hidden == 1) {
                "↕ إشعار إضافي • اسحب للأعلى أو للأسفل"
            } else {
                "↕ +$hidden إشعارات • اسحب للأعلى أو للأسفل"
            }
        }

        fun applyTheme(ink: Int, gBg: Int) {
            uiInk = ink
            glassBg = gBg
            label.setTextColor(ink)
            invalidate()
        }

        override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
            val rootShell = getRootShell()
            var ox = x
            var oy = y
            var p = parent as? View
            while (p != null && p !== rootShell) {
                ox += p.x - p.scrollX
                oy += p.y - p.scrollY
                p = p.parent as? View
            }
            val smoked = Color.argb(
                max(36, Color.alpha(glassBg)),
                (Color.red(glassBg) * 0.45f).roundToInt(),
                (Color.green(glassBg) * 0.45f).roundToInt(),
                (Color.blue(glassBg) * 0.50f).roundToInt()
            )
            glassHelper.draw(this, canvas, smoked, ox, oy)
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    private class GlassClearCircleButton(
        context: Context,
        backdrop: LiquidGlassShaders.BackdropState,
        perf: PerfMonitor,
        private val getRootShell: () -> View?,
        private val onClick: () -> Unit
    ) : View(context) {
        private val dens = resources.displayMetrics.density
        private val glassHelper = LiquidGlassCardHelper(backdrop, perf, 17f, 14f, 10f, 1.44f, 0.24f)
        private val xPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            style = Paint.Style.STROKE
            strokeWidth = 1.9f * dens
            strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
        }
        var uiInk = Color.WHITE
        var glassBg = Color.argb(20, 255, 255, 255)

        init {
            setWillNotDraw(false)
            setOnTouchListener { _, ev ->
                when (ev.actionMasked) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                        animate().cancel()
                        animate().scaleX(0.84f).scaleY(0.84f).setDuration(90L).start()
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                        animate().cancel()
                        animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(360L).setInterpolator(OvershootInterpolator(2.0f)).start()
                        onClick()
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                        animate().cancel()
                        animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(240L).start()
                        true
                    }
                    else -> false
                }
            }
        }

        override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
            val rootShell = getRootShell()
            var ox = x
            var oy = y
            var p = parent as? View
            while (p != null && p !== rootShell) {
                ox += p.x - p.scrollX
                oy += p.y - p.scrollY
                p = p.parent as? View
            }
            glassHelper.draw(this, canvas, glassBg, ox, oy)
            xPaint.color = uiInk
            val cx = width * 0.5f
            val cy = height * 0.5f
            val r = 5.2f * dens
            canvas.drawLine(cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r, xPaint)
            canvas.drawLine(cx + r, cy - r, cx - r, cy + r, xPaint)
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    private class NotificationCardRow(
        context: Context,
        private var hub: NotificationHub,
        backdrop: LiquidGlassShaders.BackdropState,
        perf: PerfMonitor,
        private val getRootShell: () -> View?,
        private val onSwipeProgress: (NotificationCardRow, Float) -> Unit,
        private val onSwipeCancel: (NotificationCardRow) -> Unit,
        private val onDismiss: (NotificationCardRow, LockNotification, Float, Float) -> Unit,
        private val onTap: (LockNotification) -> Unit,
        private val onPressCancelled: () -> Unit,
        private val onEntranceFrame: () -> Unit,
        private val onHaptic: (String) -> Unit
    ) : FrameLayout(context) {

        private val dens = resources.displayMetrics.density
        private val glassHelper = LiquidGlassCardHelper(backdrop, perf, 24f, 20f, 16f, 1.48f, 0.30f, 0.0f)
        private val dismissEase = PathInterpolator(0.22f, 1f, 0.36f, 1f)

        private val iconView: ImageView
        private val countBadge: TextView
        private val titleText: TextView
        private val bodyText: TextView
        private val timeText: TextView

        private var item: LockNotification? = null
        private var uiInk = Color.WHITE
        private var uiDim = Color.argb(212, 255, 255, 255)
        private var glassBg = Color.argb(26, 18, 22, 30)

        private val touchSlop = ViewConfiguration.get(context).scaledTouchSlop.toFloat()
        private var downRawX = 0f
        private var downRawY = 0f
        private var basePressSc = 1f
        private var basePressAlpha = 1f
        private var vt: VelocityTracker? = null
        private var enterAnim: ValueAnimator? = null
        var isDragging = false
            private set
        var isDismissing = false
        var enterFrac = 1f
            private set

        init {
            setWillNotDraw(false)
            layoutDirection = LAYOUT_DIRECTION_LTR
            clipChildren = false
            clipToPadding = false
            cameraDistance = 11500f * dens
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT).apply {
                bottomMargin = (8f * dens).roundToInt()
            }
            setPadding((13f * dens).roundToInt(), (11f * dens).roundToInt(), (14f * dens).roundToInt(), (11f * dens).roundToInt())

            val row = LinearLayout(context).apply {
                orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
                gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
                layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
            }

            val iconBox = FrameLayout(context).apply {
                val boxSz = (44f * dens).roundToInt()
                layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(boxSz, boxSz).apply { marginEnd = (11f * dens).roundToInt() }
                clipChildren = false
                clipToPadding = false
            }
            iconView = ImageView(context).apply {
                val sz = (39f * dens).roundToInt()
                layoutParams = LayoutParams(sz, sz, Gravity.START or Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL)
                scaleType = ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP
                clipToOutline = true
                outlineProvider = object : android.view.ViewOutlineProvider() {
                    override fun getOutline(v: View, outline: android.graphics.Outline) {
                        outline.setRoundRect(0, 0, v.width, v.height, 10.5f * dens)
                    }
                }
            }
            countBadge = TextView(context).apply {
                setTextColor(Color.argb(235, 16, 20, 28))
                setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 10f)
                typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.BOLD)
                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
                minWidth = (17f * dens).roundToInt()
                setPadding((4f * dens).roundToInt(), 0, (4f * dens).roundToInt(), 0)
                background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                    setColor(Color.argb(242, 244, 246, 250))
                    cornerRadius = 999f
                }
                layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, (17f * dens).roundToInt(), Gravity.TOP or Gravity.END)
                visibility = GONE
            }
            iconBox.addView(iconView)
            iconBox.addView(countBadge)

            val meta = LinearLayout(context).apply {
                orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
                layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f).apply {
                    marginEnd = (8f * dens).roundToInt()
                }
            }
            titleText = TextView(context).apply {
                setTextColor(uiInk)
                setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 14.5f)
                typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.BOLD)
                isSingleLine = true
                ellipsize = TextUtils.TruncateAt.END
            }
            bodyText = TextView(context).apply {
                setTextColor(uiDim)
                setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 12.5f)
                maxLines = 2
                ellipsize = TextUtils.TruncateAt.END
            }
            meta.addView(titleText)
            meta.addView(bodyText)

            timeText = TextView(context).apply {
                setTextColor(Color.argb(185, 255, 255, 255))
                setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 11.5f)
                typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.NORMAL)
                layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT).apply {
                    gravity = Gravity.TOP
                    topMargin = (2f * dens).roundToInt()
                }
            }

            row.addView(iconBox)
            row.addView(meta)
            row.addView(timeText)
            addView(row)
        }

        fun bind(data: LockNotification, hubRef: NotificationHub) {
            hub = hubRef
            item = data
            titleText.text = data.title
            bodyText.text = data.text
            timeText.text = NotificationHub.formatRelativeTime(data.timestampMs)
            iconView.setImageBitmap(hubRef.getAppIcon(data.packageName, (39f * dens).roundToInt()))
            if (data.count > 1) {
                countBadge.text = data.count.toString()
                countBadge.visibility = VISIBLE
            } else {
                countBadge.visibility = GONE
            }
        }

        fun applyTheme(ink: Int, dim: Int, gBg: Int) {
            uiInk = ink
            uiDim = dim
            glassBg = gBg

            timeText.setTextColor(Color.argb(190, Color.red(ink), Color.green(ink), Color.blue(ink)))
            val shadowCol = if (ink == Color.WHITE) Color.argb(64, 0, 0, 0) else Color.TRANSPARENT
            titleText.setShadowLayer(4f * dens, 0f, 1f * dens, shadowCol)
            bodyText.setShadowLayer(3.5f * dens, 0f, 1f * dens, shadowCol)
            invalidate()
        }

        fun cardHeightEstimate(): Float = if (height > 0) height.toFloat() else (68f * dens)

        fun playEntrance3D(delayMs: Long) {
            enterAnim?.cancel()
            enterFrac = 0f
            onEntranceFrame()
            enterAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f).apply {
                startDelay = delayMs
                duration = 420L
                interpolator = OvershootInterpolator(1.22f)
                addUpdateListener { a ->
                    enterFrac = a.animatedValue as Float
                    onEntranceFrame()
                    invalidate()
                }
                addListener(object : AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
                    override fun onAnimationEnd(animation: Animator) {
                        enterFrac = 1f
                        onEntranceFrame()
                        invalidate()
                    }
                })
                start()
            }
        }

        override fun onTouchEvent(ev: MotionEvent): Boolean {
            if (isDismissing) return false
            val cur = item ?: return false
            when (ev.actionMasked) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    enterAnim?.cancel()
                    enterFrac = 1f
                    downRawX = ev.rawX
                    downRawY = ev.rawY
                    isDragging = false
                    basePressSc = scaleX.coerceIn(0.80f, 1.05f)
                    basePressAlpha = alpha.coerceIn(0.05f, 1f)
                    vt?.recycle()
                    vt = VelocityTracker.obtain().apply { addMovement(ev) }
                    animate().cancel()
                    pivotX = width * 0.5f
                    pivotY = height * 0.5f
                    animate().scaleX(basePressSc * 0.978f).scaleY(basePressSc * 0.972f).setDuration(105L).start()
                    return true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    vt?.addMovement(ev)
                    val dx = ev.rawX - downRawX
                    val dy = ev.rawY - downRawY
                    if (!isDragging && abs(dx) > touchSlop && abs(dx) > abs(dy) * 1.1f) {
                        isDragging = true
                        parent?.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true)
                    }
                    if (isDragging) {
                        val w = max(1f, width.toFloat())
                        val clampedDx = if (cur.isDismissible) dx else (dx * 0.20f)
                        val dragFrac = (abs(clampedDx) / (w * 0.65f)).coerceIn(0f, 1.3f)
                        // Dissolve softly & tilt in 3D with zero edge scissor clipping
                        pivotX = width * 0.5f
                        pivotY = height * 0.5f
                        translationX = clampedDx
                        rotationY = (clampedDx / w * 11f).coerceIn(-12f, 12f)
                        rotation = (clampedDx / w * 2.4f).coerceIn(-3f, 3f)
                        val sc = basePressSc * (1f - min(0.10f, dragFrac * 0.08f))
                        scaleX = sc
                        scaleY = sc
                        val fade = (1f - dragFrac * 0.90f).coerceIn(0.02f, 1f)
                        alpha = basePressAlpha * fade * sqrt(fade)
                        onSwipeProgress(this, if (cur.isDismissible) dragFrac.coerceIn(0f, 1f) else 0f)
                        invalidate()
                    } else if (abs(dy) > touchSlop) {
                        animate().cancel()
                        onPressCancelled()
                    }
                    return true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                    vt?.addMovement(ev)
                    vt?.computeCurrentVelocity(1000)
                    val vx = vt?.xVelocity ?: 0f
                    vt?.recycle()
                    vt = null

                    if (isDragging) {
                        isDragging = false
                        val w = max(1f, width.toFloat())
                        val shouldDismiss = cur.isDismissible &&
                            (abs(translationX) >= w * 0.28f || abs(vx) >= 800f * dens) &&
                            ev.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP
                        if (shouldDismiss) {
                            dismissWithSpring3D(cur, dir = if (translationX >= 0f || vx > 0f) 1f else -1f, vx = vx)
                        } else {
                            onSwipeCancel(this)
                            snapBackRubbery()
                        }
                    } else {
                        animate().cancel()
                        onSwipeCancel(this)
                        if (ev.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP &&
                            abs(ev.rawX - downRawX) < touchSlop &&
                            abs(ev.rawY - downRawY) < touchSlop
                        ) {
                            onHaptic("pop")
                            pivotX = width * 0.5f
                            pivotY = height * 0.5f
                            scaleX = basePressSc * 0.94f; scaleY = basePressSc * 0.94f
                            animate().scaleX(basePressSc).scaleY(basePressSc).setDuration(360L).setInterpolator(OvershootInterpolator(1.9f)).start()
                            onTap(cur)
                        } else {
                            // Vertical scroll intercepted this card — restore stack/3D transforms directly without running a conflicting 440ms animator!
                            onPressCancelled()
                        }
                    }
                    return true
                }
            }
            return super.onTouchEvent(ev)
        }

        private fun snapBackRubbery() {
            animate().cancel()
            animate()
                .translationX(0f)
                .rotationY(0f)
                .rotation(0f)
                .scaleX(basePressSc)
                .scaleY(basePressSc)
                .alpha(basePressAlpha)
                .setDuration(420L)
                .setInterpolator(OvershootInterpolator(1.65f))
                .setUpdateListener { invalidate() }
                .withEndAction { onPressCancelled() }
                .start()
        }

        private fun dismissWithSpring3D(cur: LockNotification, dir: Float, vx: Float) {
            isDismissing = true
            onHaptic("pop")
            onDismiss(this, cur, dir, vx)
        }

        override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
            val w = width.toFloat()
            val h = height.toFloat()
            if (w <= 1f || h <= 1f) return

            // Exact same crisp Liquid Glass refraction + sharp directional white Fresnel inner highlight as Flashlight/Camera buttons
            val rootShell = getRootShell()
            var ox = x
            var oy = y
            var p = parent as? View
            while (p != null && p !== rootShell) {
                ox += p.x - p.scrollX
                oy += p.y - p.scrollY
                p = p.parent as? View
            }

            glassHelper.draw(this, canvas, glassBg, ox, oy)
        }
    }
}
`````

`````kotlin
package com.oclock.liquidglass

import android.app.Notification
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.content.ComponentName
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.LinearGradient
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.Path
import android.graphics.RectF
import android.graphics.Shader
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.provider.Settings
import android.service.notification.NotificationListenerService
import android.service.notification.StatusBarNotification
import android.util.LruCache
import java.lang.ref.WeakReference
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

class OClockNotificationListenerService : NotificationListenerService() {
    override fun onListenerConnected() {
        super.onListenerConnected()
        instanceRef = WeakReference(this)
        pushSnapshot()
    }

    override fun onListenerDisconnected() {
        super.onListenerDisconnected()
        if (instanceRef?.get() === this) instanceRef = null
        pendingIntents.clear()
        mainHandler.post { listenerCallback?.onSystemChanged(emptyList(), null, null) }
    }

    override fun onNotificationPosted(sbn: StatusBarNotification?) {
        super.onNotificationPosted(sbn)
        if (sbn == null) return
        if (shouldIgnore(sbn)) return
        val item = toLockNotification(sbn)
        sbn.notification.contentIntent?.let { pendingIntents[sbn.key] = it }
        mainHandler.post { listenerCallback?.onSystemPosted(item, buildSnapshot()) }
    }

    override fun onNotificationRemoved(sbn: StatusBarNotification?) {
        super.onNotificationRemoved(sbn)
        if (sbn == null) return
        pendingIntents.remove(sbn.key)
        mainHandler.post { listenerCallback?.onSystemRemoved(sbn.key, buildSnapshot()) }
    }

    private fun shouldIgnore(sbn: StatusBarNotification): Boolean {
        if (sbn.packageName == applicationContext.packageName) return true
        val n = sbn.notification ?: return true
        if ((n.flags and Notification.FLAG_GROUP_SUMMARY) != 0) return true
        val cat = n.category
        if (cat == Notification.CATEGORY_TRANSPORT && (n.flags and Notification.FLAG_ONGOING_EVENT) != 0) return true
        if ((n.flags and Notification.FLAG_FOREGROUND_SERVICE) != 0 && sbn.isOngoing) return true
        return false
    }

    private fun buildSnapshot(): List<LockNotification> {
        val active = try {
            activeNotifications ?: emptyArray()
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            emptyArray()
        }
        val list = ArrayList<LockNotification>(active.size)
        for (sbn in active) {
            if (shouldIgnore(sbn)) continue
            sbn.notification.contentIntent?.let { pendingIntents[sbn.key] = it }
            list.add(toLockNotification(sbn))
        }
        list.sortByDescending { it.timestampMs }
        return list
    }

    private fun pushSnapshot() {
        val snap = buildSnapshot()
        mainHandler.post { listenerCallback?.onSystemChanged(snap, null, null) }
    }

    private fun toLockNotification(sbn: StatusBarNotification): LockNotification {
        val n = sbn.notification
        val extras = n.extras
        val appName = resolveAppLabel(sbn.packageName)
        val rawTitle = extras?.getCharSequence(Notification.EXTRA_TITLE)?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        val rawBig = extras?.getCharSequence(Notification.EXTRA_BIG_TEXT)?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        val rawText = extras?.getCharSequence(Notification.EXTRA_TEXT)?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        val rawSub = extras?.getCharSequence(Notification.EXTRA_SUB_TEXT)?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        val title = if (rawTitle.isNotEmpty()) rawTitle else appName
        val body = when {
            rawBig.isNotEmpty() -> rawBig
            rawText.isNotEmpty() -> rawText
            rawSub.isNotEmpty() -> rawSub
            else -> "إشعار جديد"
        }
        val count = max(1, n.number)
        val col = if (n.color != 0) n.color else 0xFF38BDF8.toInt()
        return LockNotification(
            id = sbn.key,
            packageName = sbn.packageName,
            appName = appName,
            title = if (title == appName) appName else "$appName • $title",
            text = body,
            timestampMs = sbn.postTime,
            count = count,
            accentColor = col,
            isSystem = true,
            isDismissible = sbn.isClearable
        )
    }

    private fun resolveAppLabel(pkg: String): String {
        return labelCache.getOrPut(pkg) {
            try {
                val ai = packageManager.getApplicationInfo(pkg, 0)
                packageManager.getApplicationLabel(ai).toString()
            } catch (_: Throwable) {
                pkg.substringAfterLast('.')
            }
        }
    }

    interface SystemCallback {
        fun onSystemChanged(all: List<LockNotification>, posted: LockNotification?, removedId: String?)
        fun onSystemPosted(item: LockNotification, all: List<LockNotification>)
        fun onSystemRemoved(id: String, all: List<LockNotification>)
    }

    companion object {
        private val mainHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
        @Volatile
        private var instanceRef: WeakReference<OClockNotificationListenerService>? = null
        @Volatile
        var listenerCallback: SystemCallback? = null
        private val pendingIntents = ConcurrentHashMap<String, PendingIntent>()
        private val labelCache = ConcurrentHashMap<String, String>()

        fun cancelById(key: String) {
            pendingIntents.remove(key)
            try {
                instanceRef?.get()?.cancelNotification(key)
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }

        fun cancelAllSystem() {
            val svc = instanceRef?.get() ?: return
            try {
                val active = svc.activeNotifications ?: return
                for (sbn in active) {
                    if (sbn.isClearable && sbn.packageName != svc.packageName) {
                        pendingIntents.remove(sbn.key)
                        svc.cancelNotification(sbn.key)
                    }
                }
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }

        fun getContentIntent(key: String): PendingIntent? = pendingIntents[key]

        fun requestSync() {
            instanceRef?.get()?.pushSnapshot()
        }
    }
}

class NotificationHub(private val context: Context) : OClockNotificationListenerService.SystemCallback {
    interface Listener {
        fun onNotificationsUpdated(items: List<LockNotification>, added: LockNotification?, removedId: String?)
    }

    private val iconCache = LruCache<String, Bitmap>(48)
    private val items = ArrayList<LockNotification>()
    private val sampleSeq = AtomicInteger(100)
    private var listener: Listener? = null
    private var usingSamples = false

    private val sampleTemplates = listOf(
        Triple("com.snapchat.android", "Snapchat", "2 إشعارات جديدة"),
        Triple("com.twitter.android", "X", "تغريدة رائجة قد تهمك الآن"),
        Triple("com.android.dialer", "الهاتف", "مكالمات فائتة (3)"),
        Triple("com.whatsapp", "WhatsApp", "مرحباً! هل جربت التصميم الزجاجي الجديد؟"),
        Triple("org.telegram.messenger", "Telegram", "تم إرسال صورة في القناة"),
        Triple("com.instagram.android", "Instagram", "أعجب بمنشورك وعلّق عليه")
    )

    init {
        OClockNotificationListenerService.listenerCallback = this
        if (hasNotificationAccess()) {
            OClockNotificationListenerService.requestSync()
        } else {
            seedInitialSamples()
        }
    }

    fun setListener(l: Listener?) {
        listener = l
    }

    fun getItems(): List<LockNotification> = ArrayList(items)

    fun hasNotificationAccess(): Boolean {
        val flat = Settings.Secure.getString(context.contentResolver, "enabled_notification_listeners") ?: return false
        val me = ComponentName(context, OClockNotificationListenerService::class.java)
        return flat.contains(me.flattenToString()) || flat.contains(context.packageName)
    }

    fun openNotificationSettings() {
        try {
            val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SETTINGS).apply {
                addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
            }
            context.startActivity(intent)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}
    }

    fun refreshFromSystem() {
        if (hasNotificationAccess()) {
            OClockNotificationListenerService.requestSync()
        }
    }

    fun seedInitialSamples() {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        usingSamples = true
        items.clear()
        items.add(LockNotification("sample_1", "com.snapchat.android", "Snapchat", "Snapchat", "2 إشعارات جديدة", now - 60_000L, 2, 0xFFFFFC00.toInt(), false, true))
        items.add(LockNotification("sample_2", "com.twitter.android", "X", "X", "إشعار جديد • متابعة النشاط", now - 17 * 60_000L, 1, 0xFFFFFFFF.toInt(), false, true))
        items.add(LockNotification("sample_3", "com.whatsapp", "WhatsApp", "WhatsApp • عمر", "التصميم الزجاجي يبدو رائعاً جداً!", now - 42 * 60_000L, 5, 0xFF25D366.toInt(), false, true))
        items.add(LockNotification("sample_4", "org.telegram.messenger", "Telegram", "Telegram", "تم إرسال صورة في القناة", now - 2 * 3_600_000L, 4, 0xFF38BDF8.toInt(), false, true))
        items.add(LockNotification("sample_5", "com.android.dialer", "الهاتف", "الهاتف", "34 إشعارات ومكالمات", now - 3 * 3_600_000L, 34, 0xFF30D158.toInt(), false, true))
        items.add(LockNotification("sample_6", "com.instagram.android", "Instagram", "Instagram", "أعجب بمنشورك وعلّق عليه", now - 5 * 3_600_000L, 2, 0xFFE1306C.toInt(), false, true))
        listener?.onNotificationsUpdated(getItems(), null, null)
    }

    fun addSampleNotification() {
        val idx = sampleSeq.incrementAndGet()
        val tpl = sampleTemplates[idx % sampleTemplates.size]
        val cnt = if (idx % 3 == 0) 2 else 1
        val item = LockNotification(
            id = "sample_$idx",
            packageName = tpl.first,
            appName = tpl.second,
            title = tpl.second,
            text = tpl.third,
            timestampMs = System.currentTimeMillis(),
            count = cnt,
            accentColor = sampleAccent(tpl.first),
            isSystem = false,
            isDismissible = true
        )
        items.add(0, item)
        listener?.onNotificationsUpdated(getItems(), item, null)
    }

    fun dismiss(id: String) {
        val idx = items.indexOfFirst { it.id == id }
        if (idx < 0) return
        val removed = items.removeAt(idx)
        if (removed.isSystem) {
            OClockNotificationListenerService.cancelById(id)
        }
        listener?.onNotificationsUpdated(getItems(), null, id)
    }

    fun clearAll() {
        val hadSystem = items.any { it.isSystem }
        items.removeAll { it.isDismissible }
        if (hadSystem) {
            OClockNotificationListenerService.cancelAllSystem()
        }
        listener?.onNotificationsUpdated(getItems(), null, null)
    }

    fun openNotification(item: LockNotification): Boolean {
        if (!item.isSystem) return false
        val pi = OClockNotificationListenerService.getContentIntent(item.id) ?: return false
        return try {
            pi.send()
            true
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            false
        }
    }

    fun getAppIcon(packageName: String, sizePx: Int): Bitmap {
        val key = "$packageName|$sizePx"
        iconCache.get(key)?.let { return it }
        val bmp = decodePackageIcon(packageName, sizePx) ?: renderBrandedBadge(packageName, sizePx)
        iconCache.put(key, bmp)
        return bmp
    }

    private fun decodePackageIcon(packageName: String, sizePx: Int): Bitmap? {
        return try {
            val d: Drawable = context.packageManager.getApplicationIcon(packageName)
            val out = Bitmap.createBitmap(sizePx, sizePx, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
            val c = Canvas(out)
            d.setBounds(0, 0, sizePx, sizePx)
            d.draw(c)
            out
        } catch (_: PackageManager.NameNotFoundException) {
            null
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun renderBrandedBadge(pkg: String, sz: Int): Bitmap {
        val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(sz, sz, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val c = Canvas(bmp)
        val p = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
        val (cTop, cBot, glyph) = when {
            pkg.contains("snapchat") -> Triple(0xFFFFA8D8.toInt(), 0xFFF472B6.toInt(), "S")
            pkg.contains("twitter") -> Triple(0xFF1E222B.toInt(), 0xFF0A0C10.toInt(), "𝕏")
            pkg.contains("dialer") || pkg.contains("phone") -> Triple(0xFF93C5FD.toInt(), 0xFF34D399.toInt(), "✆")
            pkg.contains("whatsapp") -> Triple(0xFF4ADE80.toInt(), 0xFF16A34A.toInt(), "W")
            pkg.contains("telegram") -> Triple(0xFF38BDF8.toInt(), 0xFF0284C7.toInt(), "✈")
            pkg.contains("instagram") -> Triple(0xFFF472B6.toInt(), 0xFFF59E0B.toInt(), "◎")
            else -> Triple(0xFF60A5FA.toInt(), 0xFF2563EB.toInt(), pkg.substringAfterLast('.').take(1).uppercase())
        }
        p.shader = LinearGradient(0f, 0f, sz.toFloat(), sz.toFloat(), cTop, cBot, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP)
        val rad = sz * 0.24f
        c.drawRoundRect(RectF(0f, 0f, sz.toFloat(), sz.toFloat()), rad, rad, p)
        p.shader = null
        p.color = Color.WHITE
        p.textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
        p.typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.BOLD)
        p.textSize = sz * 0.50f
        val fm = p.fontMetrics
        val cy = sz * 0.5f - (fm.ascent + fm.descent) * 0.5f
        c.drawText(glyph, sz * 0.5f, cy, p)
        return bmp
    }

    private fun sampleAccent(pkg: String): Int = when {
        pkg.contains("snapchat") -> 0xFFF472B6.toInt()
        pkg.contains("twitter") -> 0xFFFFFFFF.toInt()
        pkg.contains("dialer") -> 0xFF30D158.toInt()
        pkg.contains("whatsapp") -> 0xFF25D366.toInt()
        pkg.contains("telegram") -> 0xFF38BDF8.toInt()
        else -> 0xFFA78BFA.toInt()
    }

    override fun onSystemChanged(all: List<LockNotification>, posted: LockNotification?, removedId: String?) {
        usingSamples = false
        items.clear()
        items.addAll(all)
        listener?.onNotificationsUpdated(getItems(), posted, removedId)
    }

    override fun onSystemPosted(item: LockNotification, all: List<LockNotification>) {
        usingSamples = false
        items.clear()
        items.addAll(all)
        listener?.onNotificationsUpdated(getItems(), item, null)
    }

    override fun onSystemRemoved(id: String, all: List<LockNotification>) {
        usingSamples = false
        items.clear()
        items.addAll(all)
        listener?.onNotificationsUpdated(getItems(), null, id)
    }

    fun shutdown() {
        if (OClockNotificationListenerService.listenerCallback === this) {
            OClockNotificationListenerService.listenerCallback = null
        }
    }

    companion object {
        fun formatRelativeTime(timestampMs: Long): String {
            val diffSec = max(0L, (System.currentTimeMillis() - timestampMs) / 1000L)
            return when {
                diffSec < 45L -> "الآن"
                diffSec < 3600L -> "${diffSec / 60L}m ago"
                diffSec < 86_400L -> "${diffSec / 3600L}h ago"
                else -> "${diffSec / 86_400L}d ago"
            }
        }
    }
}
`````

`````kotlin
class PerfMonitor(private val context: Context) : Choreographer.FrameCallback {

    private val startedMonoMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()

    @Volatile private var availRamMb = 0.0

    )

        val gpuCacheMb: Double,

        val uptimeSec: Long
    )

    }

        if (running) return
        running = true
        visible = true
        lastFrameNs = 0L
        Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(this)
        pollMemoryAsync()
    }

    fun setVisible(v: Boolean) {
        visible = v
        lastFrameNs = 0L
        if (running && v) {
            Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(this)
            Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(this)
        }
    }

    fun stop() {
        running = false
        Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(this)
    }

    fun shutdown() {
        stop()
        memExecutor.shutdownNow()
    }

    fun recordWork(name: String, ms: Double) {
        synchronized(consumers) {
            val s = consumers.getOrPut(name) { ConsumerStats() }
            s.calls += 1
            s.totalMs += ms
            s.lastMs = ms
            if (ms > s.maxMs) s.maxMs = ms
        }
    }

    fun reset() {
        synchronized(this) {
            totalFrames = 0
            dropped24 = 0
            jank50 = 0
            maxFrameGapMs = 0.0
            totalFrameSumMs = 0.0
            currentFps = 60.0
            recentFrameMs.clear()
            timeline.clear()
        }
        synchronized(consumers) {
            consumers.clear()
        }
        lastFrameNs = 0L
        notifyListener()
    }

    override fun doFrame(frameTimeNanos: Long) {
        if (!running || !visible) return
        if (lastFrameNs != 0L) {
            val dtMs = (frameTimeNanos - lastFrameNs) / 1_000_000.0
            if (dtMs in 2.0..1000.0) {
                synchronized(this) {
                    totalFrames += 1
                    totalFrameSumMs += dtMs
                    if (dtMs > maxFrameGapMs) maxFrameGapMs = dtMs
                    if (dtMs > 24.0) dropped24 += 1
                    if (dtMs > 50.0) jank50 += 1
                    if (recentFrameMs.size >= 120) recentFrameMs.removeFirst()
                    recentFrameMs.addLast(dtMs)
                    val recentAvg = recentFrameMs.average()
                    currentFps = if (recentAvg > 0.0) (1000.0 / recentAvg).coerceAtMost(120.0) else 60.0
                }
            }
        }
        lastFrameNs = frameTimeNanos

        val nowMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        if (nowMs - lastMemPollMs >= 5000L) {
            lastMemPollMs = nowMs
            pollMemoryAsync()
        }
        if (nowMs - lastSampleMs >= 1000L) {
            lastSampleMs = nowMs
            appendTimelinePoint()
            notifyListener()
        }
        Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(this)
    }

    private fun pollMemoryAsync() {
        memExecutor.execute {
            try {
                val mi = Debug.MemoryInfo()
                Debug.getMemoryInfo(mi)
                totalPssMb = round1(mi.totalPss / 1024.0)
                nativeHeapMb = round1(Debug.getNativeHeapAllocatedSize() / (1024.0 * 1024.0))
                dalvikPssMb = round1(mi.dalvikPss / 1024.0)
                val am = context.getSystemService(Context.ACTIVITY_SERVICE) as? ActivityManager
                if (am != null) {
                    val sys = ActivityManager.MemoryInfo()
                    am.getMemoryInfo(sys)
                    availRamMb = round1(sys.availMem / (1024.0 * 1024.0))
                }
            } catch (_: Throwable) {
            }
        }
    }

    fun snapshot(): SummarySnapshot {
        synchronized(this) {
            val avg = if (totalFrames > 0 && totalFrameSumMs > 0.0) {
                (1000.0 / (totalFrameSumMs / totalFrames)).coerceAtMost(120.0).roundToInt()
            } else {
                60
            }
            val low5 = if (recentFrameMs.isNotEmpty()) {
                val sorted = recentFrameMs.sortedDescending()
                val p95 = sorted[(sorted.size * 0.05).toInt().coerceIn(0, sorted.lastIndex)]
                if (p95 > 0.0) (1000.0 / p95).coerceAtMost(120.0).roundToInt() else avg
            } else {
                avg
            }
            val engine = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) "AGSL GPU + C++ مباشر" else "Native C++ مباشر"
            return SummarySnapshot(
                currentFps = currentFps.roundToInt(),
                avgFps = avg,
                low5Fps = low5,
                dropped24 = dropped24,
                jank50 = jank50,
                totalPssMb = totalPssMb,
                gpuCacheMb = round1(gpuFieldCacheBytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0)),
                engineLabel = engine,
                uptimeSec = max(0L, (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - startedMonoMs) / 1000L)
            )
        }
    }

    private fun appendTimelinePoint() {
        val snap = snapshot()
        val obj = JSONObject().apply {
            put("t", snap.uptimeSec)
            put("fps", snap.currentFps)
            put("dropped", snap.dropped24)
            put("jank", snap.jank50)
            put("pssMb", snap.totalPssMb)
            put("nativeMb", nativeHeapMb)
            put("cacheMb", snap.gpuCacheMb)
        }
        synchronized(this) {
            if (timeline.size >= 180) timeline.removeFirst()
            timeline.addLast(obj)
        }
    }

    private fun notifyListener() {
        listener?.invoke(snapshot())
    }

    fun buildReportJson(cfg: LockConfig): String {
        val snap = snapshot()
        val root = JSONObject()
        root.put("schema", "oclock.liquidglass.perf.v1")
        root.put("runtime", "pure-native-kotlin-agsl-cpp")
        root.put("sdkInt", Build.VERSION.SDK_INT)
        root.put("device", "${Build.MANUFACTURER} ${Build.MODEL}")
        root.put("startedAt", startedWallMs)
        root.put("generatedAt", System.currentTimeMillis())

        val sum = JSONObject().apply {
            put("uptimeSec", snap.uptimeSec)
            put("totalFrames", totalFrames)
            put("currentFps", snap.currentFps)
            put("avgFps", snap.avgFps)
            put("low5PctFps", snap.low5Fps)
            put("droppedOver24ms", snap.dropped24)
            put("jankOver50ms", snap.jank50)
            put("maxFrameGapMs", round1(maxFrameGapMs))
            put("totalPssMb", snap.totalPssMb)
            put("dalvikPssMb", dalvikPssMb)
            put("nativeHeapMb", nativeHeapMb)
            put("availSystemRamMb", availRamMb)
            put("gpuFieldCacheMb", snap.gpuCacheMb)
            put("engine", snap.engineLabel)
            put("font", cfg.font)
            put("size", cfg.size.toDouble())
            put("sy", cfg.sy.toDouble())
            put("clockOpacity", cfg.clockOpacity)
        }
        root.put("summary", sum)

        val topArr = JSONArray()
        synchronized(consumers) {
            consumers.entries
                .sortedByDescending { it.value.totalMs }
                .forEach { (name, st) ->
                    topArr.put(JSONObject().apply {
                        put("name", name)
                        put("calls", st.calls)
                        put("totalMs", round1(st.totalMs))
                        put("avgMs", round1(if (st.calls > 0) st.totalMs / st.calls else 0.0))
                        put("maxMs", round1(st.maxMs))
                        put("lastMs", round1(st.lastMs))
                    })
                }
        }
        root.put("topConsumers", topArr)

        val tlArr = JSONArray()
        synchronized(this) {
            timeline.forEach { tlArr.put(it) }
        }
        root.put("timeline", tlArr)
        return root.toString(2)
    }

    fun saveReportToDownloads(cfg: LockConfig, fixedName: String? = null): String? {
        val json = buildReportJson(cfg)
        val fileName = fixedName ?: ("oclock-perf-" + SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss", Locale.US).format(Date()) + ".json")
        return try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
                val resolver = context.contentResolver
                if (fixedName != null) {
                    resolver.delete(
                        MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI,
                        "${MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME}=?",
                        arrayOf(fixedName)
                    )
                }
                val values = ContentValues().apply {
                    put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME, fileName)
                    put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.MIME_TYPE, "application/json")
                    put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH, Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS + "/OClock")
                    put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.IS_PENDING, 1)
                }
                val uri = resolver.insert(MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, values) ?: return null
                resolver.openOutputStream(uri, "wt")?.use { it.write(json.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
                values.clear()
                values.put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.IS_PENDING, 0)
                resolver.update(uri, values, null, null)
                "Downloads/OClock/$fileName"
            } else {
                val dir = File(context.getExternalFilesDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS), "OClock").apply { mkdirs() }
                val out = File(dir, fileName)
                FileOutputStream(out).use { it.write(json.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
                out.absolutePath
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            null
        }
    }

    fun shareReport(cfg: LockConfig): Intent? {
        return try {
            val dir = File(context.cacheDir, "perf").apply { mkdirs() }
            val name = "oclock-perf-" + SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss", Locale.US).format(Date()) + ".json"
            val f = File(dir, name)
            FileOutputStream(f).use { it.write(buildReportJson(cfg).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
            val uri: Uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(context, "${context.packageName}.fileprovider", f)
            Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply {
                type = "application/json"
                putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, uri)
                putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, "OClock Performance Report")
                addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun round1(v: Double): Double = round(v * 10.0) / 10.0
}
`````

### FILE: `android/app/src/main/java/com/oclock/liquidglass/WallpaperEngine.kt`
<!-- size=6268 sha256_16=6a7cc8a951de4439 trailing_nl=true -->
`````kotlin
package com.oclock.liquidglass

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.LinearGradient
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.Path
import android.graphics.RadialGradient
import android.graphics.Shader
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.roundToInt
import kotlin.math.sin

object WallpaperEngine {
    private val cache = HashMap<String, Bitmap>(6)
    private val thumbCache = HashMap<String, Bitmap>(6)

    fun drawPreset(name: String, w: Int = 900, h: Int = 1800): Bitmap {
        val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(w, h, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        bmp.setHasAlpha(false)
        val c = Canvas(bmp)
        val p = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
        val sx = { v: Float -> v * (w / 900f) }
        val sy = { v: Float -> v * (h / 1800f) }

        fun sky(colors: IntArray, stops: FloatArray) {
            p.shader = LinearGradient(0f, 0f, w * 0.35f, h.toFloat(), colors, stops, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP)
            c.drawRect(0f, 0f, w.toFloat(), h.toFloat(), p)
            p.shader = null
        }

        fun blob(cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, color: Int) {
            val rr = (r * min(w / 900f, h / 1800f)).coerceAtLeast(1f)
            p.shader = RadialGradient(cx, cy, rr, color, Color.TRANSPARENT, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP)
            c.drawCircle(cx, cy, rr, p)
            p.shader = null
        }

        when (name) {
            "angel" -> {
                sky(
                    intArrayOf(
                        0xFFA9C1DD.toInt(), 0xFFDFCBD7.toInt(), 0xFF9DB0C9.toInt(),
                        0xFF5A6A81.toInt(), 0xFF333E51.toInt()
                    ),
                    floatArrayOf(0f, 0.34f, 0.64f, 0.86f, 1f)
                )
                blob(sx(220f), sy(400f), 420f, Color.argb(140, 255, 255, 255))
                blob(sx(660f), sy(300f), 380f, Color.argb(107, 255, 255, 255))
                blob(sx(450f), sy(980f), 520f, Color.argb(56, 255, 255, 255))
                val step = sx(40f).roundToInt().coerceAtLeast(4)
                for (i in 0 until 5) {
                    val y0 = sy(760f + i * 110f)
                    val a = ((0.26f - i * 0.04f) * 255f).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255)
                    p.shader = LinearGradient(
                        0f, y0 - sy(70f), 0f, y0 + sy(70f),
                        intArrayOf(0, Color.argb(a, 255, 255, 255), 0),
                        floatArrayOf(0f, 0.5f, 1f),
                        Shader.TileMode.CLAMP
                    )
                    val path = Path().apply {
                        moveTo(0f, y0)
                        var px = 0
                        while (px <= w) {
                            lineTo(px.toFloat(), y0 + sin((px / w.toFloat()) * 5f + i) * sy(28f))
                            px += step
                        }
                        lineTo(w.toFloat(), y0 + sy(150f))
                        lineTo(0f, y0 + sy(150f))
                        close()
                    }
                    c.drawPath(path, p)
                }
                p.shader = RadialGradient(
                    w * 0.5f, sy(1100f), sx(620f).coerceAtLeast(1f),
                    Color.argb(87, 255, 250, 242), Color.argb(0, 255, 250, 242),
                    Shader.TileMode.CLAMP
                )
                c.drawRect(0f, sy(400f), w.toFloat(), h.toFloat(), p)

                p.shader = RadialGradient(
                    w * 0.5f, h * 0.5f, (h * 0.8f).coerceAtLeast(1f),
                    intArrayOf(0, 0, Color.argb(87, 20, 26, 38)),
                    floatArrayOf(0f, 0.25f, 1f),
                    Shader.TileMode.CLAMP
                )
                c.drawRect(0f, 0f, w.toFloat(), h.toFloat(), p)
                p.shader = null
            }

            "obsidian" -> {
                sky(
                    intArrayOf(0xFF171B24.toInt(), 0xFF0A0C11.toInt(), 0xFF000000.toInt()),
                    floatArrayOf(0f, 0.5f, 1f)
                )
                blob(w * 0.5f, h * 0.34f, 900f * 0.9f, Color.argb(51, 90, 110, 150))
            }

            "dusk" -> {
                sky(
                    intArrayOf(
                        0xFF2A1C46.toInt(), 0xFF7C3F6B.toInt(), 0xFFD9705C.toInt(),
                        0xFFF2B07A.toInt(), 0xFF2B2039.toInt()
                    ),
                    floatArrayOf(0f, 0.3f, 0.58f, 0.78f, 1f)
                )
                blob(w * 0.7f, h * 0.66f, 300f, Color.argb(166, 255, 215, 160))
                blob(w * 0.2f, h * 0.2f, 420f, Color.argb(89, 120, 90, 200))
            }

            "aurora" -> {
                sky(
                    intArrayOf(
                        0xFF0B1030.toInt(), 0xFF1C4D8C.toInt(), 0xFF2AA88A.toInt(), 0xFF101A34.toInt()
                    ),
                    floatArrayOf(0f, 0.42f, 0.72f, 1f)
                )
                blob(sx(240f), sy(620f), 420f, Color.argb(115, 90, 255, 190))
                blob(sx(700f), sy(900f), 460f, Color.argb(115, 120, 90, 255))
                blob(sx(430f), sy(380f), 360f, Color.argb(89, 70, 200, 255))
            }

            "daylight" -> {
                sky(
                    intArrayOf(0xFFF2F6FB.toInt(), 0xFFE2EBF4.toInt(), 0xFFBFD0E2.toInt()),
                    floatArrayOf(0f, 0.46f, 1f)
                )
                blob(w * 0.7f, sy(380f), 420f, Color.argb(217, 255, 255, 255))
            }

            else -> {
                sky(intArrayOf(0xFF242A36.toInt(), 0xFF0C1016.toInt()), floatArrayOf(0f, 1f))
                blob(w * 0.5f, h * 0.3f, 900f * 0.8f, Color.argb(56, 120, 140, 180))
            }
        }
        return bmp
    }

    fun getWallpaper(name: String, customWall: Bitmap?): Bitmap {
        if (name == "custom" && customWall != null) return customWall
        val key = PresetWall.fromId(name).id
        return cache.getOrPut(key) { drawPreset(key, 900, 1800) }
    }

    fun getThumb(name: String, customWall: Bitmap?): Bitmap {
        if (name == "custom" && customWall != null) {
            return Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(customWall, 84, 108, true)
        }
        val key = PresetWall.fromId(name).id
        return thumbCache.getOrPut(key) { drawPreset(key, 84, 108) }
    }
}
`````

`````javascript
import {test} from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {readFileSync, existsSync} from 'node:fs';
import vm from 'node:vm';

const html = readFileSync('web/index.html','utf8');

test('all inline JavaScript parses', () => {
  for (const match of html.matchAll(/<script(?:\s[^>]*)?>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g)) new vm.Script(match[1]);
  for (const name of ['mobile.js','mobile-init.js','native-glass.js']) new vm.Script(readFileSync('web/'+name,'utf8'));
});

test('local fonts and pure native Kotlin assets are packaged', () => {
  assert.ok(!html.includes('fonts.googleapis.com'));
  for (const name of ['mobile.js','mobile-init.js','mobile.css','fonts/inter-latin-400-normal.woff2','fonts/oswald-latin-400-normal.woff2','fonts/bebas-neue-latin-400-normal.woff2']) assert.ok(existsSync('web/'+name));

  // Android app is pure native Kotlin + AGSL + C++ (zero WebView, bundled TTF fonts)
  const gradle = readFileSync('android/app/build.gradle','utf8');
  assert.ok(gradle.includes("id 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.android'"));
  assert.ok(!gradle.includes('androidx.webkit'));
  for (const ttf of ['bebas_neue.ttf','oswald.ttf','inter.ttf']) {
    assert.ok(existsSync('android/app/src/main/assets/fonts/'+ttf), 'missing bundled font '+ttf);
  }
});

test('hardware and reduced motion never downgrade glass quality', () => {
  const code=readFileSync('web/mobile-init.js','utf8');
  for (const [memory,cores,reduced] of [[2,2,false],[2,2,true],[8,8,false]]) {
    const context={window:{}, navigator:{deviceMemory:memory,hardwareConcurrency:cores},matchMedia:()=>({matches:reduced})};
    vm.runInNewContext(code,context); assert.equal(context.window.mobileLite,false);
  }
  assert.ok(!html.includes('window.mobileLite ? 1'));
  assert.ok(!html.includes('!window.mobileLite &&'));
`````

`````javascript
import { chromium as playwright } from '@playwright/test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
const browser = await playwright.launch({headless:true});
try {
  for (const [width,height,reducedMotion] of [[360,640,'no-preference'],[412,915,'no-preference'],[320,568,'reduce'],[800,360,'no-preference']]) {
    const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width,height},isMobile:true,hasTouch:true,reducedMotion,acceptDownloads:true});
    const errors=[]; page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));
    await page.route('https://api.open-meteo.com/**',route=>route.abort());
    await page.addInitScript(() => {
      Object.defineProperty(navigator,'deviceMemory',{get:()=>2});
      Object.defineProperty(navigator,'hardwareConcurrency',{get:()=>2});
      const RealDate = Date;
      let offsetMs = 0;
      const baseFake = new RealDate(2026, 10, 25, 18, 16, 5, 0).getTime();
      const basePerf = performance.now();
      class FixedDate extends RealDate {
        constructor(...a) {
          super(...(a.length ? a : [baseFake + offsetMs + (performance.now() - basePerf)]));
        }
        static now() { return baseFake + offsetMs + (performance.now() - basePerf); }
      }
      window.Date = FixedDate;
      window.__advanceClockMs = (ms) => { offsetMs += ms; };
    });
    await page.goto('http://localhost:5173');
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.getElementById('clock-inner').style.backgroundImage.startsWith('url('), null, {timeout:20000});
    await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>canGlass),true, 'low RAM must not disable refraction');
    const before = await page.evaluate(() => ({
      sx:CONFIG.clock.sx, sy:CONFIG.clock.sy,
      rim:document.getElementById('clock-inner').style.backgroundImage,
      width:document.getElementById('clock-glass').getBoundingClientRect().width,
      screen:document.getElementById('screen').getBoundingClientRect().width,
      quality:Clock.metrics()
    }));
    assert.ok(before.width <= before.screen + 1, 'clock must fit screen');
    const rimPixels = await page.evaluate(async () => {
      const src=document.getElementById('clock-inner').style.backgroundImage.slice(5,-2);
      const image=new Image(); image.src=src; await image.decode();
      const canvas=document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.width=image.width; canvas.height=image.height;
      const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.drawImage(image,0,0);
      const data=ctx.getImageData(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height).data;
      let white=0; for(let i=0;i<data.length;i+=4) if(data[i]>240 && data[i+1]>240 && data[i+2]>240 && data[i+3]>0) white++;
      return white;
    });
    assert.ok(rimPixels>20,'white inner shadow must contain visible pixels');
    const layoutInfo = await page.evaluate(async () => {
      const top = document.getElementById('topline').getBoundingClientRect();
      const clk = document.getElementById('clock-glass').getBoundingClientRect();
      const sh = document.getElementById('sh-left');
      const shBox = sh.getBoundingClientRect();
      const shRimBg = sh.querySelector('.lg-shadow-layer')?.style.backgroundImage || '';
      const shUrl = shRimBg.slice(4, -1).replace(/^"|"$/g, '');
      const shImg = new Image(); shImg.src = shUrl; await shImg.decode();
      const dnd = document.getElementById('dnd');
      const dndBox = dnd.getBoundingClientRect();
      let dndRimW = 0;
      if (dndBox.width > 0) {
        const dndRimBg = dnd.querySelector('.lg-shadow-layer')?.style.backgroundImage || '';
        const rimUrl = dndRimBg.slice(4, -1).replace(/^"|"$/g, '');
        const img = new Image(); img.src = rimUrl; await img.decode();
        dndRimW = img.width;
      }
      return { topBottom: top.bottom, clkTop: clk.top, shW: shBox.width, shRimW: shImg.width, dndW: dndBox.width, dndRimW };
    });
    assert.ok(layoutInfo.clkTop >= layoutInfo.topBottom - 2, 'clock must sit cleanly below topline');
    assert.ok(layoutInfo.shRimW >= layoutInfo.shW * 1.8, 'sh-left rim must be supersampled (>=2x)');
    if (layoutInfo.dndW > 0) assert.ok(layoutInfo.dndRimW >= layoutInfo.dndW * 1.8, 'dnd rim must be supersampled (>=2x)');
    await page.evaluate(()=>Clock.schedule(true));
    await page.waitForTimeout(600);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('#clock-inner').evaluate(el=>el.style.backgroundImage),before.rim,'unchanged rim is reused');
    const tickCheck = await page.evaluate(async () => {
      const glass = document.getElementById('clock-glass');
      const glow = document.getElementById('clock-glow');
      const beforeKey = glow.dataset.painted;
      let minGlassOp = 1, minGlowOp = 1, sawEmptyMask = false, sawSwapping = false;
      let active = true;
      const sample = () => {
        if (!active) return;
        const gOp = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(glass).opacity || '1');
        const glOp = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(glow).opacity || '1');
        if (gOp < minGlassOp) minGlassOp = gOp;
        if (glOp < minGlowOp) minGlowOp = glOp;
        const m = glass.style.webkitMaskImage || glass.style.maskImage || '';
        if (!m || m === 'none') sawEmptyMask = true;
        if (document.body.classList.contains('swapping')) sawSwapping = true;
        requestAnimationFrame(sample);
      };
      requestAnimationFrame(sample);
      window.__advanceClockMs(60 * 1000);
      Clock.schedule(false);
      await new Promise((res) => {
        const deadline = performance.now() + 3000;
        const wait = () => {
          if (glow.dataset.painted !== beforeKey || performance.now() > deadline) { res(); return; }
          setTimeout(wait, 25);
        };
        wait();
      });
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 120));
      active = false;
      return { beforeKey, afterKey: glow.dataset.painted, minGlassOp, minGlowOp, sawEmptyMask, sawSwapping };
    });
    assert.equal(tickCheck.beforeKey, '18:16', 'initial minute is 18:16');
    assert.equal(tickCheck.afterKey, '18:17', 'minute advances cleanly to 18:17');
    assert.ok(tickCheck.minGlassOp >= 0.99 && tickCheck.minGlowOp >= 0.99, 'minute tick must never fade or hide clock digits');
    assert.equal(tickCheck.sawEmptyMask, false, 'minute tick must never drop glyph mask');
    assert.equal(tickCheck.sawSwapping, false, 'minute tick must never disable backdrop refraction');
    await page.setViewportSize({width:height,height:width});
    await page.waitForTimeout(1100);
    assert.deepEqual(await page.evaluate(()=>({sx:CONFIG.clock.sx,sy:CONFIG.clock.sy})),{sx:before.sx,sy:before.sy},'rotation preserves glyph proportions');
    await page.setViewportSize({width,height});
    await page.waitForTimeout(1100);
    await page.evaluate(()=>Editor.open());
    assert.equal(await page.locator('#edit').evaluate(el=>el.classList.contains('open')),true);
    const box=await page.locator('#edit').boundingBox();
    assert.ok(box.x>=-1 && box.x+box.width<=width+1);
    await page.locator('#clock-fmt [data-fmt="12"]').click();
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>state.hour24),false,'12h format button sets hour24=false');
    await page.locator('#clock-fmt [data-fmt="24"]').click();
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>state.hour24),true,'24h format button sets hour24=true');
    const preY = (await page.locator('#clock-glass').boundingBox()).y;
    await page.locator('#clock-y').fill('36');
    await page.locator('#clock-y').dispatchEvent('input');
    await page.waitForTimeout(260);
    const postY = (await page.locator('#clock-glass').boundingBox()).y;
    assert.ok(postY > preY + 10, 'clock-y slider moves clock vertically');
    await page.locator('#clock-y').fill('0');
    await page.locator('#clock-y').dispatchEvent('input');
    await page.waitForTimeout(220);
    await page.locator('#clock-opacity').fill('0');
    await page.locator('#clock-opacity').dispatchEvent('input');
    const glassZero = await page.evaluate(() => ({
      tint: document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('--clock-tint'),
      shOp: document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('--clock-shadow-op'),
      innerBg: document.getElementById('clock-inner').style.backgroundImage
    }));
    assert.equal(glassZero.tint, 'transparent', '0% opacity renders pure liquid glass');
    assert.equal(glassZero.shOp, '0', '0% opacity disables flat shadow tint');
    assert.ok(glassZero.innerBg.startsWith('url('), 'inner rim stays visible at 0% opacity');

    await page.evaluate(()=>window.appBack());
    assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);
    console.log(`PASS ${width}x${height} reduced-motion=${reducedMotion}`);
    await page.close();
  }
} catch(error) {
  console.error('::error::'+String(error).replaceAll('\n','%0A'));
  throw error;
} finally { await browser.close(); }
`````
