`````javascript
// Frozen original full-quality math, used only for pixel-equivalence regression tests.

'use strict';
const clamp01=x=>Math.max(0,Math.min(1,x));
const clamp255=x=>Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(x)));
function convexCircle(x){ const c=clamp01(x); return Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-(1-c)*(1-c))); }
function convexSquircle(x){ const c=clamp01(x); return Math.pow(Math.max(0,1-Math.pow(1-c,4)),0.25); }
function smootherstep(x){ const c=clamp01(x); return c*c*c*(c*(c*6-15)+10); }
const SURFACES={convexCircle,convexSquircle,concaveSquircle:x=>1-convexSquircle(x),lipSquircle:x=>{const t=smootherstep(x);const a=convexSquircle(x),b=1-a;return a*(1-t)+b*t;}};
function refract(I,N,n1,n2){const eta=n1/n2,cosI=-(I.x*N.x+I.y*N.y),sin2T=eta*eta*(1-cosI*cosI);if(sin2T>1)return null;const cosT=Math.sqrt(1-sin2T);return {x:eta*I.x+(eta*cosI-cosT)*N.x,y:eta*I.y+(eta*cosI-cosT)*N.y};}
function dispAt(o){const x=clamp01(o.distancePx/o.bezelWidth),h=o.surfaceFn(x)*o.thickness,d=0.001;const x1=Math.max(0,x-d),x2=Math.min(1,x+d);const slope=((o.surfaceFn(x2)-o.surfaceFn(x1))/(x2-x1))*o.thickness/o.bezelWidth;let nx=-slope,nz=1;const len=Math.hypot(nx,nz)||1;nx/=len;nz/=len;const T=refract({x:0,y:-1},{x:nx,y:nz},1,o.refractiveIndex);if(!T||T.y===0)return 0;return (-h/T.y)*T.x;}
function buildProfile(o){const n=127,profile=new Array(n);let maxAbs=0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){profile[i]=dispAt({distancePx:(i/(n-1))*o.bezelWidth,bezelWidth:o.bezelWidth,thickness:o.thickness,surfaceFn:o.surfaceFn,refractiveIndex:o.ior});maxAbs=Math.max(maxAbs,Math.abs(profile[i]));}return {profile,maxAbs:maxAbs||1e-6,bezelWidth:o.bezelWidth,samples:n};}
function sampleProfile(r,distPx){const c=clamp01(distPx/r.bezelWidth)*r.bezelWidth,p=(c/r.bezelWidth)*(r.samples-1);const i0=Math.floor(p),i1=Math.min(r.samples-1,i0+1),t=p-i0;return r.profile[i0]*(1-t)+r.profile[i1]*t;}
function edt1d(f,d,v,z,n){let k=0;v[0]=0;z[0]=-1e20;z[1]=1e20;for(let q=1;q<n;q++){let s=((f[q]+q*q)-(f[v[k]]+v[k]*v[k]))/(2*q-2*v[k]);while(s<=z[k]){k--;s=((f[q]+q*q)-(f[v[k]]+v[k]*v[k]))/(2*q-2*v[k]);}k++;v[k]=q;z[k]=s;z[k+1]=1e20;}k=0;for(let q=0;q<n;q++){while(z[k+1]<q)k++;const dx=q-v[k];d[q]=dx*dx+f[v[k]];}}
function edt2d(binary,w,h,targetVal){const INF=1e12;const grid=new Float32Array(w*h);for(let i=0;i<w*h;i++)grid[i]=(binary[i]===targetVal)?0:INF;const maxDim=Math.max(w,h);const f=new Float32Array(maxDim),d=new Float32Array(maxDim),v=new Int32Array(maxDim),z=new Float32Array(maxDim+1);for(let y=0;y<h;y++){const off=y*w;for(let x=0;x<w;x++)f[x]=grid[off+x];edt1d(f,d,v,z,w);for(let x=0;x<w;x++)grid[off+x]=d[x];}for(let x=0;x<w;x++){for(let y=0;y<h;y++)f[y]=grid[y*w+x];edt1d(f,d,v,z,h);for(let y=0;y<h;y++)grid[y*w+x]=Math.sqrt(d[y]);}return grid;}

function* computeGlassJob(alpha, w, h, ss, params) {
  const nPx = w * h;
  const binary = new Uint8Array(nPx);
  for (let i = 0; i < nPx; i++) binary[i] = alpha[i] >= 128 ? 1 : 0;
  const distOut = edt2d(binary, w, h, 1);
  const distIn = edt2d(binary, w, h, 0);
  const sdf = new Float32Array(nPx);
  let maxInside = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < nPx; i++) {
    const s = distOut[i] > 0 ? (distOut[i] - 0.5) : -(distIn[i] - 0.5);
    sdf[i] = s;
    if (-s > maxInside) maxInside = -s;
  }
  const smooth = new Float32Array(nPx);
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
    const ym = y > 0 ? y - 1 : 0, yp = y < h - 1 ? y + 1 : h - 1;
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      const xm = x > 0 ? x - 1 : 0, xp = x < w - 1 ? x + 1 : w - 1;
      smooth[y*w+x] = (sdf[ym*w+xm]+2*sdf[ym*w+x]+sdf[ym*w+xp]+2*sdf[y*w+xm]+4*sdf[y*w+x]+2*sdf[y*w+xp]+sdf[yp*w+xm]+2*sdf[yp*w+x]+sdf[yp*w+xp])*0.0625;
    }
  }
  const userBezelRaster = Math.max(2, params.bezel * ss);
  const bezelRaster = Math.max(2, Math.min(userBezelRaster, Math.max(2, 0.5 * maxInside)));
  const thickRaster = (params.thickness * ss) * (bezelRaster / userBezelRaster);
  const surfaceFn = SURFACES[params.surface] || SURFACES.convexSquircle;
  const radial = buildProfile({ bezelWidth: bezelRaster, thickness: thickRaster, ior: params.ior, surfaceFn });
  const dispData = new Uint8ClampedArray(nPx * 4);
  const shadData = new Uint8ClampedArray(nPx * 4);
  const shadThick = Math.max(1, params.shadowThickness * ss);
  const feather = Math.max(0.9, shadThick * 0.15);
  const radAngle = params.shadowAngle * Math.PI / 180;
  const ax = Math.cos(radAngle), ay = Math.sin(radAngle);
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
    const ym = y > 0 ? y - 1 : 0, yp = y < h - 1 ? y + 1 : h - 1;
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      const xm = x > 0 ? x - 1 : 0, xp = x < w - 1 ? x + 1 : w - 1;
      const idx = y*w+x, p = idx*4, dd = sdf[idx];
      const gx = (smooth[y*w+xp]-smooth[y*w+xm])*0.5;
      const gy = (smooth[yp*w+x]-smooth[ym*w+x])*0.5;
      const len = Math.hypot(gx,gy)||1;
      const nx = gx/len, ny = gy/len;
      if (dd > 0) {
        dispData[p]=dispData[p+1]=dispData[p+2]=128; dispData[p+3]=255;
      } else {
        const disp = sampleProfile(radial, Math.min(-dd, radial.bezelWidth));
        dispData[p]   = clamp255(128 - nx*(disp/radial.maxAbs)*127);
        dispData[p+1] = clamp255(128 - ny*(disp/radial.maxAbs)*127);
        dispData[p+2] = 128; dispData[p+3] = 255;
      }
      if (dd > feather || -dd > shadThick + feather) {
        shadData[p+3] = 0;
      } else {
        const edge = -dd;
        const band = clamp01((shadThick - edge) / shadThick);
        const sharp = Math.pow(band, 0.6);
        const edgeAA = clamp01((feather - dd) / (2 * feather));
        const k = Math.abs(nx*ax + ny*ay);
        shadData[p]=shadData[p+1]=shadData[p+2]=255;
        shadData[p+3]=clamp255(sharp*edgeAA*Math.pow(k,1.8)*255);
      }
    }
  }
  return { maxAbsCss: radial.maxAbs/ss, dispBuf: dispData.buffer, shadBuf: shadData.buffer };
}
`````

### FILE: `scripts/glass.test.mjs`
<!-- size=1679 sha256_16=3749ca8c87c55263 trailing_nl=true -->
`````javascript
import {test} from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import vm from 'node:vm';
const original = 'const WORKER_SRC = `' + readFileSync('scripts/fixtures/glass-reference.js','utf8') + 'self.onmessage';
const updated = readFileSync('web/index.html','utf8');
function core(html) {
  const src = html.split('const WORKER_SRC = `')[1].split('self.onmessage')[0];
  return vm.runInNewContext(src+'\ncomputeGlassJob');
}
function run(fn, alpha,w,h) {
  const it=fn(alpha,w,h,2,{bezel:50,thickness:40,ior:1.5,surface:'convexSquircle',shadowThickness:2.5,shadowAngle:55});
  let next=it.next(); while (!next.done) next=it.next(); return next.value;
}
test('optimized refraction is byte-identical to the original at full resolution', () => {
  const before=core(original), after=core(updated);
  for (const [w,h] of [[96,128],[160,64],[48,80]]) {
    const alpha=new Uint8Array(w*h);
    for(let y=0;y<h;y++) for(let x=0;x<w;x++) {
      const ring=Math.abs(Math.hypot((x-w/2)*1.2,y-h/2)-Math.min(w,h)*.3);
      alpha[y*w+x]=ring<5 ? 255 : ring<6 ? 100 : 0;
    }
    const a=run(before,alpha,w,h), b=run(after,alpha,w,h);
    assert.equal(b.maxAbsCss,a.maxAbsCss);
    assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(b.dispBuf),Buffer.from(a.dispBuf));
    assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(b.shadBuf),Buffer.from(a.shadBuf));
  }
});
test('auto-fit does not overwrite saved glyph aspect ratio', () => {
  const guard=updated.split('function clampInsideScreen() {')[1].split('\n  }')[0];
  assert.ok(!guard.includes('CONFIG.clock.sx ='));
  assert.ok(!guard.includes('CONFIG.clock.sy ='));
  assert.ok(updated.includes('size *= Math.max(.1, fit)'));
});
`````

`````cpp
    int w=std::stoi(argv[1]),h=std::stoi(argv[2]);
    glass::Params p; p.surface=std::stoi(argv[3]);
    std::vector<uint8_t> input((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(std::cin)),std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    try {
        auto result=glass::compute(input,w,h,p,argc==4);
        std::cout.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&result.maxAbsCss),sizeof(double));
        std::cout.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(result.displacement.data()),result.displacement.size());
        std::cout.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(result.shadow.data()),result.shadow.size());
    } catch(const std::exception& e) { std::cerr<<e.what(); return 1; }
}
`````

`````javascript
import {test} from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {execFileSync,spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {readFileSync,mkdtempSync,rmSync} from 'node:fs';
import {tmpdir} from 'node:os';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import vm from 'node:vm';

test('C++ Android engine preserves full-quality reference refraction and rim', () => {
  const temp=mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),'oclock-native-'));
  try {
    const binary=join(temp,'core');
    execFileSync('g++',['-std=c++17','-O3','-ffp-contract=off','scripts/native-core-test.cpp','-o',binary]);
    const core=vm.runInNewContext(readFileSync('scripts/fixtures/glass-reference.js','utf8')+'\ncomputeGlassJob');
    for (const [w,h] of [[96,128],[160,64],[48,80]]) for (const [surfaceId,surface] of ['convexSquircle','convexCircle','concaveSquircle','lipSquircle'].entries()) {
      const alpha=new Uint8Array(w*h);
      for(let y=0;y<h;y++) for(let x=0;x<w;x++) {
        const ring=Math.abs(Math.hypot((x-w/2)*1.2,y-h/2)-Math.min(w,h)*.3);
        alpha[y*w+x]=ring<5?255:ring<6?100:0;
      }
      const it=core(alpha,w,h,2,{bezel:50,thickness:40,ior:1.5,surface,shadowThickness:2.5,shadowAngle:55});
      let next=it.next(); while(!next.done) next=it.next(); const reference=next.value;
      const output=execFileSync(binary,[String(w),String(h),String(surfaceId)],{input:alpha,maxBuffer:32000000});
      assert.ok(Math.abs(output.readDoubleLE()-reference.maxAbsCss)<1e-8,`${surface} displacement scale`);
      const minimal=execFileSync(binary,[String(w),String(h),String(surfaceId),'disp-only'],{input:alpha,maxBuffer:32000000});
      assert.deepEqual(minimal,output.subarray(0,8+w*h*4),'omitting unused shadow cannot change refraction');
      const expected=Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(reference.dispBuf),Buffer.from(reference.shadBuf)]);
      const actual=output.subarray(8); assert.equal(actual.length,expected.length);
      for(let i=0;i<actual.length;i++) assert.ok(Math.abs(actual[i]-expected[i])<=1,`${surface} ${w}x${h} byte ${i}: ${actual[i]} vs ${expected[i]}`);
    }
    const invalid=spawnSync(binary,['1','1','0'],{input:Buffer.from([255])});
    assert.notEqual(invalid.status,0,'invalid raster must be rejected');
  } finally { rmSync(temp,{recursive:true,force:true}); }
});

test('Android transport sends binary alpha and native results; failure disables native path', async () => {
  let packet;
  const bridge={postMessage:p=>packet=p};
  const context={window:{AndroidGlass:bridge},document:{getElementById:()=>null,addEventListener:()=>{}},setTimeout,clearTimeout,ArrayBuffer,DataView,Uint8Array,Error,Number,JSON};
  vm.runInNewContext(readFileSync('web/native-glass.js','utf8'),context);
  const engine=context.window.NativeGlassMath;
  const job=engine.compute(7,{w:4,h:4,ss:2,alpha:new Uint8Array(16).fill(255)},
    {ior:1.5,thickness:40,bezel:50,shadowThickness:2.5,shadowAngle:55,surface:'convexSquircle'});
  assert.equal(packet.byteLength,96); assert.equal(new DataView(packet).getFloat64(0,true),7);
  assert.equal(new Uint8Array(packet)[80],255);
  bridge.onmessage({data:JSON.stringify({jobId:7,maxAbsCss:20,dispUrl:'https://appassets.androidplatform.net/native-glass/1/disp.png',nativeMs:12})});
  assert.equal((await job).nativeMs,12); assert.equal(engine.stats.backend,'android-cpp');
  const transient=engine.compute(8,{w:4,h:4,ss:2,alpha:new Uint8Array(16).fill(255)},
    {ior:1.5,thickness:40,bezel:50,shadowThickness:2.5,shadowAngle:55,surface:'convexSquircle'});
  bridge.onmessage({data:JSON.stringify({jobId:8,error:'invalid raster size',fatal:false})});
  await assert.rejects(transient);
  assert.equal(engine.available,true);
  bridge.postMessage=()=>{throw new Error('unsupported');};
  await assert.rejects(engine.compute(9,{w:4,h:4,ss:2,alpha:new Uint8Array(16)},{}));
  assert.equal(engine.available,false); assert.equal(engine.stats.backend,'web-worker');
});
`````

`````html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#000000">
<title>Lock Screen — Liquid Glass</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="mobile.css">
<script src="mobile-init.js"></script>
<script src="native-glass.js"></script>
<style>
:root{
  --safe-t: max(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px), var(--native-safe-t, 0px));
  --safe-b: max(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px), var(--native-safe-b, 0px));
  --clock-top: #ffffff;
  --clock-tint: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.30), rgba(255,255,255,.10));
  --ui: #ffffff;
  --ui-dim: rgba(255,255,255,.72);
  --glass-bg: rgba(255,255,255,.05);
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1);
  --spring: cubic-bezier(.22,1.18,.36,1);
  --bounce: cubic-bezier(.2,1.52,.32,1);
  --soft: cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.24,1);
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
/* class the Liquid Glass skill expects on every glass target */
.lg-glass-layer{
  position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;
  pointer-events:none;background:var(--glass-bg);
  contain:layout style paint;
  transform:translateZ(0);
  z-index:-1;
}
#np.lg-attached,#dnd.lg-attached,.sh-btn.lg-attached{background:transparent}
.sh-btn.lg-attached.on{background:rgba(255,255,255,.92)}
.lg-shadow-layer{
  position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;
  pointer-events:none;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-size:100% 100%;
  z-index:2;
}
.glass-fallback{
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(1.6) brightness(1.08) !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(1.6) brightness(1.08) !important;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.28);
}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#000}
body{
  font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,'SF Pro Text',system-ui,sans-serif;
  color:#fff;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
  overscroll-behavior:none;
  touch-action:manipulation;
}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}
input{font:inherit}

/* ─────────────── Lock screen shell (fills the viewport) ─────────────── */
#screen{
  position:fixed;inset:0;
  overflow:hidden;
  isolation:isolate;
  background:#05060a;
}
#wall{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  width:100%;height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;
  object-position:center;
  transform:scale(var(--wall-zoom,1)) translate3d(0,0,0);
  transition:transform .7s var(--ease);
  will-change:transform;
}
#wall-dim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#000;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .5s var(--ease)}
#wall-tint{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .6s var(--ease)}

/* Depth effect: cut-out sits ABOVE the clock (clock z-index:2 < subject z-index:3 < frame/np/topline z-index:4+) */
#subject{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  width:100%;height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;object-position:center;
  pointer-events:none;
  z-index:3;
  transform:scale(var(--wall-zoom,1)) translate3d(0,0,0);
  transition:transform .7s var(--ease), opacity .5s var(--ease);
  will-change:transform;
  display:none;
}
body.has-subject #subject{display:block}

/* ─────────────── Status bar ─────────────── */
#status{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;
  padding:calc(var(--safe-t) + 10px) 26px 0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.01em;
  color:var(--ui);
  pointer-events:none;
  z-index:6;
  text-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
}
.st-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.st-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.st-icon{display:flex;align-items:center;opacity:.96;transition:opacity .3s var(--ease)}
.st-icon.off{opacity:.28}
.st-icon svg{display:block}
#battery{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
  font-size:14px;font-weight:600;
}
.bat-shell{
  width:26px;height:13px;border-radius:4px;
  border:1.4px solid currentColor;
  position:relative;opacity:.95;
}
.bat-shell::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;right:-4px;top:4px;
  width:2px;height:5px;border-radius:0 2px 2px 0;background:currentColor;
}
.bat-fill{
  position:absolute;inset:1.6px;border-radius:2px;
  background:currentColor;transform-origin:left center;
  transform:scaleX(.49);
  transition:transform .6s var(--ease), background .4s;
}
.bat-fill.low{background:#ff453a}
.bat-fill.chg{background:#30d158}

/* Dynamic island: sleek iOS live activity pill */
#island{
  position:absolute;top:calc(var(--safe-t) + 9px);left:50%;
  transform:translateX(-50%) scale(.76);
  min-width:112px;max-width:72vw;height:32px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:20px;
  background:#000;
  box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.35), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  z-index:7;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:0;
  transition:opacity .32s var(--ease), transform .5s var(--spring), min-width .5s var(--spring), height .5s var(--spring), border-radius .5s var(--spring);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;
  overflow:hidden;
}
#island.active{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1)}
#island.wide{min-width:176px;height:36px;border-radius:21px;opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1)}
#island-dot{
  width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#30d158;flex:none;
  opacity:0;transform:scale(.4);transition:opacity .25s,transform .35s var(--spring),background .25s;
}
#island.wide #island-dot{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}
#island-label{
  font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(2px);
  transition:opacity .28s .08s var(--ease), transform .32s .08s var(--spring);
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;
}
#island.wide #island-label{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ─────────────── Date + weather ─────────────── */
#topline{
  position:absolute;top:calc(var(--safe-t) + 50px);left:0;right:0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;
  font-size:17px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;
  color:var(--ui);
  z-index:5;
  pointer-events:none;
  text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
  transition:color .5s var(--ease), opacity .4s var(--ease);
}
#topline .sep{opacity:.55;font-weight:400}
#wx{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-weight:500}

/* ─────────────── Clock (TextGlass) ─────────────── */
#clock-layer{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;
  top:calc(var(--safe-t) + 82px);
  display:flex;justify-content:center;
  z-index:2;
  pointer-events:none;
}
#clock-wrap{
  position:relative;
  pointer-events:auto;
  cursor:default;
  touch-action:none;
  will-change:transform;
  /* the white halo must never be clipped by the glass mask above it */
  padding:18px 20px;
  margin:-18px -20px;
}
body.resizing #clock-wrap{pointer-events:none}
#clock-glass{
  position:relative;
  background:var(--clock-tint);
  transition:opacity .26s var(--ease);
  -webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-repeat:no-repeat;
  -webkit-mask-size:100% 100%;mask-size:100% 100%;
}
/* Digits: FLAT masked glyphs — no stroke, no glow, no halo.
   Exactly like the reference: the numbers are just tinted surfaces. */
#clock-glow{
  position:absolute;left:0;top:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  transition:filter .35s var(--ease);
  z-index:2;
}
#clock-shadow{
  position:absolute;left:0;top:0;
  width:100%;height:100%;
  pointer-events:none;
  background:var(--clock-top,#fff);
  opacity:var(--clock-shadow-op, .24);
  transition:background .22s var(--ease), opacity .2s var(--ease);
  -webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-repeat:no-repeat;
  -webkit-mask-size:100% 100%;mask-size:100% 100%;
}
/* INNER SHADOW: white map clipped to the glyph silhouette. It only lives
   INSIDE the digits — no outer halo, no stroke. */
#clock-inner{
  position:absolute;left:0;top:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  background-repeat:no-repeat;
  background-size:100% 100%;
  background-position:0 0;
  -webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat;mask-repeat:no-repeat;
  -webkit-mask-size:100% 100%;mask-size:100% 100%;
  transition:opacity .26s var(--ease);
  z-index:1;
}
#clock-fb{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-weight:700;
  white-space:pre;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.88);
  text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(8,12,20,.35), 0 8px 26px rgba(8,12,20,.22);
  pointer-events:none;
}

/* ─────────────── Clock resize frame (long-press) ─────────────── */
#clock-frame{
  position:absolute;
  left:0;top:0;
  width:0;height:0;
  border:0;
  border-radius:22px;
  z-index:4;                      /* above the clock, below the editor */
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:0;
  transform:scale(.94);
  transition:opacity .28s var(--ease), transform .38s var(--spring);
  touch-action:none;
}
#clock-frame.on{
  opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.35);
}
#clock-frame .h{
  position:absolute;
  width:20px;height:20px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  pointer-events:auto;
  touch-action:none;
  transition:transform .2s var(--spring), background .2s;
}
#clock-frame .h::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:6px;border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(20,22,28,.55);
}
#clock-frame.on .h{animation:hPulse 2.4s var(--ease) infinite}
@keyframes hPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35),0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
  50%{box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35),0 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,.22)}}
#clock-frame .h:active{transform:scale(1.25)}
#clock-frame .h.nw{left:-10px;top:-10px;cursor:nwse-resize}
#clock-frame .h.ne{right:-10px;top:-10px;cursor:nesw-resize}
#clock-frame .h.sw{left:-10px;bottom:-10px;cursor:nesw-resize}
#clock-frame .h.se{right:-10px;bottom:-10px;cursor:nwse-resize}
#clock-frame .h.n{left:50%;top:-10px;margin-left:-10px;cursor:ns-resize}
#clock-frame .h.s{left:50%;bottom:-10px;margin-left:-10px;cursor:ns-resize}
#clock-frame .h.w{left:-10px;top:50%;margin-top:-10px;cursor:ew-resize}
#clock-frame .h.e{right:-10px;top:50%;margin-top:-10px;cursor:ew-resize}
/* edge handles stay invisible: big touch targets, no visual noise */
#clock-frame .h.n,#clock-frame .h.s,#clock-frame .h.w,#clock-frame .h.e{
  width:34px;height:34px;background:transparent;box-shadow:none;animation:none;
}
#clock-frame .h.n::after,#clock-frame .h.s::after,
#clock-frame .h.w::after,#clock-frame .h.e::after{display:none}
#clock-frame-label{
  position:absolute;left:50%;top:calc(100% + 14px);
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  white-space:nowrap;
  font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);
  background:rgba(24,24,28,.72);
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  padding:6px 12px;border-radius:12px;
  opacity:0;
  transition:opacity .3s var(--ease);
  pointer-events:none;
}
#clock-frame.on #clock-frame-label{opacity:1}
#clock-frame-actions{
  position:absolute;left:50%;top:calc(100% + 44px);
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
#clock-frame.on #clock-frame-actions{display:flex}
#clock-frame-reset,#clock-frame-undo{
  padding:8px 18px;border-radius:14px;
  background:rgba(24,24,28,.72);
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
  touch-action:none;
}
#clock-frame-undo{font-size:15px;padding:8px 14px}
#clock-frame-reset:active,#clock-frame-undo:active{background:rgba(60,60,68,.9)}

/* ─────────────── Now playing card ─────────────── */
#np{
  position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;
  bottom:calc(var(--safe-b) + 84px);
  border-radius:26px;
  padding:13px 15px 9px;
  z-index:4;
  background:var(--glass-bg);
  isolation:isolate;
  contain:layout style;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.985);
  transition:opacity .38s var(--ease), transform .44s var(--spring);
  touch-action:pan-y;
}
#np.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
#np.gone{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);pointer-events:none}
#np.track-swap .np-top{animation:trackPop .42s var(--spring) both}
@keyframes trackPop{
  0%{opacity:.55;transform:scale(.97)}
  60%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.015)}
  100%{opacity:1;transform:none}
}
.np-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px}
#np-art{
  width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:9px;
  object-fit:cover;flex:none;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff5f6d,#ffc371);
  box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
  transition:transform .52s var(--spring), opacity .35s var(--ease);
}
body.np-paused #np-art{transform:scale(.88);opacity:.9}
.np-meta{flex:1;min-width:0;line-height:1.25;overflow:hidden}
.np-meta.scrolling{
  -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,#000 6%,#000 92%,transparent 100%);
  mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,#000 6%,#000 92%,transparent 100%);
}
#np-title{
  font-size:15.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.015em;
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;
  display:block;
  -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 88%,transparent 100%);
  mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 88%,transparent 100%);
}
#np-title.scroll{
  width:max-content;overflow:visible;
  -webkit-mask-image:none;mask-image:none;
  animation:marquee 9s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes marquee{
  0%,8%{transform:translateX(0)}
  46%,54%{transform:translateX(var(--mq,0))}
  92%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}
}
#np-artist{
  font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ui-dim);font-weight:500;
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;
  display:block;margin-top:1px;
}
.np-wave{opacity:.72;flex:none;contain:paint}
.np-wave rect{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center bottom}
body:not(.np-paused) .np-wave rect:nth-child(1){animation:eqBar .78s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
body:not(.np-paused) .np-wave rect:nth-child(2){animation:eqBar .62s .15s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
body:not(.np-paused) .np-wave rect:nth-child(3){animation:eqBar .88s .08s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
body:not(.np-paused) .np-wave rect:nth-child(4){animation:eqBar .70s .24s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes eqBar{0%{transform:scaleY(.38)}100%{transform:scaleY(1.04)}}
/* progress */
.np-bar{
  margin:11px 0 0;
  height:16px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;
  position:relative;
  cursor:pointer;
  touch-action:none;
}
.np-track{
  position:relative;flex:1;height:5px;border-radius:3px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.24);
  overflow:visible;
}
.np-fill{
  position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;
  border-radius:3px;background:var(--ui);
  transform-origin:left center;
  transform:scaleX(0);
  will-change:transform;
}
.np-thumb{
  position:absolute;top:50%;left:0;
  width:11px;height:11px;
  margin:-5.5px 0 0 -5.5px;
  transform:translate3d(calc(var(--p, 0) * var(--bar-w, 300px)), 0, 0);
  will-change:transform;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.np-thumb::after{
  content:'';
  display:block;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  transform:scale(.78);
  transition:transform .46s var(--bounce);
}
.np-bar:hover .np-thumb::after,
.np-bar:active .np-thumb::after{transform:scale(1.45)}
.np-bar.scrub .np-thumb::after{transform:scale(1.55)}
.np-bar.scrub .np-track{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.np-times{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
  font-size:11px;font-weight:600;
  color:var(--ui-dim);
  margin-top:-2px;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  letter-spacing:.02em;
}
/* controls */
.np-controls{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  margin-top:6px;
  padding:0 2px;
}
.np-btn{
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  width:44px;height:40px;
  border-radius:12px;
  color:var(--ui);
  transition:transform .44s var(--bounce), opacity .26s var(--ease);
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}
.np-btn:active{transform:scale(.84)}
.np-btn.nudge{animation:npNudge .46s var(--bounce) both}
@keyframes npNudge{
  0%{transform:scale(.84)}
  45%{transform:scale(1.14)}
  72%{transform:scale(.96)}
  100%{transform:scale(1)}
}
.np-btn.nudge-r{animation:npNudgeR .46s var(--bounce) both}
@keyframes npNudgeR{
  0%{transform:scale(.84) translateX(0)}
  45%{transform:scale(1.14) translateX(3px)}
  72%{transform:scale(.96) translateX(-1px)}
  100%{transform:scale(1) translateX(0)}
}
.np-btn.nudge-l{animation:npNudgeL .46s var(--bounce) both}
@keyframes npNudgeL{
  0%{transform:scale(.84) translateX(0)}
  45%{transform:scale(1.14) translateX(-3px)}
  72%{transform:scale(.96) translateX(1px)}
  100%{transform:scale(1) translateX(0)}
}
#np.track-swap .np-meta{animation:metaSwap .46s var(--soft) both}
@keyframes metaSwap{
  0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(7px) scale(.97)}
  100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}
}
#np.track-swap #np-art{animation:artSwap .56s var(--bounce) both}
@keyframes artSwap{
  0%{transform:scale(.82) rotate(-4deg)}
  55%{transform:scale(1.06) rotate(1.5deg)}
  100%{transform:scale(1) rotate(0)}
}
.np-btn.small{opacity:.62;width:38px}
#np-play svg{width:30px;height:30px}
.np-btn svg{display:block;pointer-events:none}
/* play/pause morph */
#np-play .i-pause{opacity:0;transform:scale(.4) rotate(-24deg)}
#np-play .i-play{opacity:1;transform:scale(1) rotate(0)}
#np-play .i-pause,#np-play .i-play{
  transition:opacity .26s var(--ease),transform .52s var(--bounce);
  grid-area:1/1;
}
#np-play.playing .i-pause{opacity:1;transform:scale(1) rotate(0)}
#np-play.playing .i-play{opacity:0;transform:scale(.4) rotate(24deg)}

/* ─────────────── Bottom shortcuts ─────────────── */
#bottom{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;
  bottom:calc(var(--safe-b) + 26px);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 24px;
  z-index:5;
}
.sh-btn{
  position:relative;
  width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--glass-bg);
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  color:var(--ui);
  isolation:isolate;
  transition:transform .42s var(--bounce), background .28s var(--ease),
             box-shadow .42s var(--bounce);
  touch-action:none;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}
.sh-btn:active{transform:scale(.86)}
.sh-btn.on{transform:scale(1.06);box-shadow:0 6px 22px rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.sh-btn.pop{animation:shPop .52s var(--bounce) both}
@keyframes shPop{
  0%{transform:scale(.86)}
  42%{transform:scale(1.12)}
  68%{transform:scale(.97)}
  100%{transform:scale(1)}
}
.sh-btn.on{background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:#111}
.sh-btn svg{display:block;pointer-events:none;width:23px;height:23px}
.sh-btn .glyph{font-size:22px;line-height:1;pointer-events:none}
.sh-btn.charging{transform:scale(.93)}
#dnd{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  height:34px;padding:0 15px;border-radius:17px;
  background:var(--glass-bg);
  font-size:13px;font-weight:600;
  color:var(--ui);
  isolation:isolate;
  transition:opacity .3s, transform .3s var(--spring);
}
#dnd svg{width:14px;height:14px;opacity:.9}
#dnd.gone{opacity:0;transform:scale(.9);pointer-events:none}

.s-row{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;padding:2px 2px 6px}
.s-item{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr 30px;
  align-items:center;gap:10px;
  font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ui);
}
.s-item span{opacity:.85}
.s-item b{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:12px;opacity:.7;text-align:center}
.s-item input[type=range]{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
  width:100%;height:26px;border-radius:13px;
  background:transparent;
  outline:none;
  direction:ltr;
  touch-action:none;
}
.s-item input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{
  height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);
}
.s-item input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
  width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;margin-top:-7px;
  background:#fff;border:0;
  box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
  transition:transform .28s var(--spring);
}
.s-item input[type=range]:active::-webkit-slider-thumb{transform:scale(1.18)}
.s-item input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{
  width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#fff;border:0;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
}

/* home indicator */
#bar{
  position:absolute;bottom:calc(var(--safe-b) + 7px);left:50%;
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:134px;height:5px;border-radius:3px;
  background:var(--ui);
  opacity:.92;
  z-index:6;
  pointer-events:none;
  transition:transform .25s var(--ease), background .4s;
}

/* ─────────────── Flashlight overlay ─────────────── */
#flash{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:8;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 82%,#fffef4 0%,#fff 72%);
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .3s var(--ease);
}
/* the light is purely visual: it must never swallow a tap meant for the
   shortcut buttons sitting underneath it */
#flash.on{opacity:.97;pointer-events:none}
/* …and its own dismiss button is only tappable while the light is on */
#flash.on button{pointer-events:auto}
#flash button{
  position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:calc(var(--safe-b) + 60px);
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  padding:11px 22px;border-radius:22px;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.82);color:#fff;
  font-size:14px;font-weight:600;
}

/* ─────────────── iPhone long-press feedback ─────────────── */
#shutter{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:14;
  background:#fff;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
}
#cam-iris{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:13;
  pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 42%, rgba(0,0,0,.55) 78%);
  opacity:0;
  transition:opacity .5s var(--ease);
}
#cam.on #cam-iris{opacity:1}
#cam-shutter{
  position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:calc(var(--safe-b) + 42px);
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:66px;height:66px;border-radius:50%;
  border:4px solid rgba(255,255,255,.92);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  z-index:12;
  transition:transform .22s var(--spring), background .22s, opacity .25s;
}
#cam-shutter:active{transform:translateX(-50%) scale(.88);background:#fff}
#cam-shutter:disabled{opacity:.35;pointer-events:none}

/* ─────────────── Camera sheet ─────────────── */
#cam{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:9;
  background:#000;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .35s var(--ease);
  display:grid;place-items:center;
}
#cam.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
#cam video{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
#cam .cam-msg{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);font-size:14px;text-align:center;padding:0 30px;line-height:1.6}
#cam-close{
  position:absolute;top:calc(var(--safe-t) + 14px);right:18px;
  width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  z-index:15;
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
}

/* ─────────────── Customize: simple bottom bar ─────────────── */
#edit{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
  z-index:10;
  /* an RTL sheet must never spill past the left edge — clip the horizontal rows */
  overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:auto;
  overscroll-behavior:contain;
  contain:layout style;
  padding:8px 14px calc(var(--safe-b) + 10px);
  background:rgba(18,19,24,.94);
  border-radius:26px 26px 0 0;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.14), 0 -14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  transform:translateY(104%);
  transition:transform .36s cubic-bezier(.22,1.08,.36,1);
}
body.editing #edit{will-change:transform}
#edit.open{transform:none}
.edit-grabber{
  width:36px;height:4.5px;border-radius:3px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.32);
  margin:0 auto 8px;
  cursor:grab;touch-action:none;
}
.edit-head{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 4px 6px;
}
.edit-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)}
#edit-done{
  padding:7px 16px;border-radius:15px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;
}
#edit-done:active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.26)}
.edit-label{
  font-size:11px;font-weight:600;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.42);
  margin:5px 4px 5px;
  letter-spacing:.02em;
}
/* font row */
.f-row{
  display:flex;gap:8px;
  overflow-x:auto;
  scrollbar-width:none;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
  padding-bottom:2px;
}
.f-row::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.f-chip{
  flex:none;
  min-width:54px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1px;
  color:#fff;
  transition:background .25s var(--ease), transform .25s var(--spring);
}
.f-chip b{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.f-chip span{font-size:9px;opacity:.5;font-weight:500}
.f-chip.sel{background:rgba(255,255,255,.28)}
.f-chip:active{transform:scale(.94)}
/* color row */
.c-row{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding:2px 2px 4px}
.c-row::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.c-dot{
  flex:none;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  transition:transform .28s var(--spring), box-shadow .28s;
  position:relative;
}
.c-dot.sel{
  transform:scale(1.14);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.25);
}
.c-dot:active{transform:scale(.9)}
.c-pro{
  margin:4px 2px 8px;padding:10px 11px;border-radius:14px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;
}
.c-pro-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:12px}
.c-pro-preview{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.c-pro-swatch{
  width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65);
  background:var(--clock-top,#fff);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;flex:none;
}
.c-pro-swatch input[type=color]{
  position:absolute;inset:-6px;width:36px;height:36px;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;
}
#clock-hex{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);font-weight:600;direction:ltr}
.c-pro-bar{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px 1fr 34px;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);font-weight:600;
}
.c-pro-bar input[type=range]{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:100%;height:22px;background:transparent;outline:none;direction:ltr;touch-action:none;
}
.c-pro-bar input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{
  height:10px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
}
#clock-hue::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff3b30 0%,#ffcc00 17%,#34c759 33%,#00c7be 50%,#007aff 67%,#af52de 83%,#ff2d55 100%);
}
#clock-tone::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#000000 0%,var(--pro-hue,#7ad0ff) 50%,#ffffff 100%);
}
#clock-opacity::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08) 0%,var(--clock-top,#ffffff) 100%);
}
.c-pro-bar input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
  width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;margin-top:-5px;
  background:#fff;border:2px solid rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
}
.w-chip.ai{
  width:auto;padding:0 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(90,190,255,.28),rgba(167,139,250,.28));
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.24);
  color:#fff;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;
}
.w-chip.ai.busy{opacity:.72;pointer-events:none}
#ai-depth-status{display:block;font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68);margin:2px 4px 4px}
.perf-card{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border-radius:16px;padding:10px 12px;margin:2px 0 6px;
}
.perf-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px}
.perf-stat{background:rgba(0,0,0,.22);border-radius:10px;padding:6px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.perf-stat span{font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);font-weight:600}
.perf-stat b{font-size:12.5px;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;direction:ltr;text-align:right}
.perf-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#perf-note{display:block;margin-top:6px;font-size:10.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);line-height:1.45}
/* wallpapers */
.w-row{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding:2px 2px 4px}
.w-row::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.w-chip{
  flex:none;width:42px;height:54px;border-radius:10px;
  overflow:hidden;position:relative;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  transition:transform .28s var(--spring), box-shadow .28s;
  background-size:cover;background-position:center;
}
.w-chip.sel{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.4);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.w-chip:active{transform:scale(.94)}
.w-chip.upload{display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:rgba(255,255,255,.78)}
.w-chip.upload svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.w-chip.gallery{width:auto;padding:0 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.w-chip.gallery svg{width:17px;height:17px;flex:none}
/* toggles */
.t-row{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:1px 2px 2px}
.fmt-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;padding:1px 2px 4px}
.fmt-row .t-btn{justify-content:center}
.t-btn{
  padding:6px 11px;border-radius:13px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
  font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  transition:background .25s, color .25s, transform .2s var(--spring);
}
.t-btn.on{background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);color:#111}
.t-btn:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.t-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}

/* ─────────────── Toast ─────────────── */
#toast{
  position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:calc(var(--safe-b) + 118px);
  transform:translate(-50%,10px);
  padding:9px 17px;border-radius:18px;
  background:rgba(28,28,32,.9);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .3s,transform .35s var(--spring);
  z-index:11;
  white-space:nowrap;
  max-width:88vw;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;
}
#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}

/* ─────────────── Non-Chromium notice ─────────────── */
#notice{
  position:absolute;bottom:calc(var(--safe-b) + 96px);left:50%;
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  max-width:92vw;
  padding:8px 14px;border-radius:14px;
  background:rgba(28,28,32,.88);
  font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.45;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);
  text-align:center;
  z-index:12;
  display:none;
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
}

/* During a resize gesture the expensive SVG displacement filter is swapped for a
   flat tint. The digits are mask-driven so this still looks like the clock, but
   the compositor has nothing costly to recompute — the drag stays at 60fps. */
body.resizing #clock-glass{
  backdrop-filter:none !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:none !important;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(96,106,124,.72) 0%, rgba(96,106,124,.52) 100%) !important;
}
/* the shadow map is a per-pixel PNG; keep it readable but cheap */
body.resizing #clock-shadow{opacity:.62}
body.resizing #clock-inner{opacity:.75}
body.resizing #clock-glass,
body.resizing #clock-shadow{will-change:transform}

/* while customising, clear the deck so the clock stays clearly visible above the bar
   without rescaling the SVG refraction layer during the sheet animation */
body.editing #np{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px);pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .24s,transform .32s var(--ease)}
body.editing #bottom{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .24s}
body.editing #clock-layer{transform:translateY(-14px);transition:transform .36s var(--spring)}
body.editing #bar{opacity:.35}

/* reduced motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms !important;transition-duration:.01ms !important}
}
/* wide screens: keep the lock screen phone-sized and centered */
@media (min-width:560px){
  #screen{left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:430px;right:auto;border-radius:44px;box-shadow:0 40px 120px rgba(0,0,0,.8),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
}
/* ─────────────── Landscape / short viewports ───────────────
   Full-bleed, clock shrunk at the top, music card bottom-left,
   shortcuts bottom-right — no collisions at any size. */
@media (max-height:560px) and (orientation:landscape){
  #screen{left:0;right:0;width:auto;transform:none;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none}
  #island{display:none}
  #status{padding-top:calc(var(--safe-t) + 4px);font-size:12px}
  .st-left,.st-right{font-size:12px}
  #topline{top:calc(var(--safe-t) + 26px);font-size:12px;opacity:.92}
  #clock-layer{top:calc(var(--safe-t) + 42px);transform:scale(.58);transform-origin:top center}
  body.editing #clock-layer{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(.5);transform-origin:top center}
  #np{
    bottom:calc(var(--safe-b) + 10px);left:12px;right:auto;
    width:min(54vw, 340px);padding:8px 12px 6px;border-radius:20px;
  }
  #np #np-art{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px}
  #np #np-title{font-size:13px}
  #np #np-artist{font-size:11px}
  #np .np-bar{margin-top:6px;height:12px}
  #np .np-times{font-size:10px;margin-top:-4px}
  #np .np-controls{margin-top:1px}
  #np .np-btn{width:36px;height:30px}
  #np #np-play svg{width:23px;height:23px}
  #bottom{
    left:auto;right:14px;width:auto;
    bottom:calc(var(--safe-b) + 14px);
    padding:0;gap:14px;justify-content:flex-end;
  }
  #dnd{display:none}
  #bar{display:none}
  #clock-frame-label{display:none}
  #clock-frame-actions{top:calc(100% + 10px)}
  #toast{bottom:calc(var(--safe-b) + 90px);left:auto;right:16px;transform:translate(0,10px)}
  #toast.show{transform:translate(0,0)}
  #edit{max-height:min(56dvh,270px);overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:auto;padding-top:6px}
  .s-row{gap:6px}
  .s-item{grid-template-columns:46px 1fr 26px;font-size:11.5px}
  .s-item input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{width:17px;height:17px;margin-top:-5.5px}
  .edit-head{margin-bottom:0}
  .edit-title{font-size:13px}
  .edit-label{font-size:11px;margin:2px 0 2px}
  .f-chip{min-width:46px;height:38px;border-radius:10px}
  .f-chip b{font-size:16px}
  .c-dot{width:24px;height:24px}
  .w-chip{width:34px;height:42px}
  .w-chip.gallery{width:auto;padding:0 10px;height:42px;font-size:11px}
  .t-btn{padding:4px 9px;border-radius:11px;font-size:11.5px}
}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="screen">
  <img id="wall" alt="">
  <div id="wall-tint"></div>
  <div id="wall-dim"></div>
  <img id="subject" alt="">


  <div id="topline"><span id="date"></span><span class="sep">·</span><span id="wx" dir="ltr"></span></div>

  <div id="clock-layer">
    <div id="clock-wrap">
      <div id="clock-glow"><div id="clock-shadow"></div><div id="clock-inner"></div></div>
      <div id="clock-glass"><div id="clock-fb"></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- iOS-style resize frame, shown on long-press -->
  <div id="clock-frame" aria-hidden="true">
    <span class="h nw" data-h="nw"></span>
    <span class="h ne" data-h="ne"></span>
    <span class="h sw" data-h="sw"></span>
    <span class="h se" data-h="se"></span>
    <span class="h n" data-h="n"></span>
    <span class="h s" data-h="s"></span>
    <span class="h w" data-h="w"></span>
    <span class="h e" data-h="e"></span>
    <div id="clock-frame-label">اسحب المقبض · أو اضغط تصغير</div>
    <div id="clock-frame-actions">
      <button type="button" id="clock-frame-reset">تصغير</button>
      <button type="button" id="clock-frame-undo" aria-label="رجوع للحجم السابق">↺</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="np">
    <div class="np-top" dir="ltr">
      <img id="np-art" alt="">
      <div class="np-meta">
        <span id="np-title"></span>
        <span id="np-artist"></span>
      </div>
      <div class="np-wave" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><rect x="2" y="9" width="2.4" height="6" rx="1.2"/><rect x="7" y="5.5" width="2.4" height="13" rx="1.2"/><rect x="12" y="8" width="2.4" height="8" rx="1.2"/><rect x="17" y="3.5" width="2.4" height="17" rx="1.2"/></svg>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="np-bar" id="np-bar">
      <div class="np-track"><div class="np-fill" id="np-fill"></div><div class="np-thumb" id="np-thumb"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="np-times" dir="ltr"><span id="np-elapsed">0:00</span><span id="np-remain">-0:00</span></div>
    <div class="np-controls" dir="ltr">
      <button class="np-btn small" id="np-star" aria-label="مفضلة">
        <svg width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 2.6l2.9 6 6.6.9-4.8 4.6 1.2 6.5L12 17.5 6.1 20.6l1.2-6.5L2.5 9.5l6.6-.9z"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="np-btn" id="np-prev" aria-label="السابق">
        <svg width="27" height="27" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M6 5.5h2.2v13H6zM19 5.2v13.6L8.6 12z"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="np-btn" id="np-play" aria-label="تشغيل">
        <svg class="i-play" width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M7.5 4.6v14.8L20 12z"/></svg>
        <svg class="i-pause" width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><rect x="6.4" y="4.6" width="4" height="14.8" rx="1.4"/><rect x="13.6" y="4.6" width="4" height="14.8" rx="1.4"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="np-btn" id="np-next" aria-label="التالي">
        <svg width="27" height="27" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M15.8 5.5H18v13h-2.2zM5 5.2v13.6L15.4 12z"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="np-btn small" id="np-air" aria-label="AirPlay">
        <svg width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 16l4.5 5.4h-9z"/><path d="M6 4h12a2 2 0 012 2v9.6a2 2 0 01-2 2h-1.6l-1.6-2H18V6H6v9.6h3.2l-1.6 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2z"/></svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="bottom" dir="ltr">
    <button class="sh-btn" id="sh-left" aria-label="مصباح">
      <span class="sh-inner"></span>
    </button>
    <div id="dnd">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M20.5 14.6A8.6 8.6 0 019.4 3.5a8.6 8.6 0 1011.1 11.1z"/></svg>
      <span id="dnd-text">عدم الإزعاج</span>

      <span class="sh-inner"></span>
    </button>
  </div>

  <div id="bar"></div>
  <div id="toast"></div>
  <div id="notice"></div>

  <div id="flash"><button id="flash-off">إطفاء المصباح</button></div>

  <div id="cam">
    <video id="cam-video" playsinline autoplay muted></video>

    <div id="cam-iris"></div>
    <button type="button" id="cam-shutter" aria-label="التقاط"></button>
    <div id="shutter"></div>
    <button id="cam-close" aria-label="إغلاق">
      <svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg>
    </button>
  </div>

  <div id="status" dir="ltr">
    <div class="st-left"><span id="carrier">5G</span></div>
    <div class="st-right">
      <span class="st-icon" id="i-focus"></span>
      <span class="st-icon" id="i-signal"></span>
      <span class="st-icon" id="i-wifi"></span>
      <div id="battery"><span id="bat-pct">49</span><span class="bat-shell"><span class="bat-fill" id="bat-fill"></span></span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="island"><span id="island-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span><span id="island-label"></span></div>

  <!-- Customize sheet -->
  <div id="edit" role="dialog" aria-label="تخصيص">
    <div class="edit-grabber" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="edit-head">
      <span class="edit-title">تخصيص شاشة القفل</span>
      <button id="edit-done">تم</button>
    </div>
    <div class="edit-label">الخط</div>
    <div class="f-row" id="fonts"></div>
    <label class="clock-size-control" for="clock-size">حجم الساعة <output id="clock-size-value"></output>
      <input id="clock-size" type="range" min="56" max="420" step="2" aria-label="حجم الساعة">
    </label>
    <label class="clock-size-control" for="clock-stretch">طول الساعة (بدون تشويه الوزن) <output id="clock-stretch-value"></output>
      <input id="clock-stretch" type="range" min="100" max="310" step="5" aria-label="طول الساعة">
    </label>
    <label class="clock-size-control" for="clock-y">موضع الساعة <output id="clock-y-value"></output>
      <input id="clock-y" type="range" min="-20" max="80" step="2" aria-label="موضع الساعة">
      <small>اسحب زاوية الساعة يميناً لزيادة الحجم حتى 100% ثم للأسفل لتطويلها حتى 100% بحرية.</small>
      <small id="glass-engine-status" aria-live="polite">محرك حساب الزجاج: Web Worker</small>
    </label>
    <div class="edit-label">نظام الساعة</div>
    <div class="fmt-row" id="clock-fmt">
      <button type="button" class="t-btn" data-fmt="12">12 ساعة</button>
      <button type="button" class="t-btn" data-fmt="24">24 ساعة</button>
    </div>
    <div class="edit-label">لون الساعة وشفافية الزجاج</div>
    <div class="c-row" id="colors"></div>
    <div class="c-pro" id="clock-pro-palette">
      <div class="c-pro-head">
        <span>لوحة الألوان الاحترافية</span>
        <div class="c-pro-preview">
          <span id="clock-hex">تلقائي</span>
          <label class="c-pro-swatch" id="clock-swatch" title="اختر أي لون بدقة">
            <input id="clock-color-native" type="color" value="#ffffff" aria-label="اختيار لون مخصص للساعة">
          </label>
        </div>
      </div>
      <label class="c-pro-bar"><span>الطيف</span><input id="clock-hue" type="range" min="0" max="360" step="1" value="205" aria-label="درجة اللون"><b id="clock-hue-v">205°</b></label>
      <label class="c-pro-bar"><span>الدرجة</span><input id="clock-tone" type="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="50" aria-label="سطوع اللون"><b id="clock-tone-v">50%</b></label>
      <label class="c-pro-bar"><span>الشفافية</span><input id="clock-opacity" type="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="22" aria-label="شفافية لون الساعة"><b id="clock-opacity-v">22%</b></label>
    </div>
    <div class="edit-label">الخلفية وتأثير العمق (AI مجاني)</div>
    <div class="w-row" id="walls"></div>
    <small id="ai-depth-status" aria-live="polite">الذكاء الاصطناعي المجاني لعزل الشخصية جاهز (Google ML Kit / RMBG-1.4)</small>
    <div class="edit-label">شادو الساعة الداخلي (الساعة فقط)</div>
    <div class="s-row">
      <label class="s-item">
        <span>الشفافية</span>
        <input type="range" id="in-op" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="42">
        <b id="in-op-v">42</b>

      <label class="s-item">
        <span>السماكة</span>
        <input type="range" id="in-th" min="0" max="8" step="0.5" value="2.2">
        <b id="in-th-v">2.2</b>
      </label>
      <label class="s-item">
        <span>الزاوية</span>
        <input type="range" id="in-ang" min="0" max="360" step="5" value="55">
        <b id="in-ang-v">55</b>
      </label>
    </div>
    <div class="c-row" id="in-colors"></div>
    <div class="edit-label">خيارات</div>
    <div class="t-row" id="toggles"></div>
    <div class="edit-label">مراقب الأداء المستمر (FPS · الذاكرة · الاستهلاك)</div>
    <div class="perf-card" id="perf-card">
      <div class="perf-grid" aria-live="polite">
        <div class="perf-stat"><span>معدل الإطارات (FPS)</span><b id="perf-fps">--</b></div>
        <div class="perf-stat"><span>تأخير الإطارات / Jank</span><b id="perf-jank">--</b></div>
        <div class="perf-stat"><span>ذاكرة JS / المخبأ</span><b id="perf-jsmem">--</b></div>
        <div class="perf-stat"><span>ذاكرة النظام (PSS / RAM)</span><b id="perf-sysmem">--</b></div>
      </div>
      <div class="perf-actions">
        <button type="button" class="t-btn on" id="perf-download">تحميل تقرير الأداء (.json)</button>
        <button type="button" class="t-btn" id="perf-share">مشاركة / حفظ باسم</button>
        <button type="button" class="t-btn" id="perf-reset">تصفير</button>
      </div>
      <small id="perf-note">يسجّل الأداء والذاكرة تلقائياً من فتح التطبيق وحتى الخروج منه.</small>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<input type="file" id="f-wall" accept="image/*" hidden>
<input type="file" id="f-subject" accept="image/png,image/webp" hidden>
<input type="file" id="f-audio" accept="audio/*" hidden>
<input type="file" id="f-art" accept="image/*" hidden>

<script>
'use strict';

/* ============================================================================
   CONFIG — edit these. That's the whole customization surface.
   ========================================================================= */
const CONFIG = {
  clock: {
    font: 'Bebas Neue',   // 'Bebas Neue' | 'Oswald' | 'Inter' | 'SF'
    weight: 400,
    size: 172,            // px — balanced iOS lock-screen scale
    sx: 1.0,              // natural horizontal proportion
    sy: 1.22,             // clean optical stance (scales up to 2.45x without thickening bars)
    tracking: -2,
    hour24: true,
    leadingZero: true
  },
  glass: {
    surface: 'convexSquircle',
    ior: 1.5,
    thickness: 40,
    bezel: 50,
    shadow: { thickness: 1, angle: 55, intensity: 0.36 },        // glass rim shadow (cards only)
    inner:  { thickness: 2.2, intensity: 0.42, angle: 55, color: '#ffffff' }  // INNER shadow (clock only)
  },
  depth: { enabled: false, parallax: 0 },
  radius: 26,            // card corner radius
  weather: '☁ −3°'
};

const STORE_KEY = 'lock_glass_simple_v3';

const DEFAULTS = {
  font: 'Bebas Neue',
  color: 'auto',
  clockOpacity: 22,
  wall: 'angel',
  customWall: '',
  subject: '',
  subjectWallKey: '',
  hour24: true,
  weatherOn: true,
  npOn: true,
  depth: false,
  dndOn: true,
  clockSize: 172,
  clockSx: 1.0,
  clockSy: 1.22,
  clockY: 0,
  innerThickness: 2.2,
  innerIntensity: 0.42,
  innerColor: '#ffffff',
  np: { title: 'Grown Woman', artist: 'Beyoncé', elapsed: 58, duration: 315 }
};

const state = (() => {
  let s = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULTS));
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      Object.assign(s, JSON.parse(raw));
    } else {
      const legacy = localStorage.getItem('lock_glass_simple_v2');
      if (legacy) {
        const old = JSON.parse(legacy);
        // Migrate user's custom media/toggles, while replacing the legacy stretched geometry
        for (const k of ['font','color','wall','customWall','subject','hour24','weatherOn','npOn','depth','dndOn','np']) {
          if (old[k] !== undefined) s[k] = old[k];
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return s;
})();

/* Restore any saved clock geometry so a reload keeps your size. */
if (typeof state.clockSize === 'number') CONFIG.clock.size = state.clockSize;
if (typeof state.innerThickness === 'number') {
  state.innerThickness = Math.max(0, Math.min(8, state.innerThickness));
  CONFIG.glass.inner.thickness = state.innerThickness;
}
if (typeof state.innerAngle === 'number') {
  CONFIG.glass.inner.angle = ((state.innerAngle % 360) + 360) % 360;
}
if (typeof state.innerColor === 'string' && /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(state.innerColor)) {
  CONFIG.glass.inner.color = state.innerColor;
}
if (typeof state.innerIntensity === 'number') {
  state.innerIntensity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, state.innerIntensity));
  CONFIG.glass.inner.intensity = state.innerIntensity;
}
/* Older saves wrote shadowOpacity/shadowThickness straight into the glass rim
   shadow, which made every card look wrong. Those two now belong to the clock
   glow only, so a stale save is dropped instead of poisoning the glass. */
try { delete state.shadowOpacity; delete state.shadowThickness; } catch (_) {}

if (typeof state.clockSx === 'number')   CONFIG.clock.sx = state.clockSx;
if (typeof state.clockSy === 'number')   CONFIG.clock.sy = state.clockSy;

let saveTimer = 0;
function save(immediate) {
  clearTimeout(saveTimer);
  const write = () => {
    try { localStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); }
    catch (e) {
      if (state.customWall || state.subject) toast('حجم الصورة كبير للحفظ التلقائي');
    }
  };
  if (immediate) { write(); return; }
  saveTimer = setTimeout(write, 180);
}

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const clamp01 = (v) => (v < 0 ? 0 : v > 1 ? 1 : v);

/* ============================================================================
   0. CONTINUOUS PERFORMANCE & MEMORY PROFILER
   Runs with ultra-low overhead from boot until exit; exports downloadable JSON.
   ========================================================================= */
const PerfMonitor = (() => {
  const startedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  const bootT0 = performance.now();
  let lastFrameTs = 0;
  let rafId = 0;
  let memTimer = 0;
  let uiTimer = 0;
  let cacheStatsFn = null;
  let observer = null;

  const metrics = {
    frames: 0,
    droppedFrames: 0,
    jankFrames: 0,
    maxFrameGapMs: 0,
    fpsSamples: [],
    longTasks: [],
    longTaskCount: 0,
    longTaskMaxMs: 0,
    subsystems: {},
    timeline: [],
    jsPeakMB: 0,
    nativePeakPssMB: 0,
    latestNative: null
  };

  let winStart = performance.now();
  let winFrames = 0;
  let currentFps = 0;

  function sampleStep(now) {
    rafId = 0;
    if (document.hidden) { lastFrameTs = 0; return; }
    if (lastFrameTs > 0) {
      const dt = now - lastFrameTs;
      metrics.frames++;
      winFrames++;
      if (dt > 24 && dt < 2000) metrics.droppedFrames++;
      if (dt >= 50 && dt < 2000) metrics.jankFrames++;
      if (dt < 2000 && dt > metrics.maxFrameGapMs) metrics.maxFrameGapMs = Math.round(dt * 10) / 10;
      const winDt = now - winStart;
      if (winDt >= 1000) {
        currentFps = Math.round((winFrames * 1000) / winDt);
        metrics.fpsSamples.push(currentFps);
        if (metrics.fpsSamples.length > 360) metrics.fpsSamples.shift();
        winStart = now;
        winFrames = 0;
      }
    } else {
      winStart = now;
      winFrames = 0;
    }
    lastFrameTs = now;
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(sampleStep);
  }

  function startRaf() {
    if (!rafId && !document.hidden) {
      lastFrameTs = 0;
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(sampleStep);
    }
  }
  function stopRaf() {
    if (rafId) { cancelAnimationFrame(rafId); rafId = 0; }
    lastFrameTs = 0;
  }

  function record(kind, ms, extra) {
    const d = Math.max(0, Math.round(ms * 100) / 100);
    let s = metrics.subsystems[kind];
    if (!s) {
      s = { count: 0, totalMs: 0, maxMs: 0, lastMs: 0, hits: 0, misses: 0, lastExtra: null };
      metrics.subsystems[kind] = s;
    }
    s.count++;
    s.totalMs = Math.round((s.totalMs + d) * 100) / 100;
    s.lastMs = d;
    if (d > s.maxMs) s.maxMs = d;
    if (extra && extra.hit === true) s.hits++;
    if (extra && extra.hit === false) s.misses++;
    if (extra) s.lastExtra = extra;
  }

  function readMemSnapshot() {
    const pm = performance.memory;
    const jsUsedMB = pm ? Math.round((pm.usedJSHeapSize / 1048576) * 100) / 100 : null;
    const jsTotalMB = pm ? Math.round((pm.totalJSHeapSize / 1048576) * 100) / 100 : null;
    const jsLimitMB = pm ? Math.round((pm.jsHeapSizeLimit / 1048576) * 100) / 100 : null;
    if (jsUsedMB != null && jsUsedMB > metrics.jsPeakMB) metrics.jsPeakMB = jsUsedMB;

    let nativeStats = null;
    try {
      const raw = window.AndroidHost?.getPerfStats?.();
      if (raw && raw.length > 2) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (parsed && typeof parsed.totalPssMB === 'number') {
          nativeStats = parsed;
          metrics.latestNative = nativeStats;
          if (nativeStats.totalPssMB > metrics.nativePeakPssMB) metrics.nativePeakPssMB = nativeStats.totalPssMB;
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    const entry = {
      tSec: Math.round((performance.now() - bootT0) / 100) / 10,
      fps: currentFps,
      jsUsedMB,
      nativePssMB: nativeStats ? nativeStats.totalPssMB : null,
      availRamMB: nativeStats ? nativeStats.availRamMB : null
    };
    metrics.timeline.push(entry);
    if (metrics.timeline.length > 180) metrics.timeline.shift();
    return { jsUsedMB, jsTotalMB, jsLimitMB, nativeStats };
  }

  function getSummary(liveMem = true) {
    const samples = metrics.fpsSamples.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const avgFps = samples.length ? Math.round(samples.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / samples.length) : currentFps;
    const minFps = samples.length ? samples[0] : currentFps;
    const lowIdx = samples.length ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(samples.length * 0.05)) : 0;
    const fps5PctLow = samples.length ? samples[lowIdx] : currentFps;
    let snap;
    if (liveMem) {
      snap = readMemSnapshot();
    } else {
      const pm = performance.memory;
      const jsUsedMB = pm ? Math.round((pm.usedJSHeapSize / 1048576) * 100) / 100 : null;
      if (jsUsedMB != null && jsUsedMB > metrics.jsPeakMB) metrics.jsPeakMB = jsUsedMB;
      snap = {
        jsUsedMB,
        jsTotalMB: pm ? Math.round((pm.totalJSHeapSize / 1048576) * 100) / 100 : null,
        jsLimitMB: pm ? Math.round((pm.jsHeapSizeLimit / 1048576) * 100) / 100 : null,
        nativeStats: metrics.latestNative
      };
    }
    const caches = cacheStatsFn ? cacheStatsFn() : {};
    return {
      appVersion: '1.3.0',
      startedAt,
      capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      elapsedSec: Math.round((performance.now() - bootT0) / 100) / 10,
      engine: caches.engine || (window.NativeGlassMath?.available ? 'Android-C++/JNI' : 'Web-Worker'),
      viewport: { w: window.innerWidth, h: window.innerHeight, dpr: window.devicePixelRatio || 1 },
      fps: {
        current: currentFps,
        avg: avgFps,
        min: minFps,
        low5Pct: fps5PctLow,
        totalFrames: metrics.frames,
        droppedOver24ms: metrics.droppedFrames,
        jankOver50ms: metrics.jankFrames,
        maxFrameGapMs: metrics.maxFrameGapMs
      },
      longTasks: {
        count: metrics.longTaskCount,
        maxMs: metrics.longTaskMaxMs,
        recent: metrics.longTasks.slice(-15)
      },
      memory: {
        jsUsedMB: snap.jsUsedMB,
        jsPeakMB: metrics.jsPeakMB || snap.jsUsedMB,
        jsTotalMB: snap.jsTotalMB,
        jsLimitMB: snap.jsLimitMB,
        native: snap.nativeStats || metrics.latestNative,
        nativePeakPssMB: metrics.nativePeakPssMB,
        caches
      },
      subsystems: metrics.subsystems
    };
  }

  function computeTopConsumers(summary) {
    const out = [];
    const nat = summary.memory.native;
    if (nat) {
      out.push({
        area: 'Android WebView + Graphics + Native PSS',
        value: `${nat.totalPssMB} MB (Peak ${summary.memory.nativePeakPssMB || nat.totalPssMB} MB)`,
        detail: `Native=${nat.nativePssMB}MB, Dalvik=${nat.dalvikPssMB}MB, Other/GPU=${nat.otherPssMB}MB, NativeGlassCache=${nat.nativeGlassCacheKB}KB`
      });
    }
    if (summary.memory.jsUsedMB != null) {
      out.push({
        area: 'JavaScript Heap (DOM + Canvas + Bitmaps)',
        value: `${summary.memory.jsUsedMB} MB (Peak ${summary.memory.jsPeakMB} MB)`,
        detail: `Caches: mask=${summary.memory.caches?.mask || 0}, glass=${summary.memory.caches?.glass || 0}, inner=${summary.memory.caches?.inner || 0}, glyph=${summary.memory.caches?.glyph || 0}`
      });
    }
    const subOrder = Object.entries(summary.subsystems)
      .map(([name, s]) => ({
        name,
        totalMs: s.totalMs,
        avgMs: s.count ? Math.round((s.totalMs / s.count) * 100) / 100 : 0,
        maxMs: s.maxMs,
        count: s.count,
        hits: s.hits,
        misses: s.misses
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.totalMs - a.totalMs);
    for (const s of subOrder.slice(0, 6)) {
      out.push({
        area: `CPU Subsystem: ${s.name}`,
        value: `Total ${s.totalMs}ms · Max ${s.maxMs}ms`,
        detail: `Runs=${s.count}, Avg=${s.avgMs}ms` + (s.hits + s.misses > 0 ? `, CacheHits=${s.hits}/${s.hits + s.misses}` : '')
      });
    }
    if (summary.longTasks.count > 0) {
      out.push({
        area: 'Main-Thread Long Tasks (>=50ms)',
        value: `${summary.longTasks.count} stalls (Max ${summary.longTasks.maxMs}ms)`,
        detail: 'Check timeline & subsystems for frame spikes'
      });
    }
    return out;
  }

  function buildReport() {
    const summary = getSummary();
    return {
      schema: 'oclock.liquidglass.perf.v1',
      summary,
      topConsumers: computeTopConsumers(summary),
      timeline: metrics.timeline
    };
  }

  function updateUI() {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('editing')) return;
    const fpsEl = $('perf-fps'), jankEl = $('perf-jank'), jsEl = $('perf-jsmem'), sysEl = $('perf-sysmem'), noteEl = $('perf-note');
    if (!fpsEl) return;
    const s = getSummary(false);
    fpsEl.textContent = s.fps.current ? `${s.fps.current} fps (avg ${s.fps.avg})` : `${s.fps.avg || '--'} fps`;
    jankEl.textContent = `${s.fps.jankOver50ms} jank · ${s.fps.maxFrameGapMs}ms`;
    const c = s.memory.caches || {};
    jsEl.textContent = s.memory.jsUsedMB != null ? `${s.memory.jsUsedMB} MB · C${(c.mask||0)+(c.glass||0)+(c.inner||0)}` : `Cache ${(c.mask||0)+(c.glass||0)+(c.inner||0)}`;
    const n = s.memory.native;
    sysEl.textContent = n ? `${n.totalPssMB} MB / ${n.availRamMB} MB free` : `${s.engine}`;
    if (noteEl) {
      const top = computeTopConsumers(s)[0];
      noteEl.textContent = top
        ? `المحرك: ${s.engine} · أعلى مستهلك: ${top.area} (${top.value})`
        : `المحرك: ${s.engine} · التسجيل مستمر حتى الخروج`;
    }
  }

  function downloadReport() {
    const report = buildReport();
    const json = JSON.stringify(report, null, 2);
    const d = new Date();
    const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
    const name = `oclock-perf-${d.getFullYear()}${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}${pad(d.getDate())}-${pad(d.getHours())}${pad(d.getMinutes())}${pad(d.getSeconds())}.json`;

    if (window.AndroidHost?.savePerfReport) {
      try {
        const res = window.AndroidHost.savePerfReport(name, json, false);
        if (res && res.startsWith('DOWNLOADS:')) {
          toast(`تم حفظ التقرير في التنزيلات: ${res.slice(10)}`);
          return { ok: true, method: 'android-downloads', filename: res.slice(10), bytes: json.length };
        }
        if (res && res.startsWith('PICKER:')) {
          toast('اختر مكان حفظ ملف الأداء');
          return { ok: true, method: 'android-picker', filename: name, bytes: json.length };
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    const blob = new Blob([json], { type: 'application/json;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = name;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    a.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 4000);
    toast(`تم تنزيل ملف الأداء: ${name}`);
    return { ok: true, method: 'browser-blob', filename: name, bytes: json.length };
  }

  function shareReport() {
    const report = buildReport();
    const json = JSON.stringify(report, null, 2);
    const d = new Date();
    const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
    const name = `oclock-perf-${d.getFullYear()}${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}${pad(d.getDate())}-${pad(d.getHours())}${pad(d.getMinutes())}${pad(d.getSeconds())}.json`;
    if (window.AndroidHost?.sharePerfReport) {
      try {
        if (window.AndroidHost.sharePerfReport(name, json)) return;
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    if (navigator.share) {
      try {
        const file = new File([json], name, { type: 'application/json' });
        if (!navigator.canShare || navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
          navigator.share({ files: [file], title: 'OClock Liquid Glass Performance' }).catch(() => {});
          return;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    downloadReport();
  }

  function flushOnExit() {
    try {
      const json = JSON.stringify(buildReport());
      if (window.AndroidHost?.savePerfReport) {
        window.AndroidHost.savePerfReport('OClock-Perf-Latest.json', json, true);
      }
      try { localStorage.setItem('oclock_last_perf_summary_v1', JSON.stringify(getSummary())); } catch (_) {}
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  function reset() {
    metrics.frames = 0; metrics.droppedFrames = 0; metrics.jankFrames = 0;
    metrics.maxFrameGapMs = 0; metrics.fpsSamples = [];
    metrics.longTasks = []; metrics.longTaskCount = 0; metrics.longTaskMaxMs = 0;
    metrics.subsystems = {}; metrics.timeline = [];
    metrics.jsPeakMB = 0; metrics.nativePeakPssMB = 0;
    winStart = performance.now(); winFrames = 0;
    updateUI();
    toast('تم تصفير عدادات الأداء');
  }

  function init() {
    if ('PerformanceObserver' in window) {
      try {
        observer = new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
          for (const e of list.getEntries()) {
            metrics.longTaskCount++;
            const dur = Math.round(e.duration * 10) / 10;
            if (dur > metrics.longTaskMaxMs) metrics.longTaskMaxMs = dur;
            metrics.longTasks.push({
              tSec: Math.round((performance.now() - bootT0) / 100) / 10,
              durationMs: dur,
              name: e.name || 'self'
            });
            if (metrics.longTasks.length > 40) metrics.longTasks.shift();
          }
        });
        observer.observe({ entryTypes: ['longtask'] });
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    startRaf();
    memTimer = setInterval(() => { if (!document.hidden) readMemSnapshot(); }, 5000);
    uiTimer = setInterval(updateUI, 1000);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (document.hidden) { stopRaf(); flushOnExit(); }
      else { startRaf(); }
    });
  }

  init();

  return {
    record,
    setCacheStatsFn: (fn) => { cacheStatsFn = fn; },
    getSummary,
    buildReport,
    downloadReport,
    shareReport,
    flushOnExit,
    updateUI,
    reset
  };
})();

/* ============================================================================
   1. LIQUID GLASS RECTANGLE ENGINE — verbatim from the skill file
   ========================================================================= */
const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', XLINK='http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink';
const clamp255=x=>Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(x)));

function convexCircle(x){ const c=clamp01(x); return Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-(1-c)*(1-c))); }
function convexSquircle(x){ const c=clamp01(x); return Math.pow(Math.max(0,1-Math.pow(1-c,4)),0.25); }
function smootherstep(x){ const c=clamp01(x); return c*c*c*(c*(c*6-15)+10); }
const SURFACES = {
  convexCircle, convexSquircle,
  concaveSquircle: x => 1 - convexSquircle(x),
  lipSquircle: x => { const t = smootherstep(x); const a = convexSquircle(x), b = 1 - a; return a * (1 - t) + b * t; }
};
function refract(I,N,n1,n2){
  const eta=n1/n2, cosI=-(I.x*N.x+I.y*N.y), sin2T=eta*eta*(1-cosI*cosI);
  if (sin2T>1) return null;
  const cosT=Math.sqrt(1-sin2T);
  return {x:eta*I.x+(eta*cosI-cosT)*N.x, y:eta*I.y+(eta*cosI-cosT)*N.y};
}
function dispAt(o){
  const x=clamp01(o.distancePx/o.bezelWidth), h=o.surfaceFn(x)*o.thickness, d=0.001;
  const x1=Math.max(0,x-d), x2=Math.min(1,x+d);
  const slope=((o.surfaceFn(x2)-o.surfaceFn(x1))/(x2-x1))*o.thickness/o.bezelWidth;
  let nx=-slope, nz=1; const len=Math.hypot(nx,nz)||1; nx/=len; nz/=len;
  const T=refract({x:0,y:-1},{x:nx,y:nz},1,o.refractiveIndex);
  if(!T||T.y===0) return 0;
  return (-h/T.y)*T.x;
}
const profileCache = new Map();
function buildProfile(o){
  const key = [o.bezelWidth,o.thickness,o.ior,Object.keys(SURFACES).find(k => SURFACES[k] === o.surfaceFn)].join('|');
  if (profileCache.has(key)) return profileCache.get(key);
  const n=127, profile=new Array(n); let maxAbs=0;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    profile[i]=dispAt({distancePx:(i/(n-1))*o.bezelWidth, bezelWidth:o.bezelWidth, thickness:o.thickness, surfaceFn:o.surfaceFn, refractiveIndex:o.ior});
    maxAbs=Math.max(maxAbs,Math.abs(profile[i]));
  }
  const result = {profile, maxAbs:maxAbs||1e-6, bezelWidth:o.bezelWidth, samples:n};
  if (profileCache.size >= 16) profileCache.delete(profileCache.keys().next().value);
  profileCache.set(key, result);
  return result;
}
function sampleProfile(r,distPx){
  const c=clamp01(distPx/r.bezelWidth)*r.bezelWidth, p=(c/r.bezelWidth)*(r.samples-1);
  const i0=Math.floor(p), i1=Math.min(r.samples-1,i0+1), t=p-i0;
  return r.profile[i0]*(1-t)+r.profile[i1]*t;
}
function makeShape(w,h,radius){
  const hw=w/2, hh=h/2, r=Math.max(0,Math.min(radius,hw,hh));
  function sdf(px,py){
    const qx=Math.abs(px)-hw+r, qy=Math.abs(py)-hh+r;
    return Math.hypot(Math.max(qx,0),Math.max(qy,0))+Math.min(Math.max(qx,qy),0)-r;
  }
  function normal(px,py){
    const e=0.5;
    const dx=sdf(px+e,py)-sdf(px-e,py), dy=sdf(px,py+e)-sdf(px,py-e);
    const l=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
    return {x:dx/l, y:dy/l};
  }
  return {sdf, normal};
}
function paintDisplacement(data,w,h,shape,radial){
  const cx=w/2, cy=h/2;
  for(let y=0;y<h;y++) for(let x=0;x<w;x++){
    const px=x-cx, py=y-cy, dd=shape.sdf(px,py), i=(y*w+x)*4;
    if (dd>0){ data[i]=data[i+1]=data[i+2]=128; data[i+3]=255; continue; }
    const disp=sampleProfile(radial, Math.min(-dd, radial.bezelWidth));
    const n=shape.normal(px,py);
    data[i]  =clamp255(128-n.x*(disp/radial.maxAbs)*127);
    data[i+1]=clamp255(128-n.y*(disp/radial.maxAbs)*127);
    data[i+2]=128; data[i+3]=255;
  }
}
function paintShadow(data,w,h,shape,s){
  const cx=w/2, cy=h/2, rad=s.angle*Math.PI/180, ax=Math.cos(rad), ay=Math.sin(rad);
  const feather=Math.max(0.9, s.thickness*0.15);
  for(let y=0;y<h;y++) for(let x=0;x<w;x++){
    const px=x-cx, py=y-cy, dd=shape.sdf(px,py), i=(y*w+x)*4;
    if (dd>feather || -dd>s.thickness+feather){ data[i+3]=0; continue; }
    const edge=-dd;
    const band=clamp01((s.thickness-edge)/s.thickness);
    const sharp=Math.pow(band,0.6);
    const edgeAA=clamp01((feather-dd)/(2*feather));
    const n=shape.normal(px,py);
    const k=Math.abs(n.x*ax+n.y*ay);
    data[i]=data[i+1]=data[i+2]=255;
    data[i+3]=clamp255(sharp*edgeAA*Math.pow(k,1.8)*s.intensity*255);
  }
}
function rasterCanvas(wCss,hCss,radiusCss,ss,painter){
  const w=Math.max(2,Math.round(wCss*ss)), h=Math.max(2,Math.round(hCss*ss));
  const cv=document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width=w; cv.height=h;
  const ctx=cv.getContext('2d'); const img=ctx.createImageData(w,h);
  painter(img.data,w,h,makeShape(w,h,radiusCss*ss));
  ctx.putImageData(img,0,0);
  return cv;
}
function defsRoot(){
  let el=document.getElementById('lg-svg-defs');
  if(!el){ el=document.createElementNS(NS,'svg'); el.id='lg-svg-defs';
    el.setAttribute('width','0'); el.setAttribute('height','0');
    el.style.cssText='position:absolute;overflow:hidden'; document.body.appendChild(el); }
  return el;
}

let uidCounter = 0;
/* Chrome accepts `url(#f) saturate(1.1)`; older engines only accept the bare url(). */
const supportsChainedFilter = (() => {
  try {
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.style.backdropFilter = 'url(#f) blur(1px)';
    return d.style.backdropFilter.includes('blur');
  } catch (e) { return false; }
})();

function applyLiquidGlass(el, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  const o = Object.assign({
    surface:'convexSquircle', ior:1.5, thickness:40, bezel:50,
    radius:null, supersample:null
  }, opts);
  o.shadow = Object.assign({ thickness:1, angle:55, intensity:0.36 }, opts.shadow);

  const uid = 'lgFilter' + (++uidCounter);
  let glassLayer = el.querySelector('.lg-glass-layer');
  let shadowEl = opts.shadowEl || el.querySelector('.lg-shadow-layer');
  let rafId = 0;
  let rasterKey = '';

  function rebuild(){
    if (!el.isConnected || getComputedStyle(el).display === 'none') return;
    const wCss=el.offsetWidth, hCss=el.offsetHeight;
    if (wCss < 2 || hCss < 2) return;
    const radiusCss = o.radius!=null ? o.radius : Math.min(wCss,hCss)/2;
`````
