    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const ss = o.supersample || Math.min(3, Math.max(2, Math.round(dpr * 2)));

    const key = [wCss,hCss,radiusCss,ss,o.surface,o.ior,o.thickness,o.bezel,o.shadow.thickness,o.shadow.angle,o.shadow.intensity].join('|');
    if (key === rasterKey) return;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const surfaceFn = SURFACES[o.surface] || SURFACES.convexSquircle;
    const bezelRaster = o.bezel*ss, thickRaster = o.thickness*ss;
    const radial = buildProfile({ bezelWidth:bezelRaster, thickness:thickRaster, ior:o.ior, surfaceFn });

    const glassCv = rasterCanvas(wCss,hCss,radiusCss,ss,(data,w,h,shape)=>paintDisplacement(data,w,h,shape,radial));
    const glassUrl = glassCv.toDataURL('image/png');
    const maxAbsCss = radial.maxAbs/ss;

    let f = document.getElementById(uid);
    if (f) f.remove();
    f = document.createElementNS(NS,'filter');
    f.setAttribute('id', uid);
    f.setAttribute('color-interpolation-filters','sRGB');
    const pad = Math.ceil(maxAbsCss*2)+4;
    f.setAttribute('filterUnits','userSpaceOnUse');
    f.setAttribute('x',-pad); f.setAttribute('y',-pad);
    f.setAttribute('width', wCss+pad*2); f.setAttribute('height', hCss+pad*2);

    const img = document.createElementNS(NS,'feImage');
    img.setAttribute('href', glassUrl); img.setAttributeNS(XLINK,'xlink:href', glassUrl);
    img.setAttribute('x',0); img.setAttribute('y',0);
    img.setAttribute('width', wCss); img.setAttribute('height', hCss);
    img.setAttribute('preserveAspectRatio','none');
    img.setAttribute('result','dispMap');
    f.appendChild(img);

    const dm = document.createElementNS(NS,'feDisplacementMap');
    dm.setAttribute('in','SourceGraphic'); dm.setAttribute('in2','dispMap');
    dm.setAttribute('scale', maxAbsCss*2);
    dm.setAttribute('xChannelSelector','R'); dm.setAttribute('yChannelSelector','G');
    f.appendChild(dm);
    defsRoot().appendChild(f);

    const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
    if (cs.position === 'static') el.style.position = 'relative';
    el.style.isolation = el.style.isolation || 'isolate';
    el.classList.add('lg-attached');
    el.style.backdropFilter = '';
    el.style.webkitBackdropFilter = '';

    if (!glassLayer) {
      glassLayer = document.createElement('span');
      glassLayer.className = 'lg-glass-layer';
      glassLayer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      el.insertBefore(glassLayer, el.firstChild);
    }

    const chain = `url(#${uid})`;
    glassLayer.style.backdropFilter = chain + (supportsChainedFilter ? ' saturate(1.15) contrast(1.06)' : '');
    glassLayer.style.webkitBackdropFilter = glassLayer.style.backdropFilter;

    if (!shadowEl){
      shadowEl = document.createElement('span');
      shadowEl.className='lg-shadow-layer';
      el.insertBefore(shadowEl, el.firstChild);
    }
    const shadowThickRaster = o.shadow.thickness*ss;
    const shadowCv = rasterCanvas(wCss,hCss,radiusCss,ss,(data,w,h,shape)=>
      paintShadow(data,w,h,shape, Object.assign({}, o.shadow, { thickness: shadowThickRaster }))
    );
    shadowEl.style.backgroundImage = `url(${shadowCv.toDataURL('image/png')})`;
    rasterKey = key;
    PerfMonitor.record('cardsGlass', performance.now() - t0, { wCss, hCss, ss });
  }

  rebuild();
  const ro = new ResizeObserver(()=>{
    cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(rebuild);
  });
  ro.observe(el);
  return {
    rebuild,
    disconnect: ()=> {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      ro.disconnect();
      const f = document.getElementById(uid);
      if (f) f.remove();
      if (glassLayer) { glassLayer.remove(); glassLayer = null; }
      el.classList.remove('lg-attached');
      el.style.backdropFilter = '';
      el.style.webkitBackdropFilter = '';
    },
    setOptions:(patch)=>{ const shadow = Object.assign({}, o.shadow, patch.shadow); Object.assign(o, patch); o.shadow = shadow; rebuild(); }
  };
}

/* Chromium detection: backdrop-filter:url() is Chromium-only. */
const isChromium = /Chrome\/|Edg\//.test(navigator.userAgent);
const canGlass = (Boolean(window.chrome) || isChromium) &&
  (CSS.supports('backdrop-filter','url(#lgProbe)') || CSS.supports('-webkit-backdrop-filter','url(#lgProbe)'));

/* Glass pool: hard cap of 8 simultaneous filter elements. */
const Glass = (() => {
  const pool = new Map();
  const MAX = 8;
  function attach(el, radius) {
    if (!el || !canGlass && !el.dataset.alwaysGlass) {
      if (el) el.classList.add('glass-fallback');
      return null;
    }
    if (pool.has(el)) pool.get(el).disconnect();
    let h = null;
    try {
      h = applyLiquidGlass(el, {
        surface: CONFIG.glass.surface,
        ior: CONFIG.glass.ior,
        thickness: CONFIG.glass.thickness,
        bezel: CONFIG.glass.bezel,
        radius,
        shadow: CONFIG.glass.shadow
      });
    } catch (e) { el.classList.add('glass-fallback'); return null; }
    pool.set(el, h);
    evict();
    return h;
  }
  function evict() {
    while (pool.size > MAX) {
      const [el, h] = pool.entries().next().value;
      h.disconnect();
      el.classList.add('glass-fallback');
      pool.delete(el);
    }
  }
  function detach(el) {
    if (pool.has(el)) { pool.get(el).disconnect(); pool.delete(el); }
  }
  function rebuildAll() {
    for (const [el, h] of pool) {
      h.setOptions({
        surface: CONFIG.glass.surface, ior: CONFIG.glass.ior,
        thickness: CONFIG.glass.thickness, bezel: CONFIG.glass.bezel,
        shadow: CONFIG.glass.shadow
      });
      el.classList.remove('glass-fallback');
    }
  }
  return { attach, detach, rebuildAll };
})();

/* ============================================================================
   2. TEXT GLASS — SDF + EDT + Snell refraction for the clock digits
   ========================================================================= */
const WORKER_SRC = `
'use strict';
const clamp01=x=>Math.max(0,Math.min(1,x));
const clamp255=x=>Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(x)));
function convexCircle(x){ const c=clamp01(x); return Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-(1-c)*(1-c))); }
function convexSquircle(x){ const c=clamp01(x); return Math.pow(Math.max(0,1-Math.pow(1-c,4)),0.25); }
function smootherstep(x){ const c=clamp01(x); return c*c*c*(c*(c*6-15)+10); }
const SURFACES={convexCircle,convexSquircle,concaveSquircle:x=>1-convexSquircle(x),lipSquircle:x=>{const t=smootherstep(x);const a=convexSquircle(x),b=1-a;return a*(1-t)+b*t;}};
function refract(I,N,n1,n2){const eta=n1/n2,cosI=-(I.x*N.x+I.y*N.y),sin2T=eta*eta*(1-cosI*cosI);if(sin2T>1)return null;const cosT=Math.sqrt(1-sin2T);return {x:eta*I.x+(eta*cosI-cosT)*N.x,y:eta*I.y+(eta*cosI-cosT)*N.y};}
function dispAt(o){const x=clamp01(o.distancePx/o.bezelWidth),h=o.surfaceFn(x)*o.thickness,d=0.001;const x1=Math.max(0,x-d),x2=Math.min(1,x+d);const slope=((o.surfaceFn(x2)-o.surfaceFn(x1))/(x2-x1))*o.thickness/o.bezelWidth;let nx=-slope,nz=1;const len=Math.hypot(nx,nz)||1;nx/=len;nz/=len;const T=refract({x:0,y:-1},{x:nx,y:nz},1,o.refractiveIndex);if(!T||T.y===0)return 0;return (-h/T.y)*T.x;}
function buildProfile(o){const n=127,profile=new Array(n);let maxAbs=0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){profile[i]=dispAt({distancePx:(i/(n-1))*o.bezelWidth,bezelWidth:o.bezelWidth,thickness:o.thickness,surfaceFn:o.surfaceFn,refractiveIndex:o.ior});maxAbs=Math.max(maxAbs,Math.abs(profile[i]));}return {profile,maxAbs:maxAbs||1e-6,bezelWidth:o.bezelWidth,samples:n};}
function sampleProfile(r,distPx){const c=clamp01(distPx/r.bezelWidth)*r.bezelWidth,p=(c/r.bezelWidth)*(r.samples-1);const i0=Math.floor(p),i1=Math.min(r.samples-1,i0+1),t=p-i0;return r.profile[i0]*(1-t)+r.profile[i1]*t;}
function edt1d(f,d,v,z,n){let k=0;v[0]=0;z[0]=-1e20;z[1]=1e20;for(let q=1;q<n;q++){let s=((f[q]+q*q)-(f[v[k]]+v[k]*v[k]))/(2*q-2*v[k]);while(s<=z[k]){k--;s=((f[q]+q*q)-(f[v[k]]+v[k]*v[k]))/(2*q-2*v[k]);}k++;v[k]=q;z[k]=s;z[k+1]=1e20;}k=0;for(let q=0;q<n;q++){while(z[k+1]<q)k++;const dx=q-v[k];d[q]=dx*dx+f[v[k]];}}
function edt2d(binary,w,h,targetVal){const INF=1e12;const grid=new Float32Array(w*h);for(let i=0;i<w*h;i++)grid[i]=(binary[i]===targetVal)?0:INF;const maxDim=Math.max(w,h);const f=new Float32Array(maxDim),d=new Float32Array(maxDim),v=new Int32Array(maxDim),z=new Float32Array(maxDim+1);for(let y=0;y<h;y++){const off=y*w;for(let x=0;x<w;x++)f[x]=grid[off+x];edt1d(f,d,v,z,w);for(let x=0;x<w;x++)grid[off+x]=d[x];}for(let x=0;x<w;x++){for(let y=0;y<h;y++)f[y]=grid[y*w+x];edt1d(f,d,v,z,h);for(let y=0;y<h;y++)grid[y*w+x]=Math.sqrt(d[y]);}return grid;}

function* computeGlassJob(alpha, w, h, ss, params, includeShadow = true) {
  const nPx = w * h;
  const binary = new Uint8Array(nPx);
  for (let i = 0; i < nPx; i++) binary[i] = alpha[i] >= 128 ? 1 : 0;
  const distOut = edt2d(binary, w, h, 1);
  yield;
  const distIn = edt2d(binary, w, h, 0);
  yield;
  const sdf = new Float32Array(nPx);
  let maxInside = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < nPx; i++) {
    const s = distOut[i] > 0 ? (distOut[i] - 0.5) : -(distIn[i] - 0.5);
    sdf[i] = s;
    if (-s > maxInside) maxInside = -s;
  }
  const smooth = new Float32Array(nPx);
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
    const ym = y > 0 ? y - 1 : 0, yp = y < h - 1 ? y + 1 : h - 1;
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      const xm = x > 0 ? x - 1 : 0, xp = x < w - 1 ? x + 1 : w - 1;
      smooth[y*w+x] = (sdf[ym*w+xm]+2*sdf[ym*w+x]+sdf[ym*w+xp]+2*sdf[y*w+xm]+4*sdf[y*w+x]+2*sdf[y*w+xp]+sdf[yp*w+xm]+2*sdf[yp*w+x]+sdf[yp*w+xp])*0.0625;
    }
    if (y % 32 === 31) yield;
  }
  const userBezelRaster = Math.max(2, params.bezel * ss);
  const bezelRaster = Math.max(2, Math.min(userBezelRaster, Math.max(2, 0.5 * maxInside)));
  const thickRaster = (params.thickness * ss) * (bezelRaster / userBezelRaster);
  const surfaceFn = SURFACES[params.surface] || SURFACES.convexSquircle;
  const radial = buildProfile({ bezelWidth: bezelRaster, thickness: thickRaster, ior: params.ior, surfaceFn });
  const dispData = new Uint8ClampedArray(nPx * 4);
  const shadData = includeShadow ? new Uint8ClampedArray(nPx * 4) : null;
  const shadThick = Math.max(1, params.shadowThickness * ss);
  const feather = Math.max(0.9, shadThick * 0.15);
  const outsideCutoff = includeShadow ? feather : 0;
  const flatCenter = !includeShadow && radial.profile[radial.samples - 1] === 0;
  const radAngle = params.shadowAngle * Math.PI / 180;
  const ax = Math.cos(radAngle), ay = Math.sin(radAngle);
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
    const ym = y > 0 ? y - 1 : 0, yp = y < h - 1 ? y + 1 : h - 1;
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      const xm = x > 0 ? x - 1 : 0, xp = x < w - 1 ? x + 1 : w - 1;
      const idx = y*w+x, p = idx*4, dd = sdf[idx];
      if (dd > outsideCutoff) {
        dispData[p]=dispData[p+1]=dispData[p+2]=128; dispData[p+3]=255;
        continue;
      }
      if (flatCenter && dd <= -radial.bezelWidth) {
        dispData[p]=dispData[p+1]=dispData[p+2]=128; dispData[p+3]=255;
        continue;
      }
      const gx = (smooth[y*w+xp]-smooth[y*w+xm])*0.5;
      const gy = (smooth[yp*w+x]-smooth[ym*w+x])*0.5;
      const len = Math.hypot(gx,gy)||1;
      const nx = gx/len, ny = gy/len;
      if (dd > 0) {
        dispData[p]=dispData[p+1]=dispData[p+2]=128; dispData[p+3]=255;
      } else {
        const disp = sampleProfile(radial, Math.min(-dd, radial.bezelWidth));
        dispData[p]   = clamp255(128 - nx*(disp/radial.maxAbs)*127);
        dispData[p+1] = clamp255(128 - ny*(disp/radial.maxAbs)*127);
        dispData[p+2] = 128; dispData[p+3] = 255;
      }
      if (shadData) {
        if (dd > feather || -dd > shadThick + feather) {
          shadData[p+3] = 0;
        } else {
          const edge = -dd;
          const band = clamp01((shadThick - edge) / shadThick);
          const sharp = Math.pow(band, 0.6);
          const edgeAA = clamp01((feather - dd) / (2 * feather));
          const k = Math.abs(nx*ax + ny*ay);
          shadData[p]=shadData[p+1]=shadData[p+2]=255;
          shadData[p+3]=clamp255(sharp*edgeAA*Math.pow(k,1.8)*255);
        }
      }
    }
    if (y % 16 === 15) yield;
  }
  return { maxAbsCss: radial.maxAbs/ss, dispBuf: dispData.buffer, shadBuf: shadData ? shadData.buffer : null };
}

/* inner-shadow map for the clock digits. Runs off-thread and encodes to a PNG
   blob there; capped at 520px since maskImage keeps the glyph silhouette 100% sharp. */
function paintInnerShadow(alpha, w, h, cfg) {
  const cover = cfg.cover ? Math.min(2, cfg.cover) : Math.min(1, 520 / Math.max(w, h));
  const iw = Math.max(4, Math.round(w * cover));
  const ih = Math.max(4, Math.round(h * cover));
  const thickDev = Math.max(0.75, cfg.thickness * cfg.ss * cover * 0.5);
  const feather = Math.max(1.2, thickDev * 0.55);
  const ang = (cfg.angle * Math.PI) / 180;
  const ax = Math.cos(ang), ay = Math.sin(ang);
  const hex = (cfg.color || '#ffffff').replace('#', '');
  const cr = parseInt(hex.slice(0, 2), 16) || 255;
  const cg = parseInt(hex.slice(2, 4), 16) || 255;
  const cb = parseInt(hex.slice(4, 6), 16) || 255;

  const src = new OffscreenCanvas(w, h);
  const sx = src.getContext('2d');
  const im = sx.createImageData(w, h);
  for (let i = 0; i < w * h; i++) {
    im.data[i * 4] = 255; im.data[i * 4 + 1] = 255; im.data[i * 4 + 2] = 255;
    im.data[i * 4 + 3] = alpha[i];
  }
  sx.putImageData(im, 0, 0);

  const dcv = new OffscreenCanvas(iw, ih);
  const dg = dcv.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
  dg.filter = 'blur(' + Math.max(0.05, thickDev * 0.5).toFixed(2) + 'px)';
  dg.drawImage(src, 0, 0, iw, ih);
  dg.filter = 'none';
  const dd = dg.getImageData(0, 0, iw, ih).data;

  const N = iw * ih;
  const a = new Float32Array(N);
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) a[i] = dd[i * 4 + 3];
  const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(N * 4);
  const fall = 1 / Math.max(1, feather * 2.2);
  for (let y = 0; y < ih; y++) {
    const ym = y > 0 ? y - 1 : 0, yp = y < ih - 1 ? y + 1 : ih - 1;
    for (let x = 0; x < iw; x++) {
      const xm = x > 0 ? x - 1 : 0, xp = x < iw - 1 ? x + 1 : iw - 1;
      const i = y * iw + x;
      const edge = 255 - a[i];
      if (edge <= 2) continue;
      const gx = (a[y * iw + xp] - a[y * iw + xm]) * 0.5;
      const gy = (a[yp * iw + x] - a[ym * iw + x]) * 0.5;
      if (gx === 0 && gy === 0) continue;
      const len = Math.hypot(gx, gy) || 1;
      const k = Math.abs((gx / len) * ax + (gy / len) * ay);
      const falloff = Math.pow(Math.min(1, edge * fall), 0.85);
      const q = i * 4;
      out[q] = cr; out[q + 1] = cg; out[q + 2] = cb;
      out[q + 3] = Math.pow(k, 1.6) * falloff * 255;
    }
  }
  const ocv = new OffscreenCanvas(iw, ih);
  const og = ocv.getContext('2d');
  og.putImageData(new ImageData(out, iw, ih), 0, 0);
  og.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
  og.drawImage(src, 0, 0, iw, ih);
  return ocv.convertToBlob({ type: 'image/png' });
}

self.onmessage = function (e) {
  if (e.data.kind === 'inner') {
    const jobId = e.data.jobId;
    paintInnerShadow(new Uint8Array(e.data.alphaBuf), e.data.w, e.data.h, e.data.cfg)
      .then((blob) => self.postMessage({ kind: 'inner', jobId, key: e.data.key, isPreview: !!e.data.isPreview, blob }));
    return;
  }
  const { jobId, alphaBuf, w, h, ss, params } = e.data;
  const alpha = new Uint8Array(alphaBuf);
  const it = computeGlassJob(alpha, w, h, ss, params, false);
  let r = it.next();
  while (!r.done) r = it.next();
  const res = r.value;
  const sendBuffers = () => self.postMessage({ jobId, w, h, maxAbsCss: res.maxAbsCss,
    dispBuf: res.dispBuf }, [res.dispBuf]);
  if (typeof OffscreenCanvas !== 'undefined' && OffscreenCanvas.prototype.convertToBlob) {
    const canvas = new OffscreenCanvas(w, h);
    canvas.getContext('2d').putImageData(new ImageData(new Uint8ClampedArray(res.dispBuf), w, h), 0, 0);
    canvas.convertToBlob({ type: 'image/png' }).then((dispBlob) => {
      self.postMessage({ jobId, w, h, maxAbsCss: res.maxAbsCss, dispBlob });
    }).catch(sendBuffers);
  } else sendBuffers();
};
`;

const Clock = (() => {
  const glassEl = $('clock-glass');
  const shadowEl = $('clock-shadow');
  const glowEl = $('clock-glow');
  const innerEl = $('clock-inner');
  const fbEl = $('clock-fb');
  const wrap = $('clock-wrap');

  let worker = null;
  let innerWorker = null;
  let workerUrl = null;
  let mainCore = null;
  let jobSeq = 0;
  let pendingMeta = new Map();
  let lastKey = '';
  let lastShapeKey = '';
  let lastMinute = '';
  let rafPending = 0;
  let pos = { x: 0, y: typeof state.clockY === 'number' ? Math.max(-20, Math.min(80, state.clockY)) : 0 };
  let activeDispUrl = '';
  let activeMaskUrl = '';
  let activeInnerUrl = '';
  let applySeq = 0;

  const MAX_CACHE = 4;
  const innerCache = new Map();
  const maskCache = new Map();
  const glassCache = new Map();
  const glyphCache = new Map();
  const capRatioCache = new Map();
  const MAX_GLYPH_CACHE = 24;
  let probeCtx = null;
  function getProbeCtx() {
    if (!probeCtx) probeCtx = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
    return probeCtx;
  }
  PerfMonitor.setCacheStatsFn(() => ({
    mask: maskCache.size,
    glass: glassCache.size,
    inner: innerCache.size,
    glyph: glyphCache.size,
    engine: window.NativeGlassMath?.available ? 'Android-C++/JNI' : 'Web-Worker'
  }));

  function lruGet(map, key) {
    if (!map.has(key)) return null;
    const val = map.get(key);
    map.delete(key);
    map.set(key, val);
    return val;
  }
  function lruSet(map, key, val, onEvict) {
    if (map.has(key)) map.delete(key);
    map.set(key, val);
    while (map.size > MAX_CACHE) {
      const oldestKey = map.keys().next().value;
      const oldestVal = map.get(oldestKey);
      map.delete(oldestKey);
      if (onEvict) onEvict(oldestVal);
    }
  }
  function scheduleRevoke(url, isActiveFn) {
    if (!url || !url.startsWith('blob:')) return;
    setTimeout(() => { if (!isActiveFn(url)) URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 2500);
  }

  function ensureWorker() {
    if (worker || typeof Worker === 'undefined') return worker;
    try {
      const blob = new Blob([WORKER_SRC], { type: 'text/javascript' });
      workerUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      worker = new Worker(workerUrl);
      worker.onmessage = onWorkerResult;
      worker.onerror = () => { worker = null; resetInnerPost(); };
    } catch (e) { worker = null; }
    return worker;
  }

  /* A second thread for the digits' rim: the refraction job can occupy the
     main worker for a few hundred milliseconds, and the rim must never wait
     behind it (it is what the cross-fade depends on). */
  function ensureInnerWorker() {
    if (innerWorker || typeof Worker === 'undefined') return innerWorker;
    const base = ensureWorker();
    if (!base || !workerUrl) return null;
    try {
      innerWorker = new Worker(workerUrl);
      innerWorker.onmessage = (e) => { if (e.data && e.data.kind === 'inner') onInnerResult(e.data); };
      innerWorker.onerror = () => { innerWorker = null; resetInnerPost(); };
    } catch (e) { innerWorker = null; }
    return innerWorker;
  }

  function fontStack() {
    const f = state.font;
    if (f === 'SF') return '-apple-system,"SF Pro Display","Inter",system-ui,sans-serif';
    return `"${f}",-apple-system,"Inter",sans-serif`;
  }

  function getTime() {
    const d = new Date();
    let h = d.getHours();
    if (!state.hour24) { h = h % 12; if (h === 0) h = 12; }
    const pad = (n, l) => String(n).padStart(l, '0');
    const hh = state.hour24 && CONFIG.clock.leadingZero ? pad(h, 2) : String(h);
    const mm = pad(d.getMinutes(), 2);
    return { lines: [`${hh}:${mm}`], minuteKey: `${hh}:${mm}` };
  }

  function paintInnerCpu(maskCanvas, w, h, ss, cfg) {
    const cover = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, 1600 / Math.max(w, h)));
    const iw = Math.max(4, Math.round(w * cover));
    const ih = Math.max(4, Math.round(h * cover));
    const thickDev = Math.max(0.75, cfg.thickness * ss * cover * 0.5);
    const feather = Math.max(1.2, thickDev * 0.55);
    const ang = (cfg.angle * Math.PI) / 180;
    const ax = Math.cos(ang), ay = Math.sin(ang);
    const hex = (cfg.color || '#ffffff').replace('#', '');
    const cr = parseInt(hex.slice(0, 2), 16) || 255;
    const cg = parseInt(hex.slice(2, 4), 16) || 255;
    const cb = parseInt(hex.slice(4, 6), 16) || 255;

    /* 1. distance-to-edge field, from a blurred copy of the silhouette */
    const dcv = document.createElement('canvas');
    dcv.width = iw; dcv.height = ih;
    const dg = dcv.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
    dg.filter = `blur(${(thickDev * 0.5).toFixed(2)}px)`;
    dg.drawImage(maskCanvas, 0, 0, iw, ih);
    dg.filter = 'none';
    const dd = dg.getImageData(0, 0, iw, ih).data;

    /* 2. gradient of that field → per-pixel edge normal */
    const N = iw * ih;
    const a = new Float32Array(N);
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) a[i] = dd[i * 4 + 3];
    const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(N * 4);
    const fall = 1 / Math.max(1, feather * 2.2);
    for (let y = 0; y < ih; y++) {
      const ym = y > 0 ? y - 1 : 0, yp = y < ih - 1 ? y + 1 : ih - 1;
      for (let x = 0; x < iw; x++) {
        const xm = x > 0 ? x - 1 : 0, xp = x < iw - 1 ? x + 1 : iw - 1;
        const i = y * iw + x;
        const edge = 255 - a[i];
        if (edge <= 2) continue;
        const gx = (a[y * iw + xp] - a[y * iw + xm]) * 0.5;
        const gy = (a[yp * iw + x] - a[ym * iw + x]) * 0.5;
        if (gx === 0 && gy === 0) continue;
        const len = Math.hypot(gx, gy) || 1;
        const k = Math.abs((gx / len) * ax + (gy / len) * ay);
        const falloff = Math.pow(Math.min(1, edge * fall), 0.85);
        const q = i * 4;
        out[q] = cr; out[q + 1] = cg; out[q + 2] = cb;
        out[q + 3] = Math.pow(k, 1.6) * falloff * 255;
      }
    }
    const ocv = document.createElement('canvas');
    ocv.width = iw; ocv.height = ih;
    const og = ocv.getContext('2d');
    og.putImageData(new ImageData(out, iw, ih), 0, 0);
    og.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
    og.drawImage(maskCanvas, 0, 0, iw, ih);
    return ocv.toDataURL('image/png');
  }

  /* ── live inner-shadow updates ──────────────────────────────────────────
     The per-pixel normal pass is fast, but encoding a 1.5 k-px PNG is not —
     so the identical painter runs in the existing worker and only the finished
     image comes back. Slider drags therefore never touch the main thread. */
  let innerJob = 0;
  let swapGuard = 0;

  function paintInnerNow(alpha, w, h, ss, maskKeyOverride) {
    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = w; cv.height = h;
    const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
    const img = ctx.createImageData(w, h);
    for (let i = 0; i < w * h; i++) {
      img.data[i * 4] = 255; img.data[i * 4 + 1] = 255; img.data[i * 4 + 2] = 255;
      img.data[i * 4 + 3] = alpha[i];
    }
    ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
    const cfg = CONFIG.glass.inner;
    const mk = maskKeyOverride || lastMaskKey;
    const url = paintInnerCpu(cv, w, h, ss, cfg);
    const key = [w, h, ss, mk, cfg.thickness, cfg.angle, cfg.color].join('|');
    lruSet(innerCache, key, url, (old) => scheduleRevoke(old, (u) => u === activeInnerUrl));
    setInnerImage(url, key);
  }

  let innerShownKey = '';
  let activeTargetInnerKey = '';
  let innerWaiters = [];
  let innerDispatchTs = 0;

  function isCachedInnerUrl(url) {
    for (const v of innerCache.values()) if (v === url) return true;
    return false;
  }

  function preloadImg(url) {
    if (!url) return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let settled = false;
      const done = () => { if (!settled) { settled = true; resolve(); } };
      const timer = setTimeout(done, 180);
      const im = new Image();
      im.onload = () => {
        if (im.decode) im.decode().catch(() => {}).finally(() => { clearTimeout(timer); done(); });
        else { clearTimeout(timer); done(); }
      };
      im.onerror = () => { clearTimeout(timer); done(); };
      im.src = url;
    });
  }

  function setInnerImage(url, key) {
    const prev = activeInnerUrl;
    activeInnerUrl = url || '';
    innerEl.style.backgroundImage = url ? `url("${url}")` : 'none';
    innerShownKey = key || '';
    if (prev && prev !== activeInnerUrl && !isCachedInnerUrl(prev)) {
      scheduleRevoke(prev, (u) => u === activeInnerUrl || isCachedInnerUrl(u));
    }
    notifyInnerWaiters(key, url);
  }

  function notifyInnerWaiters(key, url) {
    if (!key) return;
    const ready = innerWaiters.filter((w) => w.key === key);
    innerWaiters = innerWaiters.filter((w) => w.key !== key);
    ready.forEach((w) => w.once(url || ''));
  }

  function waitInnerCached(key) {
    const hit = lruGet(innerCache, key);
    if (hit) return Promise.resolve(hit);
    if (innerShownKey === key) return Promise.resolve(activeInnerUrl);
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const w = { key, once: (url) => { if (w.done) return; w.done = true; resolve(url || lruGet(innerCache, key) || ''); } };
      innerWaiters.push(w);
      setTimeout(() => w.once(''), 380);
    });
  }

  function onInnerResult(d) {
    innerBusy = false;
    if (innerDispatchTs > 0 && !d.isPreview) {
      PerfMonitor.record('clockInnerRim', performance.now() - innerDispatchTs);
    }
    flushInnerQueue();
    if (d.jobId !== innerJob && queuedInner) return; // a newer slider position won
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(d.blob);
    if (d.isPreview) {
      const prev = activeInnerUrl;
      activeInnerUrl = url;
      innerEl.style.backgroundImage = `url("${url}")`;
      if (prev && prev !== url && !isCachedInnerUrl(prev)) {
        scheduleRevoke(prev, (u) => u === activeInnerUrl || isCachedInnerUrl(u));
      }
      return;
    }
    lruSet(innerCache, d.key, url, (old) => scheduleRevoke(old, (u) => u === activeInnerUrl || isCachedInnerUrl(u)));
    notifyInnerWaiters(d.key, url);
    if (!activeTargetInnerKey || activeTargetInnerKey === d.key) {
      setInnerImage(url, d.key);
    }
  }

  /* Called live by the sliders: no refraction rebuild, no bitmap rebuild. */
  function refreshInner(preview) {
    if (!lastMaskCanvas || !lastMaskAlpha) { schedule(true); return; }
    const cfg = CONFIG.glass.inner;
    const w = lastMaskCanvas.width, h = lastMaskCanvas.height;
    innerEl.style.opacity = String(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, cfg.intensity)));
    if (!(cfg.thickness > 0) || !(cfg.intensity > 0)) { activeTargetInnerKey = ''; setInnerImage(''); return; }
    const key = [w, h, lastSS, lastMaskKey, cfg.thickness, cfg.angle, cfg.color].join('|');
    activeTargetInnerKey = key;
    if (key === innerShownKey) return;                     // already on screen
    const cached = lruGet(innerCache, key);
    if (cached) { setInnerImage(cached, key); return; }
    postInner(key, w, h, !!preview);
  }

  /* Ensure the rim is queued/computed for `key` without disturbing current DOM. */
  function refreshInnerFor(key, alpha, w, h, ss, maskKey) {
    if (!alpha || !key) return;
    if (key === innerShownKey) return;
    const cached = lruGet(innerCache, key);
    if (cached) { notifyInnerWaiters(key, cached); return; }
    if (ensureInnerWorker()) postInnerFor(key, alpha, w, h, ss);
    else paintInnerNow(alpha, w, h, ss, maskKey);
  }

  let innerPosted = '';
  let innerBusy = false;
  let queuedInner = null;

  function resetInnerPost() { innerPosted = ''; innerBusy = false; queuedInner = null; }

  function flushInnerQueue() {
    if (innerBusy || !queuedInner) return;
    const next = queuedInner;
    queuedInner = null;
    dispatchInner(next);
  }

  function dispatchInner(job) {
    const wk = ensureInnerWorker();
    if (!wk) {
      paintInnerNow(job.alpha, job.w, job.h, job.ss, job.maskKey);
      return;
    }
    innerBusy = true;
    innerDispatchTs = performance.now();
    const jobId = ++innerJob;
    const alphaBuf = job.alpha.slice().buffer;
    wk.postMessage({
      kind: 'inner', jobId, key: job.key, w: job.w, h: job.h,
      isPreview: !!job.isPreview,
      alphaBuf,
      cfg: {
        thickness: job.cfg.thickness,
        angle: job.cfg.angle,
        color: job.cfg.color,
        ss: job.ss,
        cover: job.isPreview ? 0.55 : 0
      }
    }, [alphaBuf]);
  }

  function queueInnerJob(job) {
    if (!job.alpha || !job.key) return;
    if (document.body.classList.contains('resizing')) return;
    const postedTag = job.key + (job.isPreview ? '|p' : '');
    if (postedTag === innerPosted) return;
    innerPosted = postedTag;
    if (innerBusy) { queuedInner = job; return; }
    dispatchInner(job);
  }

  function postInnerFor(key, alpha, w, h, ss) {
    if (!alpha || !key) return;
    queueInnerJob({
      key, alpha, w, h, ss, maskKey: lastMaskKey, isPreview: false,
      cfg: Object.assign({}, CONFIG.glass.inner)
    });
  }

  function postInner(key, w, h, isPreview) {
    if (!lastMaskAlpha) return;
    queueInnerJob({
      key, alpha: lastMaskAlpha, w, h, ss: lastSS, maskKey: lastMaskKey, isPreview: !!isPreview,
      cfg: Object.assign({}, CONFIG.glass.inner)
    });
  }

  function measureNumeralMetrics(fontStr, weight) {
    const key = `${fontStr}|${weight}`;
    if (capRatioCache.has(key)) return capRatioCache.get(key);
    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = 160; cv.height = 160;
    const gx = cv.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
    gx.font = `${weight} 100px ${fontStr}`;
    gx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    gx.textAlign = 'center';
    gx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    let yMin = 160, yMax = -1;
    for (const sample of ['0', '8', '6']) {
      gx.clearRect(0, 0, 160, 160);
      gx.fillText(sample, 80, 80);
      const d = gx.getImageData(0, 0, 160, 160).data;
      for (let y = 0; y < 160; y++) {
        const row = y * 160 * 4;
        for (let x = 0; x < 160; x++) {
          if (d[row + x * 4 + 3] > 10) {
            if (y < yMin) yMin = y;
            if (y > yMax) yMax = y;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const capRatio = yMax >= yMin ? Math.max(0.55, Math.min(0.92, (yMax - yMin + 1) / 100)) : 0.74;
    // Bebas Neue & Oswald sit above textBaseline='middle'; measure true optical numeral center
    const refMidRel = yMax >= yMin ? (((yMin + yMax + 1) * 0.5) - 80) / 100 : 0;
    const res = { capRatio, refMidRel };
    capRatioCache.set(key, res);
    return res;
  }

  function stretchDigitBitmap(ch, fontPx, weight, fontStr, sx, sy, ss, refMidRel) {
    const key = [ch, fontPx.toFixed(1), sx.toFixed(3), sy.toFixed(3), ss.toFixed(2), weight, fontStr].join('|');
    if (glyphCache.has(key)) {
      const hit = glyphCache.get(key);
      glyphCache.delete(key);
      glyphCache.set(key, hit);
      return hit;
    }

    const vSub = sy > 1.25 ? 2 : 1;
    const srcPx = fontPx * ss;
    const sw = Math.ceil(srcPx * sx * 1.25) + 16;
    const sh = Math.ceil(srcPx * vSub * 1.55) + 16;
    const src = document.createElement('canvas');
    src.width = sw; src.height = sh;
    const sctx = src.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
    sctx.scale(sx, vSub);
    sctx.font = `${weight} ${srcPx}px ${fontStr}`;
    sctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    sctx.textAlign = 'center';
    sctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    sctx.fillText(ch, sw / (2 * sx), sh / (2 * vSub));

    const sData = sctx.getImageData(0, 0, sw, sh).data;
    let xMin = sw, xMax = -1, yMin = sh, yMax = -1;
    for (let y = 0; y < sh; y++) {
      const row = y * sw * 4;
      for (let x = 0; x < sw; x++) {
        if (sData[row + x * 4 + 3] > 10) {
          if (x < xMin) xMin = x;
          if (x > xMax) xMax = x;
          if (y < yMin) yMin = y;
          if (y > yMax) yMax = y;
        }
      }
    }
    if (xMax < xMin || yMax < yMin) return null;

    const W = xMax - xMin + 1;
    const G = yMax - yMin + 1;
    const G0 = G / vSub;
    const targetG = Math.max(4, Math.round(G0 * sy));

    // Horizontal coverage per scanline: horizontal bars/crossbars have wide ink coverage;
    // vertical stems & open bowls have narrow ink coverage and absorb the elongation cleanly.
    const cov = new Float32Array(G);
    for (let r = 0; r < G; r++) {
      const row = (yMin + r) * sw * 4;
      let sum = 0;
      for (let x = xMin; x <= xMax; x++) sum += sData[row + x * 4 + 3];
      cov[r] = sum / (255 * W);
    }

    const bodyStart = Math.floor(0.16 * G);
    const bodyEnd = Math.max(bodyStart + 1, Math.ceil(0.84 * G));
    const bodyCov = [];
    for (let r = bodyStart; r < bodyEnd; r++) bodyCov.push(cov[r]);
    bodyCov.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const stemCov = bodyCov[Math.floor(bodyCov.length * 0.30)] || 0.35;
    const barThresh = Math.max(0.54, Math.min(0.80, stemCov * 1.45));

    let bar = new Float32Array(G);
    for (let r = 0; r < G; r++) bar[r] = cov[r] >= barThresh ? 1 : 0;

    // Protect outer rounded cap/arch tips connected to horizontal top/bottom strokes
    const topEnd = Math.floor(0.17 * G);
    let lastTop = -1;
    for (let r = 0; r <= topEnd; r++) if (bar[r] > 0.5) lastTop = r;
    if (lastTop >= 0) for (let r = 0; r <= lastTop; r++) bar[r] = 1;

    const botStart = Math.floor(0.83 * G);
    let firstBot = -1;
    for (let r = botStart; r < G; r++) { if (bar[r] > 0.5) { firstBot = r; break; } }
    if (firstBot >= 0) for (let r = firstBot; r < G; r++) bar[r] = 1;

    // Two-pass symmetric smoothing guarantees C1 transitions with no visible creases
    const rad = Math.max(2, Math.round(0.032 * G));
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
      const next = new Float32Array(G);
      for (let r = 0; r < G; r++) {
        let s = 0, c = 0;
        const a = Math.max(0, r - rad), b = Math.min(G - 1, r + rad);
        for (let k = a; k <= b; k++) { s += bar[k]; c++; }
        next[r] = s / c;
      }
      bar = next;
    }

    let barMass = 0, stemMass = 0;
    for (let r = 0; r < G; r++) {
      barMass += bar[r] / vSub;
      stemMass += (1 - bar[r]) / vSub;
    }

    const localScale = new Float32Array(G);
    if (sy >= 1.0 && stemMass > 0.14 * G0) {
      const stemStretch = Math.max(1.0, (targetG - barMass) / stemMass);
      for (let r = 0; r < G; r++) {
        localScale[r] = bar[r] + (1 - bar[r]) * stemStretch;
      }
    } else {
      for (let r = 0; r < G; r++) localScale[r] = sy;
    }

    const cum = new Float64Array(G + 1);
    for (let r = 0; r < G; r++) cum[r + 1] = cum[r] + localScale[r] / vSub;
    const norm = targetG / Math.max(1e-6, cum[G]);
    for (let r = 1; r <= G; r++) cum[r] *= norm;

    const outCv = document.createElement('canvas');
    outCv.width = W; outCv.height = targetG;
    const octx = outCv.getContext('2d');
    const oImg = octx.createImageData(W, targetG);
    const oData = oImg.data;

    let rCur = 0;
    for (let dy = 0; dy < targetG; dy++) {
      const target = dy + 0.5;
      while (rCur < G - 1 && cum[rCur + 1] < target) rCur++;
      const span = Math.max(1e-6, cum[rCur + 1] - cum[rCur]);
      const frac = rCur + (target - cum[rCur]) / span - 0.5;
      const syClamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(G - 1, frac));
      const f0 = Math.floor(syClamped);
      const fy = syClamped - f0;
      const w0 = 1 - fy;
      const y0 = yMin + f0;
      const y1 = Math.min(yMax, y0 + 1);
      const rowOut = dy * W * 4;
      const row0 = y0 * sw * 4;
      const row1 = y1 * sw * 4;
      for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
        const p = rowOut + x * 4;
        const sxOff = (xMin + x) * 4 + 3;
        oData[p] = 255; oData[p + 1] = 255; oData[p + 2] = 255;
        oData[p + 3] = Math.round(sData[row0 + sxOff] * w0 + sData[row1 + sxOff] * fy);
      }
    }
    octx.putImageData(oImg, 0, 0);

    // Measure relative to true optical numeral center (refMidY_src), NOT baseline-middle
    const refMidY_src = (sh * 0.5) + (refMidRel * srcPx * vSub);
    const digitCenterY_src = (yMin + yMax + 1) * 0.5;
    const res = {
      canvas: outCv,
      W, H: targetG,
      xCenterOffset: ((xMin + xMax + 1) * 0.5) - sw * 0.5,
      yCenterRel: ((digitCenterY_src - refMidY_src) / vSub) * sy
    };
    if (glyphCache.size >= MAX_GLYPH_CACHE) {
      glyphCache.delete(glyphCache.keys().next().value);
    }
    glyphCache.set(key, res);
    return res;
  }

  function getColonDots(fontPx, weight, fontStr, ss) {
    const key = `colon|${fontPx.toFixed(1)}|${ss.toFixed(2)}|${weight}|${fontStr}`;
    if (glyphCache.has(key)) return glyphCache.get(key);

    const srcPx = fontPx * ss;
    const sw = Math.ceil(srcPx * 0.8) + 16;
    const sh = Math.ceil(srcPx * 1.35) + 16;
    const src = document.createElement('canvas');
    src.width = sw; src.height = sh;
    const sctx = src.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
    sctx.font = `${weight} ${srcPx}px ${fontStr}`;
    sctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    sctx.textAlign = 'center';
    sctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    sctx.fillText(':', sw * 0.5, sh * 0.5);

    const sData = sctx.getImageData(0, 0, sw, sh).data;
    const mid = Math.floor(sh * 0.5);
    const crop = (yA, yB) => {
      let x0 = sw, x1 = -1, y0 = sh, y1 = -1;
      for (let y = yA; y < yB; y++) {
        const row = y * sw * 4;
        for (let x = 0; x < sw; x++) {
          if (sData[row + x * 4 + 3] > 10) {
            if (x < x0) x0 = x; if (x > x1) x1 = x;
            if (y < y0) y0 = y; if (y > y1) y1 = y;
          }
        }
      }
      if (x1 < x0 || y1 < y0) return null;
      const cw = x1 - x0 + 1, ch = y1 - y0 + 1;
      const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
      cv.width = cw; cv.height = ch;
      cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(src, x0, y0, cw, ch, 0, 0, cw, ch);
      return { cv, w: cw, h: ch, cy: (y0 + y1 + 1) * 0.5 };
    };
    const top = crop(0, mid);
    const bot = crop(mid, sh);
    const natSep = top && bot ? (bot.cy - top.cy) * 0.5 : srcPx * 0.14;
    const res = { top, bot, natSep };
    if (glyphCache.size >= MAX_GLYPH_CACHE) {
      glyphCache.delete(glyphCache.keys().next().value);
    }
    glyphCache.set(key, res);
    return res;
  }

  function drawOpticalClock(ctx, lines, wCss, hCss, size, ss, c, capH, refMidRel) {
    const fontStr = fontStack();
    const weight = state.font === 'SF' ? 600 : c.weight;
    const probe = getProbeCtx();
    probe.font = `${weight} ${size}px ${fontStr}`;
    if ('letterSpacing' in probe) probe.letterSpacing = '0px';

    const digitTargetH = capH * c.sy * ss;
    const lineStep = digitTargetH * 1.06;
    const startY = ((hCss * ss) - (lines.length - 1) * lineStep) * 0.5;

    lines.forEach((ln, li) => {
      const advs = Array.from(ln, (ch) => probe.measureText(ch).width);
      const totalW = advs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) + Math.max(0, ln.length - 1) * c.tracking;
      const lineCenterPx = startY + li * lineStep;
      let curX = -totalW * 0.5;

      for (let i = 0; i < ln.length; i++) {
        const ch = ln[i];
        const adv = advs[i];
        const charCenterPx = (wCss * 0.5 + (curX + adv * 0.5) * c.sx) * ss;
        curX += adv + c.tracking;

        if (ch === ':') {
          const dots = getColonDots(size, weight, fontStr, ss);
          if (dots.top && dots.bot) {
            const dotScale = Math.min(1.28, 1 + Math.max(0, c.sy - 1) * 0.16) * (0.5 + 0.5 * c.sx);
            const sep = Math.max(dots.natSep, digitTargetH * 0.158);
            const tw = dots.top.w * dotScale, th = dots.top.h * dotScale;
            const bw = dots.bot.w * dotScale, bh = dots.bot.h * dotScale;
            ctx.drawImage(dots.top.cv, charCenterPx - tw * 0.5, lineCenterPx - sep - th * 0.5, tw, th);
            ctx.drawImage(dots.bot.cv, charCenterPx - bw * 0.5, lineCenterPx + sep - bh * 0.5, bw, bh);
          }
          continue;
        }

        if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9' && c.sy >= 1.03) {
          const g = stretchDigitBitmap(ch, size, weight, fontStr, c.sx, c.sy, ss, refMidRel);
          if (g) {
            ctx.drawImage(g.canvas, charCenterPx - g.W * 0.5 + g.xCenterOffset, lineCenterPx - g.H * 0.5 + g.yCenterRel);
            continue;
          }
        }

        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(charCenterPx, lineCenterPx);
        ctx.scale(ss * c.sx, ss * c.sy);
        ctx.font = `${weight} ${size}px ${fontStr}`;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillText(ch, 0, -refMidRel * size);
        ctx.restore();
      }
    });
  }

  function renderBitmap(lines) {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const c = CONFIG.clock;
    const host = $('screen');
    const hostW = host.clientWidth || 390;

    let size = c.size;
    // Tight side padding so wide/tall iOS clock fills near edge-to-edge cleanly
    const maxW = hostW - 12;
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    let ss = Math.min(3, Math.max(2, Math.round(dpr)));

    const fontStr = fontStack();
    const weight = state.font === 'SF' ? 600 : c.weight;
    const { capRatio, refMidRel } = measureNumeralMetrics(fontStr, weight);

    const probe = getProbeCtx();
    probe.font = `${weight} ${size}px ${fontStr}`;
    if ('letterSpacing' in probe) probe.letterSpacing = '0px';

    const measureLineW = (ln) => {
      let wSum = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < ln.length; i++) wSum += probe.measureText(ln[i]).width;
      return wSum + Math.max(0, ln.length - 1) * c.tracking;
    };

    let maxLineW = 0;
    for (const ln of lines) maxLineW = Math.max(maxLineW, measureLineW(ln));

    const pad = 18;
    const rawW = Math.max(40, maxLineW * c.sx);
    // One uniform fit preserves the user's glyph proportions on every screen.
    // Reserve the music/shortcut area; never write this automatic fit to storage.
    const layerEl = $('clock-layer');
    const card = $('np');
    const bottom = $('bottom');
    const obstacle = state.npOn ? card : bottom;
    const obstacleTop = obstacle.offsetTop || obstacle.getBoundingClientRect().top;
    const layerTop = layerEl.offsetTop || layerEl.getBoundingClientRect().top;
    const availableH = Math.max(72, Math.min(host.clientHeight * .85,
      obstacleTop - (layerTop + Math.max(0, pos.y)) - 12));
    const rawH = Math.max(40, lines.length * size * capRatio * c.sy);
    const fit = Math.min(1, (maxW - pad * 2) / rawW, (availableH - pad * 2) / rawH);
    size *= Math.max(.1, fit);

    probe.font = `${weight} ${size}px ${fontStr}`;
    if ('letterSpacing' in probe) probe.letterSpacing = '0px';
    maxLineW = 0;
    for (const ln of lines) maxLineW = Math.max(maxLineW, measureLineW(ln));

    const capH = size * capRatio;
    const wCss = Math.ceil(Math.max(40, maxLineW * c.sx) + pad * 2);
    const hCss = Math.ceil(Math.max(40, lines.length * capH * c.sy) + pad * 2);

    const longSide = Math.max(wCss, hCss);
    if (longSide * ss > 1080) ss = Math.max(1, Math.floor((1080 / longSide) * 10) / 10);

    const w = Math.max(4, Math.round(wCss * ss));
    const h = Math.max(4, Math.round(hCss * ss));

    const minuteKey = lines.join('|');
    const maskKey = [size.toFixed(2), w, h, state.font, c.sx, c.sy, c.tracking, minuteKey].join('|');
    const cachedMask = lruGet(maskCache, maskKey);
    if (cachedMask) {
      const innerKey = [w,h,ss,maskKey,CONFIG.glass.inner.thickness,CONFIG.glass.inner.angle,CONFIG.glass.inner.color].join('|');
      PerfMonitor.record('clockBitmap', performance.now() - t0, { hit: true, w, h });
      return Object.assign({}, cachedMask, { minuteKey, innerKey, innerUrl: lruGet(innerCache, innerKey) || '' });
    }


    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = w; cv.height = h;
    const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
    drawOpticalClock(ctx, lines, wCss, hCss, size, ss, c, capH, refMidRel);

    const img = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h);
    const alpha = new Uint8Array(w * h);
    for (let i = 0; i < w * h; i++) alpha[i] = img.data[i * 4 + 3];

    /* The inner map is a per-pixel pass + a PNG encode. It must never run
       inside a click handler, so it is produced asynchronously (worker) and
       committed atomically once ready. */
    const innerKey = [w, h, ss, maskKey, CONFIG.glass.inner.thickness,
                      CONFIG.glass.inner.angle, CONFIG.glass.inner.color].join('|');
    const innerUrl = lruGet(innerCache, innerKey) || '';

    const built = {
      alpha, w, h, ss, wCss, hCss,
      minuteKey,
      alphaKey: maskKey,
      innerUrl, innerKey,
      maskCanvas: cv,
      maskUrl: '',
      maskPromise: null,
      size, lines,
      textW: Math.max(40, maxLineW * c.sx),
      textH: Math.max(40, lines.length * capH * c.sy),
      lineH: capH,
      pad: pad * 2
    };
    built.maskPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {
      const done = (u) => { built.maskUrl = u; resolve(u); };
      if (cv.toBlob) {
        cv.toBlob((blob) => done(blob ? URL.createObjectURL(blob) : cv.toDataURL('image/png')), 'image/png');
      } else {
        done(cv.toDataURL('image/png'));
      }
    });
    lruSet(maskCache, maskKey, built, (old) => {
      if (old && old.maskUrl) scheduleRevoke(old.maskUrl, (u) => u === activeMaskUrl);
    });
    PerfMonitor.record('clockBitmap', performance.now() - t0, { hit: false, w, h, ss });
    return built;
  }

  function bufToUrl(buf, w, h) {
    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = w; cv.height = h;
    const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
    ctx.putImageData(new ImageData(new Uint8ClampedArray(buf), w, h), 0, 0);
    return cv.toDataURL('image/png');
  }

  let refractionT0 = 0;

  function onWorkerResult(e) {
    if (e.data.kind === 'inner') { onInnerResult(e.data); return; }
    const { jobId, w, h, maxAbsCss, dispBuf, dispBlob, dispUrl } = e.data;
    const meta = pendingMeta.get(jobId);
    pendingMeta.delete(jobId);
    if (!meta || jobId !== jobSeq) return;
    if (refractionT0 > 0) {
      PerfMonitor.record('clockRefraction', performance.now() - refractionT0, {
        hit: false, engine: dispUrl ? 'NativeC++' : 'WebWorker', w, h
      });
    }
    const disp = dispUrl || (dispBlob ? URL.createObjectURL(dispBlob) : bufToUrl(dispBuf, w, h));
    const cacheKey = [meta.w, meta.h, meta.ss, meta.alphaKey,
      CONFIG.glass.surface, CONFIG.glass.ior,
      CONFIG.glass.thickness, CONFIG.glass.bezel].join('|');
    lruSet(glassCache, cacheKey, { disp, maxAbs: maxAbsCss }, (old) => {
      if (old) scheduleRevoke(old.disp, (u) => u === activeDispUrl);
    });
    apply(meta, disp, '', maxAbsCss);
  }

  let lastMetrics = null;
  let lastMaskCanvas = null;
  let lastMaskAlpha = null;
  let lastMaskKey = '';
  let lastSS = 2;

  function apply(meta, dispUrl, _shadUrl, maxAbsCss) {
    const mySeq = ++applySeq;
    const tickT0 = meta.isTick ? performance.now() : 0;
    lastMetrics = {
      textW: meta.textW, textH: meta.textH, pad: meta.pad, size: meta.size,
      baseW: meta.textW / Math.max(0.05, CONFIG.clock.sx),
      baseH: meta.textH / Math.max(0.05, CONFIG.clock.sy)
    };
    /* Assigning an unchanged width/height still re-rasterises the clock's
       backdrop-filter, so only touch the geometry when it really moved. */
    const setBox = (el, w, h) => {
      if (el.style.width !== w + 'px') el.style.width = w + 'px';
      if (el.style.height !== h + 'px') el.style.height = h + 'px';
    };
    /* mask strings are long data URLs — compare short alphaKey instead of string equality */
    const setMask = (el, url, key) => {
      if (el.dataset.maskKey === key) return;
      el.dataset.maskKey = key;
      el.style.maskImage = url;
      el.style.webkitMaskImage = url;
    };
    const finishResizeCommit = () => {
      if (document.body.classList.contains('resizing') && !rs && !sizeControl.dataset.dragging && !stretchControl.dataset.dragging) {
        preview = { x: 1, y: 1 };
        applyPosition();
        document.body.classList.remove('resizing');
        clearTimeout(resizeCommitGuard);
        if (frame.classList.contains('on')) layoutFrame();
      }
    };
    const paint = () => {
      if (applySeq !== mySeq) return;
      activeMaskUrl = meta.maskUrl || '';
      activeDispUrl = dispUrl || '';
      activeTargetInnerKey = meta.innerKey;
      const mask = `url(${meta.maskUrl})`;
      glassEl.style.transition = '';
      glowEl.style.transition = '';
      innerEl.style.transition = '';
      glassEl.style.opacity = '1';
      glowEl.style.opacity = '1';

      setBox(glassEl, meta.wCss, meta.hCss);
      setMask(glassEl, mask, meta.alphaKey);
      setBox(shadowEl, meta.wCss, meta.hCss);
      /* --clock-top drives tint & shadow at 60fps via CSS without re-raster */
      shadowEl.style.background = '';
      setMask(shadowEl, mask, meta.alphaKey);
      /* INNER shadow — tinted with the colour the user picked and rotated by the chosen angle. */
      const si = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, CONFIG.glass.inner.intensity));
      setBox(innerEl, meta.wCss, meta.hCss);
      innerEl.style.left = '0px';
      innerEl.style.top = '0px';
      if (innerShownKey !== meta.innerKey) {
        const cachedInner = lruGet(innerCache, meta.innerKey);
        if (cachedInner) {
          setInnerImage(cachedInner, meta.innerKey);
        } else {
          setInnerImage('');
          refreshInnerFor(meta.innerKey, meta.alpha, meta.w, meta.h, meta.ss, meta.alphaKey);
        }
      }
      setMask(innerEl, mask, meta.alphaKey);
      innerEl.style.opacity = String(si);
      setBox(glowEl, meta.wCss, meta.hCss);
      glowEl.style.left = glassEl.offsetLeft + 'px';
      glowEl.style.top = glassEl.offsetTop + 'px';
      glowEl.style.filter = 'none';
      glassEl.style.background = '';   // --clock-tint (set by Adaptive) drives it
      glassEl.style.mixBlendMode = 'normal';

      if (canGlass) {
        fbEl.style.display = 'none';
        const uid = 'clockFilter';
        const key = [meta.alphaKey, dispUrl, meta.wCss, meta.hCss, maxAbsCss].join('|');
        const bf = `url(#${uid})` + (supportsChainedFilter ? ' saturate(1.22) brightness(1.04)' : '');
        let f = document.getElementById(uid);
        /* A new <filter> node forces the whole clock to re-rasterise. When the
           displacement map has not changed we keep the node and touch nothing —
           that is what makes a font/colour change cost no paint at all. */
        if (!f || f.dataset.key !== key) {
          if (f) f.remove();
          f = document.createElementNS(NS, 'filter');
          f.setAttribute('id', uid);
          f.setAttribute('color-interpolation-filters', 'sRGB');
          f.dataset.key = key;
          const pad = Math.ceil(maxAbsCss * 2) + 6;
          f.setAttribute('filterUnits', 'userSpaceOnUse');
          f.setAttribute('x', -pad); f.setAttribute('y', -pad);
          f.setAttribute('width', meta.wCss + pad * 2);
          f.setAttribute('height', meta.hCss + pad * 2);
          const im = document.createElementNS(NS, 'feImage');
          im.setAttribute('href', dispUrl);
          im.setAttributeNS(XLINK, 'xlink:href', dispUrl);
          im.setAttribute('x', 0); im.setAttribute('y', 0);
          im.setAttribute('width', meta.wCss); im.setAttribute('height', meta.hCss);
          im.setAttribute('preserveAspectRatio', 'none');
          im.setAttribute('result', 'dispMap');
          f.appendChild(im);
          const dm = document.createElementNS(NS, 'feDisplacementMap');
          dm.setAttribute('in', 'SourceGraphic');
          dm.setAttribute('in2', 'dispMap');
          dm.setAttribute('scale', maxAbsCss * 2);
          dm.setAttribute('xChannelSelector', 'R');
          dm.setAttribute('yChannelSelector', 'G');
          f.appendChild(dm);
          defsRoot().appendChild(f);
        }
        if (glassEl.style.backdropFilter !== bf) {
          glassEl.style.backdropFilter = bf;
          glassEl.style.webkitBackdropFilter = bf;
        }
      } else {
        glassEl.style.backdropFilter = 'blur(16px) saturate(1.4) brightness(1.06)';
        glassEl.style.webkitBackdropFilter = glassEl.style.backdropFilter;
        fbEl.style.display = 'flex';
        fbEl.textContent = meta.lines.join('\n');
        fbEl.style.fontFamily = fontStack();
        fbEl.style.fontWeight = state.font === 'SF' ? '600' : String(CONFIG.clock.weight);
        fbEl.style.fontSize = meta.size + 'px';
        fbEl.style.transform = `scale(${CONFIG.clock.sx}, ${CONFIG.clock.sy})`;
        fbEl.style.letterSpacing = CONFIG.clock.tracking + 'px';
      }
      finishResizeCommit();
      applyPosition();
      lastCommittedSize = CONFIG.clock.size;
      lastCommittedSy = CONFIG.clock.sy;
      glowEl.dataset.painted = String(meta.minuteKey || '');
      if (tickT0 > 0) {
        PerfMonitor.record('clockTickSwap', performance.now() - tickT0, { minute: meta.minuteKey });
      }
    };

    if (meta.hardCut) {
      const mReady = meta.maskUrl ? Promise.resolve(meta.maskUrl) : (meta.maskPromise || Promise.resolve(''));
      mReady.then((mUrl) => {
        if (mUrl) meta.maskUrl = mUrl;
        if (applySeq === mySeq) requestAnimationFrame(paint);
      });
      return;
    }

    // Keep the previous minute 100% solid & opaque while the next minute's
    // mask, refraction displacement map, and inner rim PNG finish decoding,
    // then commit atomically in a single frame with zero blank flash.
    clearTimeout(swapGuard);
    document.body.classList.remove('swapping');
    const needInner = CONFIG.glass.inner.thickness > 0 && CONFIG.glass.inner.intensity > 0;
    if (needInner && innerShownKey !== meta.innerKey) {
      refreshInnerFor(meta.innerKey, meta.alpha, meta.w, meta.h, meta.ss, meta.alphaKey);
    }
    const innerPromise = (needInner && innerShownKey !== meta.innerKey)
      ? waitInnerCached(meta.innerKey).then((u) => preloadImg(u))
      : Promise.resolve();
    const maskReady = meta.maskUrl ? Promise.resolve(meta.maskUrl) : (meta.maskPromise || Promise.resolve(''));
    maskReady.then((mUrl) => {
      if (applySeq !== mySeq) return;
      if (mUrl) meta.maskUrl = mUrl;
      return Promise.all([
        preloadImg(meta.maskUrl),
        canGlass ? preloadImg(dispUrl) : Promise.resolve(),
        innerPromise
      ]);
    }).then(() => {
      if (applySeq !== mySeq) return;
      requestAnimationFrame(paint);
    });
  }

  function build(force) {
    const t = getTime();
    const key = [t.lines.join('|'), state.font, CONFIG.clock.size, CONFIG.clock.sx, CONFIG.clock.sy, CONFIG.clock.tracking, state.color, $('screen').clientWidth, $('screen').clientHeight].join('#');
    if (!force && key === lastKey) return;
    const meta = renderBitmap(t.lines);
    const shapeChanged = lastShapeKey !== '' && lastShapeKey !== meta.alphaKey;
    const isTick = lastMinute !== '' && (lastMinute !== t.minuteKey || shapeChanged);
    const hardCut = document.body.classList.contains('resizing');
    lastKey = key;
    lastShapeKey = meta.alphaKey;
    lastMinute = t.minuteKey;

    lastMaskCanvas = meta.maskCanvas; lastMaskAlpha = meta.alpha; lastMaskKey = meta.alphaKey; lastSS = meta.ss;
    meta.isTick = isTick && !hardCut;
    meta.hardCut = hardCut;
    const jobId = ++jobSeq;
    pendingMeta.clear(); // obsolete jobs must not retain multi-megapixel masks
    pendingMeta.set(jobId, meta);

    const params = {
      surface: CONFIG.glass.surface,
      ior: CONFIG.glass.ior,
      thickness: CONFIG.glass.thickness,
      bezel: CONFIG.glass.bezel,
      shadowThickness: CONFIG.glass.inner.thickness,
      shadowAngle: CONFIG.glass.inner.angle
    };

    /* ── glass raster cache ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    const gk = [meta.w, meta.h, meta.ss, meta.alphaKey,
                params.surface, params.ior, params.thickness, params.bezel].join('|');
    const cachedGlass = lruGet(glassCache, gk);
    if (cachedGlass && cachedGlass.disp) {
      // reuse: no worker round-trip, no SDF, no EDT, no PNG encode
      pendingMeta.delete(jobId);
      PerfMonitor.record('clockRefraction', 0, { hit: true, engine: 'Cache' });
      apply(meta, cachedGlass.disp, '', cachedGlass.maxAbs);
      return;
    }

    /* start the rim for these new glyphs immediately so it finishes in parallel */
    if (CONFIG.glass.inner.thickness > 0 && !lruGet(innerCache, meta.innerKey)) {
      postInnerFor(meta.innerKey, meta.alpha, meta.w, meta.h, meta.ss);
    }

    refractionT0 = performance.now();
    if (window.NativeGlassMath?.available) {
      NativeGlassMath.compute(jobId, meta, params)
        .then(data => onWorkerResult({ data }))
        .catch(() => dispatchWebJob(jobId, meta, params));
      return;
    }
    dispatchWebJob(jobId, meta, params);
  }

  function dispatchWebJob(jobId, meta, params) {
    if (jobId !== jobSeq) return;
    const wk = ensureWorker();
    if (wk) {
      // send a copy: the main thread keeps the alpha for live inner-shadow repaints
      const ab = meta.alpha.slice().buffer;
      wk.postMessage({ jobId, alphaBuf: ab, w: meta.w, h: meta.h, ss: meta.ss, params }, [ab]);
    } else {
      runOnMain(jobId, meta, params);
    }
  }

  /* No Worker: run the identical generator in idle chunks. */
  function getMainCore() {
    if (mainCore) return mainCore;
    const src = WORKER_SRC.slice(0, WORKER_SRC.indexOf('self.onmessage'));
    mainCore = new Function(src + '\nreturn computeGlassJob;')();
    return mainCore;
  }
  function runOnMain(jobId, meta, params) {
    const it = getMainCore()(meta.alpha, meta.w, meta.h, meta.ss, params, false);
    const pump = (dl) => {
      if (jobId !== jobSeq) return;
      let r;
      do {
        r = it.next();
        if (r.done) {
          const res = r.value;
          apply(meta, bufToUrl(res.dispBuf, meta.w, meta.h), '', res.maxAbsCss);
          return;
        }
      } while (dl && dl.timeRemaining() > 4);
      if (window.requestIdleCallback) requestIdleCallback(pump, { timeout: 90 });
      else setTimeout(() => pump(null), 6);
    };
    if (window.requestIdleCallback) requestIdleCallback(pump, { timeout: 90 });
    else setTimeout(() => pump(null), 0);
  }

  /* Coalesce bursts: dragging a slider fires dozens of events, we render one
     frame after the user actually pauses for a moment. */
  let buildTimer = 0;
  function schedule(force, delay) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(rafPending);
    clearTimeout(buildTimer);
    if (delay) {
      buildTimer = setTimeout(() => { rafPending = requestAnimationFrame(() => build(force)); }, delay);
      return;
    }
    rafPending = requestAnimationFrame(() => build(force));
  }

  let preview = { x: 1, y: 1 };
  let lastCommittedSize = CONFIG.clock.size;
  let lastCommittedSy = CONFIG.clock.sy;
  let resizeCommitGuard = 0;

  function applyPosition() {
    const sc = preview.x === 1 && preview.y === 1 ? '' : ` scale(${preview.x}, ${preview.y})`;
    wrap.style.transform = `translate3d(${pos.x}px, ${pos.y}px, 0)${sc}`;
    if (frame.classList.contains('on') && !frameDirty) {
      frameDirty = true;
      requestAnimationFrame(syncFrameBox);
    }
  }

  /* The clock is PINNED: dragging never moves it. A long press is the only
     gesture, and it just opens the resize handles. */
  let holdTimer = 0;
  let holdFrom = null;
  let holdFired = false;

  /* Long-press = resize. It must survive tiny finger wobble (phones always
     report a few px), so the hold is only cancelled after a real movement. */
  wrap.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    if (e.button !== undefined && e.button !== 0) return;
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.preventDefault();
    holdFired = false;
    holdFrom = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
    try { wrap.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
    rememberLastSize();                 // snapshot for the ↺ undo button
    clearTimeout(holdTimer);
    holdTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      holdFired = true;
      openResize();
    }, 360);
  });
  const endHold = () => { clearTimeout(holdTimer); holdTimer = 0; holdFrom = null; };
  wrap.addEventListener('pointerup', endHold);
  wrap.addEventListener('pointercancel', endHold);
  wrap.addEventListener('pointerleave', endHold);
  wrap.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', endHold);
  wrap.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    if (!holdFrom) return;
    // real drag, not wobble → this is not a long press
    if (Math.hypot(e.clientX - holdFrom.x, e.clientY - holdFrom.y) > 14) endHold();
  });
  /* a plain tap (no hold) does nothing, but must not leave a timer behind */
  wrap.addEventListener('click', () => { if (!holdFired) clearTimeout(holdTimer); });

  /* ── Long-press resize: drag any handle to stretch/shrink the digits.
     Only the pixel size changes — the chosen font, weight and stretch stay. ── */
  const frame = $('clock-frame');
  let rs = null;

  function layerScale() {
    const layer = $('clock-layer');
    const w = layer.offsetWidth;
    const bw = layer.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    return w > 0 && bw > 0 ? bw / w : 1;
  }

  function layoutFrame() {
    const host = $('screen').getBoundingClientRect();
    const g = glassEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    const r = g.width > 8 ? g : wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    frame.style.left = (r.left - host.left) + 'px';
    frame.style.top = (r.top - host.top) + 'px';
    frame.style.width = r.width + 'px';
    frame.style.height = r.height + 'px';
  }

  function scheduleResizeAutoClose() {
    clearTimeout(openResize._t);
    openResize._t = setTimeout(closeResize, 9000);
  }

  function openResize() {
    boxCache = null;
    clampInsideScreen();
    layoutFrame();
    frame.classList.add('on');
    frame.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    document.body.classList.add('resizing');
    vib(18, 'heavy');
    scheduleResizeAutoClose();
  }
  function closeResize() {
    frame.classList.remove('on');
    frame.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    if (!rs) document.body.classList.remove('resizing');
    clearTimeout(openResize._t);
    if (rs) {
      rs = null;
      preview = { x: 1, y: 1 };
      applyPosition();
      Clock.schedule(true);
    }
  }

  frame.querySelectorAll('[data-h]').forEach((h) => {
    h.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      e.preventDefault();
      clearTimeout(openResize._t);
      clearTimeout(resizeCommitGuard);
      boxCache = null;
      const m = clockMetrics();
      const dir = h.dataset.h;
      rs = {
        dir,
        corner: /e|w/.test(dir) && /n|s/.test(dir),
        scale: layerScale(),
        x0: e.clientX, y0: e.clientY,
        size: CONFIG.clock.size,
        fitSize: m.size || lastCommittedSize || CONFIG.clock.size,
        sx: CONFIG.clock.sx,
        sy: CONFIG.clock.sy,
        w: m.textW,
        h: m.textH,
        pendX: 0, pendY: 0,
        raf: 0
      };
      try { h.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
    });

    h.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (!rs) return;
      rs.pendX = e.clientX - rs.x0;
      rs.pendY = e.clientY - rs.y0;
      if (!rs.raf) rs.raf = requestAnimationFrame(applyHandleDelta);
    });

    const done = () => {
      if (!rs) return;
      cancelAnimationFrame(rs.raf);
      rs = null;
      persistGeometry();
      const lbl = $('clock-frame-label');
      if (lbl) lbl.textContent = 'اسحب المقبض · أو اضغط تصغير';
      // Keep preview transform + body.resizing until apply() commits the crisp bitmap
      clearTimeout(resizeCommitGuard);
      resizeCommitGuard = setTimeout(() => {
        preview = { x: 1, y: 1 };
        applyPosition();
        document.body.classList.remove('resizing');
        if (frame.classList.contains('on')) layoutFrame();
      }, 1200);
      Clock.schedule(true);
      scheduleResizeAutoClose();
      vib(8, 'tick');
    };
    h.addEventListener('pointerup', done);
    h.addEventListener('pointercancel', done);
  });

  /* Geometry of the digits themselves (not the padded canvas), used as the
     starting box and to compute the safety limits. */
  function clockMetrics() {
    if (!lastMetrics) {
      const r = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
      return { textW: r.width || 200, textH: r.height || 200 };
    }
    return lastMetrics;
  }

  /* One rAF per frame. Free 2D dragging: horizontal drag scales clock width up to
     100% of screen width; vertical drag stretches clock height optically up to 100%
     of available lock-screen height without thickening horizontal strokes. */
  function applyHandleDelta() {
    if (!rs) return;
    rs.raf = 0;
    const sc = rs.scale || 1;
    const dx = rs.pendX / sc, dy = rs.pendY / sc;
    const dir = rs.dir;
    const horiz = /e|w/.test(dir);
    const vert = /n|s/.test(dir);
    const lim = limits();
    const fitSz = Math.max(40, rs.fitSize || rs.size);
    const fullWidthSize = clampSize(Math.round(fitSz * (lim.maxW / Math.max(40, rs.w))));

    if (horiz) {
      const dxOut = dx * (dir.includes('w') ? -2 : 2);
      const nextW = clamp(rs.w + dxOut, 80, lim.maxW);
      CONFIG.clock.size = clamp(Math.round(fitSz * (nextW / Math.max(40, rs.w))), 56, fullWidthSize);
      CONFIG.clock.sx = 1.0;
      syncSizeControl();
    }

    const baseHAtSize = (rs.h / Math.max(0.5, rs.sy)) * (CONFIG.clock.size / fitSz);
    const maxSyAtSize = clamp(lim.maxH / Math.max(40, baseHAtSize), 1.0, 3.10);

    if (vert) {
      const dyOut = dy * (dir.includes('n') ? -1 : 1);
      if (dyOut >= 0) {
        const roomPx = Math.max(60, lim.maxH - rs.h);
        CONFIG.clock.sy = clamp(rs.sy + (dyOut / roomPx) * Math.max(0.35, maxSyAtSize - rs.sy), 1.0, maxSyAtSize);
      } else {
        const shrinkPx = Math.max(70, rs.h * 0.65);
        CONFIG.clock.sy = clamp(rs.sy + (dyOut / shrinkPx) * Math.max(0.25, rs.sy - 1.0), 1.0, maxSyAtSize);
      }
      syncStretchControl();
    } else if (CONFIG.clock.sy > maxSyAtSize) {
      CONFIG.clock.sy = maxSyAtSize;
      syncStretchControl();
    }

    const lbl = $('clock-frame-label');
    if (lbl) {
      const wPct = Math.round(clamp((CONFIG.clock.size / Math.max(56, fullWidthSize)) * 100, 15, 100));
      const hPct = Math.round(clamp(((CONFIG.clock.sy - 1.0) / Math.max(0.1, maxSyAtSize - 1.0)) * 100, 0, 100));
      lbl.textContent = `الحجم ${wPct}% · الطول ${hPct}%`;
    }
    renderPreview();
  }

  function renderPreview() {
    if (!rs) return;
    const baseSize = Math.max(40, clockMetrics().size || lastCommittedSize || rs.fitSize || rs.size);
    const baseSy = Math.max(0.5, lastCommittedSy || rs.sy);
    const kSize = CONFIG.clock.size / baseSize;
    preview = {
      x: kSize * (CONFIG.clock.sx / rs.sx),
      y: kSize * (CONFIG.clock.sy / baseSy)
    };
    // one composited write, no layout reads in the hot path
    wrap.style.transform =
      `translate3d(${pos.x}px, ${pos.y}px, 0) scale(${preview.x}, ${preview.y})`;
    if (frameDirty) return;
    frameDirty = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(syncFrameBox);
  }

  let frameDirty = false;
  function syncFrameBox() {
    frameDirty = false;
    if (!frame.classList.contains('on')) return;
    layoutFrame();
  }

  /* Safe box, recomputed every time the frame opens. */
  let boxCache = null;

  /* Measured once when the frame opens (or on rotate) — never in the drag loop. */
  function measureBox() {
    const host = $('screen').getBoundingClientRect();
    const m = clockMetrics();
    const sc = layerScale();
    const pad = (m.pad || 32) + 8;
    const topSafe = Math.max(
      $('topline').getBoundingClientRect().bottom + 10,
      $('clock-layer').getBoundingClientRect().top + 2
    );
    const cardTop = (state.npOn ? $('np') : $('bottom')).getBoundingClientRect().top - 12;
    boxCache = {
      vw: host.width / sc, vh: host.height / sc,
      pad, topSafe, cardTop: Math.max(topSafe + 80, cardTop), sc
    };
  }

  function limits() {
    if (!boxCache) measureBox();
    const m = clockMetrics();
    const pad = boxCache.pad;
    const maxW = Math.max(140, boxCache.vw - 16 - (m.pad || 36));
    const maxH = Math.max(96, Math.min((boxCache.cardTop - boxCache.topSafe) / boxCache.sc, boxCache.vh * 0.8) - pad);
    return {
      maxW, maxH,
      minW: Math.min(maxW, 110),
      minH: Math.min(maxH, 70),
      maxSx: clamp(maxW / Math.max(1, m.baseW), 0.3, 6),
      maxSy: clamp(maxH / Math.max(1, m.baseH), 0.4, 8),
      minSx: clamp(110 / Math.max(1, m.baseW), 0.3, 1.2),
      minSy: clamp(70 / Math.max(1, m.baseH), 0.4, 1.4)
    };
  }

  /* If a saved size is too big for this screen, bring it back in bounds. */
  function clampInsideScreen() {
    boxCache = null;
    // Fit at raster time with one scale; rotation must not stretch or save sx/sy.
    Clock.schedule(true);
  }

  function persistGeometry() {
    state.clockSize = CONFIG.clock.size;
    state.clockSx = CONFIG.clock.sx;
    state.clockSy = CONFIG.clock.sy;
    state.clockY = pos.y;
    save();
  }

  function clampSize(v) { return Math.max(56, Math.min(420, v)); }
  function clampSy(v) { return Math.max(1.0, Math.min(3.10, v)); }
  function clampY(v) { return Math.max(-20, Math.min(80, v)); }
  const sizeControl = $('clock-size');
  const sizeValue = $('clock-size-value');
  const stretchControl = $('clock-stretch');
  const stretchValue = $('clock-stretch-value');
  const yControl = $('clock-y');
  const yValue = $('clock-y-value');
  function syncSizeControl() {
    sizeControl.value = String(CONFIG.clock.size);
    sizeValue.textContent = Math.round(CONFIG.clock.size / 172 * 100) + '%';
  }
  function syncStretchControl() {
    if (!stretchControl || !stretchValue) return;
    const pct = Math.round(clamp(CONFIG.clock.sy, 1.0, 3.10) * 100);
    stretchControl.value = String(pct);
    stretchValue.textContent = pct + '%';
  }
  function syncYControl() {
    if (!yControl || !yValue) return;
    const y = Math.round(clampY(pos.y));
    yControl.value = String(y);
    yValue.textContent = (y > 0 ? '+' : '') + y + 'px';
  }
  syncSizeControl();
  syncStretchControl();
  syncYControl();
  let sizeReleaseTimer = 0;
  sizeControl.addEventListener('input', () => {
    CONFIG.clock.size = clampSize(Number(sizeControl.value));
    syncSizeControl();
    persistGeometry();
    sizeControl.dataset.dragging = '1';
    document.body.classList.add('resizing');
    const ratio = CONFIG.clock.size / Math.max(40, lastCommittedSize || CONFIG.clock.size);
    preview = { x: ratio, y: ratio };
    applyPosition();
    clearTimeout(sizeReleaseTimer);
    sizeReleaseTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      delete sizeControl.dataset.dragging;
      clearTimeout(resizeCommitGuard);
      resizeCommitGuard = setTimeout(() => {
        preview = { x: 1, y: 1 };
        applyPosition();
        document.body.classList.remove('resizing');
      }, 1200);
      schedule(true);
    }, 110);
  });

  let stretchReleaseTimer = 0;
  if (stretchControl) {
    stretchControl.addEventListener('input', () => {
      CONFIG.clock.sy = clampSy(Number(stretchControl.value) / 100);
      syncStretchControl();
      persistGeometry();
      stretchControl.dataset.dragging = '1';
      document.body.classList.add('resizing');
      const ratioY = CONFIG.clock.sy / Math.max(0.5, lastCommittedSy || CONFIG.clock.sy);
      preview = { x: 1, y: ratioY };
      applyPosition();
      clearTimeout(stretchReleaseTimer);
      stretchReleaseTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        delete stretchControl.dataset.dragging;
        clearTimeout(resizeCommitGuard);
        resizeCommitGuard = setTimeout(() => {
          preview = { x: 1, y: 1 };
          applyPosition();
          document.body.classList.remove('resizing');
        }, 1200);
        schedule(true);
      }, 110);
    });
  }

  let yReleaseTimer = 0;
  if (yControl) {
    yControl.addEventListener('input', () => {
      pos.y = clampY(Number(yControl.value));
      syncYControl();
      applyPosition();
      persistGeometry();
      clearTimeout(yReleaseTimer);
      yReleaseTimer = setTimeout(() => schedule(true), 120);
    });
  }

  /* Undo: keeps the size from before the frame was opened. */
  let lastSize = null;
  function rememberLastSize() {
    lastSize = { size: CONFIG.clock.size, sx: CONFIG.clock.sx, sy: CONFIG.clock.sy, y: pos.y };
  }
  function undoSize() {
    if (!lastSize) return;
    CONFIG.clock.size = lastSize.size;
    CONFIG.clock.sx = lastSize.sx;
    CONFIG.clock.sy = lastSize.sy;
    if (typeof lastSize.y === 'number') pos.y = lastSize.y;
    syncSizeControl();
    syncStretchControl();
    syncYControl();
    applyPosition();
    persistGeometry();
    Clock.schedule(true);
    scheduleResizeAutoClose();
    vib(10, 'tick');
  }
  $('clock-frame-undo').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    undoSize();
  });
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v; }

  $('clock-frame-reset').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    CONFIG.clock.size = 172;
    CONFIG.clock.sx = 1.0;
    CONFIG.clock.sy = 1.22;
    pos.y = 0;
    syncSizeControl();
    syncStretchControl();
    syncYControl();
    applyPosition();
    persistGeometry();
    Clock.schedule(true);
    scheduleResizeAutoClose();
    vib(10, 'tick');
  });

  /* Anywhere else closes the frame. */
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    if (!frame.classList.contains('on')) return;
    if (e.target.closest('#clock-frame')) return;
    closeResize();
  });

  function hexA(hex, a) {
    const m = /^#?([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})$/i.exec(hex || '#ffffff');
    if (!m) return `rgba(255,255,255,${a})`;
    return `rgba(${parseInt(m[1],16)},${parseInt(m[2],16)},${parseInt(m[3],16)},${a})`;
  }

  return {
    schedule, applyPosition, refreshInner,
    getPos: () => pos,
    setPos: (p) => { pos = p; applyPosition(); },
    openResize, closeResize,
    guard: clampInsideScreen,
    metrics: () => clockMetrics(),
    limits: () => limits(),
    relayout: () => { boxCache = null; if (frame.classList.contains('on')) layoutFrame(); }
  };
})();

/* Small spring helper used by a few UI bits. */
const springs = new Map();
let springRaf = 0, springLast = 0;
function springTo(key, from, to, k = 0.3, cb) {
  springs.set(key, { v: from, t: to, vel: 0, k, cb });
  if (!springRaf) { springLast = 0; springRaf = requestAnimationFrame(springStep); }
}
function springStep(now) {
  if (!springLast) springLast = now;
  const dt = Math.min(0.032, Math.max(0.001, (now - springLast) / 1000));
  springLast = now;
  for (const [key, s] of springs) {
    const force = -(s.k * 220) * (s.v - s.t) - (2 * Math.sqrt(s.k * 220) * 0.82) * s.vel;
    s.vel += force * dt;
    s.v += s.vel * dt;
    if (Math.abs(s.v - s.t) < 0.05 && Math.abs(s.vel) < 0.6) {
      s.v = s.t; s.cb(s.v); springs.delete(key); continue;
    }
    s.cb(s.v);
  }
  springRaf = springs.size ? requestAnimationFrame(springStep) : 0;
}

/* ============================================================================
   3. WALLPAPERS (drawn lazily, small thumbnails, cached as data URL)
   ========================================================================= */
const Wallpapers = (() => {
  function draw(name, W = 900, H = 1800) {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = W; c.height = H;
    const x = c.getContext('2d');
    const sx = (v) => v * (W / 900);
    const sy = (v) => v * (H / 1800);

    const sky = (stops) => {
      const g = x.createLinearGradient(0, 0, W * 0.35, H);
      stops.forEach(([p, col]) => g.addColorStop(p, col));
      x.fillStyle = g; x.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    };
    const blob = (cx, cy, r, col) => {
      const rr = r * Math.min(W / 900, H / 1800);
      const g = x.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, rr * 0.05, cx, cy, rr);
      g.addColorStop(0, col); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
      x.fillStyle = g; x.beginPath(); x.arc(cx, cy, rr, 0, 7); x.fill();
    };

    if (name === 'angel') {
      sky([[0,'#a9c1dd'],[0.34,'#dfcbd7'],[0.64,'#9db0c9'],[0.86,'#5a6a81'],[1,'#333e51']]);
      blob(sx(220), sy(400), 420, 'rgba(255,255,255,.55)');
      blob(sx(660), sy(300), 380, 'rgba(255,255,255,.42)');
      blob(sx(450), sy(980), 520, 'rgba(255,255,255,.22)');
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const y0 = sy(760 + i * 110);
        const g = x.createLinearGradient(0, y0 - sy(70), 0, y0 + sy(70));
        g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
        g.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(255,255,255,${0.26 - i * 0.04})`);
        g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
        x.fillStyle = g;
        x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(0, y0);
        const step = Math.max(4, Math.round(sx(40)));
        for (let px = 0; px <= W; px += step) x.lineTo(px, y0 + Math.sin((px / W) * 5 + i) * sy(28));
        x.lineTo(W, y0 + sy(150)); x.lineTo(0, y0 + sy(150)); x.closePath(); x.fill();
      }
      const sh = x.createRadialGradient(W*0.5, sy(760), sx(40), W*0.5, sy(1100), sx(620));
      sh.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,250,242,.34)'); sh.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,250,242,0)');
      x.fillStyle = sh; x.fillRect(0, sy(400), W, H - sy(400));
      const vg = x.createRadialGradient(W/2,H*0.42,H*0.2,W/2,H*0.5,H*0.8);
      vg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); vg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(20,26,38,.34)');
      x.fillStyle = vg; x.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    } else if (name === 'obsidian') {
      sky([[0,'#171b24'],[0.5,'#0a0c11'],[1,'#000']]);
      blob(W*0.5, H*0.34, 900*0.9, 'rgba(90,110,150,.20)');
    } else if (name === 'dusk') {
      sky([[0,'#2a1c46'],[0.3,'#7c3f6b'],[0.58,'#d9705c'],[0.78,'#f2b07a'],[1,'#2b2039']]);
      blob(W*0.7, H*0.66, 300, 'rgba(255,215,160,.65)');
      blob(W*0.2, H*0.2, 420, 'rgba(120,90,200,.35)');
    } else if (name === 'aurora') {
      sky([[0,'#0b1030'],[0.42,'#1c4d8c'],[0.72,'#2aa88a'],[1,'#101a34']]);
      blob(sx(240), sy(620), 420, 'rgba(90,255,190,.45)');
      blob(sx(700), sy(900), 460, 'rgba(120,90,255,.45)');
      blob(sx(430), sy(380), 360, 'rgba(70,200,255,.35)');
    } else if (name === 'daylight') {
      sky([[0,'#f2f6fb'],[0.46,'#e2ebf4'],[1,'#bfd0e2']]);
      blob(W*0.7, sy(380), 420, 'rgba(255,255,255,.85)');
    } else {
      sky([[0,'#242a36'],[1,'#0c1016']]);
      blob(W*0.5, H*0.3, 900*0.8, 'rgba(120,140,180,.22)');
    }
    return c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', W < 200 ? 0.8 : 0.86);
  }

  const cache = new Map();
  const PRESETS = ['angel', 'obsidian', 'dusk', 'aurora', 'daylight'];
  const thumbs = new Map();

  function urlFor(name) {
    if (name === 'custom' && state.customWall) return state.customWall;
    const key = PRESETS.includes(name) ? name : 'angel';
    if (!cache.has(key)) cache.set(key, draw(key, 900, 1800));
    return cache.get(key);
  }
  function thumb(name) {
    if (name === 'custom' && state.customWall) return state.customWall;
    if (!thumbs.has(name)) thumbs.set(name, draw(name, 84, 108));
    return thumbs.get(name);
  }

  function apply() {
    const el = $('wall');
    el.src = urlFor(state.wall);
    document.body.style.setProperty('--wall-zoom', '1');
  }

  return { apply, urlFor, thumb, PRESETS };
})();

/* ============================================================================
   4. ADAPTIVE COLOR — keeps text readable on any wallpaper
   ========================================================================= */
const Adaptive = (() => {
  const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
  cv.width = 24; cv.height = 24;
  const ctx = cv.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
  let lastLight = null;
  let sampledKey = '';

  function sample() {
    const img = $('wall');
    try {
      const srcKey = state.wall === 'custom' ? (img.src || '').slice(0, 64) + (img.src || '').length : state.wall;
      if (sampledKey !== srcKey || lastLight === null) {
        if (!img.complete || !img.naturalWidth) return;
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, 24, 24);
        const d = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, 24, 24).data;
        let lum = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) {
          lum += (0.2126 * d[i] + 0.7152 * d[i+1] + 0.0722 * d[i+2]) / 255;
        }
        lum /= (d.length / 4);
        if (lastLight === null) lastLight = lum > 0.52;
        else if (!lastLight && lum > 0.56) lastLight = true;
        else if (lastLight && lum < 0.44) lastLight = false;
        sampledKey = srcKey;
      }

      const root = document.documentElement.style;
      const ink = lastLight ? '#12151c' : '#ffffff';
      root.setProperty('--ui', ink);
      root.setProperty('--ui-dim', lastLight ? 'rgba(18,21,28,.68)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.74)');
