      root.setProperty('--glass-bg', lastLight ? 'rgba(255,255,255,.08)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.04)');
      root.setProperty('--clock-top', state.color === 'auto' ? ink : state.color);

      const p = clamp01((state.clockOpacity ?? 22) / 100);
      root.setProperty('--clock-shadow-op', p <= 0 ? '0' : (p * 0.24).toFixed(3));

      const base = state.color === 'auto'
        ? (lastLight ? [18, 24, 34] : [255, 255, 255])
        : hexToRgb(state.color);

      if (p <= 0.001) {
        root.setProperty('--clock-tint', 'transparent');
      } else if (p >= 0.995) {
        root.setProperty('--clock-tint', `rgb(${base[0]},${base[1]},${base[2]})`);
      } else {
        const a1 = p;
        const a2 = p < 0.72 ? p * 0.45 : p * (0.45 + 0.55 * ((p - 0.72) / 0.28));
        root.setProperty('--clock-tint',
          `linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(${base[0]},${base[1]},${base[2]},${a1.toFixed(3)}) 0%, rgba(${base[0]},${base[1]},${base[2]},${a2.toFixed(3)}) 100%)`);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* not ready */ }
  }

  return { sample };
})();

/* ============================================================================
   4b. AI DEPTH EXTRACTION (Free & Unlimited: Google ML Kit Native + RMBG-1.4 Web)
   ========================================================================= */
const AIDepth = (() => {
  let busy = false;
  let seq = 0;
  let webPipeline = null;
  const pending = new Map();

  function setStatus(msg) {
    const el = $('ai-depth-status');
    if (el && msg) el.textContent = msg;
    const btn = document.querySelector('.w-chip.ai');
    if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('busy', busy);
  }

  window.onSubjectDepthProgress = (reqId, pct, msg) => {
    if (!pending.has(reqId)) return;
    setStatus(`${msg || 'جاري العزل…'} (${pct}%)`);
  };
  window.onSubjectDepthReady = async (reqId, url) => {
    const job = pending.get(reqId);
    if (!job) return;
    pending.delete(reqId);
    try {
      const resp = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' });
      const blob = await resp.blob();
      const dataUrl = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const fr = new FileReader();
        fr.onload = () => resolve(fr.result);
        fr.onerror = () => reject(new Error('read failed'));
        fr.readAsDataURL(blob);
      });
      job.resolve(dataUrl);
    } catch (e) {
      job.reject(e);
    }
  };
  window.onSubjectDepthError = (reqId, code, msg) => {
    const job = pending.get(reqId);
    if (!job) return;
    pending.delete(reqId);
    const err = new Error(msg || code || 'AI error');
    err.code = code;
    job.reject(err);
  };

  function runNative(dataUrl) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      if (!window.AndroidHost?.segmentSubject) {
        const e = new Error('NO_NATIVE_AI'); e.code = 'PLAY_SERVICES_UNAVAILABLE'; reject(e); return;
      }
      const reqId = 'sd_' + (++seq);
      pending.set(reqId, { resolve, reject });
      try {
        window.AndroidHost.segmentSubject(reqId, dataUrl);
      } catch (e) {
        pending.delete(reqId);
        reject(e);
      }
    });
  }

  async function runWebCloudAI(dataUrl) {
    setStatus('جاري تحميل نموذج الذكاء الاصطناعي المجاني (RMBG-1.4)…');
    if (!webPipeline) {
      const transformers = await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@huggingface/transformers@3.3.3');
      transformers.env.allowLocalModels = false;
      const { AutoModel, AutoProcessor, RawImage } = transformers;
      const model = await AutoModel.from_pretrained('briaai/RMBG-1.4', { config: { model_type: 'custom' } });
      const processor = await AutoProcessor.from_pretrained('briaai/RMBG-1.4', {
        config: {
          do_normalize: true, do_pad: false, do_rescale: true, do_resize: true,
          image_mean: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5], feature_extractor_type: 'ImageFeatureExtractor',
          image_std: [1, 1, 1], resample: 2,
          rescale_factor: 0.00392156862745098, size: { width: 1024, height: 1024 }
        }
      });
      webPipeline = { model, processor, RawImage };
    }
    setStatus('جاري عزل الشخصية بالذكاء الاصطناعي…');
    const { model, processor, RawImage } = webPipeline;
    const image = await RawImage.fromURL(dataUrl);
    const { pixel_values } = await processor(image);
    const { output } = await model({ input: pixel_values });
    const scale = Math.min(1, 960 / Math.max(image.width, image.height));
    const ow = Math.max(2, Math.round(image.width * scale));
    const oh = Math.max(2, Math.round(image.height * scale));
    const mask = await RawImage.fromTensor(output[0].mul(255).to('uint8')).resize(ow, oh);
    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = ow; cv.height = oh;
    const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
    const baseImg = new Image();
    baseImg.src = dataUrl;
    await baseImg.decode();
    ctx.drawImage(baseImg, 0, 0, ow, oh);
    const px = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
    let fgCount = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < mask.data.length; i++) {
      const a = mask.data[i];
      if (a > 120) fgCount++;
      px.data[i * 4 + 3] = a;
    }
    const cov = fgCount / Math.max(1, mask.data.length);
    if (cov < 0.006 || cov > 0.96) {
      const e = new Error('لم يتم العثور على عنصر واضح لعزله'); e.code = 'NO_SUBJECT'; throw e;
    }
    ctx.putImageData(px, 0, 0);
    return cv.toDataURL('image/png');
  }

  function currentWallKey() {
    return state.wall === 'custom'
      ? 'custom:' + (state.customWall || '').slice(0, 48) + ':' + (state.customWall || '').length
      : 'preset:' + state.wall;
  }

  async function extractForCurrentWall() {
    if (busy) return;
    const srcUrl = Wallpapers.urlFor(state.wall);
    if (!srcUrl) return;
    busy = true;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    setStatus('جاري تحليل الخلفية بالذكاء الاصطناعي…');
    try {
      let cutoutUrl = '';
      let source = 'mlkit';
      try {
        cutoutUrl = await runNative(srcUrl);
      } catch (nativeErr) {
        if (nativeErr?.code === 'NO_SUBJECT') throw nativeErr;
        source = 'rmbg-1.4';
        cutoutUrl = await runWebCloudAI(srcUrl);
      }
      PerfMonitor.record('aiDepth', performance.now() - t0, { source, ok: true });
      state.subject = cutoutUrl;
      state.subjectWallKey = currentWallKey();
      state.depth = true;
      save(true);
      applyDepth();
      Editor.build();
      setStatus('تم تفعيل تأثير العمق بالذكاء الاصطناعي بنجاح');
      toast('الساعة الآن خلف الشخصية تلقائياً');
      vib(12, 'pop');
    } catch (e) {
      PerfMonitor.record('aiDepth', performance.now() - t0, { ok: false, code: e?.code || 'ERR' });
      const msg = e?.code === 'NO_SUBJECT'
        ? 'لم يتم العثور على شخصية أو عنصر بارز في هذه الخلفية'
        : 'تعذّر عزل الشخصية — تأكد من الاتصال أول مرة أو جرّب صورة أوضح';
      setStatus(msg);
      toast(msg);
    } finally {
      busy = false;
      setStatus();
    }
  }

  return { extractForCurrentWall, currentWallKey, isBusy: () => busy };
})();

/* Dynamic Island live activity pill */
const Island = (() => {
  const el = $('island');
  const dot = $('island-dot');
  const label = $('island-label');
  let timer = 0;

  function pulse(text, color = '#30d158', duration = 2200) {
    if (!el || !label) return;
    label.textContent = text;
    if (dot) dot.style.background = color;
    el.classList.add('active', 'wide');
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      el.classList.remove('wide');
      timer = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('active'), 320);
    }, duration);
  }

  return { pulse };
})();

/* ============================================================================
   5. MEDIA (now playing + real audio if the user picks a file)
   ========================================================================= */
const Media = (() => {
  const audio = new Audio();
  let hasFile = false;
  let audioBlobUrl = '';
  let tickTimer = 0;
  let demoStart = 0;
  let lastDrawnP = -1;

  function fmt(t) {
    t = Math.max(0, Math.floor(t));
    return Math.floor(t / 60) + ':' + String(t % 60).padStart(2, '0');
  }

  function position() {
    if (hasFile) return audio.currentTime;
    if (!state.playing) return state.np.elapsed;
    return state.np.elapsed + (performance.now() - demoStart) / 1000;
  }

  function measureTitle() {
    const title = $('np-title');
    const meta = title.parentElement;
    title.classList.remove('scroll');
    const over = title.scrollWidth > meta.clientWidth + 2;
    if (meta) meta.classList.toggle('scrolling', over);
    title.classList.toggle('scroll', over);
    if (over) title.style.setProperty('--mq', `-${title.scrollWidth - meta.clientWidth + 18}px`);
  }

  let lastElapsed = '', lastRemain = '';
  const thumbEl = $('np-thumb');
  const trackEl = document.querySelector('#np-bar .np-track');

  function measureBar() {
    const w = trackEl ? trackEl.clientWidth : 300;
    if (w > 0) thumbEl.style.setProperty('--bar-w', w + 'px');
  }
  function renderProgress(force) {
    const dur = state.np.duration || 1;
    const pos = Math.min(dur, position());
    const p = clamp01(pos / dur);
    const e = fmt(pos), r = '-' + fmt(dur - pos);
    if (force || Math.abs(p - lastDrawnP) >= 0.0012) {
      lastDrawnP = p;
      $('np-fill').style.transform = `scaleX(${p.toFixed(4)})`;
      thumbEl.style.setProperty('--p', p.toFixed(4));
    }
    if (e !== lastElapsed) { $('np-elapsed').textContent = e; lastElapsed = e; }
    if (r !== lastRemain) { $('np-remain').textContent = r; lastRemain = r; }
  }

  function render() {
    measureBar();
    $('np-title').textContent = state.np.title;
    $('np-artist').textContent = state.np.artist;
    $('np-play').classList.toggle('playing', !!state.playing);
    document.body.classList.toggle('np-paused', !state.playing);
    measureTitle();
    renderProgress(true);
  }

  function tick() {
    if (document.hidden || !state.playing) return;
    if (!hasFile && position() >= (state.np.duration || 1)) {
      nextTrack();
      return;
    }
    if (!state.npOn || document.body.classList.contains('editing')) return;
    renderProgress(false);
  }

  function startTicking() {
    if (!tickTimer && state.playing) {
      tickTimer = setInterval(tick, 140);
    }
  }
  function stopTicking() {
    if (tickTimer) { clearInterval(tickTimer); tickTimer = 0; }
  }

  function play() {
    state.playing = true;
    if (hasFile) audio.play().catch(() => {});
    else demoStart = performance.now();
    save();
    render();
    startTicking();
    Island.pulse(state.np.title, '#30d158', 2000);
    if ('mediaSession' in navigator) {
      navigator.mediaSession.metadata = new MediaMetadata({ title: state.np.title, artist: state.np.artist });
    }
  }
  function pause() {
    state.playing = false;
    if (hasFile) { audio.pause(); state.np.elapsed = audio.currentTime; }
    else state.np.elapsed = Math.min(state.np.duration, position());
    save();
    render();
    stopTicking();
  }
  function toggle() { state.playing ? pause() : play(); }

  const QUEUE = [
    { title: 'Grown Woman', artist: 'Beyoncé', duration: 315 },
    { title: 'Midnight City', artist: 'M83', duration: 243 },
    { title: 'Nights', artist: 'Frank Ocean', duration: 307 },
    { title: 'Let It Happen', artist: 'Tame Impala', duration: 467 },
    { title: 'Telepatía', artist: 'Kali Uchis', duration: 180 }
  ];
  let qi = 0;
  const idxOf = () => {
    const j = QUEUE.findIndex(t => t.title === state.np.title);
    return j < 0 ? 0 : j;
  };

  function swapTo(i, dir) {
    qi = (i + QUEUE.length) % QUEUE.length;
    const t = QUEUE[qi];
    state.np.title = t.title;
    state.np.artist = t.artist;
    state.np.duration = t.duration;
    state.np.elapsed = 0;
    if (hasFile) {
      audio.pause(); audio.src = ''; hasFile = false;
      if (audioBlobUrl) { URL.revokeObjectURL(audioBlobUrl); audioBlobUrl = ''; }
    }
    demoStart = performance.now();
    const card = $('np');
    card.classList.remove('track-swap');
    requestAnimationFrame(() => card.classList.add('track-swap'));
    setTimeout(() => card.classList.remove('track-swap'), 460);
    const art = $('np-art');
    art.style.background = ART_GRADIENTS[qi % ART_GRADIENTS.length];
    art.removeAttribute('src');
    render();
    save();
    if (state.playing) play();
    else Island.pulse(t.title, '#7ad0ff', 1900);
    if (dir) {
      const b = dir > 0 ? $('np-next') : $('np-prev');
      b.classList.remove('nudge-r', 'nudge-l');
      requestAnimationFrame(() => b.classList.add(dir > 0 ? 'nudge-r' : 'nudge-l'));
      setTimeout(() => b.classList.remove('nudge-r', 'nudge-l'), 420);
    }
  }
  const ART_GRADIENTS = [
    'linear-gradient(135deg,#ff5f6d,#ffc371)',
    'linear-gradient(135deg,#5f72ff,#8ef0ff)',
    'linear-gradient(135deg,#7a5fff,#ff8ad1)',
    'linear-gradient(135deg,#ff9a3c,#ffd93d)',
    'linear-gradient(135deg,#22c1c3,#7bffd0)'
  ];
  function nextTrack() { swapTo(idxOf() + 1, 1); vib(9, 'tick'); }
  function prevTrack() {
    if (position() > 3) { seek(0); }
    else swapTo(idxOf() - 1, -1);
    vib(9, 'tick');
  }
  function seek(p) {
    const t = clamp01(p) * state.np.duration;
    if (hasFile) audio.currentTime = t;
    state.np.elapsed = t;
    demoStart = performance.now();
    renderProgress(true);
    save();
  }

  function loadFile(file) {
    if (audioBlobUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(audioBlobUrl);
    audioBlobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    audio.src = audioBlobUrl;
    audio.load();
    hasFile = true;
    audio.onended = () => {
      state.playing = false; state.np.elapsed = 0; render();
    };
    audio.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
      if (isFinite(audio.duration) && audio.duration > 0) state.np.duration = audio.duration;
      render();
    }, { once: true });
    const name = file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '');
    state.np.title = name;
    state.np.artist = 'ملف محلي';
    state.np.elapsed = 0;
    play();
  }
  function loadArt(file) {
    compressImageFile(file, 400, true).then(url => { $('np-art').src = url; }).catch(() => {});
  }

  // scrub
  const bar = $('np-bar');
  let scrubbing = false;
  const at = (clientX) => {
    const r = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
    return (clientX - r.left) / r.width;
  };
  bar.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    scrubbing = true; bar.classList.add('scrub');
    try { bar.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
    seek(at(e.clientX)); vib(5, 'tick');
  });
  bar.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => { if (scrubbing) seek(at(e.clientX)); });
  const endScrub = () => { scrubbing = false; bar.classList.remove('scrub'); };
  bar.addEventListener('pointerup', endScrub);
  bar.addEventListener('pointercancel', endScrub);

  function bump(btn) {
    btn.classList.remove('nudge');
    void btn.offsetWidth;
    btn.classList.add('nudge');
    setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('nudge'), 500);
  }
  $('np-play').addEventListener('click', () => { toggle(); bump($('np-play')); vib(7, 'pop'); });
  $('np-prev').addEventListener('click', prevTrack);
  $('np-next').addEventListener('click', nextTrack);
  $('np-star').addEventListener('click', () => { bump($('np-star')); Island.pulse('تمت الإضافة للمفضلة', '#ffd60a', 1800); toast('أُضيفت إلى المفضلة'); vib(7, 'tick'); });
  $('np-air').addEventListener('click', () => { bump($('np-air')); Island.pulse('AirPlay نشط', '#7ad0ff', 1800); toast('AirPlay: مكبّر صوت الهاتف'); vib(7, 'tick'); });

  return { render, play, pause, tick, loadFile, loadArt, seek, nextTrack, prevTrack, measureTitle, measureBar,
           isPlaying: () => !!state.playing };
})();

/* ============================================================================
   6. SHORTCUTS — hold 350ms, tap = on/off, real Android torch + haptics
   ========================================================================= */
const Shortcuts = (() => {
  const flash = $('flash');
  let camStream = null;
  let flashBurstTimer = 0;
  let camHoldTimer = 0;

  function pop(btn) {
    btn.classList.remove('pop');
    void btn.offsetWidth;
    btn.classList.add('pop');
    setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('pop'), 560);
  }

  function setFlash(on) {
    clearTimeout(flashBurstTimer);
    flash.classList.toggle('on', on);
    $('sh-left').classList.toggle('on', on);
    try { window.AndroidHost?.setTorch?.(on); } catch (_) {}
    if (on) Island.pulse('المصباح قيد التشغيل', '#ffd60a', 1600);
  }

  function bind(btn, { onTap, onHold }) {
    let t0 = 0, raf = 0, fired = false;
    const start = (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      fired = false;
      btn.classList.add('charging');
      t0 = performance.now();
      vib(4, 'tick');
      const step = () => {
        const p = Math.min(1, (performance.now() - t0) / 350);
        btn.style.transform = `scale(${(0.9 - 0.02 * p).toFixed(3)})`;
        if (p < 1) { raf = requestAnimationFrame(step); return; }
        raf = 0;
        if (!fired) {
          fired = true;
          vib(22, 'heavy');
          if (onHold) onHold();
        }
        btn.classList.remove('charging');
        btn.style.transform = '';
        pop(btn);
      };
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    const cancel = () => {
      if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = 0;
      btn.classList.remove('charging');
      btn.style.transform = '';
    };
    const end = () => {
      const held = performance.now() - t0;
      cancel();
      if (!fired && held < 350) {
        vib(9, 'pop');
        pop(btn);
        if (onTap) onTap();
      }
      fired = false;
    };
    btn.addEventListener('pointerdown', start);
    btn.addEventListener('pointerup', end);
    btn.addEventListener('pointercancel', cancel);
    btn.addEventListener('pointerleave', cancel);
  }

  function bindAll() {
    bind($('sh-left'), {
      onTap: () => {
        const on = !flash.classList.contains('on');
        setFlash(on);
        if (on) vib(14, 'pop');
      },
      onHold: () => {
        setFlash(true);
        flashBurstTimer = setTimeout(() => setFlash(false), 420);
      }
    });
    bind($('sh-right'), {
      onTap: () => openCamera(),
      onHold: () => {
        openCamera(true);
      }
    });
  }

  function shoot() {
    if ($('cam-shutter').disabled || !camStream) return;
    const sh = $('shutter');
    const iris = $('cam-iris');
    if (!sh) return;
    sh.style.transition = 'none';
    sh.style.opacity = '1';
    if (iris) { iris.style.transition = 'none'; iris.style.opacity = '0'; }
    vib(16, 'shutter');
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        sh.style.transition = 'opacity .46s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)';
        sh.style.opacity = '0';
        if (iris) {
          iris.style.transition = 'opacity .45s ease';
          iris.style.opacity = '1';
        }
      });
    });
    Island.pulse('تم التقاط الصورة', '#ffffff', 1600);
    toast('تم التقاط الصورة');
  }
  $('cam-shutter').addEventListener('click', shoot);

  function openCamera(autoShoot = false) {
    clearTimeout(camHoldTimer);
    if (flash.classList.contains('on')) setFlash(false);
    const v = $('cam-video');
    const msg = $('cam-msg');
    const shutter = $('cam-shutter');
    msg.style.display = 'none';
    v.style.display = '';
    shutter.disabled = true;
    $('cam').classList.add('on');

    if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
      msg.style.display = 'block';
      v.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: 'environment' }, audio: false })
      .then((s) => {
        const pendingPerm = !!window.AndroidHost?.isPermissionPending?.();
        if ((document.hidden && !pendingPerm) || !$('cam').classList.contains('on')) {
          s.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
          return;
        }
        camStream = s;
        v.srcObject = s;
        shutter.disabled = false;
        v.play().catch(() => {});
        if (autoShoot) camHoldTimer = setTimeout(shoot, 520);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        msg.style.display = 'block';
        v.style.display = 'none';
        shutter.disabled = true;
      });
  }
  function closeCamera() {
    clearTimeout(camHoldTimer);
    $('cam').classList.remove('on');
    if (camStream) { camStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); camStream = null; }
    $('cam-video').srcObject = null;
    $('cam-shutter').disabled = false;
  }

  $('flash-off').addEventListener('click', () => setFlash(false));
  $('cam-close').addEventListener('click', closeCamera);

  return { bindAll, closeCamera, setFlash };
})();

function vib(ms, kind = 'tick') {
  try {
    if (window.AndroidHost?.haptic) { window.AndroidHost.haptic(kind); return; }
  } catch (_) {}
  if (navigator.vibrate) { try { navigator.vibrate(ms); } catch (e) {} }
}

let toastTimer = 0;
function toast(msg) {
  const t = $('toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 1900);
}

/* ============================================================================
   7. LOCK SCREEN STAYS LOCKED — rubber-band pull + wallpaper depth zoom
   ========================================================================= */
const Pull = (() => {
  const screen = $('screen');
  const clockLayer = $('clock-layer');
  const top = $('topline');
  const np = $('np');
  const bottom = $('bottom');
  let drag = null;
  let springRaf = 0;
  let pullY = 0;

  screen.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    if (matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
    if (Editor.isOpen()) return;
    cancelAnimationFrame(springRaf);
    if ($('cam').classList.contains('on') || $('flash').classList.contains('on')) return;
    if (e.target.closest('#np, #bottom, #edit, #clock-wrap, #clock-frame, #cam, #flash, button')) return;
    drag = { y: e.clientY, t: performance.now(), last: e.clientY, id: e.pointerId, armed: false };
  });

  screen.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    if (!drag) return;
    drag.last = e.clientY;
    const dy = e.clientY - drag.y;
    if (dy < 8) return;
    if (!drag.armed) {
      drag.armed = true;
      np.style.transition = 'none';
      try { screen.setPointerCapture(drag.id); } catch (_) {}
    }
    const y = pullY = 150 * (1 - Math.exp(-Math.max(0, dy - 8) / 500));
    clockLayer.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${y}px,0)`;
    top.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${y}px,0)`;
    np.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${y * 0.6}px,0)`;
    bottom.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${y * 0.4}px,0)`;
    document.body.style.setProperty('--wall-zoom', (1 + y * 0.00028).toFixed(4));
  });

  const settle = () => {
    if (!drag) return;
    const wasArmed = drag.armed;
    drag = null;
    if (!wasArmed) {
      clockLayer.style.transform = top.style.transform = '';
      np.style.transform = bottom.style.transform = np.style.transition = '';
      document.body.style.setProperty('--wall-zoom', '1');
      return;
    }
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const fromY = pullY;
    const step = (now) => {
      const k = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / 620);
      const y = fromY * Math.exp(-7 * k) * Math.cos(10 * k);
      clockLayer.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${y}px,0)`;
      top.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${y}px,0)`;
      np.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${y * 0.6}px,0)`;
      bottom.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${y * 0.4}px,0)`;
      document.body.style.setProperty('--wall-zoom', (1 + Math.max(0, y) * 0.00028).toFixed(4));
      if (k < 1) springRaf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else {
        clockLayer.style.transform = top.style.transform = '';
        np.style.transform = bottom.style.transform = np.style.transition = '';
        document.body.style.setProperty('--wall-zoom', '1');
      }
    };
    springRaf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };
  screen.addEventListener('pointerup', settle);
  screen.addEventListener('pointercancel', settle);
})();

/* ============================================================================
   8. CUSTOMIZE — bottom bar + interactive swipe-down dismissal
   ========================================================================= */
const Editor = (() => {
  const sheet = $('edit');
  let bound = false;

  const FONTS = [
    ['Bebas Neue', 'ببس', 'Bebas'],
    ['Oswald', 'اوس', 'Oswald'],
    ['Inter', 'إنتر', 'Inter'],
    ['SF', 'آيفون', 'SF']
  ];
  const COLORS = ['auto', '#000000', '#ffffff', '#e5e5ea', '#8e8e93', '#1c1c1e', '#ffd60a', '#7ad0ff', '#a78bfa', '#ff7eb6', '#ff9f6b', '#34d399', '#ff453a'];

  function hslToHex(h, s, l) {
    s /= 100; l /= 100;
    const k = (n) => (n + h / 30) % 12;
    const a = s * Math.min(l, 1 - l);
    const f = (n) => Math.round(255 * (l - a * Math.max(-1, Math.min(k(n) - 3, Math.min(9 - k(n), 1)))));
    return '#' + [f(0), f(8), f(4)].map((x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  }
  function hexToHsl(hex) {
    const [r0, g0, b0] = hexToRgb(hex);
    const r = r0 / 255, g = g0 / 255, b = b0 / 255;
    const mx = Math.max(r, g, b), mn = Math.min(r, g, b);
    let h = 0, s = 0;
    const l = (mx + mn) / 2;
    if (mx !== mn) {
      const d = mx - mn;
      s = l > 0.5 ? d / (2 - mx - mn) : d / (mx + mn);
      if (mx === r) h = ((g - b) / d + (g < b ? 6 : 0)) * 60;
      else if (mx === g) h = ((b - r) / d + 2) * 60;
      else h = ((r - g) / d + 4) * 60;
    }
    return [Math.round(h), Math.round(s * 100), Math.round(l * 100)];
  }

  function fontChips() {
    const row = $('fonts');
    row.innerHTML = FONTS.map(([key, _glyph, label]) => `
      <button class="f-chip ${state.font === key ? 'sel' : ''}" data-font="${key}" aria-label="خط ${label}">
        <b style="${key === 'SF' ? 'font-family:-apple-system,Inter,sans-serif;font-weight:600' : `font-family:'${key}',serif`}">12</b>
        <span>${label}</span>
      </button>`).join('');
    row.querySelectorAll('[data-font]').forEach(b => {
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        state.font = b.dataset.font;
        save(); fontChips(); Clock.schedule(true, 90); vib(6, 'tick');
      });
    });
  }

  function syncProPalette() {
    const hueEl = $('clock-hue'), toneEl = $('clock-tone'), opEl = $('clock-opacity');
    const hexEl = $('clock-hex'), natEl = $('clock-color-native'), palEl = $('clock-pro-palette');
    const op = Math.round(clamp01((state.clockOpacity ?? 22) / 100) * 100);
    if (opEl) opEl.value = String(op);
    if ($('clock-opacity-v')) $('clock-opacity-v').textContent = op + '%';

    if (state.color === 'auto') {
      if (hexEl) hexEl.textContent = 'تلقائي';
      if (natEl) natEl.value = '#ffffff';
      if (palEl) palEl.style.setProperty('--pro-hue', '#7ad0ff');
      return;
    }
    const [h, _s, l] = hexToHsl(state.color);
    if (hueEl && $('clock-hue-v')) {
      const hh = Number(hueEl.dataset.editing ? hueEl.value : h);
      hueEl.value = String(hh);
      $('clock-hue-v').textContent = hh + '°';
      if (palEl) palEl.style.setProperty('--pro-hue', `hsl(${hh},100%,50%)`);
    }
    if (toneEl && $('clock-tone-v')) {
      toneEl.value = String(l);
      $('clock-tone-v').textContent = l + '%';
    }
    if (hexEl) hexEl.textContent = state.color.toUpperCase();
    if (natEl) natEl.value = /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(state.color) ? state.color : '#ffffff';
  }

  function colorChips() {
    const row = $('colors');
    row.innerHTML = COLORS.map(c => c === 'auto'
      ? `<button class="c-dot ${state.color === 'auto' ? 'sel' : ''}" data-color="auto" style="background:conic-gradient(#fff 0 25%,#8e8e93 0 50%,#1c1c1e 0 75%,#ffd60a 0)" title="تلقائي" aria-label="لون تلقائي"></button>`
      : `<button class="c-dot ${state.color.toLowerCase() === c ? 'sel' : ''}" data-color="${c}" style="background:${c}" aria-label="لون ${c}"></button>`).join('');
    row.querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(b => {
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        state.color = b.dataset.color;
        if ($('clock-hue')) delete $('clock-hue').dataset.editing;
        save(); colorChips(); syncProPalette(); applyUiColor(); Adaptive.sample(); vib(6, 'tick');
      });
    });
    syncProPalette();
  }

  function wallChips() {
    const row = $('walls');
    const chips = Wallpapers.PRESETS.map(p => `
      <button class="w-chip ${state.wall === p ? 'sel' : ''}" data-wall="${p}" aria-label="خلفية ${p}" style="background-image:url('${Wallpapers.thumb(p)}')"></button>`).join('');
    const galleryIc = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="3"/><circle cx="8.5" cy="9.5" r="1.5"/><path d="M21 15l-4.5-4.5L7 20"/></svg>';
    const sparkIc = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3l1.9 5.2L19 10l-5.1 1.8L12 17l-1.9-5.2L5 10l5.1-1.8z"/><path d="M19 3v3M20.5 4.5h-3M5 17v3M6.5 18.5h-3"/></svg>';
    const person = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="3.2"/><path d="M5.5 20c0-3.6 2.9-6 6.5-6s6.5 2.4 6.5 6"/></svg>';
    row.innerHTML = chips + `
      <button class="w-chip gallery ${state.wall === 'custom' ? 'sel' : ''}" data-upload="1" title="اختيار صورة من المعرض" aria-label="اختيار صورة من معرض الجهاز">${galleryIc}<span>صور جهازي</span></button>
      <button class="w-chip ai ${AIDepth.isBusy() ? 'busy' : ''}" data-ai-depth="1" title="عزل الشخصية تلقائياً بالذكاء الاصطناعي المجاني" aria-label="عزل الشخصية بالذكاء الاصطناعي">${sparkIc}<span>عزل بالذكاء AI</span></button>
      <button class="w-chip upload" data-subject="1" title="رفع صورة شفافة يدوياً (PNG)" aria-label="صورة أمام الساعة">${person}</button>`;
    row.querySelectorAll('[data-wall]').forEach(b => {
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        state.wall = b.dataset.wall;
        save(); Wallpapers.apply(); wallChips();
        setTimeout(() => Adaptive.sample(), 60);
        setTimeout(() => Clock.schedule(true), 240);
        if (state.depth && state.subjectWallKey !== AIDepth.currentWallKey()) {
          setTimeout(() => AIDepth.extractForCurrentWall(), 180);
        }
        vib(6, 'tick');
      });
    });
    row.querySelector('[data-upload]').addEventListener('click', () => $('f-wall').click());
    row.querySelector('[data-ai-depth]').addEventListener('click', () => AIDepth.extractForCurrentWall());
    row.querySelector('[data-subject]').addEventListener('click', () => $('f-subject').click());
  }

  function fmtChips() {
    const row = $('clock-fmt');
    if (!row) return;
    row.querySelectorAll('[data-fmt]').forEach((b) => {
      const want24 = b.dataset.fmt === '24';
      const active = want24 === !!state.hour24;
      b.classList.toggle('on', active);
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', active ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }

  function toggles() {
    const row = $('toggles');
    const items = [
      ['weatherOn', 'الطقس', state.weatherOn],
      ['npOn', 'الموسيقى', state.npOn],
      ['depth', 'تأثير العمق', state.depth],
      ['dndOn', 'عدم الإزعاج', state.dndOn]
    ];
    row.innerHTML = items.map(([k, label, on]) => `
      <button class="t-btn ${on ? 'on' : ''}" data-tg="${k}" aria-pressed="${on ? 'true' : 'false'}">${label}</button>`).join('') +
      `<button class="t-btn" id="pick-audio" type="button">ملف صوتي…</button>
       <button class="t-btn" id="pick-art" type="button">غلاف…</button>`;
    row.querySelectorAll('[data-tg]').forEach(b => {
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const k = b.dataset.tg;
        state[k] = !state[k];
        save(); toggles(); applyToggles(); vib(8, 'pop');
        if (k === 'npOn') setTimeout(() => Clock.guard(), 40);
        if (k === 'dndOn') Island.pulse(state.dndOn ? 'عدم الإزعاج مفعّل' : 'إيقاف عدم الإزعاج', state.dndOn ? '#a78bfa' : '#8e8e93', 1800);
        if (k === 'depth') {
          if (state.depth && (!state.subject || state.subjectWallKey !== AIDepth.currentWallKey())) {
            AIDepth.extractForCurrentWall();
          } else {
            applyDepth();
          }
        }
      });
    });
    $('pick-audio').addEventListener('click', () => $('f-audio').click());
    $('pick-art').addEventListener('click', () => $('f-art').click());
  }

  const INNER_COLORS = ['#ffffff', '#e8ecf4', '#c9d4e6', '#9fb4d4', '#7ad0ff', '#a78bfa',
                        '#ff9ecb', '#ffd60a', '#ff9f6b', '#8ef0c4', '#b9b9bf', '#1c1c1e'];

  function renderInnerColors() {
    const row = $('in-colors');
    row.innerHTML = INNER_COLORS.map(c =>
      `<button class="c-dot ${(CONFIG.glass.inner.color || '#ffffff').toLowerCase() === c ? 'sel' : ''}"
               data-ic="${c}" style="background:${c}" aria-label="${c}"></button>`).join('');
    row.querySelectorAll('[data-ic]').forEach(b => {
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        CONFIG.glass.inner.color = b.dataset.ic;
        state.innerColor = b.dataset.ic;
        save(); renderInnerColors(); Clock.refreshInner(); vib(6, 'tick');
      });
    });
  }

  function syncInnerInputs() {
    const op = $('in-op'), th = $('in-th'), ang = $('in-ang');
    op.value = String(Math.round((state.innerIntensity ?? 0.42) * 100));
    th.value = String(state.innerThickness ?? 2.2);
    ang.value = String(CONFIG.glass.inner.angle);
    $('in-op-v').textContent = op.value;
    $('in-th-v').textContent = th.value;
    $('in-ang-v').textContent = ang.value;
  }

  function bindOnce() {
    if (bound) return;
    bound = true;
    $('edit-done').addEventListener('click', close);

    // Interactive iOS swipe-down-to-close on grabber/header
    let dragY0 = 0, dragDY = 0, draggingSheet = false, dragRaf = 0;
    const handle = sheet.querySelector('.edit-head');
    const grab = sheet.querySelector('.edit-grabber');
    const onStart = (e) => {
      if (e.target.closest('button')) return;
      draggingSheet = true; dragY0 = e.clientY; dragDY = 0;
      sheet.style.transition = 'none';
      try { sheet.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
    };
    [grab, handle].forEach(h => h && h.addEventListener('pointerdown', onStart));
    sheet.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (!draggingSheet) return;
      dragDY = Math.max(0, e.clientY - dragY0);
      if (!dragRaf) dragRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        dragRaf = 0;
        if (draggingSheet) sheet.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${dragDY}px,0)`;
      });
    });
    const onEnd = () => {
      if (!draggingSheet) return;
      draggingSheet = false;
      cancelAnimationFrame(dragRaf); dragRaf = 0;
      sheet.style.transition = '';
      sheet.style.transform = '';
      if (dragDY > 68) close();
    };
    sheet.addEventListener('pointerup', onEnd);
    sheet.addEventListener('pointercancel', onEnd);

    const op = $('in-op'), th = $('in-th'), ang = $('in-ang');
    let t1 = 0, t2 = 0, t3 = 0, opRaf = 0;
    op.addEventListener('input', () => {
      state.innerIntensity = Number(op.value) / 100;
      $('in-op-v').textContent = op.value;
      CONFIG.glass.inner.intensity = state.innerIntensity;
      if (!opRaf) opRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        opRaf = 0;
        const el = $('clock-inner');
        if (el) el.style.opacity = String(state.innerIntensity);
      });
      clearTimeout(t1);
      t1 = setTimeout(save, 220);
    });
    th.addEventListener('input', () => {
      state.innerThickness = Number(th.value);
      $('in-th-v').textContent = th.value;
      CONFIG.glass.inner.thickness = state.innerThickness;
      Clock.refreshInner(true);
      clearTimeout(t2);
      t2 = setTimeout(() => { Clock.refreshInner(false); save(); }, 180);
    });
    th.addEventListener('change', () => {
      clearTimeout(t2);
      Clock.refreshInner(false);
      save();
    });
    ang.addEventListener('input', () => {
      CONFIG.glass.inner.angle = Number(ang.value);
      state.innerAngle = CONFIG.glass.inner.angle;
      $('in-ang-v').textContent = ang.value;
      Clock.refreshInner(true);
      clearTimeout(t3);
      t3 = setTimeout(() => { Clock.refreshInner(false); save(); }, 180);
    });
    ang.addEventListener('change', () => {
      clearTimeout(t3);
      Clock.refreshInner(false);
      save();
    });

    const fmtRow = $('clock-fmt');
    if (fmtRow) {
      fmtRow.querySelectorAll('[data-fmt]').forEach((b) => {
        b.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const want24 = b.dataset.fmt === '24';
          if (!!state.hour24 === want24) return;
          state.hour24 = want24;
          save(); fmtChips(); Clock.schedule(true, 40); vib(8, 'pop');
        });
      });
    }

    const hueEl = $('clock-hue'), toneEl = $('clock-tone'), opEl = $('clock-opacity'), natEl = $('clock-color-native');
    let colTimer = 0, opTimer = 0;
    const applyProHex = () => {
      if (!hueEl || !toneEl) return;
      const h = Number(hueEl.value), l = Number(toneEl.value);
      state.color = hslToHex(h, 100, l);
      applyUiColor();
      Adaptive.sample();
      syncProPalette();
      document.querySelectorAll('#colors [data-color]').forEach((el) => {
        el.classList.toggle('sel', el.dataset.color.toLowerCase() === state.color.toLowerCase());
      });
      clearTimeout(colTimer);
      colTimer = setTimeout(() => save(), 180);
    };
    if (hueEl) {
      hueEl.addEventListener('input', () => { hueEl.dataset.editing = '1'; applyProHex(); });
      hueEl.addEventListener('change', () => { delete hueEl.dataset.editing; save(); });
    }
    if (toneEl) {
      toneEl.addEventListener('input', applyProHex);
      toneEl.addEventListener('change', () => save());
    }
    if (natEl) {
      natEl.addEventListener('input', () => {
        if (hueEl) delete hueEl.dataset.editing;
        state.color = natEl.value;
        applyUiColor();
        Adaptive.sample();
        colorChips();
        clearTimeout(colTimer);
        colTimer = setTimeout(() => save(), 180);
      });
    }
    if (opEl) {
      opEl.addEventListener('input', () => {
        state.clockOpacity = Number(opEl.value);
        if ($('clock-opacity-v')) $('clock-opacity-v').textContent = state.clockOpacity + '%';
        Adaptive.sample();
        clearTimeout(opTimer);
        opTimer = setTimeout(() => save(), 180);
      });
      opEl.addEventListener('change', () => save());
    }
    const perfDl = $('perf-download');
    if (perfDl) perfDl.addEventListener('click', () => { PerfMonitor.downloadReport(); vib(8, 'pop'); });
    const perfSh = $('perf-share');
    if (perfSh) perfSh.addEventListener('click', () => { PerfMonitor.shareReport(); vib(8, 'pop'); });
    const perfRst = $('perf-reset');
    if (perfRst) perfRst.addEventListener('click', () => { PerfMonitor.reset(); vib(6, 'tick'); });
  }

  function open() {
    sheet.classList.add('open');
    document.body.classList.add('editing');
    PerfMonitor.updateUI();
    vib(8, 'pop');
  }
  function close() {
    sheet.classList.remove('open');
    document.body.classList.remove('editing');
  }
  function toggle() { sheet.classList.contains('open') ? close() : open(); }

  function build() {
    bindOnce();
    fontChips(); colorChips(); wallChips(); fmtChips(); syncInnerInputs(); renderInnerColors(); toggles();
  }

  return { build, open, close, toggle, isOpen: () => sheet.classList.contains('open') };
})();

/* ============================================================================
   9. WIRING
   ========================================================================= */
function hexToRgb(hex) {
  const m = /^#?([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})$/i.exec(hex || '#ffffff');
  return m ? [parseInt(m[1], 16), parseInt(m[2], 16), parseInt(m[3], 16)] : [255, 255, 255];
}
function applyUiColor() {
  if (state.color === 'auto') { Adaptive.sample(); return; }
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--clock-top', state.color);
}

function applyToggles() {
  $('np').classList.toggle('gone', !state.npOn);
  $('dnd').classList.toggle('gone', !state.dndOn);
  const focusIcon = $('i-focus');
  if (focusIcon) focusIcon.style.display = state.dndOn ? '' : 'none';
  renderTopline();
  if (state.npOn) setTimeout(() => { Media.measureBar(); Media.measureTitle(); }, 260);
}

function applyDepth() {
  const el = $('subject');
  if (state.depth && state.subject) {
    el.src = state.subject;
    document.body.classList.add('has-subject');
    el.style.opacity = '1';
  } else {
    document.body.classList.remove('has-subject');
  }
}

let lastDateStr = '';
function renderTopline() {
  const d = new Date();
  const ds = d.toDateString();
  if (ds !== lastDateStr) {
    lastDateStr = ds;
    const opts = { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' };
    $('date').textContent = d.toLocaleDateString('ar', opts);
  }
  const wx = $('wx');
  const sep = document.querySelector('#topline .sep');
  if (state.weatherOn) {
    if (!wx.dataset.live) {
      wx.textContent = CONFIG.weather;
      fetch('https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=33.31&longitude=44.36&current=temperature_2m,weather_code&timezone=auto')
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(j => {
          const t = Math.round(j.current.temperature_2m);
          const c = j.current.weather_code;
          const ic = c === 0 ? '☀️' : c < 4 ? '🌤️' : c < 50 ? '☁️' : c < 70 ? '🌧️' : '⛈️';
          wx.textContent = `${ic} ${t}°`;
          wx.dataset.live = '1';
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }
    wx.style.display = '';
    if (sep) sep.style.display = '';
  } else {
    wx.style.display = 'none';
    if (sep) sep.style.display = 'none';
  }
}

function icons() {
  $('i-signal').innerHTML = `<svg width="18" height="12" viewBox="0 0 18 12" fill="currentColor"><rect x="0" y="8" width="3" height="4" rx="1"/><rect x="5" y="5.5" width="3" height="6.5" rx="1"/><rect x="10" y="3" width="3" height="9" rx="1"/><rect x="15" y="0" width="3" height="12" rx="1"/></svg>`;
  $('i-wifi').innerHTML = `<svg width="16" height="12" viewBox="0 0 16 12" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 11.4l2.1-2.6a3.4 3.4 0 00-4.2 0z"/><path d="M8 6.2c1.4 0 2.7.5 3.7 1.4l1.3-1.6A8 8 0 008 4a8 8 0 00-5 2l1.3 1.6A5.7 5.7 0 018 6.2z"/><path d="M8 1.8c2.3 0 4.5.8 6.2 2.3L15.5 2.4A11.6 11.6 0 008 0 11.6 11.6 0 00.5 2.4l1.3 1.7A9.7 9.7 0 018 1.8z"/></svg>`;
  $('i-focus').innerHTML = `<svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M20.5 14.6A8.6 8.6 0 019.4 3.5a8.6 8.6 0 1011.1 11.1z"/></svg>`;
}

function updateDeviceStatusUI(st) {
  if (!st) return;
  if (typeof st.batteryPct === 'number' && st.batteryPct >= 0) {
    const p = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(st.batteryPct)));
    $('bat-pct').textContent = p;
    const fill = $('bat-fill');
    fill.style.transform = `scaleX(${p / 100})`;
    fill.classList.toggle('low', p <= 20 && !st.charging);
    fill.classList.toggle('chg', !!st.charging);
  }
  if (st.network) {
    const wifi = $('i-wifi'), sig = $('i-signal'), car = $('carrier');
    if (st.network === 'offline') {
      wifi.classList.add('off'); sig.classList.add('off');
      if (car) car.textContent = 'غير متصل';
    } else if (st.network === 'wifi') {
      wifi.classList.remove('off'); sig.classList.remove('off');
      if (car) car.textContent = 'Wi-Fi';
    } else {
      wifi.classList.add('off'); sig.classList.remove('off');
      if (car) car.textContent = '5G';
    }
  }
}
window.onNativeDeviceStatus = updateDeviceStatusUI;

function battery() {
  try {
    const raw = window.AndroidHost?.getDeviceStatus?.();
    if (raw) { updateDeviceStatusUI(JSON.parse(raw)); return; }
  } catch (_) {}
  if (!('getBattery' in navigator)) return;
  navigator.getBattery().then(b => {
    const sync = () => updateDeviceStatusUI({ batteryPct: Math.round(b.level * 100), charging: !!b.charging });
    sync();
    b.addEventListener('levelchange', sync);
    b.addEventListener('chargingchange', sync);
  }).catch(() => {});
}

const GlassTargets = (() => {
  const targets = [];

  function attachAll() {
    targets.length = 0;
    const list = [$('np'), $('dnd'), $('sh-left'), $('sh-right')].filter(Boolean);
    const radiusOf = (el) => {
      const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
      return parseFloat(cs.borderTopLeftRadius) || CONFIG.radius;
    };
    let idx = 0;
    const step = () => {
      if (idx >= list.length) return;
      const el = list[idx++];
      Glass.attach(el, radiusOf(el));
      targets.push(el);
      if (idx < list.length) requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  function refresh() {
    for (const el of targets) {
      const h = el.querySelector('.lg-shadow-layer');
      if (h) el.classList.remove('glass-fallback');
    }
    Glass.rebuildAll();
  }

  return { attachAll, refresh };
})();

function shortcutsRender() {
  const inner = document.querySelector('#sh-left .sh-inner');
  inner.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 6c0 2-2 2-2 4v10a2 2 0 01-2 2h-4a2 2 0 01-2-2V10c0-2-2-2-2-4V2h12z"/><path d="M6 6h12"/><path d="M12 12v2"/></svg>`;
  const right = document.querySelector('#sh-right .sh-inner');
  right.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M9 3L7.2 5H4a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2h16a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2h-3.2L15 3H9zm3 15a5 5 0 110-10 5 5 0 010 10z"/></svg>`;
}

function compressImageFile(file, maxDim = 1440, opaque = true) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      const scale = Math.min(1, maxDim / Math.max(img.naturalWidth || 1, img.naturalHeight || 1));
      const w = Math.max(2, Math.round((img.naturalWidth || 1) * scale));
      const h = Math.max(2, Math.round((img.naturalHeight || 1) * scale));
      const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
      cv.width = w; cv.height = h;
      cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
      resolve(cv.toDataURL(opaque ? 'image/jpeg' : 'image/png', 0.86));
    };
    img.onerror = () => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); reject(new Error('image load failed')); };
    img.src = url;
  });
}

/* Uploads */
$('f-wall').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
  const f = e.target.files[0];
  if (!f) return;
  compressImageFile(f, 1440, true).then((dataUrl) => {
    state.wall = 'custom';
    state.customWall = dataUrl;
    state.subject = '';
    state.subjectWallKey = '';
    save(true);
    Wallpapers.apply();
    applyDepth();
    Editor.build();
    setTimeout(() => { Adaptive.sample(); Clock.schedule(true); }, 140);
    toast('تم تغيير الخلفية');
    if (state.depth) {
      setTimeout(() => AIDepth.extractForCurrentWall(), 220);
    }
  }).catch(() => toast('تعذّر قراءة الصورة'));
  e.target.value = '';
});
$('f-subject').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
  const f = e.target.files[0];
  if (!f) return;
  compressImageFile(f, 960, false).then((dataUrl) => {
    state.subject = dataUrl;
    state.subjectWallKey = AIDepth.currentWallKey();
    state.depth = true;
    save(true);
    applyDepth();
    Editor.build();
    toast('تأثير العمق مفعّل');
  }).catch(() => toast('تعذّر قراءة الصورة'));
  e.target.value = '';
});
$('f-audio').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
  const f = e.target.files[0];
  if (f) { Media.loadFile(f); toast('تم تحميل المقطع الصوتي'); }
  e.target.value = '';
});
$('f-art').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
  const f = e.target.files[0];
  if (f) { Media.loadArt(f); toast('تم تحديث غلاف الألبوم'); }
  e.target.value = '';
});

/* double-tap the wallpaper to open the editor (iOS-style) */
(() => {
  let last = 0;
  $('screen').addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => {
    if (e.target.closest('#np, #bottom, #edit, #cam, #flash, #clock-frame')) return;
    const now = performance.now();
    if (now - last < 320) { Editor.toggle(); vib(10, 'pop'); }
    last = now;
  });
})();

window.Clock = Clock;
window.Shortcuts = Shortcuts;
window.Editor = Editor;
window.Media = Media;
window.AIDepth = AIDepth;
window.PerfMonitor = PerfMonitor;
window.appPause = () => { save(true); PerfMonitor.flushOnExit(); };

/* Boot: load bundled fonts before caching initial glyph masks. */
async function boot() {
  const bootStart = performance.now();
  await Promise.all([
    document.fonts.load('400 128px "Bebas Neue"'),
    document.fonts.load('400 128px "Oswald"'),
    document.fonts.load('400 16px "Inter"')
  ]).catch(() => {});

  icons();
  shortcutsRender();
  Shortcuts.bindAll();
  GlassTargets.attachAll();

  let initialClockScheduled = false;
  $('wall').addEventListener('load', () => {
    Adaptive.sample();
    if (!initialClockScheduled) {
      initialClockScheduled = true;
      Clock.schedule(true);
    }
  });
  Wallpapers.apply();
  applyUiColor();
  applyDepth();
  Editor.build();
  applyToggles();
  Media.render();
  $('np').classList.add('in');
  battery();
  // Fallback if wall load already resolved synchronously before listener or failed
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    if (!initialClockScheduled) {
      initialClockScheduled = true;
      Adaptive.sample();
      Clock.schedule(true);
    }
  });

  if (!canGlass) {
    const n = $('notice');
    n.style.display = 'block';
    n.textContent = 'هذا الإصدار من WebView لا يدعم انكسار الزجاج؛ حدّث Android System WebView للحصول على التأثير الكامل.';
    setTimeout(() => { n.style.display = 'none'; }, 7000);
  }

  let minuteTimer = 0;
  function scheduleMinuteTick() {
    clearTimeout(minuteTimer);
    const now = new Date();
    const msToNextMin = (60 - now.getSeconds()) * 1000 - now.getMilliseconds() + 40;
    minuteTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (!document.hidden) {
        Clock.schedule(false);
        renderTopline();
      }
      scheduleMinuteTick();
    }, Math.max(500, msToNextMin));
  }
  scheduleMinuteTick();

  let viewportTimer = 0;
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    clearTimeout(viewportTimer);
    viewportTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      Clock.guard();
      Media.measureTitle(); Media.measureBar();
      GlassTargets.refresh();
    }, 200);
  });

  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (!document.hidden) {
      Clock.schedule(false);
      renderTopline();
      Media.render();
      scheduleMinuteTick();
    } else {
      save(true);
      PerfMonitor.flushOnExit();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { save(true); PerfMonitor.flushOnExit(); });
  PerfMonitor.record('boot', performance.now() - bootStart);
}

boot();
</script>

(() => {
  const reduced = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  const active = new Map();
  // Skip elements that already drive their own transform scale/pop animations.
  const OWN_MOTION = '.sh-btn, .np-btn, .c-dot, #cam-shutter';
  function release(id) {
    const el = active.get(id);
    if (!el) return;
    active.delete(id);
    el.getAnimations().filter(a => a.id === 'touch-spring').forEach(a => a.cancel());
    if (reduced.matches || !el.isConnected) { el.style.scale = ''; return; }
    const a = el.animate(
      [{scale:'.94'},{scale:'1.03',offset:.48},{scale:'.992',offset:.76},{scale:'1'}],
      {duration:420,easing:'cubic-bezier(.22,.85,.32,1)'}
    );
    a.id = 'touch-spring';
    el.style.scale = '';
  }
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
    const el = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!el || reduced.matches || el.matches(OWN_MOTION)) return;
    active.set(e.pointerId, el);
    el.getAnimations().filter(a => a.id === 'touch-spring').forEach(a => a.cancel());
    el.style.scale = '.94';
  }, {passive:true});
  for (const event of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])
    document.addEventListener(event, e => release(e.pointerId), {passive:true});
  document.addEventListener('pointerout', e => {
    if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && active.get(e.pointerId) === e.target) release(e.pointerId);
  }, {passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => [...active.keys()].forEach(release));
  window.appBack = () => {
    if (document.getElementById('cam').classList.contains('on')) { Shortcuts.closeCamera(); return true; }
    if (document.getElementById('flash').classList.contains('on')) { document.getElementById('flash-off').click(); return true; }
    if (document.getElementById('clock-frame').classList.contains('on')) { Clock.closeResize(); return true; }
    if (Editor.isOpen()) { Editor.close(); return true; }
    return false;
  };
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden && !window.AndroidHost?.isPermissionPending?.()) {
      Shortcuts.closeCamera();
    }
  });
})();

/* Android-only binary bridge. A browser or older WebView keeps the full-quality
   Worker implementation; no base64 alpha serialization across the bridge. */
(() => {
  let enabled = !!window.AndroidGlass;
  let pending = null;
  const stats = { backend: 'web-worker', nativeMs: 0, fallbacks: 0 };
  function showBackend() {
    const label = document.getElementById('glass-engine-status');
    if (label) label.textContent = 'محرك حساب الزجاج: ' + (stats.backend === 'android-cpp' ? 'Android C++' : 'Web Worker');
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', showBackend);
  window.NativeGlassMath = {
    get available() { return enabled; },
    stats,
    compute(jobId, meta, params) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        if (!enabled) { reject(new Error('native unavailable')); return; }
        if (pending) { clearTimeout(pending.timer); pending.reject(new Error('superseded')); pending = null; }
        const packet = new ArrayBuffer(80 + meta.alpha.length);
        const header = new DataView(packet);
        const surface = ['convexSquircle','convexCircle','concaveSquircle','lipSquircle'].indexOf(params.surface);
        [jobId,meta.w,meta.h,meta.ss,params.ior,params.thickness,params.bezel,
          params.shadowThickness,params.shadowAngle,Math.max(0,surface)]
          .forEach((value, i) => header.setFloat64(i*8,value,true));
        new Uint8Array(packet,80).set(meta.alpha);
        const fail = (error, permanent = true) => {
          if (!pending || pending.jobId !== jobId) return;
          clearTimeout(pending.timer); pending = null;
          if (permanent) enabled = false;
          stats.fallbacks++; stats.backend = 'web-worker'; showBackend(); reject(error);
        };
        pending = {jobId,resolve,reject,fail,timer:setTimeout(()=>fail(new Error('native timeout'), true),3000)};
        try { window.AndroidGlass.postMessage(packet); } catch(error) { fail(error, true); }
      });
    }
  };
  if (enabled) window.AndroidGlass.onmessage = event => {
    let data;
    try { data = JSON.parse(event.data); } catch (_) { return; }
    if (!pending || data.jobId !== pending.jobId) return;
    if (data.error || !Number.isFinite(data.maxAbsCss) ||
        !data.dispUrl?.startsWith('https://appassets.androidplatform.net/native-glass/') ||
        (data.shadUrl && !data.shadUrl.startsWith('https://appassets.androidplatform.net/native-glass/'))) {
      pending.fail(new Error(data.error || 'invalid native result'), data.fatal !== false);
      return;
    }
    const job = pending; pending = null; clearTimeout(job.timer);
    stats.backend = 'android-cpp'; stats.nativeMs = data.nativeMs; showBackend();
    job.resolve(data);
  };
})();
